prompt_en: A frosted amber glass dropper bottle of Lumira brand vitamin C serum stands centered on a wet, polished travertine slab. A single fresh orange slice and two glossy water droplets sit beside it. Soft diffused daylight streams from the upper left, casting a long gentle shadow to the right. Warm honey-gold and cream palette, matte white seamless background fading to soft beige. Shot slightly above eye level with a 90mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, crisp label focus, dewy luxurious skincare mood.
prompt_zh: 一支 Lumira 品牌的磨砂琥珀色玻璃滴管精华瓶，居中立在湿润抛光的洞石台面上。旁边放着一片新鲜橙子和两颗晶莹水珠。柔和的散射日光从左上方斜射进来，在右侧投下一道细长柔和的影子。整体为暖蜜金与奶油色调，哑光白无缝背景渐变到柔和米色。相机略高于视平线，90mm 微距镜头，浅景深，标签锐利清晰，呈现水润高级的护肤氛围。

prompt_en: A pearlescent lavender ceramic jar of Dewhaus retinol night cream sits open on a raw silk cloth, a swirl of ivory cream visible inside and a smooth dollop resting on the frosted-glass lid. Dried lavender sprigs lie diagonally in the foreground. Cool twilight lighting with a soft violet gradient background, low-key and calm. Overhead three-quarter angle, 100mm lens, gentle rim highlight on the jar rim, luxurious nighttime spa mood, minimal negative space on the right.
prompt_zh: 一只珠光淡紫陶瓷罐装的 Dewhaus 视黄醇晚霜敞口放在生丝布上，罐内可见象牙白面霜的漩涡纹理，磨砂玻璃盖上挑着一团顺滑的膏体。前景斜放几枝干薰衣草。冷调暮光配柔和紫罗兰渐变背景，暗调而静谧。俯拍四分之三角度，100mm 镜头，罐口有柔和的轮廓高光，营造奢华的夜间水疗氛围，右侧留出简洁留白。

prompt_en: A translucent aqua-blue tube of Hydra Nova hyaluronic gel moisturizer floats mid-frame surrounded by a frozen crown of clear water splash suspended in air. Tiny air bubbles glisten within the droplets. Bright high-key studio lighting, glacial cyan and white palette, seamless icy-blue backdrop. Straight-on eye-level shot with a 105mm macro lens, tack-sharp splash detail frozen at 1/8000s, refreshing hydration mood, product perfectly upright and centered.
prompt_zh: 一支半透明水蓝色的 Hydra Nova 玻尿酸凝胶保湿霜悬浮在画面中央，四周环绕着凝固在空中的清澈水花皇冠。水珠里点缀着晶亮的细小气泡。明亮的高调棚拍布光，冰川青与白色调，无缝的冰蓝背景。视平线正面拍摄，105mm 微距镜头，1/8000 秒定格出水花的锐利细节，清爽补水的氛围，产品完全直立且居中。

prompt_en: A slim olive-green glass bottle of Botanica Verde botanical facial oil rests on a mossy stone ledge, golden oil catching the light through the glass. Fresh eucalyptus leaves and a sprig of rosemary frame the lower right. Dappled forest sunlight filters through unseen leaves, casting organic shadows. Earthy green and gold palette, blurred deep-forest bokeh background. Low 15-degree camera angle, 85mm lens, shallow focus, natural botanical apothecary mood.
prompt_zh: 一支细长的橄榄绿玻璃瓶装 Botanica Verde 植物面部精华油放在长着青苔的石台上，瓶中金色油液透光生辉。新鲜的尤加利叶和一枝迷迭香点缀在右下角。斑驳的林间阳光透过看不见的树叶洒下，投出自然的叶影。大地绿与金色调，虚化的深林散景背景。相机低约 15 度仰拍，85mm 镜头，浅焦，营造天然植物药铺的氛围。

prompt_en: A squat frosted-white tub of Ceraluna ceramide barrier balm sits on a folded oatmeal linen napkin, its brushed-gold lid leaning against the base. A soft smear of the rich balm arcs across a clean acrylic swatch card nearby. Warm soft-box lighting from the right, creamy beige and pale sand palette, seamless taupe background. Overhead flat-lay tilted to 45 degrees, 60mm lens, cozy comforting skincare mood, generous breathing room around the product.
prompt_zh: 一只矮胖的磨砂白罐装 Ceraluna 神经酰胺修护屏障膏放在折叠的燕麦色亚麻餐巾上，拉丝金盖斜靠在罐身旁。旁边一张干净的亚克力试色卡上抹着一道厚润的膏体弧线。暖调柔光箱从右侧打光，奶油米与浅沙色调，无缝的灰褐背景。俯拍平铺但倾斜到 45 度，60mm 镜头，温暖抚慰的护肤氛围，产品四周留有充裕的呼吸空间。

prompt_en: A tall clear glass bottle of Glasslake AHA exfoliating toner with a minimalist black cap stands on a mirrored acrylic surface, its reflection perfectly doubling below. Thin ribbons of pink toner swirl visibly inside. Sharp directional light from the upper right creates a bright vertical highlight down the bottle. Blush-pink and charcoal palette, gradient dark-to-light grey backdrop. Eye-level straight-on shot, 100mm lens, sleek modern clinical skincare mood.
prompt_zh: 一支高挑的透明玻璃瓶装 Glasslake 果酸焕肤爽肤水，配极简黑色瓶盖，立在镜面亚克力台面上，下方倒影完美对称。瓶内可见粉色水液盘旋的细丝纹理。锐利的定向光从右上方打下，在瓶身正中形成一道明亮的垂直高光。腮红粉与炭灰色调，由深到浅的灰色渐变背景。视平线正面拍摄，100mm 镜头，呈现利落现代的医美护肤氛围。

prompt_en: A tiny rose-gold aluminum tube of Marisel peptide eye cream lies at a slight diagonal on a smooth pink marble tile, a pearl-sized bead of pale cream squeezed onto the surface catching a soft glint. A single fresh cucumber slice rests behind it. Delicate soft morning light, blush and champagne palette, softly blurred pink background. Extreme close-up macro at eye level, 105mm lens, dewy premium anti-aging mood, product occupying lower third.
prompt_zh: 一支小巧的玫瑰金铝管 Marisel 胜肽眼霜略微斜放在光滑的粉色大理石砖上，管口挤出一颗珍珠大小的浅色膏珠，在台面上泛着柔光。后方放着一片新鲜黄瓜。细腻柔和的晨光，腮红与香槟色调，粉色背景轻柔虚化。视平线极近微距特写，105mm 镜头，营造水润高端的抗衰氛围，产品位于画面下三分之一。

prompt_en: A matte terracotta-clay jar of Sable & Ren purifying clay mask sits on a rough concrete pedestal, its wooden lid off and resting flat, revealing a swirl of grey-green clay. A bamboo mask brush lies across the front. Dramatic side lighting from the left carves deep textured shadows. Muted sage, clay-brown and stone-grey palette, raw concrete backdrop. Slightly high three-quarter angle, 85mm lens, earthy artisanal spa mood.
prompt_zh: 一只哑光赤陶泥色罐装 Sable & Ren 净化泥膜放在粗糙的水泥基座上，木盖揭开平放一旁，露出灰绿色泥膏的漩涡纹理。一把竹柄面膜刷横搭在罐前。戏剧性的侧光从左侧打来，勾勒出深邃而有质感的阴影。柔和的鼠尾草绿、陶土棕与石灰色调，原始水泥背景。略高的四分之三角度，85mm 镜头，营造质朴手作的水疗氛围。

prompt_en: A pump bottle of Aurelia snail-mucin essence in translucent milky-white glass stands on a slick of clear glossy gel that pools around its base like liquid glass. Soft catchlights ripple across the gel. Clean high-key lighting, pearly white and soft grey palette, seamless white cyclorama background. Straight eye-level hero shot, 100mm lens, immaculate glossy hydrating mood, faint reflection under the product, centered composition with airy top space.
prompt_zh: 一支半透明乳白玻璃按压瓶装 Aurelia 蜗牛黏液精华立在一摊清透光亮的凝胶上，凝胶如液态玻璃般在瓶底四周汪成一片。柔和的反光在凝胶表面荡起波纹。干净的高调布光，珍珠白与浅灰色调，无缝白色天幕背景。视平线正面主图，100mm 镜头，营造无瑕光泽的补水氛围，产品下方有淡淡倒影，居中构图，顶部留有通透空间。

prompt_en: A slim coral-orange squeeze tube of Velvet Bloom mineral SPF 50 fluid stands upright on warm golden sand, a scatter of tiny seashells and a curl of dried palm frond beside it. Bright midday sun from directly above throws a crisp compact shadow. Sunny apricot, cream and turquoise accents, soft blurred beach-sky gradient background. Low 20-degree angle, 70mm lens, cheerful summer sun-care mood, product centered with warm glow.
prompt_zh: 一支纤细的珊瑚橙挤压软管装 Velvet Bloom 物理防晒 SPF50 乳液直立在温暖的金色沙滩上，旁边散落着几枚小贝壳和一卷干枯的棕榈叶。正午阳光从正上方直射，投下一道利落紧凑的影子。明媚的杏橙、奶油与青绿点缀，柔和虚化的海滩天空渐变背景。低约 20 度仰拍，70mm 镜头，欢快的夏日防晒氛围，产品居中且带暖光晕。

prompt_en: A sleek black-and-gold tube of Noir Muse matte liquid lipstick in shade 'Cherry Ink' lies at a dynamic diagonal on black glass, a bold swipe of deep-red pigment streaked beside it. A single glossy cherry with a stem rests in the corner. Precise spotlight from above-left, high-contrast crimson, black and gold palette, dark reflective backdrop. Overhead 30-degree angle, 90mm macro lens, luxe editorial beauty mood, sharp texture on the swatch.
prompt_zh: 一支利落的黑金管身 Noir Muse 哑光唇釉，色号「樱桃墨」，以富有张力的斜角躺在黑色玻璃上，旁边刷出一道浓郁的深红色试色。角落里放着一颗带梗的光亮樱桃。精准的聚光从左上方打下，高对比的绯红、黑与金色调，深色反光背景。俯拍 30 度角，90mm 微距镜头，营造奢华的时尚美妆氛围，试色纹理清晰锐利。

prompt_en: An open rose-gold Lush Palette eyeshadow compact displays twelve pans in warm terracotta, bronze, mauve and shimmering copper, a small dual-ended brush laid across it. Loose shimmer dusts softly onto the surface below. Warm soft-box lighting, autumnal peach and copper palette, seamless blush-nude background. Overhead flat-lay at 90 degrees, 50mm lens, inviting cozy glam mood, subtle sparkle catchlights on the shimmer shades, balanced symmetrical framing.
prompt_zh: 一盘敞开的玫瑰金 Lush Palette 眼影盘，展示着十二格暖陶土、古铜、藕紫与闪亮铜色的眼影，一支双头小刷横搭在上面。散粉般的珠光轻轻落在下方台面。暖调柔光箱布光，秋意的蜜桃与铜色调，无缝的裸粉背景。俯拍 90 度平铺，50mm 镜头，营造诱人温暖的精致妆感氛围，珠光色块上有细微的闪光点，构图均衡对称。

prompt_en: Three clear wand-applicator tubes of Chroma Kiss plumping lip gloss stand in a staggered row on a glossy acrylic riser, shades peach, rose and clear-pink glinting with tiny gold flecks. Bright glossy droplets scatter across the surface. Fresh high-key lighting, candy-pink and gold palette, gradient pastel-pink background. Slight low three-quarter angle, 85mm lens, playful juicy beauty mood, sharp focus on the middle tube, soft bokeh on the outer two.
prompt_zh: 三支透明棒状涂抹头的 Chroma Kiss 丰唇唇蜜错落排成一行，立在光亮的亚克力展台上，蜜桃、玫瑰与透明粉三个色号闪着细小金片。晶亮的水珠散落在台面。清新的高调布光，糖果粉与金色调，粉彩渐变背景。略低的四分之三角度，85mm 镜头，营造俏皮多汁的美妆氛围，中间那支对焦清晰，两侧柔和虚化。

prompt_en: A round mirrored-lid compact of Studio Fawn cushion foundation lies open on a marble vanity, the plush cushion pressed with a soft dab of beige foundation and a matching puff resting on the lid's mirror. A single blush-pink peony petal curls beside it. Soft flattering daylight, warm nude and cream palette, blurred pale-marble background. Overhead 45-degree tilt, 60mm lens, elegant everyday glam mood, gentle reflection in the compact mirror.
prompt_zh: 一只圆形镜面盖的 Studio Fawn 气垫粉底敞开躺在大理石梳妆台上，柔软的气垫上按着一抹米色粉底，配套的粉扑搁在盖子的镜面上。旁边卷着一片腮红粉的牡丹花瓣。柔和讨喜的日光，暖裸色与奶油色调，浅色大理石背景虚化。俯拍 45 度倾斜，60mm 镜头，营造优雅的日常精致妆容氛围，气垫镜面里有柔和的映影。

prompt_en: A twist-up Opal Glow cream highlighter stick in a pearly white barrel stands diagonally propped against a smooth river pebble, its champagne-shimmer bullet extended and catching prismatic light. A soft iridescent swatch glows on frosted glass beside it. Dreamy soft lighting with subtle rainbow flares, opalescent white, silver and pale-gold palette, misty grey-white background. Close macro at eye level, 100mm lens, ethereal luminous beauty mood.
prompt_zh: 一支旋转式 Opal Glow 膏状高光棒，珠光白管身，斜倚在一块光滑的河石上，香槟珠光的膏体旋出，折射出七彩光泽。旁边磨砂玻璃上抹着一道柔和的虹彩试色，微微发光。梦幻的柔光配淡淡的彩虹光晕，蛋白石白、银与浅金色调，雾灰白背景。视平线近微距，100mm 镜头，营造空灵通透的光泽美妆氛围。

prompt_en: A slim matte-black Kohl & Co precision liquid eyeliner pen rests on a wet black slate, a single crisp black wing-flick painted beside it as if drawn straight onto the stone. A tiny puddle mirrors the pen's fine tip. Sharp high-contrast lighting, pure black and silver palette, glossy dark backdrop with a subtle spotlight pool. Extreme close-up at a low 10-degree angle, 105mm macro lens, bold precise editorial mood, deep negative space above.
prompt_zh: 一支纤细哑光黑的 Kohl & Co 精细液体眼线笔搁在湿润的黑板岩上，旁边刷出一道利落的黑色上扬眼线，仿佛直接画在石头上。一小滩积水映出笔尖的精细。锐利的高对比布光，纯黑与银色调，光亮的深色背景配一小片聚光光池。极近特写，低约 10 度角，105mm 微距镜头，营造大胆精准的时尚氛围，上方留有大片负空间。

prompt_en: A round embossed-tin compact of Petal Rouge silk powder blush in shade 'Rosewood' lies open on a bed of scattered dried rose petals, its pressed powder showing a soft floral debossed pattern, a fluffy kabuki brush resting across it. Warm romantic backlight glows through the petals. Dusty-rose, mauve and soft-cream palette, dreamy blurred petal background. Overhead 40-degree angle, 70mm lens, romantic feminine beauty mood.
prompt_zh: 一只圆形压花锡盒的 Petal Rouge 丝绒粉质腮红，色号「玫瑰木」，敞开躺在散落的干玫瑰花瓣上，压制的粉饼上有柔和的花卉压纹，一支蓬松的散粉刷横搭其上。温暖浪漫的逆光透过花瓣泛起光晕。灰玫瑰、藕紫与柔奶油色调，梦幻虚化的花瓣背景。俯拍 40 度角，70mm 镜头，营造浪漫柔美的美妆氛围。

prompt_en: A sculptural matte-burgundy tube of Velluto volumizing mascara stands upright on a black acrylic cube, its wand pulled out and leaning against the tube showing a dense curved brush. A few dramatic false-lash fans fan out on the surface. Focused spotlight from above creates a glossy highlight on the cap. Deep burgundy, black and gold palette, dark gradient backdrop. Eye-level straight shot, 90mm lens, bold dramatic luxury mood, sharp brush-bristle detail.
prompt_zh: 一支造型感十足的哑光酒红管身 Velluto 浓密睫毛膏直立在黑色亚克力方块上，刷头抽出斜靠在管身旁，露出浓密的弧形刷毛。台面上呈扇形散开几片戏剧性的假睫毛。聚光从上方打下，在瓶盖上形成光亮的高光。深酒红、黑与金色调，深色渐变背景。视平线正面拍摄，90mm 镜头，营造大胆戏剧的奢华氛围，刷毛细节清晰。

prompt_en: A frosted glass spray bottle of Rougevert dewy setting spray stands centered while a fine mist plume sprays upward and drifts to the right, tiny water beads suspended in the air catching light. A sprig of fresh green mint lies at the base. Fresh cool lighting, mint-green, clear-glass and white palette, soft gradient seamless background. Straight eye-level shot, 100mm lens, crisp refreshing beauty mood, frozen mist detail, airy negative space around.
prompt_zh: 一支磨砂玻璃喷雾瓶装 Rougevert 水润定妆喷雾居中而立，一缕细密的雾气向上喷出并往右飘散，悬在空中的细小水珠反着光。瓶底躺着一枝新鲜的绿薄荷。清新冷调布光，薄荷绿、透明玻璃与白色调，柔和渐变的无缝背景。视平线正面拍摄，100mm 镜头，营造清爽提神的美妆氛围，雾气细节定格清晰，四周留有通透的负空间。

prompt_en: Two slim clear tubes of Mireille tinted brow gel stand paired on a warm honey-oak surface, one taupe and one soft-brown, their spoolie wands angled outward like a mirrored pair. A scatter of fine hair-like brush strokes marks the wood beside them. Warm natural window light from the left, honey-brown and cream palette, softly blurred wood-grain background. Slight three-quarter angle, 85mm lens, natural everyday beauty mood.
prompt_zh: 两支纤细透明管身的 Mireille 染色眉胶成对立在温暖的蜜色橡木台面上，一支灰棕、一支柔棕，螺旋刷头向外张开如镜像一对。旁边木面上刷着几道细如发丝的笔触。左侧温暖的自然窗光，蜜棕与奶油色调，木纹背景柔和虚化。略带四分之三角度，85mm 镜头，营造自然的日常美妆氛围。

prompt_en: A faceted rectangular clear-glass flacon of Maison Cendre 'Ambre Fumé' eau de parfum stands on a slab of grey veined marble, amber liquid glowing within and a heavy silver cap beside it. A single dried tobacco leaf and a curl of cinnamon bark rest in the foreground. Warm dramatic side light from the right casts a long elegant shadow. Amber, smoke-grey and silver palette, dark moody gradient background. Low 15-degree hero angle, 100mm lens, opulent perfume mood.
prompt_zh: 一只多切面矩形透明玻璃瓶装 Maison Cendre「烟熏琥珀」淡香精立在灰纹大理石板上，琥珀色香液在瓶中生辉，厚重的银盖搁在一旁。前景放着一片干烟草叶和一卷肉桂皮。右侧温暖戏剧的侧光投下一道优雅的长影。琥珀、烟灰与银色调，深沉暗调的渐变背景。低约 15 度的主图仰角，100mm 镜头，营造华贵的香水氛围。

name_zh: Fleur de Nuit 花香香水
prompt_en: A blush-pink frosted-glass perfume bottle of Fleur de Nuit with a gold blossom-shaped cap sits among fresh peonies and jasmine on a white silk-draped surface. Soft petals scatter loosely around the base. Delicate romantic backlight glows through the translucent bottle. Blush-pink, ivory and gold palette, dreamy soft-focus floral background. Eye-level straight shot slightly above, 105mm lens, luxurious romantic feminine mood, gentle bloom of light around the cap.
prompt_zh: 一只腮红粉磨砂玻璃香水瓶装 Fleur de Nuit，配金色花朵造型瓶盖，坐落在铺着白丝绸的台面上，四周是新鲜的牡丹与茉莉。柔软的花瓣松松散散地落在瓶底四周。细腻浪漫的逆光透过半透明瓶身泛起光晕。腮红粉、象牙白与金色调，梦幻柔焦的花卉背景。视平线略高正面拍摄，105mm 镜头，营造奢华浪漫的柔美氛围，瓶盖周围晕开柔和光斑。

prompt_en: A heavy smoked-glass bottle of Oud Atelier niche fragrance with a brushed-brass label plate stands on dark polished ebony wood, wisps of real incense smoke curling upward behind it. A cluster of oud wood chips and a dried rose sit beside the base. Dramatic low-key chiaroscuro lighting, deep espresso-brown, brass and charcoal palette, near-black background. Straight eye-level shot, 90mm lens, mysterious opulent niche-perfume mood, single warm rim highlight.
prompt_zh: 一只厚重烟熏玻璃瓶装 Oud Atelier 沙龙香水，配拉丝黄铜标牌，立在深色抛光乌木上，身后有真实的熏香烟丝袅袅上升。瓶底旁堆着一簇沉香木片和一朵干玫瑰。戏剧性的暗调明暗对照布光，深浓咖啡棕、黄铜与炭灰色调，近黑背景。视平线正面拍摄，90mm 镜头，营造神秘华贵的沙龙香氛围，一道暖色轮廓高光。

prompt_en: A tall cylindrical clear-glass bottle of Bergamia bright citrus cologne stands on a sunlit white stone counter, fresh bergamot and lemon slices scattered around it with glistening juice droplets. Bright airy morning sunlight streams from the left, casting crisp leaf shadows. Zesty yellow, green and clear-glass palette, clean white gradient background. Slight three-quarter angle, 85mm lens, fresh energetic summer cologne mood, vibrant and clean.

Positioned against a warm oatmeal linen backdrop with soft directional light from the left highlighting the liquid satin sheen and drape. Palette of emerald, oatmeal and gold. Eye-level frontal-to-three-quarter angle. Elegant contemporary womenswear catalog mood, refined and fluid with visible fabric luster.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Verdant Thread 的翠绿色缎面系带衬衫，飘逸垂坠，展示在哑光裸色人台上半身，前襟系带在腰间打结，泡泡袖在袖口轻轻收拢。人台立于暖燕麦色亚麻背景前，柔和的方向光从左侧照来，凸显缎面如水的光泽与垂感。配色为翠绿、燕麦与金。平视正面转四分之三机位。优雅的当代女装画册氛围，精致而流动，面料光泽清晰可见。

prompt_en: Top-down flat-lay of a fine-gauge cashmere cardigan in soft dove grey from the invented brand Ceruli, buttoned partway and folded to display the plush brushed knit and mother-of-pearl buttons. Arranged on a pale marble surface with a folded silk scarf, delicate gold hoop earrings and a stem of white ranunculus. Bright soft daylight from above gives a clean luxurious glow. Palette of dove grey, blush and warm gold. Overhead 90-degree angle, quiet-luxury minimalist product mood.
prompt_zh: 俯拍平铺一件虚构品牌 Ceruli 的细针羊绒开衫，柔鸽灰色，扣上部分纽扣并折叠，展示柔软磨绒的针织质感与贝母纽扣。铺在浅色大理石台面上，旁边有折好的真丝方巾、精致的金色圆环耳环和一枝白色芹叶牡丹。明亮柔和的日光从上方洒下，带来干净奢华的光泽。配色为鸽灰、腮红粉与暖金。正俯视 90 度机位，静奢极简的产品氛围。

prompt_en: A crisp minimalist low-top leather sneaker in optic white from the invented brand Stride Nine, shown as a hero product shot floating slightly above a soft gradient pale-blue studio backdrop with a subtle contact shadow. Perforated toe box, tonal laces and a chunky cream gum sole in sharp focus. Clean bright studio lighting with a gentle rim highlight along the silhouette. Palette of optic white, sky blue and cream. Slight low three-quarter angle. Fresh modern footwear e-commerce mood, ultra-clean and premium.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Stride Nine 的极简低帮皮革运动鞋，纯净亮白色，作为主图产品，微微悬浮在浅蓝色柔和渐变影棚背景之上，带一道淡淡的接触阴影。冲孔鞋头、同色鞋带和厚实的奶油色橡胶大底清晰锐利。干净明亮的影棚灯光沿轮廓打出柔和的边缘高光。配色为亮白、天蓝与奶油。略低的四分之三机位。清新现代的鞋类电商氛围，极致干净且高级。

prompt_en: A rugged trail running shoe in slate grey and volt-lime from the invented brand Terra Vela, captured mid-air kicking up a small burst of dry desert dust against a warm ochre canyon-toned backdrop. Aggressive lugged rubber outsole, breathable ripstop mesh upper and a reinforced toe cap sharply detailed. Hard warm side light from the low right creates dramatic energetic shadows. Palette of slate, volt-lime and ochre. Dynamic low three-quarter action angle. High-energy performance footwear ad mood with visible motion.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Terra Vela 的硬派越野跑鞋，石板灰配荧光青柠色，捕捉腾空瞬间，扬起一小簇干燥的沙漠尘土，背景为暖赭石色峡谷色调。凶悍的深齿橡胶大底、透气的格子布网面鞋身和加固鞋头细节锐利。低角度右侧的暖硬光营造出戏剧性的动感阴影。配色为石板灰、荧光青柠与赭石。动感十足的低位四分之三运动机位。高能的运动鞋广告氛围，动态感十足。

prompt_en: Top-down flat-lay of a pair of hand-stitched penny loafers in rich cognac leather from the invented brand Casa Marlo, arranged neatly heel-to-toe to show the burnished patina, leather tassel and stacked leather heel. Styled on a dark walnut wood surface with a folded pair of ribbed navy socks, a shoe horn and a small tin of leather balm. Warm focused overhead light emphasizes the glossy grain. Palette of cognac, walnut and navy. Overhead 90-degree angle, refined gentleman's outfitter product mood.
prompt_zh: 俯拍平铺一双虚构品牌 Casa Marlo 的手工缝制乐福鞋，浓郁干邑棕皮革，鞋跟对鞋头整齐摆放，展示打磨出的皮革光泽、皮质流苏和叠层皮跟。搭配在深胡桃木台面上，配一双折好的螺纹藏青袜、一只鞋拔和一小罐皮革护理膏。温暖聚焦的顶光凸显光亮的皮纹。配色为干邑棕、胡桃与藏青。正俯视 90 度机位，精致的绅士鞋履店产品氛围。

prompt_en: A single strappy stiletto sandal in metallic rose-gold from the invented brand Onda, standing elegantly on a polished blush-marble pedestal against a soft peach gradient backdrop. Slim ankle strap, delicate crossover toe straps and a slender 90mm heel catch a bright specular highlight. Soft glamorous lighting from the front with a warm reflection on the marble. Palette of rose-gold, blush and warm peach. Eye-level three-quarter angle. Feminine luxury evening-wear footwear campaign mood, glossy and elegant.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Onda 的一只细带高跟凉鞋，金属玫瑰金色，优雅地立在抛光的腮红大理石展台上，背景为柔和的蜜桃渐变。纤细的踝带、精致的交叉脚背带和 90 毫米细高跟泛起明亮的镜面高光。柔美的迷人灯光从正面打来，大理石上映出暖色倒影。配色为玫瑰金、腮红粉与暖蜜桃。平视四分之三机位。女性化的奢华晚宴鞋履广告氛围，光亮而优雅。

prompt_en: A pair of chunky lug-sole combat boots in matte black grained leather from the invented brand Fold, posed on a raw poured-concrete plinth against a moody dark charcoal backdrop. Chunky treaded outsole, glossy metal eyelets, thick waxed laces and a padded collar sharply lit. Hard cool key light from the upper left with deep dramatic shadows. Palette of black, gunmetal and cold grey. Low three-quarter camera angle for an imposing stance. Edgy streetwear footwear campaign mood, tough and sculptural.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Fold 的一双厚齿底马丁靴，哑光荔枝纹黑皮，摆在粗糙的现浇水泥基座上，背景为阴郁的深炭灰。厚实的深齿大底、亮面金属鞋眼、粗蜡鞋带和加厚靴口在硬光下清晰可见。冷调硬主光从左上方打来，投下深邃戏剧的阴影。配色为黑、枪灰与冷灰。低位四分之三机位，营造压迫气场。硬朗的街头潮流鞋履广告氛围，粗犷且富有雕塑感。

name_zh: 芭蕾平底鞋柔美产品图
prompt_en: A pair of dainty ballet flats in soft blush suede from the invented brand Aeroleaf, arranged one upright and one on its side on a cream ribbed-linen surface, showing the delicate bow, elasticated topline and cushioned leather insole. Styled beside pale pink peony petals and a folded gauze ribbon. Gentle soft daylight from the upper right gives a dreamy diffused glow. Palette of blush, cream and pale pink. Slightly elevated three-quarter angle. Romantic feminine footwear lookbook mood, soft and delicate.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Aeroleaf 的一双精致芭蕾平底鞋，柔和腮红色麂皮，一只立起一只侧放在奶油色螺纹亚麻布面上，展示小巧的蝴蝶结、松紧鞋口和柔软的皮革内垫。旁边搭配浅粉牡丹花瓣和一条折好的薄纱缎带。柔和的日光从右上方漫射，带来梦幻朦胧的光晕。配色为腮红、奶油与浅粉。略高的四分之三机位。浪漫女性化的鞋履 lookbook 氛围，柔美而细腻。

prompt_en: A bold high-top basketball sneaker in deep royal-blue and metallic orange from the invented brand Volta, shown as a dramatic hero shot on a glossy black reflective floor against a dark backdrop with a single spotlight beam. Padded ankle collar, translucent air-cushion sole, ripstop overlays and a bold molded logo tab in sharp focus. Cool spotlight from above with strong reflection below. Palette of royal blue, orange and black. Low three-quarter angle for power. Explosive performance sportswear campaign mood.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Volta 的一双大胆的高帮篮球鞋，深宝蓝配金属橙色，作为戏剧性主图立在光亮反射的黑色地面上，背景昏暗，一束聚光灯打下。加厚的护踝、半透明气垫大底、格子布贴片和立体压印 logo 标清晰锐利。冷调聚光灯从上方打下，下方映出强烈倒影。配色为宝蓝、橙与黑。低位四分之三机位彰显力量。爆发力十足的运动鞋广告氛围。

prompt_en: Overhead flat-lay of a pair of woven canvas espadrilles in sunny lemon-yellow from the invented brand Costa Sole, laid on warm terracotta tiles to show the braided jute midsole and lace-up ankle ties. Styled with a folded striped beach towel, a halved lemon, small seashells and a woven fan. Bright hard Mediterranean sun from the upper left casts crisp shadows. Palette of lemon-yellow, terracotta and natural jute. Top-down 90-degree angle, breezy summer holiday footwear mood, warm and playful.
prompt_zh: 俯拍平铺一双虚构品牌 Costa Sole 的编织帆布麻底鞋，明媚柠檬黄色，摆在暖陶土瓷砖上，展示编织黄麻中底和系带脚踝绑带。搭配折好的条纹沙滩巾、半只柠檬、小贝壳和一把编织团扇。明亮硬朗的地中海阳光从左上方打来，投出清晰的阴影。配色为柠檬黄、陶土与本色黄麻。正俯视 90 度机位，轻快的夏日度假鞋履氛围，温暖俏皮。

prompt_en: A retro-inspired suede-and-mesh running shoe in cream, forest-green and mustard from the invented brand Lumen Runners, styled on a warm beige seamless backdrop with a soft vintage color grade. Gum outsole, suede overlays, a stitched N-style side panel and waffle tread sharply detailed. Warm nostalgic daylight from the right with soft grain and slight halation. Palette of cream, forest green and mustard. Eye-level three-quarter angle. Seventies-inspired heritage sneaker campaign mood, warm and analog with visible suede nap.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Lumen Runners 的一双复古风麂皮拼网面跑鞋，奶油、森林绿与芥末黄配色，摆在暖米色无缝背景前，带柔和的复古调色。橡胶大底、麂皮贴片、缝制侧板和华夫格鞋纹细节锐利。温暖怀旧的日光从右侧照入，带柔和颗粒和轻微光晕。配色为奶油、森林绿与芥末黄。平视四分之三机位。七十年代复古慢跑鞋广告氛围，温暖复古，可见麂皮绒面。

prompt_en: A pair of glossy rubber rain boots in cheerful cobalt blue from the invented brand Puddle & Co, standing on a wet reflective grey surface with scattered water droplets and a few autumn leaves against a soft misty-grey backdrop. Matte buckle strap, chunky treaded sole and a subtle logo emboss sharply lit. Soft cool overcast light with reflections in the puddle below. Palette of cobalt, grey and amber leaf. Eye-level three-quarter angle. Fun functional rainy-day footwear product mood, fresh and lively.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Puddle & Co 的一双光亮橡胶雨靴，欢快钴蓝色，立在潮湿反光的灰色地面上，四周散落着水珠和几片秋叶，背景为柔和的雾灰。哑光搭扣带、厚齿大底和低调的压印 logo 在光下清晰。柔和的阴天冷光，下方水洼映出倒影。配色为钴蓝、灰与琥珀色落叶。平视四分之三机位。趣味实用的雨天鞋履产品氛围，清新活泼。

prompt_en: A structured top-handle tote in smooth saddle-tan leather from the invented brand Belvoir, standing upright on a warm cream pedestal against a soft gradient beige backdrop. Crisp architectural lines, a polished gold twist-lock clasp and neat edge-painted seams sharply in focus. Soft even studio lighting with a gentle highlight tracing the front panel. Palette of saddle tan, cream and warm gold. Slight low three-quarter angle to emphasize the boxy silhouette. Refined luxury handbag e-commerce mood, clean and aspirational with visible leather grain.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Belvoir 的一款结构挺括的顶提手手提包，光滑鞍棕色皮革，直立在暖奶油色展台上，背景为柔和的米色渐变。利落的建筑线条、抛光金色旋锁扣和整齐的封边缝线清晰锐利。柔和均匀的影棚灯光沿正面板打出柔和高光。配色为鞍棕、奶油与暖金。略低的四分之三机位以强调方正廓形。精致的奢华手袋电商氛围，干净且令人向往，皮纹清晰可见。

prompt_en: Top-down flat-lay of a quilted mini crossbody bag in soft lilac lambskin from the invented brand Lune & Oak, with its slim chain strap arranged in a graceful loop. Styled on a pale grey linen surface with a tube of nude lipstick, gold-rimmed sunglasses, a folded silk pocket square and dried lavender. Soft diffused daylight from above for an even glow. Palette of lilac, grey and warm gold. Overhead 90-degree angle, feminine everyday-luxury accessory flat-lay mood, delicate and curated.
prompt_zh: 俯拍平铺一款虚构品牌 Lune & Oak 的绗缝迷你斜挎包，柔和丁香紫羊皮，纤细的链条肩带盘成优雅的环形。搭配在浅灰亚麻布面上，配一支裸色口红、一副金边墨镜、一方折好的真丝口袋巾和几枝干薰衣草。柔和的日光从上方漫射，光线均匀。配色为丁香紫、灰与暖金。正俯视 90 度机位，女性化的日常轻奢配饰平铺氛围，精致而讲究。

prompt_en: A round woven straw bucket bag with tan leather trim from the invented brand Sienne, hanging from a piece of natural driftwood against a warm sandy-beige backdrop dappled with soft palm-leaf shadows. Tight basketweave texture, a drawstring top and a braided leather handle sharply detailed. Warm dappled sunlight creates gentle organic shadow patterns. Palette of natural straw, tan and warm sand. Eye-level three-quarter angle. Relaxed coastal resort accessory campaign mood, warm and textural with visible weave.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Sienne 的一款圆形编织草编水桶包，配棕褐皮革镶边，挂在一段天然浮木上，背景为暖沙米色，映着柔和的棕榈叶斑影。紧密的篮编纹理、束口设计和编织皮手柄细节锐利。温暖的斑驳阳光投下柔和的自然光影。配色为本色草编、棕褐与暖沙。平视四分之三机位。慵懒的海滨度假配饰广告氛围，温暖且富有肌理，编织纹清晰可见。

prompt_en: A wide braided leather belt in deep oxblood from the invented brand Corda, coiled into an elegant spiral on a dark slate surface to showcase the intricate hand-braiding and an antique brass buckle. Set against a moody dark backdrop with a warm focused spotlight raking across the leather to reveal texture and sheen. Palette of oxblood, brass and charcoal. Slightly elevated angle looking down into the coil. Rich artisanal leather-goods product mood, warm and detailed with visible hand-craft texture.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Corda 的一条宽版编织皮带，深牛血红色，盘成优雅的螺旋放在深板岩台面上，展示精巧的手工编织和仿古黄铜带扣。背景为沉郁的暗色，一束暖色聚光斜掠过皮革，凸显纹理与光泽。配色为牛血红、黄铜与炭灰。略高俯视机位望入盘卷之中。浓郁的手工皮具产品氛围，温暖且细腻，可见手作纹理。

prompt_en: A large square silk twill scarf with an ornate paisley-and-botanical print in teal, coral and gold from the invented brand Marchetti, captured mid-air billowing in a graceful fluid ripple against a clean warm-white backdrop. The lustrous twill catches soft studio light showing the vivid printed detail and rolled hem. Bright even lighting with a gentle sheen. Palette of teal, coral and gold. Straight-on camera angle capturing the fabric motion. Elegant luxury silk accessory campaign mood, vibrant and dynamic.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Marchetti 的一条大方形真丝斜纹丝巾，印有华丽的佩斯利与植物花纹，青绿、珊瑚与金配色，捕捉其腾空飘动、优雅流动的涟漪瞬间，背景为干净的暖白。光泽的斜纹面料映着柔和的影棚光，展现鲜艳的印花细节和手卷边。明亮均匀的灯光带柔和光泽。配色为青绿、珊瑚与金。正面机位捕捉面料的动态。优雅的奢华丝巾配饰广告氛围，鲜艳而灵动。

prompt_en: A waxed-canvas and leather weekender duffel in olive-green and chestnut from the invented brand Otto Bell, positioned on a warm wooden bench beside a vintage brass-cornered suitcase against a soft warm-grey backdrop. Rolled leather handles, a brass zip pull and reinforced base corners sharply detailed. Warm directional light from the left evokes golden-hour travel. Palette of olive, chestnut and warm grey. Eye-level three-quarter angle. Aspirational heritage travel-goods campaign mood, rugged yet refined with visible waxed texture.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Otto Bell 的一款上蜡帆布拼皮革周末旅行袋，橄榄绿配栗棕色，放在温暖的木长椅上，旁边是一只黄铜包角的复古行李箱，背景为柔和的暖灰。卷制皮手柄、黄铜拉链头和加固的底部包角细节锐利。温暖的方向光从左侧打来，营造黄金时刻的出行感。配色为橄榄绿、栗棕与暖灰。平视四分之三机位。令人向往的复古旅行箱包广告氛围，粗犷又精致，上蜡质感清晰可见。

prompt_en: A slim bifold card wallet in smooth pebbled navy leather from the invented brand Hargrove, shown slightly open to reveal three neat card slots and a couple of tan cards, resting on a pale grey stone slab. Set against a soft cool-grey backdrop with clean directional light from the upper right highlighting the fine pebble grain and edge stitching. Palette of navy, tan and cool grey. Slight three-quarter overhead angle. Sleek modern small-leather-goods product mood, minimal and precise with visible texture.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Hargrove 的一款纤薄双折卡包，光滑荔枝纹藏青皮革，微微翻开露出三个整齐的卡位和几张棕褐色卡片，放在浅灰石板上。背景为柔和的冷灰，干净的方向光从右上方打来，凸显细腻的荔枝纹和封边缝线。配色为藏青、棕褐与冷灰。略带四分之三的俯视机位。利落现代的小皮具产品氛围，极简而精准，纹理清晰可见。

prompt_en: A coordinated set of a quilted nylon bucket hat and matching mini shoulder bag in soft sage-green from the invented brand Bramble, arranged together on a natural travertine surface against a warm neutral backdrop. Puffy channel-quilting, tonal webbing straps and matte metal hardware sharply detailed. Soft even daylight from above for a clean modern look. Palette of sage-green, taupe and silver. Slightly elevated three-quarter angle. Contemporary lifestyle accessory campaign mood, coordinated and fresh with visible quilted texture.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Bramble 的一套配套单品——绗缝尼龙渔夫帽和同款迷你单肩包，柔和鼠尾草绿，一同摆在天然洞石台面上，背景为暖中性色。蓬松的沟槽绗缝、同色织带和哑光金属五金细节锐利。柔和均匀的日光从上方洒下，画面干净现代。配色为鼠尾草绿、灰褐与银。略高的四分之三机位。当代生活方式配饰广告氛围，成套且清新，绗缝质感清晰可见。

prompt_en: A sleek envelope clutch covered in deep emerald crystal-cut beading from the invented brand Verdi, propped upright against a folded black velvet drape on a dark reflective surface. The faceted beads sparkle under a single dramatic spotlight, with a slim gold-tone snap closure catching a bright glint. Moody low-key lighting with rich reflections below. Palette of emerald, gold and black. Eye-level slightly angled camera. Opulent evening-wear accessory campaign mood, glamorous and sparkling with visible beadwork detail.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Verdi 的一款流线型信封手拿包，通体镶嵌深祖母绿刻面珠饰，斜靠在深色反光台面上一块折好的黑丝绒帷幔前。刻面珠子在一束戏剧性聚光下闪烁，纤细的金色按扣泛起明亮的光点。低调沉郁的灯光，下方映出浓郁倒影。配色为祖母绿、金与黑。平视略侧机位。奢华的晚宴配饰广告氛围，璀璨迷人，珠饰细节清晰可见。

prompt_en: A minimalist roll-top commuter backpack in matte graphite recycled nylon from the invented brand Verdi Works, standing on a raw concrete ledge against a soft cool-grey urban backdrop with subtle window-light gradients. Palette of sunset orange, cream and teal. Eye-level frontal-to-three-quarter angle. Playful nostalgic sporty-casual campaign mood, vibrant and clean with visible glossy nylon texture.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Vela Sport 的一件复古风撞色防风外套，日落橙、奶油与青绿配色，展示在哑光浅灰人台上，背景为暖蜜桃渐变。光亮的尼龙外壳、半拉链套头领、袋鼠口袋和松紧袖口细节锐利，带微妙光泽。明亮均匀的灯光从正面打来，阴影柔和。配色为日落橙、奶油与青绿。平视正面转四分之三机位。俏皮怀旧的运动休闲广告氛围，鲜艳干净，光亮尼龙质感清晰可见。

prompt_en: Top-down flat-lay of a sleek gym duffel in matte black recycled polyester from the invented brand Aeon Active, surrounded by neatly arranged workout gear — rolled resistance bands, a stainless water bottle, folded moisture-wicking towel and lightweight training shoes. Set on a cool concrete-grey surface with clean geometric spacing. Soft bright even lighting with crisp small shadows. Palette of matte black, cool grey and a single lime accent. Overhead 90-degree angle, organized modern fitness-lifestyle flat-lay mood, clean and motivating with visible textures.
prompt_zh: 俯拍平铺一只虚构品牌 Aeon Active 的利落健身包，哑光黑再生聚酯材质，四周整齐摆放着健身装备——卷起的阻力带、一只不锈钢水壶、折好的速干毛巾和轻量训练鞋。置于冷调水泥灰台面上，几何间距干净。柔和明亮均匀的灯光带清晰的小阴影。配色为哑光黑、冷灰配一抹青柠点缀。正俯视 90 度机位，有序的现代健身生活方式平铺氛围，干净励志，质感清晰可见。

prompt_en: A pleated tennis skort in crisp white with a soft lilac trim from the invented brand Corefold, displayed on a lower-body athletic mannequin against a bright fresh mint-green backdrop. The knife-pleated skirt, built-in compression shorts and ball pocket are crisply detailed under clean bright lighting. Soft defined shadow adds depth. Palette of white, lilac and fresh mint. Slight low three-quarter angle. Fresh preppy court-sport activewear campaign mood, crisp and sporty with visible pleat structure and clean fabric texture.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Corefold 的一条百褶网球裙裤，清爽白色配柔丁香紫镶边，展示在下半身运动人台上，背景为明亮清新的薄荷绿。刀褶裙、内置压缩短裤和球袋在干净明亮的灯光下细节锐利。柔和分明的阴影增添层次。配色为白、丁香紫与清新薄荷。略低的四分之三机位。清新的学院风球场运动服广告氛围，利落运动感十足，褶皱结构和干净的面料质感清晰可见。

prompt_en: Top-down flat-lay of a sleek A-line faux-leather mini skirt in deep espresso-brown from the invented brand Solene, laid flat to show the smooth matte-grain surface, hidden side zip and clean topstitched hem. Styled on a warm cream linen backdrop with a folded ribbed knit top, gold hoop earrings and a suede ankle boot. Soft directional daylight from the upper right highlights the supple texture. Palette of espresso brown, cream and gold. Overhead 90-degree angle, chic contemporary apparel flat-lay mood, refined and modern with visible grain texture.
prompt_zh: 俯拍平铺一条虚构品牌 Solene 的利落 A 字仿皮迷你半裙，深浓咖啡棕，平铺展示光滑的哑光纹面、隐藏侧拉链和干净的明线下摆。搭配在暖奶油亚麻背景上，配一件折好的螺纹针织上衣、金色圆环耳环和一只麂皮踝靴。柔和的日光从右上方斜射，凸显柔软的质感。配色为浓咖啡棕、奶油与金。正俯视 90 度机位，别致的当代服装平铺氛围，精致现代，纹面质感清晰可见。

prompt_en: A quilted down puffer vest in warm rust-orange with a matte-black zip from the invented brand Nord Peak, displayed on a matte grey mannequin torso against a soft cool-toned backdrop with subtle mountain-mist gradient. The channel-quilted baffles, stand collar and tonal zippers are crisply detailed with a soft technical sheen. Cool directional light from the left with defined shadow. Palette of rust orange, matte black and cool grey. Slight low three-quarter angle. Rugged outdoor lifestyle apparel campaign mood, cozy and functional with visible quilting.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Nord Peak 的一件绗缝羽绒马甲，暖铁锈橙配哑光黑拉链，展示在哑光灰人台上半身，背景为柔和冷调，带微妙的山间雾气渐变。沟槽绗缝隔层、立领和同色拉链细节锐利，带柔和的功能性光泽。冷调方向光从左侧打来，阴影分明。配色为铁锈橙、哑光黑与冷灰。略低的四分之三机位。硬朗的户外生活方式服装广告氛围，惬意实用，绗缝清晰可见。

prompt_en: A pair of sleek Chelsea boots in smooth chestnut leather from the invented brand Ridge & Co, posed side by side on a warm cream pedestal against a soft gradient beige backdrop. The elasticated side gusset, pull tab, sleek almond toe and stacked leather sole are crisply detailed with a soft polished sheen. Clean directional studio light from the upper left with a gentle rim highlight. Palette of chestnut, cream and warm tan. Slight low three-quarter angle. Refined premium footwear e-commerce mood, clean and timeless with visible leather grain.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Ridge & Co 的一双利落切尔西靴，光滑栗棕色皮革，并排立在暖奶油展台上，背景为柔和米色渐变。松紧侧拼、后拉环、利落的杏仁鞋头和叠层皮底细节锐利，带柔和的抛光光泽。干净的方向影棚光从左上方打来，带柔和边缘高光。配色为栗棕、奶油与暖棕褐。略低的四分之三机位。精致的高级鞋履电商氛围，干净永恒，皮纹清晰可见。

prompt_en: A pair of minimalist molded slide sandals in soft matte sand-beige from the invented brand Onda Casa, arranged one flat and one tilted on a smooth pale-terracotta surface against a warm minimal backdrop. The contoured footbed, wide padded strap and subtle logo emboss are crisply detailed. Soft warm directional light from the right casts a clean gentle shadow. Palette of sand-beige, terracotta and warm cream. Slightly elevated three-quarter angle. Calm modern slow-fashion footwear product mood, minimal and warm with visible soft-matte texture.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Onda Casa 的一双极简一体成型拖鞋，柔和哑光沙米色，一只平放一只倾斜地摆在光滑的浅陶土色台面上，背景为暖色极简。贴合的鞋床、宽软带面和低调的压印 logo 细节锐利。柔和温暖的方向光从右侧打来，投下干净轻柔的阴影。配色为沙米、陶土与暖奶油。略高的四分之三机位。宁静现代的慢时尚鞋履产品氛围，极简温暖，柔哑质感清晰可见。

prompt_en: An extreme macro shot of a pair of elegant cufflinks in brushed silver with a deep-navy enamel inlay and a tiny inset crystal from the invented brand Aldwych Fine, resting on folded charcoal-grey wool suiting fabric against a moody dark backdrop. Precise directional light reveals the brushed metal texture, glossy enamel and crystal sparkle. Deep soft shadow adds depth. Palette of silver, navy enamel and charcoal. Tight overhead-angled macro view. Refined masculine accessory campaign mood, precise and sophisticated with ultra-sharp detail.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Aldwych Fine 的一对优雅袖扣的极致微距特写，拉丝银配深藏青珐琅镶嵌和一颗嵌入式小水晶，搁在折叠的炭灰羊毛西装面料上，背景为沉郁暗色。精准的方向光凸显拉丝金属质感、光亮珐琅和水晶闪光。深邃柔和的阴影增添层次。配色为银、藏青珐琅与炭灰。紧凑的俯角微距视角。精致的男士配饰广告氛围，精准而考究，细节超清晰。

prompt_en: An extreme macro shot of a bold cocktail ring featuring a large oval citrine cabochon set in textured hammered gold from the invented brand Kestrel Bold, resting on a dark charcoal-slate surface against a moody near-black backdrop. Warm focused light makes the honey-gold stone glow while revealing the hammered metal texture. Deep dramatic shadow with a soft reflection. Palette of citrine gold, hammered gold and charcoal. Tight low three-quarter macro angle. Opulent statement fine-jewelry campaign mood, warm and bold with ultra-sharp detail.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Kestrel Bold 的一枚大胆鸡尾酒戒指的极致微距特写，一颗大椭圆黄水晶凸圆面主石镶嵌于锤纹金托上，搁在深炭板岩面上，背景为沉郁的近黑。暖色聚光让蜜金色宝石泛光，同时凸显锤纹金属质感。深邃戏剧的阴影配柔和倒影。配色为黄水晶金、锤纹金与炭灰。紧凑的低位四分之三微距机位。奢华的个性高级珠宝广告氛围，温暖大胆，细节超清晰。

prompt_en: Top-down flat-lay of three folded silk pocket squares in a paisley print, a polka-dot and a solid burgundy from the invented brand Aldwych Gentlemen, arranged in an overlapping fan on a dark charcoal wool surface with a pair of silver cufflinks and a sprig of dried lavender. Warm focused directional light from the right reveals the silk sheen and printed detail. Palette of burgundy, navy and silver. Overhead 90-degree angle, refined menswear accessory flat-lay mood, sophisticated and warm with visible silk luster.
prompt_zh: 俯拍平铺三方虚构品牌 Aldwych Gentlemen 的折叠真丝口袋巾，分别为佩斯利印花、波点和纯酒红，交叠成扇形排列在深炭灰羊毛面上，旁边有一对银色袖扣和一枝干薰衣草。温暖聚焦的方向光从右侧打来，凸显真丝光泽和印花细节。配色为酒红、藏青与银。正俯视 90 度机位，精致的男装配饰平铺氛围，考究而温暖，真丝光泽清晰可见。

prompt_en: Top-down flat-lay of a silk necktie in deep forest-green with a subtle micro-dot weave from the invented brand Meridian Gentlemen, rolled into a neat spiral beside a brushed-silver tie clip, folded on a warm oatmeal linen surface with a sprig of eucalyptus and a leather-bound notebook. Soft directional daylight from the upper right reveals the silk sheen and woven texture. Palette of forest green, silver and oatmeal. Overhead 90-degree angle, refined modern menswear accessory flat-lay mood, sophisticated and calm with visible silk texture.
prompt_zh: 俯拍平铺一条虚构品牌 Meridian Gentlemen 的真丝领带，深森林绿带微妙的细点织纹，盘成整齐的螺旋放在一枚拉丝银领带夹旁，铺在暖燕麦亚麻面上，旁边有一枝桉叶和一本皮革封面笔记本。柔和的日光从右上方斜射，凸显真丝光泽和织纹。配色为森林绿、银与燕麦。正俯视 90 度机位，精致现代的男装配饰平铺氛围，考究而宁静，真丝质感清晰可见。

prompt_en: An oversized heavyweight fleece hoodie in washed sand-beige with a tonal drawstring and boxy fit from the invented brand Meridian Street, displayed on a matte charcoal mannequin against a raw concrete-grey backdrop. The brushed loopback interior peek, ribbed cuffs, kangaroo pocket and structured hood are crisply detailed. Cool directional light from the left with defined shadow reveals the heavy fabric texture. Palette of sand beige, charcoal and cool grey. Slight low three-quarter angle. Elevated streetwear apparel campaign mood, relaxed and premium with visible fleece texture.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Meridian Street 的一件宽松厚磅抓绒连帽卫衣，水洗沙米色，配同色抽绳和方正版型，展示在哑光炭灰人台上，背景为粗糙的水泥灰。露出的磨毛毛圈内里、螺纹袖口、袋鼠口袋和挺括帽兜细节锐利。冷调方向光从左侧打来，阴影分明，凸显厚重面料质感。配色为沙米、炭灰与冷灰。略低的四分之三机位。高级街头服装广告氛围，慵懒而精致，抓绒质感清晰可见。

prompt_en: A flowing accordion-pleated midi skirt in shimmering champagne-gold from the invented brand Aurelle Maison, displayed on a slim ivory mannequin against a soft warm-taupe backdrop. The fine metallic pleats catch soft directional light from the left, showing fluid movement and a delicate sheen along each fold. Elegant soft shadow. Palette of champagne gold, ivory and warm taupe. Eye-level frontal-to-three-quarter angle. Refined elegant womenswear campaign mood, fluid and luminous with visible pleat structure and metallic shimmer.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Aurelle Maison 的一条飘逸的手风琴百褶中长裙，闪光香槟金色，展示在纤细的象牙色人台上，背景为柔和暖灰褐。细密的金属光泽褶皱映着从左侧照来的柔和方向光，每道褶间都显出流动感和精致光泽。优雅柔和的阴影。配色为香槟金、象牙与暖灰褐。平视正面转四分之三机位。精致优雅的女装广告氛围，流动而莹亮，褶皱结构和金属微光清晰可见。

prompt_en: Top-down flat-lay of a delicate silk-satin camisole in soft blush-pink with fine spaghetti straps and a lace-trimmed neckline from the invented brand Aurelle Intimates, laid flat with the straps gracefully curved on a warm ivory silk surface. Styled with a folded silk robe, a pearl bracelet and a single white orchid bloom. Soft diffused daylight from above gives a gentle luminous glow highlighting the satin sheen. Palette of blush pink, ivory and pearl. Overhead 90-degree angle, elegant feminine lingerie-adjacent flat-lay mood, soft and refined with visible satin luster.
prompt_zh: 俯拍平铺一件虚构品牌 Aurelle Intimates 的精致真丝缎面吊带背心，柔和腮红粉，细吊带配蕾丝边领口，平铺展开，吊带优雅地弯曲在暖象牙真丝面上。搭配一件折好的真丝睡袍、一条珍珠手链和一朵白色兰花。柔和的日光从上方漫射，带来温柔莹润的光晕，凸显缎面光泽。配色为腮红粉、象牙与珍珠。正俯视 90 度机位，优雅女性化的近内衣平铺氛围，柔美精致，缎面光泽清晰可见。

prompt_en: A stable cross-training shoe in cool graphite with volt-yellow laces and a wide flat outsole from the invented brand Strata Move Footwear, shown as a hero product on a soft cool-grey gradient backdrop with a subtle contact shadow. The reinforced heel cage, breathable engineered mesh, rope-guard side wrap and flat grip sole are crisply detailed. Clean bright directional lighting with a subtle rim highlight. Palette of graphite, volt yellow and cool grey. Slight low three-quarter angle. Modern gym-performance footwear campaign mood, stable and clean with visible technical texture.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Strata Move Footwear 的一双稳定综合训练鞋，冷石墨灰配荧光黄鞋带和宽平大底，作为主图立在柔和冷灰渐变背景上，带一道淡淡的接触阴影。加固的后跟支撑、透气工程网面、护绳侧包和平抓地大底细节锐利。干净明亮的方向光带微妙轮廓高光。配色为石墨、荧光黄与冷灰。略低的四分之三机位。现代健身性能鞋履广告氛围，稳定干净，功能性质感清晰可见。

prompt_en: Top-down flat-lay of a pair of geometric hexagonal sunglasses with a thin rose-gold frame and pink-to-purple ombre lenses from the invented brand Cassini Vue, arranged diagonally on a soft holographic-iridescent surface. Styled with a folded pastel silk scarf, a shell hair clip and a scattering of tiny pearls. Bright soft even lighting reveals the lens gradient and metallic frame sheen. Palette of rose gold, pink, purple and iridescent pastel. Overhead 90-degree angle, dreamy playful eyewear flat-lay mood, fresh and colorful with visible ombre detail.
prompt_zh: 俯拍平铺一副虚构品牌 Cassini Vue 的几何六边形墨镜，纤细玫瑰金框配粉到紫的渐变镜片，斜置于柔和的全息虹彩面上。搭配一方折好的粉彩真丝方巾、一只贝壳发夹和散落的小珍珠。明亮柔和均匀的灯光凸显镜片渐变和金属框光泽。配色为玫瑰金、粉、紫与虹彩粉彩。正俯视 90 度机位，梦幻俏皮的眼镜平铺氛围，清新多彩，渐变细节清晰可见。

prompt_en: A delicate gold charm bracelet with tiny enameled charms — a star, a moon and a heart — from the invented brand Celeste Fine, arranged in a graceful loose curve on a soft cream velvet surface against a warm ivory backdrop. Soft diffused light makes the polished gold and glossy enamel charms glow with a gentle warm shimmer. Delicate soft shadow. Palette of warm gold, pastel enamel and cream. Close-up slightly elevated angle. Dainty romantic fine-jewelry campaign mood, delicate and warm with visible charm detail and metal sheen.
prompt_zh: 虚构品牌 Celeste Fine 的一条精致金质吊坠手链，缀有细小的珐琅吊饰——星星、月亮和爱心，优雅松散地弯成一道弧线放在柔奶油丝绒面上，背景为暖象牙色。柔和漫射的光线让抛光金和光亮珐琅吊饰泛出温柔的暖色微光。精致柔和的阴影。配色为暖金、粉彩珐琅与奶油。特写略高机位。精巧浪漫的高级珠宝广告氛围，细腻温暖，吊饰细节和金属光泽清晰可见。

prompt_en: Top-down flat-lay of a washed-indigo denim bucket hat with topstitched panels and a tonal embroidered emblem from the invented brand Nomad Denim, laid on a warm sandy-beige surface with a pair of round sunglasses, a woven friendship bracelet and a folded bandana. Bright warm daylight from the upper left casts crisp shadows and reveals the denim weave and stitching detail. Palette of washed indigo, sandy beige and warm tan. Overhead 90-degree angle, laid-back festival streetwear accessory flat-lay mood, casual and warm with visible denim texture.
prompt_zh: 俯拍平铺一顶虚构品牌 Nomad Denim 的水洗靛蓝牛仔渔夫帽，明线拼块配同色刺绣徽标，摆在暖沙米色台面上，旁边有一副圆框墨镜、一条编织友谊手链和一方折好的印花头巾。明亮温暖的日光从左上方打来，投下清晰阴影，凸显牛仔织纹和缝线细节。配色为水洗靛蓝、沙米与暖棕褐。正俯视 90 度机位，慵懒的音乐节街头配饰平铺氛围，休闲温暖，牛仔质感清晰可见。

prompt_en: Top-down flat-lay of a set of playful hard-enamel lapel pins — a tiny cactus, a crescent moon and a rainbow — in bright glossy colors with gold outlines from the invented brand Vann Studio, arranged in a neat cluster on a soft pastel-lilac card backdrop. Bright soft even lighting reveals the glossy enamel and gold plating sheen with crisp small shadows. Palette of bright multicolor, gold and pastel lilac. Overhead 90-degree angle, cheerful playful accessory flat-lay mood, colorful and fun with visible glossy enamel detail.
prompt_zh: 俯拍平铺一套虚构品牌 Vann Studio 的俏皮硬珐琅胸针——小仙人掌、月牙和彩虹，明亮光泽的色彩配金色描边，整齐聚成一簇摆在柔和粉彩丁香紫卡纸背景上。明亮柔和均匀的灯光凸显光亮珐琅和镀金光泽，带清晰的小阴影。配色为亮彩、金与粉彩丁香紫。正俯视 90 度机位，欢快俏皮的配饰平铺氛围，多彩有趣，光亮珐琅细节清晰可见。

prompt_en: A minimalist Instagram quote card, 1:1. Warm oat-beige background with a subtle recycled-paper grain. Centered text in a tall elegant serif reads "Grow through what you go through" with the word "grow" hand-underlined in a single terracotta brushstroke. A tiny line-art sprig of olive leaves sits below the text. Generous negative space, calm and grounded editorial mood, muted earth palette of oat, clay and sage, soft even studio lighting.
prompt_zh: 极简风 Instagram 语录卡,1:1 比例。背景是温暖的燕麦米色,带细腻的再生纸颗粒质感。画面正中是修长优雅的衬线英文字体 "Grow through what you go through",其中 "grow" 一词下方用赤陶色画笔一笔手绘下划线。文字下方点缀一小枝线描橄榄叶。大面积留白,整体沉静而踏实的杂志感,配色为燕麦、陶土与鼠尾草绿的低饱和大地色,柔和均匀的棚拍光。

prompt_en: A bold motivational post, 4:5. Full-bleed gradient sky blending coral, peach and lavender like a summer dusk. Layered over it, oversized condensed sans-serif text in glowing off-white reads "You are allowed to start over as many times as you need" wrapping across four lines, with soft drop shadow. A thin sun-halo arc glows behind the words. Dreamy, hopeful mood, film-grain texture, gentle backlit glow at the horizon.
prompt_zh: 醒目的励志贴文,4:5 比例。整幅背景是珊瑚橘、蜜桃粉与薰衣草紫交融的渐变天空,宛如夏日黄昏。上方叠加超大号窄体无衬线英文 "You are allowed to start over as many times as you need",米白色带微光,分四行排布,带柔和投影。文字背后透出一道细细的太阳光晕弧线。氛围梦幻而充满希望,画面带胶片颗粒,地平线处透着温柔的逆光。

prompt_en: A cozy affirmation card, 4:5. Torn-edge cream notepaper photographed flat on a linen surface. Flowing dark-ink handwritten script reads "Small steps still move you forward" across the center, with a couple of playful ink swirls. A dried pressed daisy and a brass paperclip rest in the corner. Warm window light casts a soft diagonal shadow. Intimate journaling mood, natural textures, muted cream and charcoal palette.
prompt_zh: 温馨的肯定语卡片,4:5 比例。米白色撕边便签纸平铺在亚麻布面上拍摄。画面中央是深墨色流畅手写英文 "Small steps still move you forward",搭配几笔俏皮的墨迹卷曲。角落放着一朵压干的雏菊和一枚黄铜回形针。温暖的窗光投下柔和的斜向阴影。私密的手账氛围,自然肌理,配色为柔和的奶白与炭灰。

prompt_en: A high-impact quote graphic, 1:1. Deep charcoal-black background with faint concrete texture. Center text in a glowing electric-cyan neon-tube typeface reads "Discipline is choosing what you want most over what you want now", the word "most" flickering brighter. Subtle magenta reflection on the floor below. Moody, motivational gym-poster energy, high contrast, soft neon bloom and light haze around the letters.
prompt_zh: 强冲击力的语录图,1:1 比例。深炭黑背景带淡淡的水泥墙质感。中央文字采用发光的电光青色霓虹灯管字体,写着 "Discipline is choosing what you want most over what you want now",其中 "most" 一词闪烁得更亮。下方地面透出淡淡的洋红色反光。氛围硬核,像健身房励志海报,高对比,字母周围有柔和的霓虹光晕与光雾。

prompt_en: A scrapbook-style quote post, 4:5. Layered torn paper collage in mustard, dusty rose and cream on a kraft background. Mixed typography spells "Bloom where you are planted" using cut-out magazine letters in varied fonts, slightly uneven. A tiny illustrated potted plant and washi-tape strips accent the corners. Playful analog craft mood, visible paper edges and shadows, warm retro palette, tactile handmade feel.
prompt_zh: 剪贴簿风格的语录贴文,4:5 比例。牛皮纸背景上层叠着芥末黄、灰玫瑰与奶白的撕纸拼贴。用杂志剪字拼出 "Bloom where you are planted",字体各异、略微高低错落。角落点缀一个手绘小盆栽和几条和纸胶带。趣味十足的手工拼贴氛围,可见纸张毛边与阴影,温暖复古配色,充满手作的触感。

prompt_en: A soft self-love quote card, 1:1. Off-white background scattered with organic blob shapes in butter yellow, blush and mint. Centered rounded sans-serif text reads "You are a work in progress, and that is beautiful". A tiny smiling sun and a heart doodle float among the shapes. Cheerful, gentle wellness mood, flat vector illustration style, pastel palette, balanced airy composition with plenty of breathing room.
prompt_zh: 柔和的自爱语录卡,1:1 比例。米白背景上散落着奶油黄、腮红粉与薄荷绿的有机色块。画面正中是圆润的无衬线英文 "You are a work in progress, and that is beautiful"。色块之间漂浮着一个微笑小太阳和一颗爱心涂鸦。愉悦温柔的疗愈氛围,扁平矢量插画风格,粉彩配色,通透平衡的构图,留有充足呼吸空间。

prompt_en: A punchy Monday-motivation post, 9:16 story format. Split layout: top two-thirds in vivid tangerine, bottom third in deep plum. Giant stacked bold display type reads "NEW WEEK, NEW ENERGY" with each word in a contrasting color block. A small arrow icon and "swipe up" hint sit at the base. Energetic, confident brand-story mood, clean geometric composition, saturated complementary palette, crisp flat design.
prompt_zh: 活力满满的周一激励贴文,9:16 竖屏故事版式。画面上下分割:上三分之二为鲜亮的橘橙色,下三分之一为深紫红色。巨大的粗体展示字层叠排布 "NEW WEEK, NEW ENERGY",每个单词落在对比色块中。底部有一个小箭头图标和 "swipe up" 提示。充满干劲、自信的品牌故事氛围,简洁的几何构图,高饱和互补配色,利落的扁平设计。

prompt_en: A serene zen quote card, 1:1. Textured rice-paper background in warm ivory. A single sweeping black sumi-e brushstroke arcs across the upper area. Beneath it, calm minimalist serif text reads "Peace begins the moment you stop needing an answer". A small red seal-style stamp accents the lower right. Meditative, understated mood, high negative space, monochrome ink palette with one red accent, refined and quiet.
prompt_zh: 宁静的禅意语录卡,1:1 比例。背景是温暖象牙白的宣纸肌理。上方一道挥洒的黑色水墨笔触横扫成弧。笔触下方是沉静的极简衬线英文 "Peace begins the moment you stop needing an answer"。右下角点缀一枚红色印章。冥想般内敛的氛围,大面积留白,水墨单色调仅配一抹朱红,精致而安静。

prompt_en: A groovy retro quote poster, 4:5. Warm amber-and-rust background with a repeating rainbow-arc sunburst radiating from the center. Chunky bubble-style 70s lettering reads "Chase the dream, not the competition" in cream outlined with brown. Small daisy motifs dot the corners. Nostalgic, optimistic vintage mood, grainy print texture, earthy 1970s palette of mustard, terracotta and cream, symmetrical playful layout.
prompt_zh: 复古摩登的语录海报,4:5 比例。琥珀与铁锈色的暖调背景,中心放射出层层彩虹拱形光芒。厚实的 70 年代泡泡字体写着 "Chase the dream, not the competition",奶白字身配棕色描边。四角点缀小雏菊图案。怀旧而乐观的复古氛围,颗粒印刷质感,芥末黄、陶土红与奶白的 70 年代大地色系,对称而俏皮的版式。

prompt_en: A joyful celebration quote card, 1:1. Clean white background bursting with hand-drawn confetti, streamers and sparkles in coral, gold and teal. Centered playful mixed typography reads "Celebrate how far you have come", with "far" enlarged in a bouncy script. A tiny party-popper icon sits above the text. Upbeat, festive milestone mood, cheerful bright palette, flat illustrated confetti, balanced energetic composition.
prompt_zh: 欢快的庆祝语录卡,1:1 比例。干净的白色背景上洒满手绘彩纸、飘带与闪光,配色为珊瑚橘、金色与青蓝。画面正中是俏皮的混排字体 "Celebrate how far you have come",其中 "far" 用弹跳感手写体放大。文字上方是一个小彩炮图标。积极喜庆的里程碑氛围,明亮愉悦的配色,扁平插画彩纸,平衡而富有活力的构图。

prompt_en: A clean beauty brand lifestyle post, 4:5. Overhead flatlay on a smooth travertine-stone surface. A frosted-glass serum bottle labeled "Lumé" in delicate sans-serif, a matching amber dropper, a folded sand-colored linen cloth, a single white orchid stem and two smooth pebbles arranged asymmetrically. Soft diffused morning light with gentle shadows. Elevated, spa-like minimalist mood, warm neutral palette of stone, sand and cream, premium editorial styling.
prompt_zh: 简约美妆品牌生活方式贴文,4:5 比例。俯拍平铺在光滑洞石台面上。一瓶磨砂玻璃精华露,标签用纤细无衬线写着 "Lumé",搭配同款琥珀色滴管、一块折叠的沙色亚麻布、一枝白色兰花和两颗光滑鹅卵石,不对称摆放。柔和漫射的晨光带来轻柔阴影。高级、如水疗般的极简氛围,石灰、沙与奶白的暖调中性配色,精致的杂志感陈列。

prompt_en: A warm coffee-brand lifestyle post, 1:1. A hand in a chunky knit sweater cradles a speckled ceramic mug of steaming pour-over on a wooden table by a rainy window. A kraft bag stamped "Cobble Coffee Roasters" and scattered coffee beans sit beside it. Soft grey daylight, visible steam curling upward. Cozy, slow-morning mood, muted earthy palette of brown, oatmeal and grey, lifestyle photography with shallow depth of field.
prompt_zh: 温暖的咖啡品牌生活方式贴文,1:1 比例。一只穿着粗针织毛衣的手,捧着一只带斑点的陶瓷马克杯,杯中是冒着热气的手冲咖啡,置于雨天窗边的木桌上。旁边摆着印有 "Cobble Coffee Roasters" 的牛皮纸袋和散落的咖啡豆。柔和的灰色天光,蒸汽袅袅上升。慵懒、慢清晨的氛围,棕、燕麦与灰的低饱和大地色,浅景深的生活摄影。

prompt_en: A moody candle-brand post, 4:5. A lit amber-glass candle labeled "Emberhaus" glows on a dark walnut nightstand beside a folded charcoal throw and an open hardcover book. Warm flame light flickers across the scene, wisps of smoke rising. Dried eucalyptus and a matte-black lighter complete the styling. Intimate, hygge evening mood, deep shadows, warm amber-and-espresso palette, cinematic low-key lighting, cozy premium feel.
prompt_zh: 氛围感十足的蜡烛品牌贴文,4:5 比例。一支点燃的琥珀玻璃香薰蜡烛,标签写着 "Emberhaus",在深胡桃木床头柜上发出暖光,旁边是折叠的炭灰色毛毯和一本摊开的精装书。温暖的烛光在场景中摇曳,几缕青烟升起。干桉树叶和一只哑黑打火机点缀陈列。私密的北欧 hygge 夜晚氛围,深邃阴影,琥珀与浓咖色的暖调,电影感低调布光,慵懒而高级。

prompt_en: An athleisure brand lifestyle post, 4:5. A person mid-stride on a sunlit concrete walkway, cropped from shoulders to knees, wearing a sage-green seamless sportswear set with a small woven "Strade" tag on the waistband. A matching water bottle in hand. Long soft morning shadows stretch across the pavement. Fresh, active, aspirational mood, muted sage and warm-grey palette, natural sunlight, clean lifestyle photography, motion-blur hint on the legs.
prompt_zh: 运动休闲品牌生活方式贴文,4:5 比例。一个人正大步走在阳光洒落的水泥步道上,取景从肩到膝,身穿鼠尾草绿无缝运动套装,腰头有一枚织标 "Strade"。手里拿着同色系水瓶。柔和的晨间长影横铺在路面上。清新、活力、令人向往的氛围,鼠尾草绿与暖灰的低饱和配色,自然阳光,干净的生活方式摄影,腿部带一丝动态模糊。

prompt_en: An artisan ceramics brand post, 1:1. Three handmade stoneware mugs in speckled cream, dusty terracotta and slate glaze arranged on a raw wooden shelf, one turned to show a subtle stamped "Terracina" mark on the base. A trailing pothos plant and soft window light frame the scene. Warm, tactile handcrafted mood, earthy matte palette of clay, cream and green, cozy studio-shop atmosphere, shallow focus on the front mug.
prompt_zh: 手作陶瓷品牌贴文,1:1 比例。三只手工粗陶马克杯,分别是带斑点的奶白、灰陶土色与石板灰釉色,摆在原木搁架上,其中一只翻转露出杯底细小的 "Terracina" 印记。一株垂蔓绿萝与柔和窗光框住画面。温暖、可触的手作氛围,陶土、奶白与绿意的哑光大地色,慵懒的工作室店铺氛围,焦点落在最前面的杯子上。

prompt_en: A luxury fragrance brand post, 4:5. A faceted crystal perfume bottle labeled "Noirée" stands on a black marble pedestal, catching a single dramatic beam of light. Silk fabric in deep burgundy pools around the base, a few fresh rose petals scattered nearby. Dark gradient backdrop with a soft golden glow. Opulent, sensual evening mood, high-contrast lighting, rich black, gold and wine palette, glossy reflections, high-end commercial styling.
prompt_zh: 奢华香水品牌贴文,4:5 比例。一瓶切面水晶香水,标签写着 "Noirée",立在黑色大理石台座上,被一束戏剧性的光线照亮。深勃艮第红丝绸在瓶底铺散,几片新鲜玫瑰花瓣散落一旁。深色渐变背景透出柔和金光。奢靡、感性的夜晚氛围,高对比布光,浓郁的黑、金与酒红配色,光泽反射,高端广告陈列。

prompt_en: A calming tea-brand lifestyle post, 1:1. Overhead shot of a clear glass teapot of golden brew, a paper tin labeled "Verdant Leaf", loose dried tea leaves in a small dish, and a bamboo strainer on a pale linen runner. A sprig of fresh mint and a honey dipper accent the arrangement. Serene, wholesome afternoon mood, soft natural light, muted green, honey and cream palette, minimal styling with airy spacing.
prompt_zh: 沉静的茶叶品牌生活方式贴文,1:1 比例。俯拍一只透明玻璃茶壶,盛着金黄茶汤,一个标着 "Verdant Leaf" 的纸罐、一小碟散装干茶叶,以及一把竹滤网,摆在浅色亚麻桌旗上。一枝新鲜薄荷和一根蜂蜜勺点缀其间。宁静、健康的午后氛围,柔和自然光,茶绿、蜜黄与奶白的低饱和配色,极简陈列,留白通透。

prompt_en: A stationery-brand lifestyle post, 4:5. A tidy desk flatlay with an open dotted planner branded "Pageturn", a row of pastel highlighters, a brass pen, a small potted succulent and a cup of tea in the corner. Neatly handwritten weekly layout visible on the page. Bright soft daylight from the left. Fresh, organized, productive mood, clean pastel-and-white palette, crisp lifestyle photography, satisfying flat-lay symmetry.
prompt_zh: 文具品牌生活方式贴文,4:5 比例。整洁的桌面平铺:一本摊开的点阵手账,品牌为 "Pageturn",一排粉彩荧光笔、一支黄铜笔、一盆小多肉,角落放着一杯茶。手账页上是工整的手写周计划。左侧透入明亮柔和的天光。清新、条理、高效的氛围,干净的粉彩与白色配色,利落的生活方式摄影,令人舒适的平铺对称感。

prompt_en: A sustainable brand lifestyle post, 1:1. A natural canvas tote screen-printed with a small leaf logo and the name "Rootside" hangs on a wooden peg against a whitewashed wall. Fresh farmers-market produce, a baguette and a bunch of wildflowers peek out of the top. Soft daylight and gentle shadow. Wholesome, eco-conscious slow-living mood, earthy natural palette of oat, olive and warm wood, clean documentary-style photography.
prompt_zh: 可持续品牌生活方式贴文,1:1 比例。一只本色帆布托特包,丝网印着一个小叶子标志和品牌名 "Rootside",挂在刷白墙面的木钉上。新鲜的农夫市集蔬果、一根法棍和一束野花从包口探出。柔和天光与轻柔阴影。健康、环保的慢生活氛围,燕麦、橄榄绿与暖木色的自然大地色系,干净的纪实风摄影。

prompt_en: A delicate jewelry-brand post, 4:5. A close-up of layered thin gold necklaces and a single pearl ring displayed on a folded blush-silk cushion, with a small card reading "Aurelin" in fine serif. A softbox reflection glints on the metal. Dried baby's-breath sprigs frame one corner. Elegant, feminine, minimalist luxury mood, warm gold and soft-pink palette, gentle highlights, macro clarity, premium editorial styling.
prompt_zh: 精致的珠宝品牌贴文,4:5 比例。特写一组层叠的细金项链和一枚珍珠戒指,陈列在折叠的腮红色丝绸垫上,旁边有一张小卡片,用纤细衬线写着 "Aurelin"。柔光箱的反射在金属上闪烁。干满天星点缀一角。优雅、女性化的极简轻奢氛围,暖金与柔粉配色,柔和高光,微距清晰,精致的杂志感陈列。

prompt_en: A bold product-launch post, 1:1. A single chunky white-and-electric-lime sneaker floats center against a split background of concrete grey and vivid lime. Big condensed type declares "NEW DROP" above and "FRIDAY 10AM" below, with the invented brand "VOLTA" small in the corner. Dynamic diagonal speed lines radiate behind the shoe. Hype, streetwear energy, high-contrast bold palette, crisp studio product lighting, subtle floating shadow.
prompt_zh: 醒目的产品发售贴文,1:1 比例。一只厚底的白配电光青柠色球鞋悬浮在画面中央,背景是水泥灰与鲜亮青柠色的对半分割。上方用粗窄字体宣告 "NEW DROP",下方写 "FRIDAY 10AM",角落是虚构品牌 "VOLTA" 的小字。鞋后放射出动感的斜向速度线。潮流炒作、街头风的能量,高对比的醒目配色,利落的棚拍产品光,鞋下有微妙的悬浮阴影。

prompt_en: A skincare product-launch post, 4:5. A single dewy serum bottle labeled "Halo Glow" stands centered on a soft peach gradient backdrop, surrounded by floating water droplets and a slice of fresh orange. Elegant text above reads "Introducing your morning glow" with "NEW" in a small rounded badge. Fresh, radiant, clean-beauty mood, bright airy peach-and-white palette, glossy dewy highlights, crisp product photography, gentle glow around the bottle.
prompt_zh: 护肤产品发布贴文,4:5 比例。一瓶水润精华露,标签写着 "Halo Glow",立于柔和的蜜桃渐变背景中央,四周漂浮着水珠和一片新鲜橙子。上方优雅文字写着 "Introducing your morning glow","NEW" 落在一个圆角小徽章里。清新、焕亮、净颜美妆的氛围,明亮通透的蜜桃与白色配色,水润光泽高光,利落的产品摄影,瓶身周围有柔和光晕。

prompt_en: A tech product-launch post, 1:1. A pair of matte-white wireless earbuds in an open pebble-shaped case levitates on a cool graphite-to-navy gradient, glowing rim light around the edges. Sleek text reads "Meet Aura Buds. Sound, reimagined." with a small "PRE-ORDER NOW" pill button. Faint sound-wave rings ripple outward. Futuristic, premium, minimalist tech mood, cool blue-grey palette, crisp reflections, dramatic studio lighting.
prompt_zh: 科技产品发布贴文,1:1 比例。一副哑光白无线耳机装在打开的鹅卵石形充电盒里,悬浮于冷调石墨灰到藏青的渐变背景上,边缘环绕发光轮廓光。简洁文字写着 "Meet Aura Buds. Sound, reimagined.",配一个小小的 "PRE-ORDER NOW" 胶囊按钮。淡淡的声波环向外扩散。未来感、高端、极简的科技氛围,冷蓝灰配色,利落反射,戏剧性棚拍布光。

prompt_en: A coffee product-launch post, 4:5. A kraft coffee bag labeled "Cinder & Oak — House Blend" stands upright surrounded by roasted beans spilling across a dark slate surface, a steaming cup beside it. Warm text above reads "Now roasting: our new House Blend" with a small "LIMITED BATCH" stamp. Cozy, artisanal, inviting mood, warm brown-and-cream palette, moody directional light, rich texture, appetizing product styling.
prompt_zh: 咖啡产品上市贴文,4:5 比例。一个牛皮纸咖啡袋,标签写着 "Cinder & Oak — House Blend",直立摆放,四周是散落在深板岩台面上的烘焙咖啡豆,旁边一杯冒着热气的咖啡。上方暖色文字写着 "Now roasting: our new House Blend",配一枚 "LIMITED BATCH" 小印章。慵懒、手作、诱人的氛围,暖棕与奶白配色,氛围感侧光,质感丰富,令人食欲大开的产品陈列。

prompt_en: An app-launch announcement, 9:16 story format. A floating smartphone mockup displays a clean habit-tracker interface with soft cards and a progress ring, app named "Sprout". Rounded 3D shapes and a leaf icon float in a mint-and-cream gradient background. Bold text reads "Build better habits, one day at a time" with an "AVAILABLE NOW" rounded button. Friendly, fresh, approachable tech mood, mint-green pastel palette, soft drop shadows, playful modern UI styling.
prompt_zh: 应用上线公告,9:16 竖屏故事版式。一部悬浮的智能手机样机展示简洁的习惯打卡界面,带柔和卡片和进度环,应用名为 "Sprout"。圆润的 3D 形状和一个叶子图标漂浮在薄荷绿与奶白的渐变背景中。醒目文字写着 "Build better habits, one day at a time",配一个 "AVAILABLE NOW" 圆角按钮。友好、清新、平易近人的科技氛围,薄荷绿粉彩配色,柔和投影,俏皮的现代 UI 风格。

prompt_en: A book-launch announcement post, 4:5. A hardcover novel titled "The Weight of Light" by invented author "M. Halloran" rests on a stack of two closed books beside a mug and dried flowers on a linen bedspread. Overlay text reads "Out now, everywhere books are sold" in an elegant serif. Cozy reading-nook mood, warm afternoon light, muted cream, sage and dusty-blue palette, soft lifestyle photography with a shallow, dreamy focus.
prompt_zh: 新书发布公告贴文,4:5 比例。一本精装小说,书名为 "The Weight of Light",作者是虚构的 "M. Halloran",搁在两本合上的书堆上,旁边是一只马克杯和干花,置于亚麻床品上。叠加文字用优雅衬线写着 "Out now, everywhere books are sold"。慵懒的阅读角氛围,温暖午后光,奶白、鼠尾草绿与灰蓝的低饱和配色,柔和的生活方式摄影,浅而梦幻的焦点。

prompt_en: A fashion product-launch post, 4:5. A neatly folded knitwear flatlay in caramel, cream and rust tones on a warm oat backdrop, with a leather belt and gold hoop earrings arranged alongside. Elegant text overlays "THE AUTUMN EDIT" at the top and "Shop the collection" below, brand "Maren & Co" in small type. Sophisticated, seasonal, editorial mood, cozy autumn palette of caramel, cream and rust, soft warm light, refined styling.
prompt_zh: 时装上新贴文,4:5 比例。焦糖色、奶白与铁锈色的针织衫整齐折叠平铺在温暖燕麦色背景上,旁边搭配一条皮带和金色圆环耳环。优雅文字上方叠加 "THE AUTUMN EDIT",下方写 "Shop the collection",品牌 "Maren & Co" 以小字呈现。精致、应季、杂志感的氛围,焦糖、奶白与铁锈色的温暖秋季配色,柔和暖光,考究的陈列。

prompt_en: A candle product-launch post, 1:1. Three matte-glass candles in olive, terracotta and cream stand in a row on a wooden ledge, each labeled with a new scent — "Fig & Cedar", "Amber Dusk", "Sea Salt" — brand "Ashcroft Home". Dried grasses and one lit flame accent the scene. Top text reads "Introducing three new scents". Warm, cozy, inviting home mood, earthy olive-terracotta-cream palette, soft golden light, tactile styling.
prompt_zh: 香氛蜡烛新品发布贴文,1:1 比例。三支哑光玻璃蜡烛,分别是橄榄绿、陶土色与奶白,一字排开摆在木质搁板上,各自贴着新香标签 —— "Fig & Cedar"、"Amber Dusk"、"Sea Salt",品牌为 "Ashcroft Home"。干草与一簇点燃的火焰点缀画面。顶部文字写着 "Introducing three new scents"。温暖、慵懒、诱人的居家氛围,橄榄、陶土与奶白的大地色系,柔和金光,可触的质感陈列。

prompt_en: A beverage product-launch post, 4:5. A tall glass of layered iced matcha latte sits center on a soft sage backdrop, condensation on the glass, a bamboo whisk and a ceramic bowl of bright green matcha powder beside it. Overlay text reads "Limited edition: Ceremonial Matcha" with a small "WHILE IT LASTS" tag, brand "Kumo Tea". Fresh, vibrant, wellness cafe mood, calming green-and-cream palette, bright natural light, appetizing crisp styling.
prompt_zh: 饮品新品发布贴文,4:5 比例。一杯高身分层冰抹茶拿铁置于柔和鼠尾草绿背景中央,杯壁凝着水珠,旁边有一把竹茶筅和一只盛着鲜绿抹茶粉的陶碗。叠加文字写着 "Limited edition: Ceremonial Matcha",配一枚 "WHILE IT LASTS" 小标签,品牌为 "Kumo Tea"。清新、鲜活的养生咖啡氛围,舒缓的抹茶绿与奶白配色,明亮自然光,诱人利落的陈列。

prompt_en: A product-launch post, 1:1. A sleek insulated water bottle in a soft dusty-blue finish stands center on a clean gradient of sky-blue to white, a few playful water splashes frozen mid-air around it. Bold text reads "Stay cold for 24 hours" above and "NEW COLORS" below, brand "Driftwell". Small color-swatch dots line the base. Fresh, active, clean product mood, cool blue-and-white palette, crisp studio lighting, glossy reflections.
prompt_zh: 产品上市贴文,1:1 比例。一只线条流畅的保温水瓶,采用柔和的灰蓝色调,立于天蓝到白色的干净渐变背景中央,四周几束顽皮的水花凝固在半空。醒目文字上方写 "Stay cold for 24 hours",下方写 "NEW COLORS",品牌为 "Driftwell"。底部排着一列小色卡圆点。清新、活力、干净的产品氛围,冷调蓝白配色,利落棚拍布光,光泽反射。

prompt_en: A carousel cover graphic, 4:5. Warm cream background with a large hand-drawn sun rising over a thin horizon line. Bold friendly headline reads "5 Morning Habits That Changed My Life" with the number "5" oversized in soft terracotta. A small "SWIPE →" prompt and page-dots sit at the bottom. Simple line-art icons of a mug, book and stretch pose dot the corners. Warm, inviting, self-improvement mood, cozy cream-and-terracotta palette, clean flat design.
prompt_zh: 轮播封面图,4:5 比例。温暖的奶白背景上,一轮手绘太阳在纤细的地平线上升起。醒目而友好的标题写着 "5 Morning Habits That Changed My Life",数字 "5" 用柔和陶土色超大号呈现。底部有一个 "SWIPE →" 提示和页码圆点。角落点缀马克杯、书本和伸展姿势的线描小图标。温暖、亲切的自我提升氛围,奶白与陶土色的暖调配色,干净的扁平设计。

prompt_en: A finance-tips carousel cover, 1:1. Deep forest-green background with a subtle gold coin-and-leaf pattern in the corners. Clean modern headline reads "7 Money Habits for Your 20s" with a small gold piggy-bank line icon. A "SAVE THIS POST" bookmark ribbon curls in the top right, page-dots at the bottom. Trustworthy, polished, aspirational finance mood, rich green-and-gold palette, elegant sans-serif type, crisp minimal layout.
prompt_zh: 理财技巧轮播封面,1:1 比例。深森林绿背景,四角有淡淡的金色硬币与叶片图案。简洁现代的标题写着 "7 Money Habits for Your 20s",配一个金色储钱罐线描小图标。右上角卷着一条 "SAVE THIS POST" 书签飘带,底部是页码圆点。可信、精致、令人向往的理财氛围,浓郁的绿金配色,优雅的无衬线字体,利落的极简版式。

prompt_en: A skincare-tips carousel cover, 4:5. Soft blush-pink background with a gentle glossy sheen. Elegant headline reads "Your Perfect Night Routine in 4 Steps" with delicate line icons of a bottle, drop, cream jar and moon arranged in a row. A thin "SWIPE TO SEE →" prompt sits below with page-dots. Fresh, clean-beauty, calming mood, soft pink-and-cream palette, minimal airy layout, thin modern serif typography.
prompt_zh: 护肤技巧轮播封面,4:5 比例。柔和的腮红粉背景带轻微光泽。优雅标题写着 "Your Perfect Night Routine in 4 Steps",一排纤细线描图标依次是瓶子、水滴、面霜罐和月亮。下方是细细的 "SWIPE TO SEE →" 提示和页码圆点。清新、净颜美妆、舒缓的氛围,柔粉与奶白配色,极简通透版式,纤细的现代衬线字体。

prompt_en: A productivity-tips carousel cover, 1:1. Clean off-white background with a bold navy header block across the top reading "6 Focus Hacks for Deep Work". A large minimalist line illustration of a laptop, coffee and a checklist sits centered. A yellow highlighter swipe underlines "Deep Work". Page-dots and a small "→" cue at the bottom right. Sharp, professional, motivating mood, navy-white-and-yellow palette, grid-aligned clean layout, confident sans-serif type.
prompt_zh: 效率技巧轮播封面,1:1 比例。干净的米白背景,顶部横贯一条醒目的藏青标题块,写着 "6 Focus Hacks for Deep Work"。中央是笔记本电脑、咖啡和清单的大号极简线描插画。一道黄色荧光笔划线强调 "Deep Work"。右下角有页码圆点和一个小 "→" 提示。利落、专业、激励人心的氛围,藏青、白与黄的配色,网格对齐的干净版式,自信的无衬线字体。

prompt_en: A recipe carousel cover, 4:5. Overhead of a rustic bowl of creamy tomato pasta on a wooden table, fresh basil and a fork beside it. A translucent warm-white band across the middle holds the headline "15-Minute Creamy Tomato Pasta" in a friendly bold serif, with a small "RECIPE INSIDE →" tag and page-dots. Appetizing, homey, warm mood, rich red-and-cream food palette, soft natural light, cozy food-blog styling.
prompt_zh: 食谱轮播封面,4:5 比例。俯拍木桌上一碗质朴的奶油番茄意面,旁边是新鲜罗勒和一把叉子。画面中部横贯一条半透明的暖白色条带,承载标题 "15-Minute Creamy Tomato Pasta",采用友好的粗衬线字体,配一枚 "RECIPE INSIDE →" 小标签和页码圆点。诱人、温馨的居家氛围,浓郁的红与奶白食物配色,柔和自然光,慵懒的美食博客风陈列。

prompt_en: A travel-tips carousel cover, 1:1. Flatlay of a neatly packed open carry-on suitcase with rolled clothes, a passport, sunglasses and a small camera on a warm sand background. A clean overlay band reads "Pack a Week in One Carry-On" with a small airplane line icon, plus "SWIPE FOR TIPS →" and page-dots. Fresh, wanderlust, practical mood, warm sand-and-teal palette, bright even light, tidy organized flat-lay styling.
prompt_zh: 旅行技巧轮播封面,1:1 比例。平铺一只打包整齐的敞开登机箱,里面是卷好的衣物、一本护照、墨镜和一台小相机,置于暖沙色背景上。干净的叠加条带写着 "Pack a Week in One Carry-On",配一个小飞机线描图标,还有 "SWIPE FOR TIPS →" 和页码圆点。清新、心向远方、实用的氛围,暖沙色与青蓝配色,明亮均匀的光,整洁有序的平铺陈列。

prompt_en: A home-tips carousel cover, 4:5. A bright, tidy corner of a small apartment with floating shelves, woven baskets and a trailing plant, styled minimally. A soft cream banner reads "10 Small-Space Storage Ideas" in a clean rounded font, with a small basket line icon, "SWIPE →" and page-dots. Fresh, calm, inspiring home mood, airy white-and-natural-wood palette, soft daylight, clean scandi-style photography with plenty of light.
prompt_zh: 家居技巧轮播封面,4:5 比例。一间小公寓明亮整洁的角落,有隔板搁架、编织篮筐和一株垂蔓植物,极简陈列。柔和的奶白横幅用干净的圆体字写着 "10 Small-Space Storage Ideas",配一个小篮筐线描图标、"SWIPE →" 和页码圆点。清新、宁静、启发灵感的居家氛围,通透的白与原木色配色,柔和天光,干净的北欧风摄影,光线充足。

prompt_en: A marketing-tips carousel cover, 1:1. Bold gradient background from coral to hot-pink with subtle grain. Big punchy headline reads "Grow Your First 1,000 Followers" with "1,000" oversized in glossy white. A small line-art rocket and upward chart accent the corners, "SAVE + SWIPE →" prompt and page-dots at the bottom. Energetic, confident, creator-economy mood, vibrant coral-pink palette, modern bold sans-serif, punchy high-contrast layout.
prompt_zh: 营销技巧轮播封面,1:1 比例。珊瑚橘到亮粉的醒目渐变背景带细腻颗粒。硕大有冲击力的标题写着 "Grow Your First 1,000 Followers","1,000" 用光泽白超大号呈现。角落点缀一个线描小火箭和上升折线图,底部有 "SAVE + SWIPE →" 提示和页码圆点。充满活力、自信的创作者经济氛围,鲜亮的珊瑚粉配色,现代粗体无衬线,有冲击力的高对比版式。

prompt_en: A book-list carousel cover, 4:5. A warm library-toned background with a soft stack of colorful book spines illustrated along the bottom edge. Elegant headline reads "5 Books That Rewired How I Think" in a classic serif, with a tiny reading-glasses line icon. A "SWIPE FOR THE LIST →" prompt and page-dots below. Cozy, intellectual, inviting mood, warm burgundy, mustard and cream palette, soft vintage-paper texture, refined literary styling.
prompt_zh: 书单轮播封面,4:5 比例。温暖图书馆色调的背景,底部边缘插画绘着一摞五彩书脊。优雅标题用经典衬线写着 "5 Books That Rewired How I Think",配一个小小的老花镜线描图标。下方是 "SWIPE FOR THE LIST →" 提示和页码圆点。慵懒、知性、亲切的氛围,勃艮第红、芥末黄与奶白的暖调配色,柔和的复古纸张肌理,考究的文艺陈列。

prompt_en: A wellness carousel cover, 1:1. Soft lavender-to-blush gradient background with a few drifting cloud shapes. Gentle rounded headline reads "Your Cozy Self-Care Sunday Reset" with small hand-drawn icons of a candle, teacup and bath. A "SWIPE FOR IDEAS →" prompt and page-dots at the bottom. Calm, nurturing, soothing mood, dreamy lavender-and-blush pastel palette, soft airy layout, delicate friendly typography with plenty of white space.
prompt_zh: 疗愈轮播封面,1:1 比例。柔和的薰衣草紫到腮红粉渐变背景,几朵飘浮的云形。温柔的圆体标题写着 "Your Cozy Self-Care Sunday Reset",配蜡烛、茶杯和浴缸的手绘小图标。底部是 "SWIPE FOR IDEAS →" 提示和页码圆点。宁静、滋养、舒缓的氛围,梦幻的薰衣草紫与腮红粉的粉彩配色,通透的版式,精致友好的字体,大量留白。

prompt_en: A café lifestyle post, 1:1. Directly overhead shot of a flat-white with delicate rosetta latte art in a matte-grey ceramic cup on a marble café table. A folded newspaper corner, a brass spoon and a few coffee beans styled beside it. Soft window light casts a gentle shadow across the marble. Cozy, aesthetic, slow-café mood, warm cream-and-grey palette, crisp appetizing detail, minimalist top-down composition with negative space.
prompt_zh: 咖啡馆生活方式贴文,1:1 比例。正上方俯拍一杯馥芮白,哑光灰陶瓷杯中是精致的叶形拉花,置于大理石咖啡桌上。旁边陈列着报纸的折角、一把黄铜勺和几颗咖啡豆。柔和窗光在大理石上投下轻柔阴影。慵懒、有美感的慢咖啡氛围,温暖的奶白与灰调配色,利落诱人的细节,极简俯拍构图,留有余白。

prompt_en: A food-lifestyle brunch post, 4:5. Overhead of a bright brunch spread on a white table: a plate of golden fluffy pancakes drizzled with syrup and berries, a green smoothie, a small vase of tulips and two hands holding forks about to dig in. Bright airy morning light. Fresh, joyful, weekend mood, cheerful berry-red, green and cream palette, appetizing crisp textures, inviting lifestyle food photography.
prompt_zh: 美食生活方式早午餐贴文,4:5 比例。俯拍白色桌面上明亮丰盛的早午餐:一盘金黄松软的松饼,淋着糖浆和莓果,一杯青蔬奶昔,一小瓶郁金香,还有两只握着叉子准备开动的手。明亮通透的晨光。清新、欢愉的周末氛围,愉悦的莓红、绿与奶白配色,诱人利落的质感,亲切的生活方式美食摄影。

prompt_en: A café lifestyle post, 4:5. A flaky golden croissant on a small ceramic plate beside a cappuccino, on a round bistro table by a sunlit window. Buttery crumbs scattered, a paperback book and reading glasses nearby. Warm morning sunbeams cast long shadows and highlight the pastry's flaky layers. Cozy, indulgent, Parisian-café mood, warm golden-brown-and-cream palette, soft glowing light, appetizing shallow-focus lifestyle photography.
prompt_zh: 咖啡馆生活方式贴文,4:5 比例。一只酥脆金黄的可颂放在小陶瓷盘上,旁边是一杯卡布奇诺,置于阳光洒落的窗边圆桌上。散落着黄油碎屑,附近有一本平装书和老花镜。温暖的晨光投下长影,勾勒出可颂酥脆的层次。慵懒、惬意的巴黎咖啡馆氛围,温暖的金棕与奶白配色,柔和的发光光线,诱人的浅焦生活方式摄影。

prompt_en: A café lifestyle post, 1:1. A tall clear glass of layered iced matcha latte — creamy white milk fading into vivid green — on a pale wooden table, condensation dripping down the glass, a paper straw and a single sprig of mint on top. Soft dappled light through leaves in the background. Fresh, calming, aesthetic-café mood, soothing green-and-cream palette, bright natural light, clean minimal styling with airy space.
prompt_zh: 咖啡馆生活方式贴文,1:1 比例。一杯高身透明玻璃杯装的分层冰抹茶拿铁 —— 奶白牛奶渐变为鲜绿抹茶 —— 置于浅色木桌上,杯壁挂着水珠往下淌,插着一根纸吸管,顶上放一枝薄荷。背景是透过树叶的斑驳柔光。清新、舒缓的美学咖啡馆氛围,舒心的抹茶绿与奶白配色,明亮自然光,干净极简的陈列,留白通透。

prompt_en: A food-lifestyle post, 4:5. Overhead flatlay of two slices of rustic sourdough avocado toast topped with cherry tomatoes, chili flakes and microgreens, on a speckled ceramic plate. A halved avocado, a squeezed lemon and a linen napkin styled around it on a warm oat table. Bright natural light. Fresh, wholesome, healthy-brunch mood, vibrant green-red-and-oat palette, crisp appetizing textures, clean lifestyle food styling.
prompt_zh: 美食生活方式贴文,4:5 比例。俯拍平铺两片质朴酸种面包做的牛油果吐司,上面点缀圣女果、辣椒碎和微型菜苗,盛在带斑点的陶瓷盘上。周围陈列着切半的牛油果、挤过的柠檬和一块亚麻餐巾,置于温暖燕麦色桌面。明亮自然光。清新、健康的早午餐氛围,鲜活的绿、红与燕麦色配色,利落诱人的质感,干净的生活方式美食陈列。

prompt_en: A dessert-lifestyle post, 1:1. A close-up slice of layered vanilla sponge cake with cream and fresh raspberries on a small vintage plate, a fork lifting a bite. A whole cake softly blurred behind, dried flowers and a cup of tea in the frame. Soft warm café light. Indulgent, sweet, inviting mood, blush-pink, cream and berry-red palette, dreamy shallow focus, appetizing tactile texture, cozy dessert styling.
prompt_zh: 甜点生活方式贴文,1:1 比例。特写一块夹心香草海绵蛋糕,配奶油和新鲜树莓,盛在复古小盘上,一把叉子正舀起一口。背景是柔焦的整块蛋糕,画面里还有干花和一杯茶。柔和温暖的咖啡馆光。惬意、香甜、诱人的氛围,腮红粉、奶白与莓红配色,梦幻浅焦,诱人可触的质感,慵懒的甜点陈列。

prompt_en: A café lifestyle post, 4:5. A warm cozy café corner: a small round wooden table by a large window, a cappuccino and an open notebook on it, a rattan chair, hanging plants and warm pendant lights overhead. Soft afternoon sun streams in, dust motes drifting in the light. Inviting, relaxed, work-from-café mood, warm brown, green and cream palette, gentle golden light, atmospheric lifestyle photography with depth.
prompt_zh: 咖啡馆生活方式贴文,4:5 比例。一处温暖惬意的咖啡馆角落:大窗边一张木质小圆桌,桌上放着一杯卡布奇诺和一本摊开的笔记本,一把藤椅、垂挂的绿植和头顶暖色吊灯。柔和午后阳光洒入,尘埃在光束中飘动。亲切、放松的咖啡馆办公氛围,温暖的棕、绿与奶白配色,柔和金光,富有层次的氛围生活方式摄影。

prompt_en: A food-lifestyle post, 1:1. Overhead of a vibrant pink dragonfruit smoothie bowl topped with neat rows of banana slices, blueberries, granola, coconut flakes and a drizzle of honey, in a light ceramic bowl on a bright white table. A few loose berries and a wooden spoon beside it. Bright sunny light. Fresh, energetic, healthy-breakfast mood, cheerful pink-and-white palette, crisp appetizing detail, clean top-down styling.
prompt_zh: 美食生活方式贴文,1:1 比例。俯拍一碗鲜艳的粉色火龙果奶昔碗,顶部整齐码放着香蕉片、蓝莓、燕麦脆、椰片,淋上一圈蜂蜜,盛在浅色陶瓷碗中,置于明亮白桌上。旁边散落几颗莓果和一把木勺。明亮阳光。清新、活力的健康早餐氛围,愉悦的粉与白配色,利落诱人的细节,干净的俯拍陈列。

prompt_en: A food-lifestyle post, 4:5. A candle-lit rustic dinner scene: a bowl of twirled spaghetti with herbs and parmesan on a dark wooden table, a glass of red wine, fresh basil, a torn piece of bread and a linen napkin. Warm low candlelight glows across the table. Intimate, indulgent, evening-dinner mood, moody warm palette of deep red, green and amber, soft dramatic light, appetizing shallow focus, cozy trattoria styling.
prompt_zh: 美食生活方式贴文,4:5 比例。烛光下质朴的晚餐场景:深色木桌上一碗卷成团的意面,撒着香草和帕玛森芝士,一杯红酒、新鲜罗勒、一块撕开的面包和一条亚麻餐巾。温暖低柔的烛光在桌面上流淌。私密、惬意的夜晚晚餐氛围,深红、绿与琥珀的暖调氛围色,柔和戏剧性光线,诱人的浅焦,慵懒的意式小馆陈列。

prompt_zh: 美学情绪板贴文,1:1 比例。一个秋日瞬间的拼贴网格:粗针织毯上冒着热气的马克杯、飘落的橙色枫叶、一支点燃的琥珀蜡烛,以及一摞放着老花镜的书。温暖的金色午后光线将各格统一。慵懒、怀旧的北欧 hygge 氛围,和谐的铁锈、芥末、焦糖与奶白配色,柔和可触的质感,温暖的杂志感拼贴,满是亲切舒适的秋意。

prompt_en: An aesthetic mood-board post, 4:5. A soft feminine collage grid: a satin bow, blush peonies, a pearl necklace, a ballet slipper and a strawberry pastry. Delicate soft light and a dreamy haze tie the panels together. Romantic, delicate, coquette mood, cohesive blush-pink, cream and pearl palette, soft glowing textures, pretty editorial collage with airy spacing and a sweet, whimsical, ultra-feminine feel.
prompt_zh: 美学情绪板贴文,4:5 比例。一个柔美女性化的拼贴网格:一个缎面蝴蝶结、腮红色芍药、一串珍珠项链、一只芭蕾舞鞋和一块草莓酥点。精致柔和的光与梦幻薄雾将各格串联。浪漫、精致的少女 coquette 氛围,和谐的腮红粉、奶白与珍珠色配色,柔和发光的质感,漂亮的杂志感拼贴,间距通透,甜美俏皮、极致女性化。

prompt_en: An aesthetic mood-board post, 1:1. A moody scholarly collage grid: an old leather-bound book, a fountain pen and ink, a candle beside a tweed blazer, and a rainy library window. Dim warm lamplight unifies the frames. Intellectual, mysterious, dark-academia mood, cohesive deep-brown, forest-green, oxblood and cream palette, rich vintage textures, atmospheric editorial collage with a nostalgic, studious, timeless feel.
prompt_zh: 美学情绪板贴文,1:1 比例。一个氛围感十足的学者拼贴网格:一本旧皮革精装书、一支钢笔配墨水、粗花呢西装旁的一支蜡烛,以及一扇雨中的图书馆窗户。昏暗温暖的灯光将各格统一。知性、神秘的暗黑学院氛围,和谐的深棕、森林绿、牛血红与奶白配色,浓郁的复古质感,富有氛围的杂志感拼贴,怀旧、好学、隽永。

prompt_en: An aesthetic mood-board post, 4:5. A whimsical cottage collage grid: a wildflower bouquet in an enamel jug, a wicker basket of fresh strawberries, a linen apron on a wooden fence, and a butterfly on lavender. Soft dappled garden light unifies the panels. Whimsical, wholesome, cottagecore mood, cohesive sage-green, butter-yellow, dusty-rose and cream palette, soft natural textures, gentle editorial collage with a dreamy pastoral feel.
prompt_zh: 美学情绪板贴文,4:5 比例。一个俏皮的田园小屋拼贴网格:搪瓷壶里的野花束、一篮新鲜草莓、木栅栏上的亚麻围裙,以及薰衣草上的一只蝴蝶。柔和斑驳的花园光线将各格统一。俏皮、健康的田园森系氛围,和谐的鼠尾草绿、奶油黄、灰玫瑰与奶白配色,柔和的自然质感,温柔的杂志感拼贴,满是梦幻的田园气息。

prompt_en: An aesthetic mood-board post, 1:1. A playful Y2K collage grid: a translucent frosted flip-phone, holographic star stickers, butterfly hair clips, chunky platform sneakers and a lip-gloss tube. Bright glossy studio light and a slight chrome shine tie the panels together. Fun, nostalgic, early-2000s mood, cohesive bubblegum-pink, baby-blue, lilac and silver palette, shiny playful textures, vibrant editorial collage with a bold retro-pop feel.
prompt_zh: 美学情绪板贴文,1:1 比例。一个俏皮的 Y2K 拼贴网格:一部半透明磨砂翻盖手机、镭射星星贴纸、蝴蝶发夹、厚底松糕鞋和一支唇彩。明亮光泽的棚拍光与一丝铬金属光将各格串联。有趣、怀旧的千禧初氛围,和谐的泡泡糖粉、婴儿蓝、丁香紫与银色配色,闪亮俏皮的质感,鲜活的杂志感拼贴,大胆的复古波普感。

prompt_en: An aesthetic mood-board post, 4:5. A clean Scandinavian collage grid: a pale-wood chair, a white ceramic vase with a single branch, a folded grey wool throw, and soft geometric shadows on a white wall. Bright even Nordic daylight unifies the panels. Calm, airy, minimalist-Scandi mood, cohesive white, pale-wood and soft-grey palette, smooth matte textures, refined editorial collage with generous white space and a serene, uncluttered feel.
prompt_zh: 美学情绪板贴文,4:5 比例。一个干净的北欧拼贴网格:一把浅木椅、插着一枝枝条的白陶花瓶、一条折叠的灰羊毛毯,以及白墙上柔和的几何阴影。明亮均匀的北欧天光将各格统一。宁静、通透的北欧极简氛围,和谐的白、浅木与柔灰配色,平滑的哑光质感,考究的杂志感拼贴,大量留白,静谧而清爽。

prompt_en: An aesthetic mood-board post, 1:1. A golden-hour collage grid: a sun flaring over rippling water, warm palm-frond shadows on a wall, a glass of orange spritz, and a silk scarf catching amber light. Glowing warm sunset light unifies the panels. Dreamy, warm, golden-hour mood, cohesive tangerine, coral, amber and soft-peach palette, glowing hazy textures, luminous editorial collage with a nostalgic, radiant summer-evening feel.
prompt_zh: 美学情绪板贴文,1:1 比例。一个黄金时刻的拼贴网格:太阳在粼粼水面上迸出光芒、墙上温暖的棕榈叶影、一杯橙色气泡饮,以及一条丝巾承接着琥珀光。发光的暖调落日光线将各格统一。梦幻、温暖的黄金时刻氛围,和谐的橘橙、珊瑚、琥珀与柔桃色配色,发光朦胧的质感,明亮的杂志感拼贴,满是怀旧而灿烂的夏日傍晚感。

prompt_en: An aesthetic mood-board post, 4:5. A lush botanical collage grid: a monstera leaf close-up, a hand misting a fern, a row of small potted plants on a windowsill, and dewdrops on green foliage. Soft fresh daylight unifies the panels. Fresh, calming, plant-lover mood, cohesive emerald, sage and soft-white palette, crisp natural textures, clean editorial collage with an airy, revitalizing, green-thumb feel.
prompt_zh: 美学情绪板贴文,4:5 比例。一个葱郁的植物拼贴网格:龟背竹叶片的特写、一只手在给蕨类喷雾、窗台上一排小盆栽,以及绿叶上的露珠。柔和清新的天光将各格统一。清新、舒缓的植物爱好者氛围,和谐的翡翠绿、鼠尾草绿与柔白配色,利落的自然质感,干净的杂志感拼贴,通透而焕活,满是绿手指气息。

prompt_en: A festive Christmas sale banner for an invented home-goods brand 'Frostpine'. A centered bold cream slab-serif headline 'HOLIDAY SALE — UP TO 40% OFF' sits over a deep pine-green background. Hand-drawn flat illustrations of red baubles, gold snowflakes, a holly sprig and candy canes frame the four corners. A red rounded pill at the bottom reads 'Ends December 24'. Warm, cozy, cheerful mood; pine-green, cream, red and gold palette; crisp vector style, symmetrical layout with generous negative space.
prompt_zh: 为虚构家居品牌'Frostpine'设计的圣诞促销横幅。深松绿色背景,正中是奶油色粗衬线大标题'HOLIDAY SALE — UP TO 40% OFF'。四角用手绘扁平插画点缀:红色圣诞球、金色雪花、一束冬青和拐杖糖。底部一枚红色圆角胶囊写着'Ends December 24'。温暖惬意、欢快;松绿、奶油、红与金配色;干净矢量风格,对称构图,留白充足。

prompt_en: An elegant New Year's Eve social graphic. A pure black background carries a shimmering gold-foil headline 'CHEERS TO 2027' in tall condensed serif capitals. Below it a champagne coupe glass rises with bubbles rendered as tiny gold dots, and gold-and-white confetti drifts across the whole frame. A thin script subheading reads 'Midnight countdown starts here'. Luxe, celebratory, sparkling mood; high-contrast black-and-gold palette; centered vertical composition with metallic texture and soft glow.
prompt_zh: 优雅的跨年夜社交图。纯黑背景顶部是闪耀的金箔大标题'CHEERS TO 2027',瘦长衬线大写字母。下方一只香槟浅口杯,上升气泡用细小金点表现,金白彩纸屑洒满整个画面。细手写体副标'Midnight countdown starts here'。奢华、喜庆、闪耀;高对比黑金配色;居中竖构图,金属质感与柔光。

prompt_en: A cozy Christmas greeting card where the whole scene looks knitted from chunky wool. A cream cable-knit background carries a red-and-white Fair Isle border of reindeer and snowflakes. Centered, the words 'Warm Wishes This Season' appear as if stitched in green yarn. A small knitted robin perches on a knitted pine branch in the lower right. Soft, tactile, homely mood; heritage palette of oatmeal, brick red and forest green; visible wool fibers and stitch texture throughout.
