prompt_zh: 整幅像用粗毛线针织出来的圣诞贺卡。奶油色麻花针织背景,配红白相间的驯鹿雪花北欧提花花边。正中'Warm Wishes This Season'仿佛用绿色毛线绣成。右下角一只针织知更鸟停在针织松枝上。温暖、有质感、居家;燕麦米、砖红与森林绿复古配色;通篇可见毛线纤维与针脚纹理。

prompt_en: A playful 3D-rendered Christmas gift-guide graphic for invented shop 'Lumo'. In a soft clay-render style, three glossy wrapped presents in red, mint and mustard with satin bows float on a pastel-pink stage with soft drop shadows. A rounded white 3D balloon-letter headline 'THE GIFT EDIT' arcs across the top, with a small caption 'Shop under $50'. Cute, soft, toy-like mood; pastel candy palette; centered hero layout, studio softbox lighting, rounded glossy surfaces.
prompt_zh: 为虚构小店'Lumo'设计的俏皮 3D 圣诞礼物精选图。柔和黏土渲染风格:红、薄荷绿、芥末黄三个带缎带蝴蝶结的光泽礼盒,漂浮在粉彩粉色舞台上,带柔和投影。顶部弧形排布白色 3D 气球字标题'THE GIFT EDIT',下方小字'Shop under $50'。可爱、柔软、玩具感;粉彩糖果配色;居中主体布局,柔光箱打光。

prompt_en: A minimal New Year intentions social post. A warm off-white paper-textured background carries a thin editorial serif headline 'New Year, New Chapter' at the top left. Below it, a short hand-drawn checklist with three ticked boxes reads 'Move more', 'Read 12 books' and 'Say yes'. A single fine-line illustration of a sprouting plant sits in the lower right in sage green. Calm, aspirational, quiet mood; ivory, charcoal and sage palette; airy asymmetric layout with lots of whitespace.
prompt_zh: 极简的新年愿望社交图。温暖米白纸质纹理背景,左上是细窄杂志衬线标题'New Year, New Chapter'。下方一份手绘清单,三个已打钩的小方框写着'Move more'、'Read 12 books'、'Say yes'。右下角一株细线条鼠尾草绿嫩芽插画。平静、向往、安静;象牙白、炭灰与鼠尾草绿配色;通透的非对称布局,大量留白。

prompt_en: A charming winter-drinks promo for invented cafe 'Cocoa Lane'. A deep navy background is dusted with tiny white snow specks. Centered is an illustration of a steaming mug of hot cocoa topped with marshmallows and a candy cane, wrapped in a knitted scarf. A warm creamy-white headline reads 'WINTER WARMERS ARE BACK', and a ribbon price tag reads 'From $4.50'. Cozy, inviting, hand-illustrated mood; navy, cream and caramel palette; vertical poster layout with soft grain.
prompt_zh: 为虚构咖啡馆'Cocoa Lane'设计的冬日暖饮宣传图。深藏青背景撒着细小白雪点。正中一杯冒热气的热可可,顶着棉花糖和拐杖糖,裹着针织围巾。奶白色暖标题'WINTER WARMERS ARE BACK',丝带价签'From $4.50'。惬意、诱人、手绘感;藏青、奶油与焦糖配色;竖版海报布局,柔和颗粒。

prompt_en: A cute cartoon Christmas story graphic. A round-bellied jolly toymaker in a red suit hammers a wooden train at a cluttered workshop bench, surrounded by tiny elf helpers, stacked gift boxes and hanging tools. Warm lantern glow pours in from the left. A top banner reads 'Making Magic Since Forever' in bouncy red display type. Whimsical, warm, storybook mood; saturated red, green and gold palette; soft shading, thick outlines, cinematic vertical framing.
prompt_zh: 可爱的卡通圣诞故事图。圆滚滚、乐呵呵的红衣玩具匠人在杂乱工作台上敲打一列小木火车,周围是小精灵助手、堆叠礼盒和悬挂工具。暖暖灯笼光从左侧倾泻。顶部横幅是弹跳感红色展示字'Making Magic Since Forever'。奇趣、温暖、绘本感;饱和红绿金配色;柔和阴影,粗描边,电影感竖构图。

prompt_en: A dramatic New Year fireworks graphic. A stylized dark city-skyline silhouette runs across the bottom, and above it an explosive burst of gold, magenta and teal fireworks fills a deep indigo night sky. A bold centered headline 'HAPPY NEW YEAR 2027' glows softly in white, with a small line beneath 'New beginnings await'. Festive, energetic, hopeful mood; indigo night with vivid firework sparks; wide balanced composition, bokeh light flecks and soft lens flare.
prompt_zh: 震撼的新年烟花图。底部是风格化的深色城市天际线剪影,上方深靛蓝夜空中金、品红、青三色烟花炸开。居中大标题'HAPPY NEW YEAR 2027'白色柔光,下方小字'New beginnings await'。喜庆、有活力、充满希望;靛蓝夜色配鲜艳烟花火花;宽幅平衡构图,散景光斑与柔和镜头光晕。

prompt_en: A clean e-commerce Christmas promo banner for invented brand 'Everly'. A bright red background carries a thin white dashed border like a gift tag. A bold white headline reads 'FREE SHIPPING ON EVERYTHING', with a smaller line 'Order by Dec 22 for delivery before Christmas'. A flat white illustration of a delivery van with a wreath on its grille sits at the lower left. Friendly, urgent, commercial mood; red-and-white palette; crisp vector flat style, tidy square layout.
prompt_zh: 为虚构品牌'Everly'设计的干净电商圣诞促销横幅。鲜红背景配像礼品吊牌的白色虚线边框。粗白标题'FREE SHIPPING ON EVERYTHING',下方小字'Order by Dec 22 for delivery before Christmas'。左下角一辆车头挂着花环的白色扁平快递货车插画。友好、紧迫、商业感;红白配色;干净矢量扁平风格,方形整洁布局。

prompt_en: A paper-craft advent-calendar social graphic where everything looks cut and folded from colored cardstock. A grid of 24 small numbered doors in red, green and gold sits over a snowy layered-paper village with paper pine trees. Door number 1 is popped open, revealing a tiny paper star. A top title 'Count Down to Christmas' is built from layered paper letters. Handmade, cheerful, tactile mood; festive primary palette; visible paper edges and soft drop shadows.
prompt_zh: 纸艺降临节日历社交图,一切都像用彩色卡纸剪折而成。24 扇编号小门以红、绿、金排成网格,置于分层纸艺雪村与纸松树之上。1 号门弹开,露出一颗小纸星。顶部标题'Count Down to Christmas'由分层纸字拼成。手作、欢快、有质感;喜庆三原色配色;可见纸张切边与柔和投影。

prompt_en: A vibrant Chinese New Year promo banner. A rich crimson background has a gold-foil texture. Centered is a large golden character '福' displayed upside-down on a diamond-shaped red paper cut, flanked by two hanging gold tassels and blooming plum blossoms. A top gold headline reads 'Happy Lunar New Year' with a subline 'Prosperity & Joy'. Cascading gold coins and a red envelope sit at the bottom. Festive, auspicious, luxurious mood; red-and-gold palette; symmetrical vertical layout, ornate paper-cut detailing.
prompt_zh: 喜气洋洋的春节宣传横幅。浓郁大红背景带金箔纹理。正中一个金色'福'字倒贴在菱形红色剪纸上,两侧垂挂金色流苏与盛放的梅花。顶部金色标题'Happy Lunar New Year',副标'Prosperity & Joy'。底部金币如瀑,一只红包相衬。喜庆、吉祥、奢华;红金配色;对称竖版布局,繁复剪纸细节。

prompt_en: A cute Lunar New Year mascot graphic for the Year of the Horse. A chubby cartoon golden pony wearing a red silk vest and a tiny gold bell prances at the center, holding a gold ingot. Behind it, a burst of red lanterns and firework sparkles. A rounded gold headline '马到成功' pairs with an English subline 'Gallop into Fortune'. Playful, adorable, festive mood; red, gold and warm-orange palette; soft 3D cartoon render, glossy highlights, centered square layout.
prompt_zh: 可爱的马年吉祥物图。一匹圆润的卡通金色小马穿着红丝马甲、挂着小金铃,前蹄腾跃立于正中,抱着一枚金元宝。身后红灯笼与烟花火花绽放。圆润金色标题'马到成功',配英文副标'Gallop into Fortune'。俏皮、可爱、喜庆;红、金与暖橙配色;柔和 3D 卡通渲染,光泽高光,居中方形布局。

prompt_en: A warm Spring Festival reunion-dinner illustration seen from above. A round table is laden with festive dishes — a whole steamed fish, dumplings, spring rolls, a hot pot, tangerines and rice cakes — on a red tablecloth, with two pairs of chopsticks reaching in and warm overhead lantern light. An elegant script headline 'Reunion & Abundance' curves along the top beside the character '团圆'. Homely, abundant, heartfelt mood; warm red, gold and food-tone palette; flat illustration with soft gradients.
prompt_zh: 温暖的春节团圆饭俯视插画。一张红桌布圆桌摆满年菜——整条清蒸鱼、饺子、春卷、火锅、橘子和年糕,两双筷子伸向菜肴,头顶暖暖灯笼光。顶部优雅手写体'Reunion & Abundance'沿弧线排布,旁边配'团圆'二字。居家、丰盛、暖心;暖红、金与食物色调配色;扁平插画配柔和渐变。

prompt_en: A dreamy Lantern Festival social graphic. Rows of glowing red-and-gold lanterns hang above a softly blurred traditional street at dusk, with warm bokeh in the distance. In the foreground, two paper lanterns drift upward into a deep blue-purple sky. A vertical gold headline '元宵节快乐' pairs with small English 'Lantern Festival'. Magical, serene, festive mood; deep twilight blue with warm lantern glow; cinematic vertical composition, glowing light and gentle grain.
prompt_zh: 梦幻的元宵灯节社交图。一排排发光的红金灯笼悬在暮色中虚化的古街上方,远处暖暖散景。前景两只纸灯笼升向深蓝紫夜空。竖排金色标题'元宵节快乐',配小字英文'Lantern Festival'。梦幻、宁静、喜庆;深暮蓝配暖灯笼光;电影感竖构图,发光光晕与柔和颗粒。

prompt_en: A traditional Chinese paper-cut style graphic. A single sheet of red paper is cut into an intricate circular window-flower '窗花' featuring a leaping horse surrounded by peonies, auspicious clouds and the character '春'. It is placed dead-center on a clean warm-white background so every delicate cut and negative space stays crisp. A small red caption below reads 'Welcome the Spring'. Elegant, cultural, handcrafted mood; single red-on-white palette; perfectly symmetrical, high-contrast flat paper-cut detail.
prompt_zh: 传统中国剪纸风格图。一张红纸剪成繁复的圆形'窗花',图案是一匹奔跃的马,四周环绕牡丹、祥云与'春'字。它端正居中置于干净的暖白背景上,每一处细密剪口与镂空都清晰锐利。下方红色小字'Welcome the Spring'。优雅、文化、手作;单一红底白配色;完全对称,高对比扁平剪纸细节。

prompt_en: A festive Lunar New Year e-commerce sale banner for invented brand 'Jinli Living'. A red-to-gold gradient background carries subtle cloud motifs. A bold gold headline reads 'NEW YEAR MEGA SALE', with a large red '新年钜惠 8折起' on a gold ribbon. A cluster of red envelopes, gold coins and a blooming plum branch fills the right side. A small tag reads 'Feb 1–15 only'. Energetic, prosperous, commercial mood; red-and-gold festive palette; balanced left-text, right-decoration layout.
prompt_zh: 为虚构品牌'Jinli Living'设计的春节电商促销横幅。红到金渐变背景带隐约祥云纹样。粗金标题'NEW YEAR MEGA SALE',金色丝带上是红色大字'新年钜惠 8折起'。右侧一簇红包、金币与盛开梅枝。小标签'Feb 1–15 only'。有活力、兴旺、商业感;红金喜庆配色;左文字右装饰的平衡布局。

prompt_en: A cheerful cartoon God-of-Wealth greeting graphic. A smiling round figure in golden embroidered robes and a black-and-gold hat holds a large gold ingot and a scroll reading '恭喜发财'. Gold coins rain down around him against a bright red background scattered with tiny gold sparkles. An English subline reads 'Wishing You Wealth & Luck'. Joyful, lucky, festive mood; vivid red and gold palette; soft cartoon shading, thick clean outlines, centered vertical composition.
prompt_zh: 喜气的卡通财神爷贺图。一位笑呵呵的圆脸财神,身穿金绣红袍、戴黑金帽,手捧大金元宝和写着'恭喜发财'的卷轴。金币如雨落下,背景是撒着细小金点的鲜红色。英文副标'Wishing You Wealth & Luck'。欢乐、吉利、喜庆;鲜艳红金配色;柔和卡通阴影,粗净描边,居中竖构图。

prompt_en: An elegant minimalist Lunar New Year card. A soft ivory background carries a single ink-painted plum-blossom branch arcing from the lower left, its red blossoms delicately detailed. A vertical column of calligraphy on the right reads '岁岁平安', with a small red seal stamp beneath it. Refined, tranquil, upscale mood; restrained ivory, ink-black and vermilion palette; abundant negative space, a traditional gongbi-meets-modern aesthetic, portrait framing.
prompt_zh: 优雅极简的春节贺卡。柔和象牙白背景上,一枝水墨梅花自左下方弧形伸出,红色花朵刻画细腻。右侧竖排书法'岁岁平安',下方一枚小红印章。精致、宁静、高级;克制的象牙白、墨黑与朱红配色;大量留白,工笔与现代结合的美学,竖版构图。

prompt_en: A lively Lunar New Year celebration graphic. A long undulating dragon-dance winds through a festive street packed with red lanterns and confetti, with performers in gold and red beneath it and drummers to the side. Fireworks bloom in the sky above. A bold banner headline reads 'Let the Celebrations Begin' alongside '新春快乐'. Dynamic, joyful, bustling mood; saturated red, gold and warm crowd tones; a dynamic diagonal composition, energetic motion and confetti flecks.
prompt_zh: 热闹的春节庆典图。一条起伏的长龙在挂满红灯笼、飘着彩纸屑的节日街道上蜿蜒,下方是金红舞龙人,旁边有鼓手。上空烟花绽放。醒目横幅标题'Let the Celebrations Begin',旁配'新春快乐'。动感、欢乐、热闹;饱和红、金与暖人群色调;动感对角构图,充满动势与彩纸屑。

prompt_en: A modern Lunar New Year digital red-packet giveaway graphic. A clean red gradient background carries soft gold bokeh. A single glossy 3D red envelope with a golden '福' seal pops forward at the center, its flap slightly open with gold light spilling out. A bold white headline reads 'CLAIM YOUR LUCKY RED PACKET', with a gold pill button 'Tap to open'. Modern, exciting, celebratory mood; red-and-gold with glossy 3D render; centered app-promo layout, crisp soft shadows.
prompt_zh: 现代感的春节电子红包福利图。干净的红色渐变背景配柔和金色散景。一只光泽 3D 红包正对镜头弹出,封口烫金'福'字,袋口微开,金光溢出。粗白标题'CLAIM YOUR LUCKY RED PACKET',金色胶囊按钮'Tap to open'。现代、兴奋、喜庆;红金配光泽 3D 渲染;居中的应用推广布局,干净柔和投影。

name_en: Rose And Co Be Mine Sale
prompt_en: A sweet Valentine's Day sale banner for invented brand 'Rosé & Co'. A blush-pink background has a scatter of small glossy red and pink hearts drifting upward. A centered bold rounded headline 'BE MINE — 25% OFF' sits in deep rose on a cream heart-shaped badge, with a subline 'Treat someone you love'. Thin gold sparkle accents frame the corners. Romantic, playful, sweet mood; blush pink, rose red and gold palette; symmetrical centered layout, soft glossy 3D hearts.
prompt_zh: 为虚构品牌'Rosé & Co'设计的甜蜜情人节促销横幅。腮红粉背景上,小巧的光泽红粉爱心向上飘散。正中奶油色心形徽章上是玫瑰深红圆润大标题'BE MINE — 25% OFF',副标'Treat someone you love'。四角以纤细金色闪光点缀。浪漫、俏皮、甜美;腮红粉、玫瑰红与金色配色;对称居中布局,柔和光泽 3D 爱心。

prompt_en: A vintage romantic Valentine's graphic. An aged cream envelope tied with a red satin ribbon and stamped with a heart-shaped wax seal rests on a dusty-rose linen surface, a sprig of dried lavender beside it. An elegant looping script headline 'With All My Love' runs across the top in deep burgundy, with a small line 'Sealed with a kiss'. Nostalgic, tender, refined mood; muted rose, cream and burgundy palette; overhead flat-lay photographic style, soft window light and gentle grain.
prompt_zh: 复古浪漫的情人节图。一枚做旧的奶油色信封系着红缎带、盖着心形火漆印,放在暗玫瑰色亚麻布上,旁边一束干薰衣草。顶部深酒红优雅花体标题'With All My Love',配小字'Sealed with a kiss'。怀旧、温柔、雅致;柔和玫瑰、奶油与酒红配色;俯拍平铺摄影风格,柔和窗光与细腻颗粒。

prompt_en: A romantic Valentine's Day social graphic. A silhouetted couple stands close beneath a single blooming tree on a hill against a warm gradient sunset of coral, peach and lavender, with tiny heart-shaped leaves drifting from the tree. A delicate script headline 'You & Me, Always' glows softly in white at the top. Dreamy, heartfelt, serene mood; warm coral-to-lavender gradient palette; minimal silhouette illustration, soft bokeh, portrait composition with a low horizon.
prompt_zh: 浪漫的情人节社交图。一对情侣剪影相依站在山丘上一棵盛开的树下,背景是珊瑚、蜜桃与薰衣草色的暖调日落渐变,心形小叶从树上飘落。顶部纤细花体标题'You & Me, Always'白色柔光。梦幻、走心、宁静;暖珊瑚到薰衣草渐变配色;极简剪影插画,柔和散景,低地平线竖构图。

prompt_en: An elegant Valentine's dinner promo for invented restaurant 'Amoré Bistro'. A deep wine-red background carries soft candlelight bokeh. At the center, two wine glasses clink over a small round table with a single rose and a lit candle. A gold serif headline 'A Table for Two' sits above a subline 'Valentine's Set Menu · Feb 14 · $68 per couple', with a reserve pill button 'Book your table'. Intimate, luxe, romantic mood; wine-red, gold and candle-warm palette; refined centered layout.
prompt_zh: 为虚构餐厅'Amoré Bistro'设计的优雅情人节晚宴宣传图。深酒红背景带柔和烛光散景。正中一张小圆桌上两只酒杯轻碰,一朵玫瑰、一支点燃的蜡烛。金色衬线标题'A Table for Two',下方副标'Valentine's Set Menu · Feb 14 · $68 per couple',预订胶囊按钮'Book your table'。亲密、奢华、浪漫;酒红、金与烛暖配色;精致居中布局。

prompt_en: A fun Galentine's Day social graphic. A bright coral background is dotted with confetti hearts and sparkles. A flat illustration of three friends in colorful outfits laughing and toasting pink mocktails sits at the center. A bold playful headline 'GALENTINE'S BRUNCH' is set in bubbly white, with a subline 'Feb 13 · Bring your besties'. Cheerful, empowering, fun mood; coral, hot pink and mint palette; lively flat-illustration style, thick outlines, energetic square layout.
prompt_zh: 欢乐的闺蜜情人节社交图。明亮珊瑚色背景点缀着爱心彩纸屑和亮片。正中一幅扁平插画:三位穿彩色服装的朋友大笑着举起粉色无酒精鸡尾酒干杯。醒目俏皮标题'GALENTINE'S BRUNCH'为泡泡白字,副标'Feb 13 · Bring your besties'。欢快、有力量、有趣;珊瑚、亮粉与薄荷配色;活泼扁平插画风格,粗描边,活力方形布局。

prompt_en: A luxurious Valentine's chocolate promo. An overhead flat-lay shows an open heart-shaped box lined with red velvet, filled with glossy artisan chocolates in neat rows, rose petals scattered around it on a marble surface. An elegant gold-foil headline 'Made With Love' curves along the top, with a small line 'Handcrafted Valentine's Collection'. Indulgent, premium, romantic mood; red, gold and marble-white palette; top-down photographic style, soft studio light and rich detail.
prompt_zh: 奢华的情人节巧克力宣传图。俯拍平铺一只打开的心形礼盒,内衬红丝绒,整齐排列着光泽的手工巧克力,大理石桌面上散落玫瑰花瓣。顶部烫金优雅标题'Made With Love'沿弧线排布,小字'Handcrafted Valentine's Collection'。奢享、高级、浪漫;红、金与大理石白配色;俯拍摄影风格,柔和影棚光,细节丰富。

prompt_en: A modern Valentine's countdown story graphic. A vertical gradient of soft pink to warm red carries floating translucent 3D hearts. A large white headline '3 DAYS TO VALENTINE'S' sits above a smaller line 'Order your bouquet now'. A single long-stemmed red rose illustration rises from the bottom edge. Fresh, urgent, romantic mood; pink-to-red gradient with glossy 3D hearts; clean vertical story layout with generous top space for stickers.
prompt_zh: 现代感的情人节倒数快拍图。柔粉到暖红的竖向渐变中漂浮着半透明 3D 爱心。大白标题'3 DAYS TO VALENTINE'S'上方,下方小字'Order your bouquet now'。一枝长茎红玫瑰插画从底部升起。清新、紧迫、浪漫;粉到红渐变配光泽 3D 爱心;干净的竖版快拍布局,顶部留足贴纸空间。

prompt_en: A delicate watercolor Valentine's card. Loose hand-painted red and blush peonies, roses and eucalyptus sprigs frame the top and bottom edges, paint bleeding softly into cream paper. Centered elegant script reads 'Happy Valentine's Day' in dusty rose, with a tiny painted heart dotting the 'i'. Soft, artistic, romantic mood; watercolor palette of blush, coral, red and sage; airy centered composition, visible paper texture and paint blooms.
prompt_zh: 精致的水彩情人节贺卡。顶部和底部以松散手绘的红色与腮红色牡丹、玫瑰和尤加利枝叶为边框,颜料柔和地晕染进奶油色纸面。正中暗玫瑰色优雅花体'Happy Valentine's Day','i'的点是一颗小小手绘爱心。柔美、艺术、浪漫;腮红、珊瑚、红与鼠尾草的水彩配色;通透居中构图,可见纸纹与晕染。

prompt_en: A retro pop-art Valentine's graphic in 1960s comic style. A Ben-Day dot background in bubblegum pink sets off a comic speech bubble that bursts with bold outlined text 'LOVE YOU TONS!'. A winking cartoon heart wearing sunglasses and a red bow strikes a pose beside it, with halftone shading and thick black outlines. A yellow starburst reads 'XOXO'. Bold, retro, cheeky mood; pink, red, yellow and black comic palette; dynamic pop-art layout, halftone texture.
prompt_zh: 1960 年代漫画风的复古波普情人节图。泡泡糖粉的本戴点背景衬托出一个爆炸式漫画对话气泡,里面是粗描边文字'LOVE YOU TONS!'。旁边一颗戴墨镜、系红蝴蝶结的卡通爱心眨眼摆姿势,配半色调阴影和粗黑描边。黄色星芒里写着'XOXO'。大胆、复古、俏皮;粉、红、黄与黑漫画配色;动感波普布局,半色调纹理。

prompt_en: A heartfelt long-distance Valentine's graphic. A soft cream vintage-map background carries two glowing red location pins connected by a dotted heart-shaped flight path, with a small illustrated plane travelling along the line. A handwritten script headline 'Miles Apart, Close at Heart' sits in navy, with a small line 'Sending love across the miles'. Sentimental, warm, hopeful mood; cream, red and navy palette; illustrated map style, gentle texture, portrait composition.
prompt_zh: 走心的异地恋情人节图。柔和奶油色复古地图背景上,两枚发光的红色定位针由一条心形虚线航线连接,一架小飞机插画沿线飞行。手写体标题'Miles Apart, Close at Heart'为藏青色,小字'Sending love across the miles'。感性、温暖、充满希望;奶油、红与藏青配色;插画地图风格,柔和纹理,竖构图。

prompt_en: A spooky Halloween sale banner for invented shop 'Hexley'. A deep purple-black background carries a glowing green mist along the bottom. A bold dripping horror-style headline 'SPOOKY SALE — 31% OFF' glows in toxic green with an orange halo. Grinning jack-o'-lanterns, bats and a crescent moon frame the text. A small tag reads 'Haunts your cart til Oct 31'. Eerie, fun, energetic mood; purple, toxic green and pumpkin orange palette; centered layout, glowing neon and drippy type.
prompt_zh: 为虚构小店'Hexley'设计的诡异万圣节促销横幅。深紫黑背景底部涌动着发光绿雾。粗滴血恐怖风标题'SPOOKY SALE — 31% OFF'为荧光绿字带橙色光晕。咧嘴的南瓜灯、蝙蝠和一弯新月围绕文字。小标签'Haunts your cart til Oct 31'。诡异、有趣、有活力;紫、荧光绿与南瓜橙配色;居中布局,发光霓虹与滴落字体。

prompt_en: An adorable kawaii Halloween graphic. A group of round smiling pumpkins with rosy cheeks sit in a patch, a tiny friendly ghost floats above holding a candy bucket, and a big-eyed black cat curls nearby. A soft dusk sky glows with a big orange moon. A bubbly cream headline reads 'Happy Haunting!'. Cute, gentle, playful mood; warm orange, cream and dusty-purple palette; soft cartoon render, rounded shapes, cozy square composition.
prompt_zh: 超可爱的卡哇伊万圣节图。一群圆滚滚、脸颊红扑扑、笑眯眯的南瓜坐在田里,一只友善的小幽灵拎着糖果桶飘在上方,一只大眼睛黑猫蜷在旁边。柔和暮色天空里挂着一轮橙色大月亮。泡泡奶油色标题'Happy Haunting!'。可爱、温柔、俏皮;暖橙、奶油与灰紫配色;柔和卡通渲染,圆润造型,惬意方形构图。

prompt_en: A moody Halloween poster. A crooked silhouetted haunted mansion stands on a hill with glowing yellow windows, a full moon wreathed in wispy clouds behind it, a swarm of bats crossing the sky and a gnarled bare tree in the foreground. A gothic headline 'ENTER IF YOU DARE' sits at the top in cracked white letters. Creepy, atmospheric, cinematic mood; midnight blue, black and sickly-yellow palette; vertical composition, fog and dramatic backlight.
prompt_zh: 阴森的万圣节海报。一座歪斜的鬼宅剪影立于山丘,窗内透出黄光,身后一轮满月缠绕着薄云,蝙蝠群划过夜空,前景一棵嶙峋枯树。顶部哥特标题'ENTER IF YOU DARE'为开裂白字。惊悚、氛围感、电影感;午夜蓝、黑与病态黄配色;竖构图,雾气与戏剧性逆光。

prompt_en: A charming Halloween trick-or-treat illustration. Three costumed kids — a little witch, a ghost in a sheet and a pumpkin — walk down a leaf-strewn suburban street at dusk carrying glowing candy buckets, with warm porch lights and carved pumpkins on the steps behind them. A hand-lettered banner 'Trick or Treat!' arcs overhead. Nostalgic, warm, whimsical mood; autumn orange, purple and warm-glow palette; storybook illustration, soft grain, vertical framing.
prompt_zh: 温馨的万圣节'不给糖就捣蛋'插画。三个变装小孩——小女巫、披床单的幽灵和南瓜——黄昏时走在落叶铺满的郊区街道上,拎着发光糖果桶,身后台阶上是暖暖门廊灯和雕刻南瓜。头顶手写横幅'Trick or Treat!'弧形排布。怀旧、温暖、奇趣;秋橙、紫与暖光配色;绘本插画,柔和颗粒,竖构图。

prompt_en: A stylish Halloween party invitation flyer for invented venue 'The Crypt Lounge'. A matte black background carries glossy orange and purple splatter accents. A bold retro headline 'MONSTER MASH BASH' sits in orange, with details beneath 'Sat Oct 31 · 9PM til late · Costumes required'. A cocktail glass with an eyeball garnish and a skull motif decorate the corners. Edgy, fun, party mood; black, orange and violet palette; centered flyer layout, grungy texture, bold display type.
prompt_zh: 为虚构场地'The Crypt Lounge'设计的时髦万圣节派对传单。哑光黑背景带光泽的橙紫色泼溅点缀。粗复古标题'MONSTER MASH BASH'为橙色,下方细节'Sat Oct 31 · 9PM til late · Costumes required'。角落装饰着插眼球的鸡尾酒杯和骷髅图案。前卫、有趣、派对感;黑、橙与紫罗兰配色;居中传单布局,做旧纹理,粗展示字体。

prompt_en: A cute Halloween bakery promo for invented shop 'Sugar Hollow'. A warm cream background has a scalloped purple border. A tray of decorated treats — ghost sugar cookies, spiderweb cupcakes and a candy-corn cake pop — sits at the center. A rounded orange headline reads 'SPOOKY SWEETS ARE HERE', with a price tag 'Boxes from $12'. Playful, appetizing, festive mood; cream, pumpkin orange and grape purple palette; friendly illustration, soft shadows, square layout.
prompt_zh: 为虚构小店'Sugar Hollow'设计的可爱万圣节烘焙宣传图。温暖奶油色背景配扇贝形紫色边框。正中一托盘装饰甜点——幽灵糖霜饼干、蜘蛛网纸杯蛋糕和玉米糖蛋糕棒棒糖。圆润橙色标题'SPOOKY SWEETS ARE HERE',价签'Boxes from $12'。俏皮、诱人、节日感;奶油、南瓜橙与葡萄紫配色;友好插画,柔和投影,方形布局。

prompt_en: A mystical witchy Halloween graphic. A deep midnight-blue background carries gold constellations and a crescent moon. A crystal ball glowing purple sits on an open spellbook beside dripping candles, dried herbs and a black cat's silhouette. An elegant gold headline reads 'Season of the Witch', with a small line 'Magic is in the air'. Enchanting, mysterious, elegant mood; midnight blue, gold and amethyst palette; ornate illustration, glowing accents, portrait composition.
prompt_zh: 神秘的女巫风万圣节图。深午夜蓝背景带金色星座和一弯新月。一颗发着紫光的水晶球置于摊开的魔法书上,旁边是滴蜡的蜡烛、干香草和黑猫剪影。优雅金色标题'Season of the Witch',小字'Magic is in the air'。迷人、神秘、优雅;午夜蓝、金与紫水晶配色;繁复插画,发光点缀,竖构图。

prompt_en: A dramatic Halloween close-up graphic. A hand-carved jack-o'-lantern with a jagged grin glows fiery orange from within, sitting on weathered wood surrounded by dry autumn leaves and a single trailing wisp of smoke, a pitch-black background behind it. Small glowing text at the bottom reads 'Happy Halloween'. Warm, eerie, atmospheric mood; deep black with fiery orange candlelight; photographic macro style, rich shadow, warm glow and fine detail.
prompt_zh: 戏剧性的万圣节特写图。一只手工雕刻、咧着锯齿笑脸的南瓜灯,内部透出炽热橙光,置于陈旧木面上,四周是干枯秋叶和一缕升起的青烟,身后一片漆黑。底部发光小字'Happy Halloween'。温暖、诡异、有氛围;深黑配炽橙烛光;微距摄影风格,浓郁阴影,暖光与细腻细节。

prompt_en: A vintage 1980s VHS-horror-style Halloween graphic. A grainy purple-and-teal gradient with scanlines frames a glowing chrome headline 'NIGHT OF THE PUMPKIN' in dripping retro chrome type. A silhouetted figure with a lantern stands in fog below, a blood-orange moon behind. A small tagline reads 'Coming this Halloween'. Retro, campy, spooky mood; teal, purple and blood-orange palette; VHS grain, chromatic aberration, vertical poster layout.
prompt_zh: 复古 1980 年代录像带恐怖风的万圣节图。带扫描线的紫青颗粒渐变衬托出滴落的复古铬色标题'NIGHT OF THE PUMPKIN'。下方雾中一个提灯人剪影,身后一轮血橙色月亮。小标语'Coming this Halloween'。复古、b级片、诡异;青、紫与血橙配色;录像带颗粒,色差,竖版海报布局。

prompt_en: A fun Halloween countdown story graphic. A vivid purple gradient carries floating cartoon bats and tiny orange sparkles. A big white headline '5 DAYS TIL HALLOWEEN' has a smiling ghost peeking from behind the number, with a small line 'Get your costume ready'. A row of mini pumpkins lines the bottom edge. Playful, upbeat, spooky mood; purple, orange and cream palette; clean vertical story layout with room for stickers at the top.
prompt_zh: 欢乐的万圣节倒数快拍图。鲜艳紫色渐变里漂浮着卡通蝙蝠和细小橙色亮片。大白标题'5 DAYS TIL HALLOWEEN',一只微笑幽灵从数字后探头,小字'Get your costume ready'。底部一排迷你南瓜。俏皮、活力、诡异;紫、橙与奶油配色;干净竖版快拍布局,顶部留出贴纸空间。

prompt_en: A bright summer sale banner for invented brand 'Solmar'. A sunny turquoise background carries a diagonal band of tropical monstera leaves and hibiscus flowers along the left. A bold white headline 'SUMMER SALE — UP TO 50% OFF' pairs with a coral subline 'Dive into savings'. A flat illustration of sunglasses and a beach ball sits in the corner. Fresh, breezy, cheerful mood; turquoise, coral and sunshine-yellow palette; clean vector flat style, balanced square layout.
prompt_zh: 为虚构品牌'Solmar'设计的明亮夏季促销横幅。阳光青绿背景左侧是一道斜向排布的热带龟背竹叶和扶桑花。粗白标题'SUMMER SALE — UP TO 50% OFF',配珊瑚色副标'Dive into savings'。角落一副扁平墨镜和一只沙滩球插画。清新、轻快、欢乐;青绿、珊瑚与阳光黄配色;干净矢量扁平风格,方形平衡布局。

prompt_en: A vibrant summer flat-lay social graphic. An overhead view on golden sand arranges a straw hat, round mirrored sunglasses, a striped beach towel, seashells, a scoop of ice cream and a pair of flip-flops neatly. A hand-lettered coral headline 'Hello, Summer' runs across the top. Sunny, relaxed, playful mood; sandy beige, aqua, coral and cream palette; top-down photographic style, bright natural light and crisp shadows.
prompt_zh: 活泼的夏日平铺社交图。金色沙滩上俯拍整齐摆放着草帽、圆形镜面墨镜、条纹沙滩巾、贝壳、一球冰淇淋和一双人字拖。顶部手写珊瑚色标题'Hello, Summer'。阳光、放松、俏皮;沙米、水蓝、珊瑚与奶油配色;俯拍摄影风格,明亮自然光与清晰阴影。

prompt_en: A dreamy summer surf graphic. A silhouetted surfer carries a board along a wet beach at golden hour, the sun melting into the ocean in bands of tangerine, pink and gold, gentle waves reflecting the light. A retro script headline 'Endless Summer' sits at the top in warm cream. Nostalgic, warm, free-spirited mood; tangerine-to-pink sunset gradient; cinematic vertical composition, lens flare and soft film grain.
prompt_zh: 梦幻的夏日冲浪图。黄金时刻,一个冲浪者剪影扛着冲浪板走在湿漉漉的海滩上,夕阳融入海面,化作橘、粉、金的光带,轻柔海浪映着光。顶部复古花体标题'Endless Summer'为暖奶油色。怀旧、温暖、自由;橘到粉的日落渐变;电影感竖构图,镜头光晕与柔和胶片颗粒。

prompt_en: A fun summer pool-party invitation for invented brand 'Splash Club'. A bright aqua water background ripples with caustics, a pink flamingo float and a yellow inner tube drifting on it. A bold rounded headline 'POOL PARTY' in white pairs with details 'Saturday · 2PM · Bring your floaties'. A slice of watermelon and sunglasses accent the corner. Energetic, playful, refreshing mood; aqua, hot pink and yellow palette; top-down layout, glossy water highlights.
prompt_zh: 为虚构品牌'Splash Club'设计的欢乐夏日泳池派对邀请图。明亮水蓝背景荡漾着水波光影,一只粉色火烈鸟浮圈和黄色游泳圈漂在上面。粗圆白色标题'POOL PARTY',配细节'Saturday · 2PM · Bring your floaties'。角落点缀一块西瓜和墨镜。活力、俏皮、清凉;水蓝、亮粉与黄色配色;俯视布局,光泽水面高光。

prompt_en: A refreshing summer drinks promo for invented bar 'Palm & Tonic'. A warm gradient of mango-orange to coral sets off a frosty glass of layered tropical smoothie with a paper umbrella, pineapple wedge and straw at the center, condensation droplets on the glass. A rounded headline 'HAPPY HOUR ALL SUMMER' pairs with a subline '2-for-1 · 4–7PM daily'. Juicy, inviting, upbeat mood; mango, coral and lime palette; vibrant illustration with glossy highlights, portrait layout.
prompt_zh: 为虚构酒吧'Palm & Tonic'设计的清爽夏日饮品宣传图。芒果橙到珊瑚的暖调渐变衬托出正中一杯挂着冷凝水珠的分层热带冰沙,插着小纸伞、菠萝角和吸管。圆润标题'HAPPY HOUR ALL SUMMER',配副标'2-for-1 · 4–7PM daily'。多汁、诱人、欢快;芒果、珊瑚与青柠配色;鲜艳插画配光泽高光,竖版布局。

name_zh: 卡哇伊冰淇淋保持清凉
prompt_en: An adorable summer ice-cream graphic. A smiling cartoon ice-cream cone with a swirl of strawberry and vanilla, rosy cheeks and tiny arms waves against a pastel-mint background dotted with sprinkles and a happy sun in the corner. A bubbly coral headline reads 'Stay Cool!'. Cute, sweet, cheerful mood; pastel mint, strawberry pink and cream palette; soft kawaii illustration, thick outlines, playful square composition.
prompt_zh: 超可爱的夏日冰淇淋图。一支笑眯眯的卡通蛋筒冰淇淋,草莓与香草的螺旋、红扑扑的脸颊和小手臂,在点缀着糖粒的粉彩薄荷背景前挥手,角落一个开心的太阳。泡泡珊瑚色标题'Stay Cool!'。可爱、甜美、欢快;粉彩薄荷、草莓粉与奶油配色;柔和卡哇伊插画,粗描边,俏皮方形构图。

prompt_en: A clean summer travel promo for invented agency 'Wandertide'. A split layout has, on the left, a bright photo-style illustration of a turquoise sea meeting white sand under palm shadows, and, on the right, a soft cream panel with a thin serif headline 'Escape to Paradise' and a line 'Beach getaways from $299'. A small pin icon and a 'Book now' pill button finish it. Aspirational, airy, premium mood; turquoise, sand and cream palette; balanced two-column layout.
prompt_zh: 为虚构旅行社'Wandertide'设计的干净夏日旅行宣传图。左右分栏:左侧是照片感插画,青绿海水在棕榈树影下拍打白沙;右侧柔和奶油色面板上是细窄衬线标题'Escape to Paradise'和一行'Beach getaways from $299'。配一个小定位图标和'Book now'胶囊按钮。向往、通透、高级;青绿、沙色与奶油配色;平衡的双栏布局。

prompt_en: A vibrant summer music-festival poster for invented event 'Sunwave Fest'. A bold gradient sky of magenta, orange and purple frames a stylized palm-lined stage silhouette and a glowing sun. A retro-groovy headline 'SUNWAVE FEST' is set in wavy chrome-yellow letters, with details beneath 'July 18–20 · Coral Bay Beach'. Energetic, retro, festive mood; magenta, orange and purple sunset palette; 70s-inspired typography, vertical poster layout, sunburst rays.
prompt_zh: 为虚构活动'Sunwave Fest'设计的活力夏日音乐节海报。品红、橙、紫的大胆渐变天空衬托出风格化的棕榈舞台剪影和一轮发光太阳。复古律动标题'SUNWAVE FEST'为波浪铬黄字,下方细节'July 18–20 · Coral Bay Beach'。有活力、复古、节日感;品红、橙与紫的日落配色;70 年代风格字体,竖版海报布局,放射光芒。

prompt_en: A juicy summer pattern social graphic. A flat-illustration background of repeating watermelon slices, lemon halves and mint leaves sits on a soft coral field. A white rounded badge centers the frame with a bold headline 'FRESH SUMMER VIBES' and a small line 'Sip. Splash. Repeat.'. Fresh, playful, summery mood; coral, watermelon-red, lemon-yellow and mint palette; clean flat vector pattern, cheerful centered badge, square layout.
prompt_zh: 多汁的夏日图案社交图。柔珊瑚底色上是重复排列的西瓜片、柠檬半块和薄荷叶扁平插画。正中一枚白色圆润徽章,内含粗标题'FRESH SUMMER VIBES'和小字'Sip. Splash. Repeat.'。清新、俏皮、夏日感;珊瑚、西瓜红、柠檬黄与薄荷配色;干净扁平矢量图案,欢快居中徽章,方形布局。

prompt_en: A bright summer skincare promo for invented brand 'Sunkissed'. A soft sky-blue gradient background carries a big warm sun and a few fluffy clouds. A pastel-yellow unbranded sunscreen tube floats at the center with a dollop of cream and a slice of orange beside it. A rounded headline 'PROTECT YOUR GLOW' pairs with a subline 'SPF season is on · 20% off'. Fresh, wholesome, upbeat mood; sky blue, buttery yellow and coral palette; clean product layout, portrait framing.
prompt_zh: 为虚构品牌'Sunkissed'设计的明亮夏日护肤宣传图。柔和天蓝渐变背景里挂着一个暖太阳和几朵蓬松云。正中漂浮一支无品牌粉黄防晒管,旁边一坨面霜和一片橙子。圆润标题'PROTECT YOUR GLOW',配副标'SPF season is on · 20% off'。清新、健康、活力;天蓝、奶油黄与珊瑚配色;干净产品布局,竖版构图。

prompt_en: A high-impact Black Friday banner for invented store 'Voltix'. A matte black background carries glowing electric-yellow and magenta accents. An enormous condensed headline 'BLACK FRIDAY' sits above a huge '70% OFF' in yellow, with a magenta neon underline and a small pill 'Everything must go · One day only'. Bold, urgent, electric mood; black, electric-yellow and magenta palette; centered maximal typography layout, glow effects, crisp contrast.
prompt_zh: 为虚构商店'Voltix'设计的强冲击力黑五横幅。哑光黑背景带发光的电光黄与品红点缀。超大压缩标题'BLACK FRIDAY'上方,下方是巨大的黄色'70% OFF',配品红霓虹下划线和一枚小胶囊'Everything must go · One day only'。大胆、紧迫、电光感;黑、电光黄与品红配色;居中极致字体布局,发光效果,锐利对比。

prompt_en: A sleek Cyber Monday banner for invented electronics brand 'Nimbus'. A dark-navy gradient carries a subtle circuit-line pattern and a soft blue glow. A modern headline 'CYBER MONDAY' in white sits above a bright cyan '48-HOUR FLASH DEAL' and a line 'Up to 60% off tech'. A small floating pair of earbuds and a smartwatch icon accent it. Futuristic, premium, urgent mood; navy, cyan and white palette; clean centered layout, tech glow, thin sans-serif type.
prompt_zh: 为虚构电子品牌'Nimbus'设计的时尚网络星期一横幅。深藏青渐变带隐约电路线纹样和柔和蓝光。白色现代标题'CYBER MONDAY'上方,下方亮青色'48-HOUR FLASH DEAL'和一行'Up to 60% off tech'。旁边一副漂浮的耳机和一个智能手表图标。未来感、高级、紧迫;藏青、青色与白色配色;干净居中布局,科技辉光,细无衬线字体。

prompt_en: A punchy flash-sale banner. A bright red-orange gradient background carries a bold white lightning bolt behind the text. A huge headline 'FLASH SALE' sits above a digital countdown '02 : 45 : 10' in a black pill and a line 'Deals end at midnight'. A yellow starburst reads 'Extra 15% at checkout'. Urgent, energetic, loud mood; red-orange, yellow and white palette; dynamic diagonal composition, bold sans type, high contrast.
prompt_zh: 有冲击力的闪购横幅。明亮红橙渐变背景,文字后是一道粗白闪电。巨大标题'FLASH SALE'上方,下方黑色胶囊里是数字倒计时'02 : 45 : 10',以及一行'Deals end at midnight'。黄色星芒里写着'Extra 15% at checkout'。紧迫、有活力、张扬;红橙、黄与白配色;动感对角构图,粗无衬线字,高对比。

prompt_en: A minimalist luxury Black Friday banner for invented brand 'Noir Atelier'. A pure black background carries a single thin gold hairline frame. A centered fine serif headline 'BLACK FRIDAY' in gold sits above a smaller line 'Private sale · 30% off select pieces', with tiny gold dot separators. Understated, elegant, exclusive mood; black-and-gold palette; abundant negative space, refined centered typography, portrait layout.
prompt_zh: 为虚构品牌'Noir Atelier'设计的极简奢华黑五横幅。纯黑背景配一道纤细金色内框线。居中精致衬线标题'BLACK FRIDAY'为金色,下方小字'Private sale · 30% off select pieces',配细小金色圆点分隔符。含蓄、优雅、专属;黑金配色;大量留白,精致居中字体,竖版布局。

prompt_en: A playful weekend flash-sale banner for invented brand 'Poppy'. A cheerful cream background is dotted with confetti and a wavy sticker headline 'WEEKEND ONLY' in orange. A big bold '40% OFF EVERYTHING' in navy sits above a rounded pink pill 'Use code POPPY40'. A cute illustrated shopping bag winks in the corner. Fun, friendly, upbeat mood; cream, orange, navy and pink palette; bouncy layout, sticker-style shapes, square composition.
prompt_zh: 为虚构品牌'Poppy'设计的俏皮周末闪购横幅。欢快奶油色背景点缀着彩纸屑,橙色波浪贴纸标题'WEEKEND ONLY'。藏青粗大字'40% OFF EVERYTHING'上方,下方一枚粉色圆润胶囊'Use code POPPY40'。角落一个眨眼的可爱购物袋插画。有趣、友好、活力;奶油、橙、藏青与粉配色;弹跳布局,贴纸风造型,方形构图。

prompt_en: A bold early-bird Black Friday banner. A deep-plum background carries a bright gold sunrise burst behind the text. A headline 'EARLY BIRD DOORBUSTERS' in white sits above 'First 100 orders get an extra gift' in gold, with a rooster icon and a ticking clock as accents and a small pill 'Opens 6AM Friday'. Urgent, rewarding, bold mood; plum, gold and white palette; centered radiant layout, strong hierarchy, portrait framing.
prompt_zh: 大胆的早鸟黑五横幅。深梅子紫背景,文字后是明亮金色日出光芒。白色标题'EARLY BIRD DOORBUSTERS'上方,下方金色'First 100 orders get an extra gift',配一个公鸡图标和滴答走的时钟点缀,以及小胶囊'Opens 6AM Friday'。紧迫、有奖励感、大胆;梅子紫、金与白配色;居中放射布局,强层级,竖版构图。

prompt_en: An explosive mega-sale banner for invented marketplace 'Dealio'. A vivid yellow background carries a comic-style red explosion burst at the center reading 'MEGA SALE'. A bold black '80% OFF' pops from the burst, with price tags and coins flying outward and a small banner 'Storewide · 3 days only'. Loud, exciting, comic mood; yellow, red and black palette; pop-art explosion composition, halftone accents, bold outlined type.
prompt_zh: 为虚构商城'Dealio'设计的爆炸式巨惠横幅。鲜艳黄底,正中一团漫画风红色爆炸,里面写着'MEGA SALE'。粗黑'80% OFF'从爆炸中弹出,价签和硬币向外飞散,配小横幅'Storewide · 3 days only'。张扬、兴奋、漫画感;黄、红与黑配色;波普爆炸构图,半色调点缀,粗描边字体。

prompt_en: A modern Black Friday story graphic for invented fashion brand 'Lune'. A charcoal background carries a soft spotlight and a single draped satin ribbon in deep red. A bold white headline 'THE BLACK FRIDAY DROP' sits above '25% off · midnight only', with a 'Swipe up to shop' pill at the bottom. Sleek, moody, premium mood; charcoal, white and crimson palette; clean vertical story layout, cinematic spotlight, generous negative space.
prompt_zh: 为虚构时尚品牌'Lune'设计的现代黑五快拍图。炭灰背景配柔和聚光灯和一条垂坠的深红缎带。粗白标题'THE BLACK FRIDAY DROP'上方,下方'25% off · midnight only',底部一枚'Swipe up to shop'胶囊。利落、氛围感、高级;炭灰、白与绯红配色;干净竖版快拍布局,电影感聚光,大量留白。

prompt_en: A bright BOGO promo banner for invented brand 'Freshly'. A split-color background, half teal and half coral, is divided by a bold zigzag. A headline 'BUY ONE GET ONE FREE' in white spans both halves, a big '2 FOR 1' badge in yellow sits at the center and a line reads 'This weekend only'. Two illustrated product boxes tilt toward each other. Cheerful, generous, punchy mood; teal, coral and yellow palette; symmetrical split layout, bold sans type.
prompt_zh: 为虚构品牌'Freshly'设计的明亮买一送一横幅。半青绿半珊瑚的分色背景由一道粗锯齿线分隔。白色标题'BUY ONE GET ONE FREE'横跨两半,正中一枚黄色大徽章'2 FOR 1',一行'This weekend only'。两个产品盒插画相向倾斜。欢快、大方、有冲击;青绿、珊瑚与黄配色;对称分色布局,粗无衬线字。

prompt_en: An urgent clearance banner. A distressed kraft-paper background carries a bold red rubber-stamp headline 'FINAL CLEARANCE' angled across the top. Below it, a big black 'EVERYTHING 50–75% OFF' sits above a red pill 'Final hours — until stock lasts', with a torn price-tag graphic and a hand-drawn arrow pointing to the offer. Gritty, urgent, no-nonsense mood; kraft brown, red and black palette; stamped-poster layout, rough texture, bold condensed type.
prompt_zh: 紧迫的清仓横幅。做旧牛皮纸背景顶部斜盖着红色橡皮图章式标题'FINAL CLEARANCE'。下方黑色大字'EVERYTHING 50–75% OFF',其下一枚红色胶囊'Final hours — until stock lasts',配一枚撕开的价签图形和一支手绘箭头指向优惠。粗粝、紧迫、直白;牛皮棕、红与黑配色;盖章海报布局,粗糙纹理,粗压缩字体。

prompt_en: A cheerful back-to-school sale banner for invented brand 'Scholarly'. A chalkboard-green background carries faint chalk doodles. Flat illustrations of a stack of colorful books, pencils, a ruler, scissors and an apple line the bottom. A bold cream headline 'BACK TO SCHOOL SALE' pairs with a yellow subline 'Up to 40% off supplies'. Friendly, fresh, organized mood; chalkboard green, cream, red and yellow palette; clean flat-vector style, balanced square layout.
prompt_zh: 为虚构品牌'Scholarly'设计的欢快开学季促销横幅。黑板绿背景带淡淡粉笔涂鸦。底部一排扁平插画:一摞彩色书本、铅笔、直尺、剪刀和苹果。粗奶油色标题'BACK TO SCHOOL SALE',配黄色副标'Up to 40% off supplies'。友好、清新、有条理;黑板绿、奶油、红与黄配色;干净扁平矢量风格,方形平衡布局。

prompt_en: An adorable first-day-of-school graphic. A smiling cartoon kid with a big red backpack waves while standing beside a yellow school bus, autumn leaves drifting and a bright sun overhead. A hand-lettered banner 'First Day, Big Adventure!' runs across the top in navy. Warm, encouraging, playful mood; sunny yellow, red, navy and grass-green palette; soft cartoon illustration, thick outlines, cheerful portrait composition.
prompt_zh: 可爱的开学第一天图。一个背着大红书包的卡通小孩笑着挥手,站在黄色校车旁,秋叶飘落,头顶明亮太阳。顶部藏青色手写横幅'First Day, Big Adventure!'。温暖、鼓励、俏皮;阳光黄、红、藏青与草绿配色;柔和卡通插画,粗描边,欢快竖构图。

prompt_en: A tidy back-to-school flat-lay social graphic. An overhead view on a warm wood desk arranges an open notebook, sharpened pencils in a cup, a mini succulent, round glasses, sticky notes and a cup of coffee neatly. A minimal serif headline 'New Term, Fresh Start' sits at the top left. Organized, calm, aspirational mood; warm wood, sage, cream and mustard palette; top-down photographic style, soft daylight and crisp detail.
prompt_zh: 整洁的开学季平铺社交图。暖木书桌上俯拍整齐摆放着摊开的笔记本、笔筒里削好的铅笔、迷你多肉、圆框眼镜、便利贴和一杯咖啡。左上极简衬线标题'New Term, Fresh Start'。有条理、平静、向往;暖木、鼠尾草、奶油与芥末配色;俯拍摄影风格,柔和日光与清晰细节。

prompt_en: A bright dorm-essentials promo for invented brand 'Nestly'. A soft peach background carries a rounded checklist card, with flat illustrations of a desk lamp, storage bins, a plant, bedding and a mug surrounding it. A bold headline 'DORM READY' pairs with a subline 'Everything for your first place · 25% off bundles'. Fresh, helpful, upbeat mood; peach, teal and cream palette; clean illustrated layout, soft shadows, portrait framing.
prompt_zh: 为虚构品牌'Nestly'设计的明亮宿舍必备宣传图。柔和蜜桃色背景上一张圆角清单卡片,四周环绕扁平插画:台灯、收纳箱、绿植、床品和马克杯。粗标题'DORM READY',配副标'Everything for your first place · 25% off bundles'。清新、实用、活力;蜜桃、青绿与奶油配色;干净插画布局,柔和投影,竖版构图。

prompt_en: A bold back-to-school product graphic for invented brand 'Trekpack'. A bright cobalt background carries a big diagonal yellow stripe. A hero shot of a sporty teal-and-orange backpack floats at the center with a soft shadow, small feature call-outs 'Laptop pocket' and 'Water bottle holder' pointing to it. A headline 'GEAR UP FOR CLASS' pairs with 'From $39'. Energetic, sporty, modern mood; cobalt, yellow and teal palette; centered hero layout, crisp render.
prompt_zh: 为虚构品牌'Trekpack'设计的醒目开学产品图。明亮钴蓝背景带一道斜向黄条。正中漂浮一款运动感青橙双肩包,带柔和投影,旁边小标注'Laptop pocket'和'Water bottle holder'指向它。标题'GEAR UP FOR CLASS',配'From $39'。有活力、运动、现代;钴蓝、黄与青绿配色;居中主体布局,清晰渲染。

prompt_en: A warm teacher welcome-back graphic. A cartoon chalkboard has a shiny red apple on the ledge and a 'Welcome Back Class!' message written in white chalk cursive, surrounded by doodled stars, ABCs and numbers. A stack of books and a pencil pot sit in front. Cheerful, wholesome, nostalgic mood; chalkboard green, chalk white, red and yellow palette; flat illustration with chalk texture, centered square composition.
prompt_zh: 温馨的老师欢迎回班图。一块卡通黑板,托槽上放着一颗亮红苹果,白色粉笔草书写着'Welcome Back Class!',四周是涂鸦的星星、字母和数字。前面一摞书本和一个笔筒。欢快、健康、怀旧;黑板绿、粉笔白、红与黄配色;带粉笔质感的扁平插画,居中方形构图。

prompt_en: A clean back-to-school countdown story graphic. A bright yellow gradient carries floating paper-plane and star doodles. A big navy headline '7 DAYS TIL SCHOOL' pairs with a cartoon pencil mascot giving a thumbs up and a small line 'Grab your supplies now'. A row of crayons lines the bottom edge. Upbeat, motivating, friendly mood; sunny yellow, navy and red palette; vertical story layout with space for stickers at the top.
prompt_zh: 干净的开学倒数快拍图。明亮黄色渐变里漂浮着纸飞机和星星涂鸦。藏青大标题'7 DAYS TIL SCHOOL',配一个竖大拇指的卡通铅笔吉祥物和小字'Grab your supplies now'。底部一排蜡笔。活力、激励、友好;阳光黄、藏青与红配色;竖版快拍布局,顶部留出贴纸空间。

prompt_en: An aesthetic stationery promo for invented brand 'Inkwell'. A soft lavender background arranges pastel notebooks, washi-tape rolls, gel pens and paper clips in a gentle flat-lay. A thin modern headline 'Stationery That Sparks Joy' pairs with 'New term collection out now'. Calm, pretty, trendy mood; lavender, mint, blush and cream pastel palette; airy flat-lay illustration, soft shadows, square composition.
prompt_zh: 为虚构品牌'Inkwell'设计的美学文具宣传图。柔和薰衣草色背景上,粉彩笔记本、和纸胶带卷、中性笔和回形针以温柔的平铺方式摆放。细窄现代标题'Stationery That Sparks Joy',配'New term collection out now'。平静、精致、时髦;薰衣草、薄荷、腮红与奶油的粉彩配色;通透平铺插画,柔和投影,方形构图。

prompt_en: A helpful back-to-school study-tips infographic card. A cream paper-textured background carries a bold navy headline 'Ace Your New Term' at the top, then three numbered tips in rounded boxes: '1 Plan your week', '2 Take real breaks' and '3 Sleep 8 hours', each with a small doodle icon. Friendly, useful, tidy mood; navy, mustard, coral and cream palette; clean infographic layout, hand-drawn accents, portrait framing.
prompt_zh: 实用的开学学习贴士信息图卡。奶油纸质纹理背景,顶部粗藏青标题'Ace Your New Term',下方三条编号贴士置于圆角框中:'1 Plan your week'、'2 Take real breaks'、'3 Sleep 8 hours',每条配一个小涂鸦图标。友好、实用、整洁;藏青、芥末、珊瑚与奶油配色;干净信息图布局,手绘点缀,竖版构图。

prompt_en: A lively campus-life illustration for a back-to-school post. Students walk and chat across a sunny college quad with a brick building, a green lawn, a tree and bikes leaning against a rack, with warm autumn light and drifting leaves. A hand-lettered headline 'Welcome Back to Campus' arcs across the top. Vibrant, social, optimistic mood; warm autumn orange, brick red and green palette; flat illustration, soft shading, wide composition.
prompt_zh: 生动的校园生活插画,用于开学季推文。学生们在阳光明媚的大学中庭走动交谈,红砖楼、绿草坪、一棵树和靠在车架上的自行车,暖暖秋光和飘落的叶子。顶部手写标题'Welcome Back to Campus'弧形排布。生动、社交、乐观;暖秋橙、砖红与绿配色;扁平插画,柔和阴影,宽幅构图。

prompt_en: An elegant Mother's Day sale banner for invented brand 'Bloomhaus'. A soft blush background is framed by hand-painted pink peonies and eucalyptus along the top and bottom. A graceful script headline 'For the Best Mum' in rose-gold pairs with a subline 'Mother's Day Sale · 20% off gifts', a small gift-box icon and a 'Shop the edit' pill. Tender, elegant, warm mood; blush, rose-gold and sage palette; watercolor floral frame, airy centered layout.
prompt_zh: 为虚构品牌'Bloomhaus'设计的优雅母亲节促销横幅。柔和腮红色背景,上下以手绘粉色牡丹和尤加利叶为边框。玫瑰金优雅花体标题'For the Best Mum',配副标'Mother's Day Sale · 20% off gifts'、一个小礼盒图标和一枚'Shop the edit'胶囊。温柔、优雅、温暖;腮红、玫瑰金与鼠尾草配色;水彩花卉边框,通透居中布局。

prompt_en: A sweet cartoon Mother's Day card. A smiling mama bear hugs her little cub under a heart-shaped tree, with tiny hearts floating around them against a soft sky-blue background dotted with fluffy clouds. A rounded coral headline 'Happy Mother's Day' pairs with a small line 'Thanks for everything, Mum'. Heartwarming, cute, gentle mood; sky blue, coral and cream palette; soft cartoon illustration, thick outlines, portrait composition.
prompt_zh: 甜美的卡通母亲节贺卡。一只微笑的熊妈妈在一棵心形树下拥抱她的小熊崽,身边漂浮着小爱心,背景是点缀着蓬松云朵的柔和天蓝色。圆润珊瑚色标题'Happy Mother's Day',配小字'Thanks for everything, Mum'。暖心、可爱、温柔;天蓝、珊瑚与奶油配色;柔和卡通插画,粗描边,竖构图。

prompt_en: A bright Mother's Day brunch promo for invented cafe 'Rosewood Kitchen'. A cream background carries a delicate floral border. A flat-lay illustration of pancakes with berries, a mimosa, a teacup and a single rose sits on a table. An elegant headline 'Treat Mum to Brunch' pairs with details 'Sunday May 10 · Reservations open · Free dessert for mums'. Warm, inviting, celebratory mood; cream, blush and berry palette; illustrated flat-lay, soft light, portrait layout.
prompt_zh: 为虚构咖啡馆'Rosewood Kitchen'设计的明亮母亲节早午餐宣传图。奶油色背景配精致花卉边框。桌上一幅平铺插画:配浆果的松饼、含羞草鸡尾酒、茶杯和一朵玫瑰。优雅标题'Treat Mum to Brunch',配细节'Sunday May 10 · Reservations open · Free dessert for mums'。温暖、诱人、庆祝感;奶油、腮红与浆果配色;插画平铺,柔和光线,竖版布局。

prompt_en: A minimal Mother's Day quote graphic. A warm ivory background carries a single fine-line illustration of a woman and child holding hands in the lower corner. A centered elegant serif quote 'A mother's love is the heart of home' sits above a small 'Happy Mother's Day' in script. Calm, heartfelt, refined mood; ivory, dusty-rose and charcoal palette; abundant whitespace, delicate line art, square composition.
prompt_zh: 极简的母亲节语录图。温暖象牙白背景,下角是一幅细线条插画:一位母亲牵着孩子的手。正中优雅衬线语录'A mother's love is the heart of home',下方小字花体'Happy Mother's Day'。平静、走心、雅致;象牙白、暗玫瑰与炭灰配色;大量留白,精致线描,方形构图。

prompt_en: A bold Father's Day sale banner for invented brand 'Ironwood'. A dark charcoal background carries a subtle wood-grain texture. A strong condensed headline 'FOR THE BEST DAD' in cream sits above 'Father's Day Sale · 30% off' in amber. Flat icons of a wristwatch, a coffee mug and a tie frame the text. Masculine, sturdy, warm mood; charcoal, amber and cream palette; bold centered layout, wood texture, strong type hierarchy.
prompt_zh: 为虚构品牌'Ironwood'设计的大胆父亲节促销横幅。深炭灰背景带隐约木纹质感。粗压缩奶油色标题'FOR THE BEST DAD'上方,下方琥珀色'Father's Day Sale · 30% off'。手表、马克杯和领带的扁平图标围绕文字。硬朗、稳重、温暖;炭灰、琥珀与奶油配色;粗体居中布局,木纹质感,强字体层级。

prompt_en: A hearty Father's Day BBQ promo for invented brand 'Grillhouse'. A warm kraft-brown background carries a flat illustration of a sizzling grill, burgers, corn and a checkered napkin. A bold cream headline 'DAD'S DAY GRILL FEST' pairs with details 'Sunday June 21 · Family combo $45 · Dads eat free'. Fun, appetizing, casual mood; kraft brown, tomato red and mustard palette; friendly illustration, warm shadows, square layout.
prompt_zh: 为虚构品牌'Grillhouse'设计的丰盛父亲节烧烤宣传图。温暖牛皮棕背景上一幅扁平插画:滋滋作响的烤架、汉堡、玉米和格子餐巾。粗奶油色标题'DAD'S DAY GRILL FEST',配细节'Sunday June 21 · Family combo $45 · Dads eat free'。有趣、诱人、随意;牛皮棕、番茄红与芥末配色;友好插画,温暖投影,方形布局。

prompt_en: A stylish Father's Day flat-lay graphic. An overhead view on a slate surface arranges a leather watch, a wallet, a folding knife, a coffee mug and a pair of glasses neatly, with a sprig of greenery for accent. A minimal headline 'To the Man Who Does It All' sits at the top above 'Happy Father's Day'. Refined, masculine, warm mood; slate grey, tan-leather and amber palette; top-down photographic style, soft directional light.
prompt_zh: 时髦的父亲节平铺图。石板灰桌面上俯拍整齐摆放着皮革手表、钱包、折叠刀、马克杯和一副眼镜,一小枝绿植点缀。顶部极简标题'To the Man Who Does It All',下方'Happy Father's Day'。精致、硬朗、温暖;石板灰、棕褐皮革与琥珀配色;俯拍摄影风格,柔和方向光。

prompt_en: A warm family-celebration illustration for a parents' day post. A cozy scene shows two parents and two kids gathered on a couch sharing a photo album and laughing, a cat curled at their feet, soft evening lamp light and a window with a sunset behind. A hand-lettered headline 'Grateful for Family' arcs across the top. Loving, cozy, nostalgic mood; warm amber, terracotta and cream palette; soft illustration, gentle grain, portrait composition.
prompt_zh: 温暖的家庭庆祝插画,用于亲子节日推文。温馨场景中,两位父母和两个孩子围坐沙发上翻看相册大笑,一只猫蜷在脚边,柔和晚间灯光,身后窗外是日落。顶部手写标题'Grateful for Family'弧形排布。充满爱意、温馨、怀旧;暖琥珀、赤陶与奶油配色;柔和插画,细腻颗粒,竖构图。

prompt_en: A wide YouTube thumbnail of a young man in a crisp white shirt, mouth open in shocked excitement, pointing up at a glowing green line chart rocketing off the top-right corner. Deep navy-to-black gradient background with neon-green grid lines. Huge bold white-and-green text 'ZERO TO $10K' fills the left third, with a thick yellow upward arrow slicing through the numbers. Stacks of gold coins glow in the lower corner, dramatic rim lighting, punchy high-contrast finance energy.
prompt_zh: 宽幅YouTube封面：一位穿笔挺白衬衫的年轻男子张大嘴巴、又惊又喜，手指向右上角冲出画面的荧光绿上涨曲线。深藏蓝到纯黑的渐变背景配霓虹绿网格线。左侧三分之一是超大加粗的白绿撞色标题「0到1万美元」，一支粗黄色向上箭头贯穿数字。画面下角堆着发光的金币，戏剧性轮廓光，强对比的理财爽感扑面而来。

prompt_en: A confident middle-aged woman in a charcoal blazer stands with arms crossed inside a glowing steel bank vault, red warning lights flashing behind her. A cracked red stock-crash line falls in the background while a protective blue glass shield wraps around her stack of cash. Massive impact text 'RECESSION PROOF' in bold red and white dominates the top, a green shield icon beside it. High-contrast cinematic lighting, tense but reassuring click-bait mood.
prompt_zh: 一位自信的中年女性身穿炭灰色西装外套，抱臂站在发光的钢制银行金库里，身后红色警报灯闪烁。背景是一条断裂下跌的红色股灾曲线，而一层蓝色玻璃护盾把她面前的现金牢牢护住。顶部是超大冲击力标题「抗衰退不亏钱」，红白撞色加粗，旁边配一枚绿色盾牌图标。高对比电影级灯光，紧张又安心的标题党氛围。

prompt_en: A cheerful investor in a green sweater pushes a giant snowball made entirely of glowing gold coins down a snowy hill, the ball growing huge toward the camera. Icy blue winter background with soft bokeh. Bold rounded text 'DIVIDEND SNOWBALL' arcs across the top in white with a mint-green outline, and a curved yellow arrow shows the ball getting bigger. Money sparkles trail behind. Playful, bright, high-contrast passive-income vibe.
prompt_zh: 一位穿绿色毛衣的开心投资者，在雪坡上推着一个完全由发光金币组成的巨大雪球，雪球越滚越大朝镜头压来。冰蓝色冬日背景带柔和光斑。顶部弧形排布着白色加薄荷绿描边的圆润大字「股息滚雪球」，一条弯曲的黄色箭头标示雪球越滚越大。身后拖着钱币闪光。轻快明亮、强对比的被动收入氛围。

prompt_en: Split-screen thumbnail: left half blood-red with a plunging candlestick chart and a panicked trader clutching his head; right half electric-green with the same chart bouncing upward and the same man now grinning and giving a thumbs up. A giant white lightning bolt divides the two sides. Huge stacked text 'BUY THE DIP' in yellow with a black stroke sits center, a red down-arrow morphing into a green up-arrow. Intense, dramatic, click-worthy.
prompt_zh: 分屏封面：左半边血红色，K线暴跌，一位交易员抱头惊慌；右半边电光绿，同一根曲线触底反弹，同一个人此刻咧嘴大笑竖起大拇指。一道巨大的白色闪电把两边劈开。正中是超大堆叠标题「果断抄底」，黄字黑边，一支红色下跌箭头正变形成绿色上涨箭头。强烈、戏剧化、极具点击欲。

prompt_en: A dramatic thumbnail of a shocked young trader in a dark hoodie, blue screen glow on his face, watching glowing digital coins shatter and rain down around him. Deep purple-to-black background with falling red numbers like a data storm. Enormous jagged text 'CRYPTO CRASH' in white and red fills the top, a broken red arrow smashing downward. Cracked-glass overlay effect on the edges. High-contrast, fearful, doom-scroll energy.
prompt_zh: 一张戏剧化封面：一位穿深色连帽衫的年轻交易员满脸惊恐，蓝色屏幕光打在脸上，看着周围发光的数字币碎裂坠落。深紫到纯黑背景，红色数字如数据暴雨般下落。顶部是巨大的锯齿状标题「币圈崩盘」，白红撞色，一支断裂的红箭头向下砸去。边缘叠加碎裂玻璃特效。高对比、恐慌、令人心慌的氛围。

prompt_en: A relaxed man in sunglasses and a linen shirt lounges in a hammock on a tropical beach, turquoise water behind him, while a glowing pile of cash and a golden clock float beside him. Warm sunset gradient, palm silhouettes. Giant bold text 'RETIRE AT 40' in white with a gold outline arcs across the sky, a green upward arrow through the number 40. Sun-flare highlights, aspirational high-contrast lifestyle energy.
prompt_zh: 一位戴墨镜、穿亚麻衬衫的悠闲男子躺在热带海滩的吊床上，身后是碧绿海水，旁边漂浮着一堆发光现金和一只金色时钟。暖色日落渐变，椰影婆娑。天空中弧形排布着超大加粗标题「四十岁退休」，白字金边，一支绿色上涨箭头穿过数字40。太阳耀斑高光，令人向往的强对比生活方式氛围。

prompt_en: A grinning entrepreneur in a bright blue shirt throws his arms wide as glowing green dollar bills rain down from above, filling the frame. Warm gold-and-teal background with soft light rays. Massive playful text 'PASSIVE INCOME' in white with a thick green shadow sits at the bottom, a curved yellow arrow pointing at the money. Coins bounce off his shoulders. Joyful, over-the-top, high-contrast money-magnet vibe.
prompt_zh: 一位咧嘴大笑、穿亮蓝衬衫的创业者张开双臂，头顶飘落如雨的发光绿色钞票，铺满整个画面。暖金配青绿背景，柔和光束穿透。底部是超大俏皮标题「被动收入」，白字配厚实绿色阴影，一条弯曲黄箭头指向钞票。金币在他肩头弹跳。欢乐、夸张、强对比的吸金氛围。

prompt_en: A triumphant woman in a red top snaps a heavy iron chain labeled with glowing red bill icons, sparks flying as it breaks. Dark stormy background clearing to bright blue on the right side where she stands free. Huge celebratory text 'DEBT FREE!' in gold and white bursts across the top, a green checkmark beside it and a broken red arrow falling away. Backlit hero lighting, empowering high-contrast breakthrough energy.
prompt_zh: 一位穿红色上衣的女性满脸胜利，猛地扯断一条挂着发光红色账单图标的沉重铁链，断裂处火花四溅。背景由阴沉风暴过渡到她所在的右侧明亮蓝天，象征重获自由。顶部炸开超大庆祝标题「零负债！」，金白撞色，旁边一枚绿色对勾，一支断裂的红箭头坠落。逆光英雄式打光，赋能感十足的强对比突破氛围。

prompt_en: A serious man in a dark suit leans toward the camera with a finger over his lips, one eyebrow raised, half his face lit in cold blue, half in warm gold. Behind him a blurred trading floor with glowing green tickers. Bold conspiratorial text 'THE STOCK THEY HIDE' in yellow with a black outline fills the right side, a red circle-and-arrow highlighting a mystery ticker. Moody, secretive, high-contrast click-bait tension.
prompt_zh: 一位穿深色西装、神情严肃的男子俯身凑近镜头，一根手指竖在唇前示意噤声，一边眉毛挑起，半张脸打冷蓝光、半张脸打暖金光。身后是虚化的交易大厅，绿色行情牌闪烁。右侧是加粗的阴谋感标题「庄家藏的股票」，黄字黑边，一个红色圈加箭头圈住神秘代码。氛围阴郁、神秘，强对比的标题党张力。

prompt_en: A polished man in a golden-hour city penthouse sips coffee while checking a glowing green portfolio on a tablet, sunrise skyline behind floor-to-ceiling windows. Warm gold-and-cream palette. Bold text 'MILLIONAIRE HABITS' in deep navy on a bright gold banner runs across the top, a small green up-arrow and a checklist of glowing checkmarks floating beside him. Crisp, aspirational, high-contrast wealth-lifestyle energy.
prompt_zh: 一位形象考究的男子在洒满晨光的城市顶层公寓里啜着咖啡，同时用平板查看发光的绿色投资组合，落地窗外是日出天际线。暖金配奶油色调。顶部一条明亮金色横幅上印着深藏蓝加粗标题「百万富翁的习惯」，旁边漂浮着一个绿色小上箭头和一串发光的对勾清单。清爽、令人向往，强对比的财富生活方式氛围。

prompt_en: An energetic young woman in a mustard blazer points both hands at a floating laptop that glows with a green rising revenue graph, coins spilling from the screen. Bold teal-to-black gradient background with light streaks. Enormous stacked text 'SIX FIGURE SIDE HUSTLE' in white and orange fills the left side, a thick green arrow curving up past a '$100K' badge. Confident smile, dynamic pose, high-contrast entrepreneurial hype.
prompt_zh: 一位活力四射、穿芥末黄西装的年轻女性双手指向一台悬浮的笔记本电脑，屏幕闪着绿色上涨营收曲线，金币从屏幕里溢出。青绿到纯黑的渐变背景配光线条纹。左侧是超大堆叠标题「六位数副业」，白橙撞色，一支粗绿箭头弯曲上冲，越过一枚「10万美元」徽章。自信笑容、动感姿态，强对比的创业燃感。

prompt_en: A man in a wrinkled office shirt joyfully tosses a company ID badge into the air, tie loosened, gray cubicle office behind him dissolving into a bright open sky. Split lighting: dull gray left, vibrant orange right. Giant bold text 'I QUIT MY JOB' in white with a red outline dominates the top, a green arrow pointing from a tiny office toward a big sun. Freeing, dramatic, high-contrast escape-the-9-to-5 energy.
prompt_zh: 一位穿皱巴巴办公室衬衫的男子欢喜地把工牌抛向空中，领带松开，身后灰暗的格子间办公室正溶解成明亮开阔的天空。分区打光：左侧沉闷灰、右侧鲜活橙。顶部霸占着超大加粗标题「我辞职了」，白字红边，一支绿色箭头从小小办公室指向大大的太阳。解脱、戏剧化，强对比的逃离朝九晚五氛围。

prompt_en: A determined female founder in a sleek black turtleneck stands before a giant glowing bar chart climbing from a tiny bar to a towering gold '$1M' column. Deep purple stage background with spotlight beams. Massive text 'SCALE TO $1M' in white and gold across the top, a bright green arrow rocketing up the bars. A rocket-ship icon launches from the tallest column. Bold, cinematic, high-contrast growth-story energy.
prompt_zh: 一位坚定的女性创始人身穿利落的黑色高领衫，站在一张发光柱状图前，柱子从矮小一路攀升到一根高耸的金色「100万美元」大柱。深紫舞台背景配聚光灯束。顶部是超大标题「做到一百万」，白金撞色，一支亮绿箭头沿柱子火箭式上冲。最高的柱子上有一枚火箭图标升空。大气、电影感，强对比的增长故事氛围。

prompt_en: A stressed young founder in a gray hoodie holds his head in disbelief in front of a cracked laptop showing a red flatlining revenue chart. Dark smoky background with embers, a broken company sign labeled 'NOVARA' falling behind him. Huge alarming text 'THIS KILLED MY STARTUP' in red and white fills the top, a jagged red down-arrow and a warning triangle. Regretful, dramatic, high-contrast cautionary tale energy.
prompt_zh: 一位穿灰色连帽衫的年轻创始人满脸不敢置信地抱着头，面前是一台屏幕碎裂的笔记本，上面是一条拉平归零的红色营收曲线。昏暗烟雾背景带余烬，身后一块写着虚构品牌「NOVARA」的招牌正在坠落。顶部是巨大的警示标题「这毁了我的创业」，红白撞色，一支锯齿状红色下跌箭头加一个警告三角。懊悔、戏剧化，强对比的前车之鉴氛围。

prompt_en: A confident marketer in a bright orange shirt smirks and points at a floating email window glowing green with a 'REPLY: YES!' notification and dollar signs popping out. Clean blue-to-teal gradient background. Bold text 'COLD EMAIL HACK' in white with a yellow highlight sits on the right, a green arrow from the send button to a stack of cash. A giant cursor clicks 'SEND'. Snappy, punchy, high-contrast growth-hack energy.
prompt_zh: 一位穿亮橙衬衫的自信营销人得意一笑，手指向一个悬浮的邮件窗口，窗口泛着绿光，弹出「回复：成交！」的通知和一串美元符号。干净的蓝到青渐变背景。右侧是加粗标题「陌生邮件绝招」，白字配黄色高亮，一支绿箭头从发送键连到一叠现金。一个巨大光标正点击「发送」。利落、有冲击力，强对比的增长黑客氛围。

prompt_en: A skeptical entrepreneur in a denim jacket shrugs with a puzzled 'really?' expression beside a cardboard shipping box wrapped in a glowing red question mark. Split background: green profit graph on one side, red crossed-out cart on the other. Huge text 'DROPSHIPPING DEAD?' in yellow and black across the top, a red down-arrow versus a small green up-arrow. Debate-style, provocative, high-contrast hot-take energy.
prompt_zh: 一位穿牛仔外套、满脸怀疑的创业者耸着肩，露出「真的假的？」的困惑表情，旁边是一个缠着发光红色问号的快递纸箱。分屏背景：一边是绿色盈利曲线，另一边是被红叉划掉的购物车。顶部是巨大标题「无货源电商凉了？」，黄黑撞色，一支红色下跌箭头对上一个绿色小上箭头。辩论式、挑衅感，强对比的热点观点氛围。

prompt_en: A beaming beginner in a simple green tee holds up a phone showing a glowing '$100.00' payout notification, confetti bursting around him. Bright warm-yellow background with soft radial glow. Big friendly text 'MY FIRST $100 ONLINE' in white with a blue outline fills the bottom, a green up-arrow from a laptop to the phone. A gold coin mascot gives a thumbs up. Encouraging, wholesome, high-contrast beginner-win energy.
prompt_zh: 一位笑得合不拢嘴的新手穿着简单的绿色T恤，举起手机展示一条发光的「+100.00美元」到账通知，身边彩纸炸开。明亮暖黄背景带柔和放射光晕。底部是友好的大字「网上赚的第一个100美元」，白字蓝边，一支绿色上箭头从笔记本连到手机。一枚金币吉祥物竖起大拇指。鼓舞、治愈，强对比的新手首胜氛围。

prompt_en: A bold young woman in a red power suit points a giant glowing 'YOU'RE FIRED' stamp toward the viewer, smirking with total confidence. Dramatic dark-red background with spotlight and rising smoke. Enormous impact text 'FIRE YOUR BOSS' in white and gold across the top, a green arrow from an office chair to a beach chair. Sparks around the stamp. Rebellious, empowering, high-contrast attention-grabbing energy.
prompt_zh: 一位气场十足的年轻女性身穿红色干练西装，把一枚发光的巨大「你被炒了」印章朝观众推来，得意又自信地微笑。戏剧化的暗红背景配聚光灯和升腾烟雾。顶部是超大冲击标题「炒掉你老板」，白金撞色，一支绿箭头从办公椅指向沙滩椅。印章周围火花四溅。叛逆、赋能，强对比的抢眼氛围。

prompt_en: An excited developer in a hoodie sits before three glowing monitors displaying a sleek dashboard app, code streaming past, a green subscriber counter ticking up. Cool blue-purple tech background with circuit patterns. Bold text 'SaaS IN 30 DAYS' in white with a cyan glow fills the top, a bright green arrow spiraling around a big '30' badge. A rocket launches from a screen. Fast-paced, techy, high-contrast build-in-public energy.
prompt_zh: 一位兴奋的开发者穿着连帽衫，坐在三块发光显示器前，屏幕上是一款精致的仪表盘应用，代码流淌而过，绿色订阅数一路跳涨。冷调蓝紫科技背景带电路纹理。顶部是加粗标题「三十天做出SaaS」，白字配青色辉光，一支亮绿箭头绕着一枚巨大「30」徽章盘旋。一枚火箭从屏幕里升空。快节奏、科技感，强对比的公开开发氛围。

prompt_en: A slick agency owner in a black blazer pulls back a red velvet curtain to reveal a glowing wall of client logos and rising green revenue graphs. Moody spotlight, deep charcoal background. Huge text 'AGENCY SECRETS' in gold and white across the top with a small red 'EXPOSED' stamp slapped diagonally, a green arrow pointing behind the curtain. Mysterious, insider-reveal, high-contrast curiosity-gap energy.
prompt_zh: 一位派头十足、穿黑色西装的代运营公司老板拉开一道红丝绒帷幕，露出一面发光的客户标识墙和一条条上涨的绿色营收曲线。氛围聚光灯，深炭灰背景。顶部是巨大标题「代运营内幕」，金白撞色，斜贴一枚红色「曝光」印章，一支绿箭头指向帷幕后方。神秘、揭内幕，强对比的好奇心缺口氛围。

prompt_en: A sun-kissed backpacker in a floral shirt grins wide beside a scooter loaded with fruit, emerald rice terraces and palm trees behind him under a bright blue sky. Warm tropical color grade. Massive text 'BALI ON $20/DAY' in white with an orange outline arcs across the top, a green arrow pointing at a fanned stack of small bills. A coconut and a beach flag frame the corners. Vibrant, wanderlust, high-contrast budget-travel energy.
prompt_zh: 一位晒得黝黑、穿花衬衫的背包客咧嘴大笑，旁边一辆载满水果的小摩托，身后是碧绿梯田和椰林，头顶湛蓝天空。暖调热带调色。顶部弧形排布着超大标题「20美元玩转巴厘岛」，白字橙边，一支绿箭头指向一把摊开的小额钞票。椰子和沙滩旗点缀画面四角。鲜艳、勾人旅行欲，强对比的穷游氛围。

prompt_en: A relaxed young couple sits in the open back doors of a cozy converted van, string lights glowing inside, parked on a cliff overlooking a golden-orange sunset ocean. Warm dreamy tones. Big handwritten-style text 'LIVING IN A VAN' in white with a teal shadow across the bottom, a small heart and a green arrow pointing into the snug interior. A dog peeks out. Cozy, aspirational, high-contrast van-life energy.
prompt_zh: 一对惬意的年轻情侣坐在一辆温馨改装房车敞开的后门口，车内串灯发着暖光，车停在悬崖上，俯瞰金橙色日落大海。暖调梦幻色彩。底部是手写风格大字「住在房车里」，白字配青色阴影，一颗小爱心和一支绿箭头指向舒适的车内。一只狗探出头来。温馨、令人向往，强对比的房车生活氛围。

prompt_en: A wide-eyed traveler in a black jacket stands amazed in a rain-slick neon alley bursting with glowing pink, blue, and purple signs in invented kanji-style characters. Reflections shimmer on wet pavement. Bold text 'LOST IN TOKYO' in white with a magenta glow fills the top-left, a red arrow pointing down a mysterious side street. A steaming ramen stall glows nearby. Electric, immersive, high-contrast night-vlog energy.
prompt_zh: 一位睁大双眼、穿黑色夹克的旅行者惊叹地站在被雨水打湿的霓虹小巷里，四周是发光的粉、蓝、紫招牌，招牌上是虚构的仿汉字字符。湿漉漉的地面倒映着流光。顶部左侧是加粗标题「迷失东京」，白字配洋红辉光，一支红箭头指向一条神秘小街。近处一个热气腾腾的拉面摊发着暖光。electric感、沉浸式，强对比的夜间vlog氛围。

prompt_en: A frazzled traveler slumps in a cramped economy seat with a shocked, exhausted face, oxygen mask dangling and turbulence tossing luggage overhead. Harsh cabin lighting, tilted horizon through the window showing storm clouds. Huge alarming text 'WORST FLIGHT EVER' in yellow and red across the top, a red arrow pointing at the chaos and a warning triangle. Chaotic, relatable, high-contrast travel-disaster energy.
prompt_zh: 一位焦头烂额的旅客瘫坐在狭窄的经济舱座位上，一脸震惊又疲惫，氧气面罩晃荡着，颠簸把头顶行李震得乱飞。刺眼的客舱灯光，倾斜的地平线透过舷窗露出乌云。顶部是巨大的警示标题「史上最糟航班」，黄红撞色，一支红箭头指向混乱现场，配一个警告三角。混乱、有共鸣，强对比的旅行灾难氛围。

name_zh: 一美元对一千美元酒店
prompt_en: Split-screen thumbnail: left half a grimy budget room with peeling walls and a shocked traveler, tinted sickly green; right half a lavish marble suite with a floating pool view and the same traveler in a plush robe, warm gold. A glowing white 'VS' divides them. Big text '$1 VS $1000 HOTEL' in white with a red outline across the top, arrows labeling each side. Contrasty, jaw-dropping, high-contrast comparison energy.
prompt_zh: 分屏封面：左半边是墙皮脱落的脏乱平价房，一位旅客惊呆了，画面泛着病态绿；右半边是豪华大理石套房，无边泳池景观漂浮眼前，同一位旅客裹着蓬松浴袍，暖金色调。中间一个发光白色「VS」把两边隔开。顶部是大字「1美元 对 1000美元酒店」，白字红边，箭头分别标注两侧。反差强烈、令人瞠目，强对比的对比测评氛围。

prompt_en: An excited vlogger in sunglasses leans out of a golden supercar in front of a towering futuristic skyline glowing at sunset, a glowing clock reading 24:00 floating beside him. Warm luxury color grade with lens flare. Massive text '24 HOURS IN DUBAI' in gold and white across the top, a green arrow sweeping across the skyline. A stack of luxury shopping bags in the corner. Flashy, extravagant, high-contrast luxury-travel energy.
prompt_zh: 一位戴墨镜的兴奋vlogger从一辆金色超跑里探身而出，身后是一片高耸的未来感天际线在日落中发光，旁边漂浮着一只显示24:00的发光时钟。暖调奢华调色带镜头光晕。顶部是超大标题「迪拜24小时」，金白撞色，一支绿箭头横扫天际线。角落堆着一摞奢侈品购物袋。炫、奢华，强对比的高端旅行氛围。

prompt_en: A confident solo traveler with a backpack stands on a mountain ridge at golden hour, arms raised in triumph, a vast valley and winding river below. Warm empowering light. Bold text 'SOLO FEMALE TRAVEL' in white with a coral outline arcs across the sky, a small green heart and a compass icon beside it. A gentle wind lifts her scarf. Inspiring, free, high-contrast adventure-vlog energy.
prompt_zh: 一位自信的独行旅者背着背包，在金色黄昏时分站在山脊上，双臂高举庆祝，脚下是辽阔山谷和蜿蜒河流。温暖赋能的光线。天空中弧形排布着加粗标题「女生独自旅行」，白字配珊瑚色描边，旁边一颗绿色小爱心和一枚指南针图标。微风掀起她的围巾。励志、自由，强对比的冒险vlog氛围。

prompt_en: A weary traveler in a puffy jacket curls up across a row of metal airport chairs using a backpack as a pillow, harsh fluorescent lighting, a giant departures board glowing 'DELAYED' in red behind him. Cold blue-teal tint. Big funny text 'SLEEPING IN THE AIRPORT' in white with a red outline across the top, a red arrow at the delayed board and a snoring 'Zzz'. Relatable, comedic, high-contrast travel-fail energy.
prompt_zh: 一位疲惫的旅客穿着蓬松羽绒服，横躺在一排金属机场座椅上，拿背包当枕头，头顶惨白日光灯，身后巨大的航班信息屏红字显示「延误」。冷调蓝青色。顶部是搞笑大字「睡在机场」，白字红边，一支红箭头指向延误信息屏，配一串打呼的「Zzz」。有共鸣、搞笑，强对比的旅行翻车氛围。

prompt_en: An awestruck traveler in swim shorts stands in impossibly clear turquoise water over glowing pink sand, a heart-shaped reef visible below and dramatic tropical clouds above. Hyper-saturated dreamy color grade. Huge text 'THIS BEACH IS REAL?!' in white with a cyan glow across the top, a green arrow pointing at the surreal water and a shocked emoji-style face. Jaw-dropping, unbelievable, high-contrast paradise-reveal energy.
prompt_zh: 一位惊叹不已、穿泳裤的旅行者站在清澈到不真实的碧绿海水中，脚下是发光的粉色沙滩，水下可见一片心形珊瑚礁，头顶是壮丽的热带云层。极度饱和的梦幻调色。顶部是巨大标题「这海滩是真的？！」，白字配青色辉光，一支绿箭头指向超现实的海水，旁边一张震惊的表情脸。令人瞠目、难以置信，强对比的天堂揭秘氛围。

prompt_en: A laptop-toting nomad works at a beachside cafe table under a palm umbrella, iced coffee sweating, ocean waves behind, a glowing 'WORKING' banner over a hammock. Warm sunny palette with soft shadows. Bold text 'DIGITAL NOMAD LIFE' in white with an orange shadow across the bottom, a green arrow from a laptop to a passport stamp collage. A tiny plane icon flies overhead. Relaxed, aspirational, high-contrast remote-work energy.
prompt_zh: 一位带着笔记本的游民在海边咖啡桌旁办公，桌上冰咖啡凝着水珠，身后海浪翻涌，吊床上方挂着发光的「工作中」横幅，头顶棕榈遮阳伞。暖调阳光色彩带柔和阴影。底部是加粗标题「数字游民生活」，白字配橙色阴影，一支绿箭头从笔记本连到一组护照盖章拼贴。一架小飞机图标从头顶掠过。放松、令人向往，强对比的远程办公氛围。

prompt_en: Side-by-side thumbnail of the same man: left in dim gray light looking soft and slouched, right in bright warm light with defined muscles, flexed and confident. A glowing white arrow labeled '30 DAYS' sweeps from left to right. Huge text 'BODY TRANSFORMATION' in yellow and black across the top, a green up-arrow beside the fit side. Dramatic before-and-after lighting, motivating, high-contrast fitness-result energy.
prompt_zh: 同一位男子的前后对比封面：左边在昏暗灰光下显得松垮、含胸驼背，右边在明亮暖光下肌肉线条分明，绷紧肌肉、自信满满。一支写着「30天」的发光白箭头从左扫向右。顶部是巨大标题「身材蜕变」，黄黑撞色，健身那侧旁边配一个绿色上箭头。戏剧化的前后打光，激励感强，强对比的健身成果氛围。

prompt_en: A muscular man mid-flex grins in a moody gym lit with red and blue accent lights, chalk dust in the air, a barbell loaded heavy behind him. His shadow shows a smaller 'before' silhouette. Bold text 'SKINNY TO BUFF' in white with a red outline dominates the top, a thick green arrow from a thin outline to his big frame. Sweat and rim light, intense, high-contrast bulking-journey energy.
prompt_zh: 一位肌肉发达的男子正绷紧肌肉、咧嘴而笑，身处氛围感十足的健身房，红蓝辅光交织，空气中飘着镁粉，身后一根杠铃压满了片。他的影子呈现出一个更瘦小的「之前」轮廓。顶部是霸气标题「瘦子变壮汉」，白字红边，一支粗绿箭头从瘦削轮廓指向他壮硕的身形。汗水加轮廓光，强烈，强对比的增肌历程氛围。

prompt_en: A worried gym-goer in a tank top clutches his head beside a red-circled donut and a glowing 'NO GAINS' warning sign. Dark gym background with a dramatic red spotlight. Huge alarming text 'THIS RUINS YOUR GAINS' in yellow and red across the top, a red X over the junk food and a green checkmark over a protein shake. A muscle-arm icon deflating like a balloon. Cautionary, punchy, high-contrast fitness-myth energy.
prompt_zh: 一位穿背心、忧心忡忡的健身者抱着头，旁边是一个被红圈圈住的甜甜圈和一块发光的「零增肌」警示牌。昏暗健身房背景配戏剧化红色聚光灯。顶部是巨大警示标题「这毁掉你的肌肉」，黄红撞色，垃圾食品上打红叉、蛋白粉上打绿勾。一个肌肉手臂图标像气球一样瘪下去。警示、有冲击力，强对比的健身误区氛围。

prompt_en: A fit woman in athletic wear points proudly at her defined six-pack abs, glowing green outline tracing each muscle, in a bright modern gym with soft blue lighting. Clean energetic palette. Bold text 'GET ABS FAST' in white with a hot-pink outline fills the right side, a green arrow and a glowing '30 DAY' badge. A stopwatch icon ticks beside her. Motivating, crisp, high-contrast fitness-goal energy.
prompt_zh: 一位身材紧实、穿运动装的女性自豪地指着自己清晰的六块腹肌，每块肌肉都被发光的绿色轮廓勾勒，身处明亮现代的健身房，柔和蓝光。干净有活力的配色。右侧是加粗标题「快速练出腹肌」，白字配亮粉描边，一支绿箭头和一枚发光的「30天」徽章。旁边一只秒表图标滴答走动。激励、清爽，强对比的健身目标氛围。

prompt_en: A sweat-drenched athlete mid-pushup on a gym floor stares intensely at the camera, veins popping, a glowing calendar behind him with 30 days X'd out in red. Moody spotlight, dark background. Huge text 'I TRAINED EVERY DAY' in white with an orange outline across the top, a green arrow tracking a rising strength graph. Water splashes frozen mid-air. Grueling, inspiring, high-contrast discipline-challenge energy.
prompt_zh: 一位汗如雨下的运动员正做俯卧撑，趴在健身房地板上死死盯着镜头，青筋暴起，身后是一面发光日历，30天被红叉逐一划掉。氛围聚光灯，昏暗背景。顶部是巨大标题「我天天练」，白字橙边，一支绿箭头追踪一条上升的力量曲线。飞溅的汗水凝固在半空。艰苦、励志，强对比的自律挑战氛围。

prompt_en: An energetic guy does a bodyweight lunge in a bright living room, dumbbell-free, glowing motion arcs tracing his movement, a rolled yoga mat and water bottle nearby. Clean bright-white and lime-green palette. Bold text 'NO GYM NEEDED' in navy on a lime banner across the top, a red X over a barbell and a green checkmark over a home icon. Approachable, upbeat, high-contrast home-fitness energy.
prompt_zh: 一位充满活力的男子在明亮客厅里做徒手箭步蹲，没有器械，发光的运动弧线勾勒出他的动作，旁边放着一卷瑜伽垫和一瓶水。干净的亮白配青柠绿配色。顶部一条青柠色横幅上印着藏蓝加粗标题「不用健身房」，杠铃上打红叉、家的图标上打绿勾。亲切、活力满满，强对比的居家健身氛围。

prompt_en: A powerlifter mid-deadlift grits his teeth under a bar bending with massive plates labeled with a glowing '405 LB' total, chalk exploding off his hands. Dramatic dark gym with a single overhead spotlight. Enormous text 'BIGGEST DEADLIFT EVER' in white with a red outline across the top, a green up-arrow and lightning bolts around the bar. Straining, epic, high-contrast personal-record energy.
prompt_zh: 一位力量举选手正做硬拉，咬紧牙关，杠铃被巨大的杠铃片压弯，片上发光标注着「405磅」总重，双手镁粉炸开。戏剧化的昏暗健身房，头顶一束孤光。顶部是超大标题「史上最大硬拉」，白字红边，一支绿色上箭头和杠铃周围的闪电。发力、史诗感，强对比的个人纪录氛围。

prompt_en: A smiling woman pinches a shrinking waistline, a glowing green measuring tape wrapping her midsection with the number dropping, bright clean studio background. Fresh mint-and-white palette with soft light. Big bold text 'LOSE BELLY FAT' in white with a teal outline fills the top-left, a green down-arrow on the waist number and a red X over sugary snacks. A running-shoe icon beside her. Positive, motivating, high-contrast weight-loss energy.
prompt_zh: 一位微笑的女性捏着日渐纤细的腰身，一条发光的绿色卷尺缠在腰间，数字不断下降，明亮干净的影棚背景。清新的薄荷配白色调，柔光。左上方是加粗大字「减掉肚腩」，白字配青色描边，腰围数字旁一支绿色下降箭头，含糖零食上打红叉。旁边一只跑鞋图标。正能量、激励，强对比的减脂氛围。

prompt_en: A comedic scene of a wobbling gym-goer about to drop a wildly unbalanced barbell, face frozen in panic, weights slipping off one side. Bright gym with warning-yellow accents. Huge funny text 'GYM FAILS!' in white with a red outline across the top, a red arrow at the tipping bar and a cartoon '!' burst. A spotter face-palms in the background. Chaotic, funny, high-contrast comedy-compilation energy.
prompt_zh: 一个搞笑场景：一位摇摇晃晃的健身者眼看要甩掉一根严重失衡的杠铃，脸上凝固着惊慌，一侧的杠铃片正往下滑。明亮健身房配警示黄点缀。顶部是搞笑大字「健身房翻车！」，白字红边，一支红箭头指向倾斜的杠铃，配一个卡通「！」爆点。背景里一位保护者捂脸。混乱、搞笑，强对比的翻车合集氛围。

prompt_en: A jacked bodybuilder flexes his chest and arms post-workout, skin glistening with sweat and a visible pump, veins bulging, in a red-and-black lit hardcore gym with fog. Intense dramatic lighting. Bold text 'PUSH DAY PUMP' in white with a fiery orange outline across the top, a green up-arrow and flame graphics around his arms. A protein shaker glows nearby. Aggressive, hyped, high-contrast gym-motivation energy.
prompt_zh: 一位肌肉暴涨的健美选手在训练后绷紧胸肌和手臂，皮肤汗光闪亮、充血泵感明显，青筋暴起，身处红黑灯光的硬核健身房，雾气弥漫。强烈戏剧化打光。顶部是加粗标题「练胸日泵感」，白字配火焰橙描边，一支绿色上箭头和手臂周围的火焰图形。旁边一只摇摇杯发着光。攻击性强、燃爆，强对比的健身激励氛围。

name_zh: 五美元对五百美元牛排
prompt_en: Split-screen thumbnail: left a plain thin steak on a paper plate under dull light, right a thick marbled ribeye seared golden on a sizzling cast-iron with rising steam, under warm gourmet lighting. A glowing white 'VS' splits them. Huge text '$5 VS $500 STEAK' in white with a red outline across the top, arrows labeling each. A shocked chef peeks in the corner. Mouth-watering, dramatic, high-contrast food-comparison energy.
prompt_zh: 分屏封面：左边是暗淡灯光下纸盘里一块寡淡的薄牛排，右边是暖调美食灯光下一块厚切雪花肋眼在滋滋作响的铸铁锅里煎得金黄、热气升腾。中间一个发光白色「VS」把两边分开。顶部是巨大标题「5美元 对 500美元牛排」，白字红边，箭头分别标注两侧。角落一位惊呆的厨师探头。诱人、戏剧化，强对比的美食对比氛围。

prompt_en: A delighted home cook holds up a forkful of glossy, cheesy baked feta-and-tomato pasta, strings of melted cheese stretching, steam rising, against a warm rustic kitchen background. Vibrant red-and-cream palette. Bold text 'VIRAL PASTA!' in white with a red outline fills the top, a green arrow at the cheese pull and a glowing '10M VIEWS' badge. A fork icon with sparkles. Cozy, crave-worthy, high-contrast trending-recipe energy.
prompt_zh: 一位满脸欣喜的家庭厨师举起一叉油亮拉丝的芝士番茄烤菲达意面，融化的芝士拉出长长的丝，热气升腾，背景是温暖质朴的厨房。鲜活的红配奶油色调。顶部是加粗标题「全网爆火意面」，白字红边，一支绿箭头指向拉丝的芝士，配一枚发光的「千万播放」徽章。一个带闪光的叉子图标。温馨、馋人，强对比的爆款菜谱氛围。

prompt_en: An overwhelmed chef stands behind a mountain of eggs cooked every way imaginable, fried, boiled, scrambled, poached, holding a spatula with a wide-eyed 'help me' grin. Bright cheerful kitchen with yellow accents. Huge text 'I COOKED 100 EGGS' in white with an orange outline across the top, a green arrow sweeping the pile and a glowing '100' badge. Yolks drip comically. Absurd, fun, high-contrast challenge-cooking energy.
prompt_zh: 一位手忙脚乱的厨师站在一座各种做法的鸡蛋小山后面——煎的、煮的、炒的、水波的，手握锅铲，睁大双眼露出「救救我」的笑容。明亮欢快的厨房配黄色点缀。顶部是巨大标题「我做了100个蛋」，白字橙边，一支绿箭头扫过蛋堆，配一枚发光「100」徽章。蛋黄滑稽地滴落。荒诞、有趣，强对比的挑战料理氛围。

prompt_en: A red-faced person fans their open mouth, eyes watering and sweating, holding a bowl of glowing crimson chili noodles wreathed in fiery flame graphics. Dark background with blazing orange glow. Huge text 'WORLD'S SPICIEST NOODLES' in yellow and red across the top, a warning triangle and a red arrow at the flaming bowl. A cartoon 'HOT' pepper icon with a flame. Painful, hilarious, high-contrast spicy-challenge energy.
prompt_zh: 一位辣得满脸通红的人张大嘴巴猛扇风，眼泪汪汪、汗水直冒，手捧一碗发光的深红辣椒泡面，碗身缠着火焰图形。昏暗背景配炽烈的橙色辉光。顶部是巨大标题「世界最辣泡面」，黄红撞色，一个警告三角和一支红箭头指向冒火的面碗。一个带火焰的卡通「辣」椒图标。痛苦、爆笑，强对比的辣度挑战氛围。

prompt_en: A hungry eater grips a towering, teetering burger stacked with countless patties, melting cheese oozing down the sides, sesame bun on top, against a bold red-and-yellow background. Mouth wide open. Enormous text '10 LB BURGER!' in white with a red outline dominates the top, a green arrow measuring its height and a glowing 'CHALLENGE' stamp. A napkin flag on a skewer. Ridiculous, appetizing, high-contrast food-challenge energy.
prompt_zh: 一位饥肠辘辘的食客双手抱住一个高得摇摇欲坠的汉堡，层层肉饼堆叠，融化的芝士从侧面淌下，顶上是芝麻面包，背景是抢眼的红黄撞色。嘴张得老大。顶部霸占着超大标题「十磅巨无霸」，白字红边，一支绿箭头量着它的高度，配一枚发光「挑战」印章。一根签子上插着餐巾小旗。夸张、诱人，强对比的大胃挑战氛围。

prompt_en: Split-screen: left a limp greasy fast-food burger in a crumpled wrapper from invented chain 'BURGERBLITZ', dull lighting; right a gorgeous homemade burger glowing under warm light, fresh toppings, on a wooden board. A glowing 'VS' between them. Bold text 'HOMEMADE WINS' in white with a green outline across the top, a green checkmark on the home side and a red X on the other. Satisfying, comparison, high-contrast recipe-battle energy.
prompt_zh: 分屏：左边是虚构快餐品牌「BURGERBLITZ」皱巴巴包装纸里一个软趴趴、油腻的快餐汉堡，灯光暗淡；右边是一个在暖光下发亮的绝美自制汉堡，配料新鲜，摆在木板上。中间一个发光「VS」。顶部是加粗标题「自制完胜」，白字绿边，自制那侧打绿勾、另一侧打红叉。解气、对比感，强对比的菜谱对决氛围。

prompt_en: A cheerful cook plates a colorful avocado-and-egg toast in a bright sunny kitchen, a glowing timer reading 5:00 floating beside a stack of fresh ingredients. Clean fresh green-and-white palette. Bold text '5 MIN BREAKFAST' in navy on a bright yellow banner across the top, a green arrow from a clock to the finished plate and a checkmark. A steaming coffee mug nearby. Quick, wholesome, high-contrast easy-recipe energy.
prompt_zh: 一位开心的厨师在明亮阳光的厨房里摆盘一份色彩缤纷的牛油果鸡蛋吐司，一只显示5:00的发光计时器漂浮在一堆新鲜食材旁。清新的绿白配色。顶部一条亮黄横幅上印着藏蓝加粗标题「五分钟早餐」，一支绿箭头从时钟连到成品，配一个绿勾。旁边一杯热气腾腾的咖啡。快手、健康，强对比的简易菜谱氛围。

prompt_en: A grinning chef holds up a piece of impossibly crispy golden fried chicken with a visible crunch and steam, oil droplets glistening, against a warm amber background. Rich crispy textures. Huge text 'PERFECT FRIED CHICKEN' in white with a red outline across the top, a green arrow at the crunchy crust and a glowing 'SECRET' badge. A pile of golden chicken behind. Crispy, irresistible, high-contrast recipe-reveal energy.
prompt_zh: 一位咧嘴大笑的厨师举起一块酥脆到不可思议的金黄炸鸡，脆壳分明、热气蒸腾，油珠闪亮，背景是温暖的琥珀色。丰富的酥脆质感。顶部是巨大标题「完美炸鸡」，白字红边，一支绿箭头指向酥脆外壳，配一枚发光的「秘诀」徽章。身后堆着一摞金黄炸鸡。酥脆、无法抗拒，强对比的菜谱揭秘氛围。

prompt_en: Two competing cooks face off across a kitchen counter, each holding a mysterious glowing box, dramatic tension between them, spotlight on a covered dish in the center. Bold red-and-blue split lighting per side. Huge text 'MYSTERY BOX!' in white with a gold outline across the top, a question mark on each box and a 'VS' in the middle. Sparks and steam. Competitive, suspenseful, high-contrast cooking-battle energy.
prompt_zh: 两位竞争的厨师隔着厨房台面对峙，各自捧着一个发光的神秘盒子，彼此间张力十足，聚光灯打在中央一道盖着盖子的菜上。两侧分别是红蓝分区打光。顶部是巨大标题「神秘食材盒！」，白字金边，每个盒子上一个问号，中间一个「VS」。火花与蒸汽四溅。竞争、悬念，强对比的料理对决氛围。

prompt_en: A flustered baker stares in despair at a hilariously collapsed multi-tier cake sliding sideways, frosting smeared everywhere, one hand on their forehead. Bright pastel kitchen with pink accents. Big comedic text 'THIS CAKE BROKE ME' in white with a hot-pink outline across the top, a red down-arrow at the toppling cake and a crying-laughing face. Frosting splatters frozen mid-air. Messy, funny, high-contrast baking-fail energy.
prompt_zh: 一位手足无措的烘焙师绝望地盯着一个滑稽塌向一边的多层蛋糕，糖霜糊得到处都是，一只手扶着额头。明亮的马卡龙色厨房配粉色点缀。顶部是搞笑大字「这蛋糕整崩了我」，白字配亮粉描边，一支红色下降箭头指向倾倒的蛋糕，配一张笑哭的脸。糖霜飞溅凝固在半空。狼狈、搞笑，强对比的烘焙翻车氛围。

prompt_en: A friendly host in a teal shirt gestures at a glowing 3D diagram of a router beaming radio waves to floating devices, animated signal arcs and data packets zipping around. Clean tech-blue background with grid lines. Bold text 'HOW WIFI WORKS' in white with a cyan outline across the top, a green arrow tracing a signal and a lightbulb icon. Simple labels on the waves. Clear, curious, high-contrast explainer energy.
prompt_zh: 一位穿青色衬衫、亲切的主持人指向一张发光的路由器3D示意图，路由器向漂浮的设备发出无线电波，信号弧线和数据包动感地穿梭。干净的科技蓝背景带网格线。顶部是加粗标题「WiFi怎么工作」，白字配青色描边，一支绿箭头追踪一道信号，配一个灯泡图标。电波上有简单标签。清晰、勾起好奇，强对比的科普讲解氛围。

prompt_en: An awed presenter points at a swirling glowing accretion disk around a pitch-black sphere warping starlight around it, cosmic purples and oranges. Deep space background with distant galaxies. Huge text 'BLACK HOLE EXPLAINED' in white with a violet glow across the top, a green arrow bending into the event horizon and a small 'WHY?' bubble. Bright light bends dramatically. Mind-blowing, cinematic, high-contrast science-explainer energy.
prompt_zh: 一位满脸敬畏的讲解者指向一颗漆黑球体周围旋转发光的吸积盘，球体把周围星光扭曲弯折，宇宙紫与橙交织。深空背景点缀着遥远星系。顶部是巨大标题「黑洞讲明白」，白字配紫罗兰辉光，一支绿箭头弯折着没入事件视界，配一个小小的「为什么？」气泡。明亮的光被戏剧性地弯曲。震撼、电影感，强对比的科学科普氛围。

prompt_en: A thoughtful host in a dark shirt stands between a glowing blue robot arm and a fading human silhouette, a holographic list of job icons flickering between them. Cool tech-blue and warning-red lighting. Bold text 'AI WILL REPLACE THIS' in white with a red outline across the top, a red arrow at jobs vanishing and a green checkmark on 'safe' ones. A glowing brain-chip icon. Provocative, futuristic, high-contrast debate-explainer energy.
prompt_zh: 一位神情若有所思、穿深色衬衫的主持人站在一只发光的蓝色机械臂和一个渐隐的人形剪影之间，一张全息职业图标清单在两者间闪烁。冷调科技蓝与警示红交织。顶部是加粗标题「AI将取代这些」，白字红边，一支红箭头指向正在消失的职业，「安全」职业上打绿勾。一个发光的脑芯片图标。挑衅、未来感，强对比的辩论科普氛围。

prompt_en: An enthusiastic teacher points at a chalkboard where a clever visual shortcut turns a scary equation into a simple glowing answer, lightbulb moment sparkles above. Warm classroom with a bold blue backdrop. Huge text 'MATH THEY NEVER TAUGHT' in white with a yellow outline across the top, a green arrow from a confusing formula to '= EASY' and a checkmark. Colorful numbers float. Eye-opening, clever, high-contrast learning-hack energy.
prompt_zh: 一位热情的老师指向黑板，板上一个巧妙的可视化捷径把一道吓人的方程变成一个简单的发光答案，头顶灵光一现的火花闪烁。温暖教室配抢眼的蓝色背景。顶部是巨大标题「学校没教的数学」，白字黄边，一支绿箭头从令人困惑的公式连到「= 超简单」，配一个绿勾。彩色数字漂浮。豁然开朗、巧妙，强对比的学习妙招氛围。

prompt_en: A serious narrator holds an ancient torn map beside a glowing hidden document stamped 'CLASSIFIED' in red, dramatic candlelight over dark aged parchment textures. Moody sepia-and-gold palette. Bold text 'HISTORY THEY HID' in white with a gold outline across the top, a red arrow at a redacted line and a magnifying glass. Dust motes drift in the light. Mysterious, intriguing, high-contrast documentary-explainer energy.
