prompt_zh: 一位神情严肃的讲述者手持一张残破的古地图，旁边是一份发光的隐秘文件，上面盖着红色「机密」印章，戏剧化的烛光洒在深色陈旧的羊皮纸质感上。氛围感的棕褐配金色调。顶部是加粗标题「被藏起的历史」，白字金边，一支红箭头指向一行被涂黑的文字，配一只放大镜。光束里尘埃浮动。神秘、引人入胜，强对比的纪录片科普氛围。

prompt_en: A friendly coder in a green hoodie gives a thumbs up beside a glowing laptop showing clean colorful code and a checkmark, floating code snippets and a snake mascot icon around him. Cool dark-blue tech background with neon accents. Bold text 'LEARN PYTHON FAST' in white with a lime outline across the top, a green arrow from '0' to 'PRO' and a glowing '7 DAYS' badge. Approachable, upbeat, high-contrast coding-tutorial energy.
prompt_zh: 一位穿绿色连帽衫、亲切的程序员竖起大拇指，旁边一台发光笔记本显示着干净多彩的代码和一个绿勾，周围漂浮着代码片段和一个蛇形吉祥物图标。冷调深蓝科技背景带霓虹点缀。顶部是加粗标题「快速学会Python」，白字配青柠描边，一支绿箭头从「0」指向「高手」，配一枚发光的「7天」徽章。亲切、活力满满，强对比的编程教程氛围。

prompt_en: A curious host points up at a bright blue sky where a glowing beam of sunlight splits into scattering blue light rays, a small diagram of a prism and air molecules floating beside them. Cheerful daytime palette. Bold text 'WHY IS THE SKY BLUE?' in white with a sky-blue outline across the top, a green arrow following the scattered light and a lightbulb. Simple science labels. Bright, curious, high-contrast kid-friendly explainer energy.
prompt_zh: 一位好奇的主持人指向明亮的蓝天，一束发光的阳光在空中散射成蓝色光线，旁边漂浮着一个小小的棱镜和空气分子示意图。欢快的白昼配色。顶部是加粗标题「天空为什么是蓝的？」，白字配天蓝描边，一支绿箭头跟随散射的光线，配一个灯泡。简单的科学标签。明亮、勾起好奇，强对比的亲子科普氛围。

prompt_en: A concerned host points at a glowing 3D brain lighting up with red sugar-rush zones, sugar cubes and a soda can with an invented 'FIZZPOP' label floating nearby. Clean medical-white background with red accents. Huge text 'YOUR BRAIN ON SUGAR' in white with a red outline across the top, a red arrow spiking then crashing on a mood graph and a warning icon. Alarming, informative, high-contrast health-explainer energy.
prompt_zh: 一位神情担忧的主持人指向一颗发光的3D大脑，大脑上红色的「糖分冲击」区域亮起，旁边漂浮着方糖和一罐印着虚构品牌「FIZZPOP」的汽水。干净的医疗白背景配红色点缀。顶部是巨大标题「糖对大脑做了什么」，白字红边，一支红箭头在情绪曲线上先飙升后暴跌，配一个警告图标。警示、信息量足，强对比的健康科普氛围。

prompt_en: An amazed presenter gestures at a glowing quantum particle existing in two places at once, blurred probability clouds and glowing wave patterns around it. Deep violet-and-cyan cosmic background. Bold text 'QUANTUM IN 5 MIN' in white with a cyan glow across the top, a green arrow between two ghostly particles and a '?!' bubble. Glowing atom icons float. Mind-bending, sleek, high-contrast science-explainer energy.
prompt_zh: 一位惊叹的讲解者比划着一个同时存在于两处的发光量子粒子，周围是模糊的概率云和发光的波纹图案。深紫配青色的宇宙背景。顶部是加粗标题「五分钟懂量子」，白字配青色辉光，一支绿箭头连接两个幽灵般的粒子，配一个「?!」气泡。发光的原子图标漂浮。烧脑、精致，强对比的科学科普氛围。

prompt_en: An animated host stands before a glowing timeline where one pivotal glowing invention icon splits history into a dim 'before' and a bright 'after'. Dramatic split lighting, deep charcoal background. Huge text 'THIS CHANGED EVERYTHING' in white with a gold outline across the top, a green arrow from a small spark to a bright future and a lightbulb burst. Bold, epic, high-contrast big-idea explainer energy.
prompt_zh: 一位表情丰富的主持人站在一条发光时间线前，线上一个关键的发光发明图标把历史劈成昏暗的「之前」和明亮的「之后」。戏剧化的分区打光，深炭灰背景。顶部是巨大标题「这改变了一切」，白字金边，一支绿箭头从一点小火花指向光明未来，配一个灯泡爆闪。大气、史诗感，强对比的大概念科普氛围。

prompt_en: A calm, focused person in workout clothes stretches on a balcony at dawn, warm orange sunrise flooding the sky, a glowing clock reading 5:00 AM beside them. Fresh peaceful gold-and-blue palette. Bold text '5AM CHANGED MY LIFE' in white with an orange outline across the top, a green up-arrow on a rising energy graph and a sun icon. A steaming mug and journal nearby. Serene, motivating, high-contrast self-improvement energy.
prompt_zh: 一位平静专注、穿运动服的人在破晓的阳台上拉伸，暖橙色日出染满天空，旁边是一只显示凌晨5:00的发光时钟。清新宁静的金蓝配色。顶部是加粗标题「五点早起改变我」，白字橙边，一支绿色上箭头位于上升的精力曲线上，配一个太阳图标。旁边一杯热饮和一本日记。宁静、激励，强对比的自我提升氛围。

prompt_en: A determined young person holds up a phone with several glowing generic social-media app icons being dragged to a red trash bin, a satisfied smirk. Clean bright background split light-and-dark. Huge text 'DELETE THESE APPS' in white with a red outline across the top, a red X over the icons and a green checkmark over a 'free time' clock. A dopamine-brain icon calms down. Bold, decisive, high-contrast digital-detox energy.
prompt_zh: 一位坚定的年轻人举着手机，几个发光的通用社交App图标正被拖进一个红色垃圾桶，脸上露出满意的坏笑。干净明亮的背景一半亮一半暗。顶部是巨大标题「删掉这些App」，白字红边，图标上打红叉，「自由时间」时钟上打绿勾。一个多巴胺大脑图标平静下来。果断、有力，强对比的数字戒断氛围。

prompt_en: A person leaps off a couch mid-motion, transforming from slouched and sleepy on the left to energized and standing tall on the right, motion blur streaks. Split dull-gray to vibrant-orange lighting. Bold text 'STOP BEING LAZY' in white with a red outline across the top, a green arrow from couch to action and a lightning bolt. A discarded remote falls away. Punchy, tough-love, high-contrast motivation energy.
prompt_zh: 一个人从沙发上一跃而起、动作定格在半空，左边还是含胸犯困的样子，右边已经精力充沛、挺直站立，带运动模糊拖影。分区打光由沉闷灰过渡到鲜活橙。顶部是加粗标题「别再懒了」，白字红边，一支绿箭头从沙发指向行动，配一道闪电。被丢开的遥控器坠落。有冲击力、严厉又激励，强对比的动力氛围。

prompt_en: A satisfied reader sits surrounded by a towering, glowing spiral of stacked books, holding one open with a knowing smile, warm cozy library lighting. Rich amber-and-teal palette. Huge text 'I READ 50 BOOKS' in white with a gold outline across the top, a green up-arrow on a 'knowledge' meter and a glowing '50' badge. A brain icon lighting up. Cozy, aspirational, high-contrast reading-challenge energy.
prompt_zh: 一位心满意足的读者坐在一圈高耸发光、层层叠叠的书塔中，手捧一本翻开的书，会心一笑，温暖惬意的图书馆灯光。浓郁的琥珀配青色调。顶部是巨大标题「我读了50本书」，白字金边，一支绿色上箭头位于一个「知识」量表上，配一枚发光「50」徽章。一个大脑图标亮起。惬意、令人向往，强对比的阅读挑战氛围。

prompt_en: A refreshed, glowing person pushes away a plate of sugary donuts and cake, choosing a bowl of bright fruit instead, clear-skinned and energetic. Clean fresh green-and-white background. Bold text 'NO SUGAR 30 DAYS' in white with a mint outline across the top, a red X over the sweets and a green checkmark over the fruit, a glowing '30' badge. An energy bar filling up. Fresh, disciplined, high-contrast health-challenge energy.
prompt_zh: 一位神清气爽、容光焕发的人推开一盘含糖甜甜圈和蛋糕，转而选择一碗鲜亮的水果，皮肤透亮、活力十足。干净清新的绿白背景。顶部是加粗标题「戒糖30天」，白字配薄荷描边，甜点上打红叉、水果上打绿勾，配一枚发光「30」徽章。一根精力条正在填满。清爽、自律，强对比的健康挑战氛围。

prompt_en: A gasping person stands under a rushing icy shower, arms braced and eyes wide with a determined grin, frost and cold-blue mist swirling around, glowing ice-crystal accents. Dramatic cold blue lighting. Huge text 'COLD SHOWER CHALLENGE' in white with a cyan outline across the top, a green up-arrow on a 'willpower' meter and a snowflake icon. Water droplets frozen mid-splash. Intense, invigorating, high-contrast challenge energy.
prompt_zh: 一个人倒吸凉气地站在急冲的冰冷淋浴下，双臂紧撑、双眼圆睁却带着坚定的笑，四周冷蓝雾气与霜花打旋，点缀着发光的冰晶。戏剧化的冷蓝打光。顶部是巨大标题「冷水澡挑战」，白字配青色描边，一支绿色上箭头位于「意志力」量表上，配一个雪花图标。飞溅的水珠凝固在半空。强烈、提神，强对比的挑战氛围。

prompt_en: A peaceful person sleeps soundly in a cozy dim bedroom, a glowing moon and floating 'Zzz' above, a bright energy meter charging to full beside a soft alarm clock. Calm indigo-and-lavender palette. Bold text 'FIX YOUR SLEEP' in white with a soft-blue outline across the top, a green up-arrow on a rest graph and a checkmark. A crossed-out phone icon. Soothing, helpful, high-contrast wellness-explainer energy.
prompt_zh: 一位安详的人在温馨昏暗的卧室里酣睡，头顶漂浮着发光的月亮和一串「Zzz」，旁边一个明亮的精力条正充满，紧挨着一只柔光闹钟。宁静的靛蓝配薰衣草紫色调。顶部是加粗标题「修好你的睡眠」，白字配柔蓝描边，一支绿色上箭头位于休息曲线上，配一个绿勾。一个被划掉的手机图标。舒缓、实用，强对比的健康科普氛围。

prompt_en: A calm, centered person meditates cross-legged as glowing distractions, phone, games, junk food, drift away like fading smoke behind them, a bright focused aura forming ahead. Deep purple-to-teal gradient background. Huge text 'DOPAMINE DETOX' in white with a lime outline across the top, a red arrow at fading distractions and a green arrow at a rising focus meter. A calm brain icon. Zen, powerful, high-contrast mindset-reset energy.
prompt_zh: 一位平静自持的人盘腿冥想，身后手机、游戏、垃圾食品等发光的干扰源像渐散的烟雾般飘走，身前凝聚起一圈明亮专注的光晕。深紫到青色的渐变背景。顶部是巨大标题「多巴胺戒断」，白字配青柠描边，一支红箭头指向渐散的干扰，一支绿箭头指向上升的专注量表。一个平静的大脑图标。禅意、有力，强对比的心态重启氛围。

prompt_en: A focused athlete grinds through a tough workout in the dark while a glowing 'motivation' flame fizzles out beside a steady, unbreakable 'discipline' anchor icon. Moody spotlight, deep charcoal background. Bold text 'DISCIPLINE > MOTIVATION' in white with a gold outline across the top, a red down-arrow on the flame and a green steady line on discipline. Sweat and grit. Intense, philosophical, high-contrast mindset energy.
prompt_zh: 一位专注的运动员在黑暗中咬牙完成一组高强度训练，旁边一团发光的「动力」火焰正逐渐熄灭，而一枚稳固不破的「自律」锚形图标屹立不动。氛围聚光灯，深炭灰背景。顶部是加粗标题「自律 > 动力」，白字金边，火焰上一支红色下降箭头，自律上一条平稳的绿线。汗水与坚毅。强烈、有哲思，强对比的心态氛围。

prompt_en: A steadily climbing figure walks up a glowing staircase of small daily wins that compounds into a towering summit, warm sunrise breaking behind the peak. Inspiring gold-and-blue palette. Huge text '1% BETTER DAILY' in white with an orange outline across the top, a green exponential up-arrow curving to the top and small checkmarks on each step. A summit flag glows. Uplifting, aspirational, high-contrast growth-mindset energy.
prompt_zh: 一个稳步攀登的身影走上一段由每日小胜利铺成的发光阶梯，这些小胜利复利累积成一座高耸的顶峰，暖橙日出在峰后破晓。励志的金蓝配色。顶部是巨大标题「每天进步1%」，白字橙边，一支绿色指数上升箭头弯向顶端，每级台阶上有小绿勾。峰顶一面旗帜发着光。振奋、令人向往，强对比的成长心态氛围。

prompt_en: A shocked young man points accusingly at a glowing shattered mask floating mid-air, revealing a shadowy figure behind it, dramatic red-and-black lighting with cracks radiating. Huge text 'HE LIED TO EVERYONE' in yellow and red across the top, a red arrow at the broken mask and a jagged exclamation burst. Sparks and shattered glass fragments. Tense, scandalous, high-contrast drama-reaction energy.
prompt_zh: 一位震惊的年轻男子指着控诉般悬在半空、发光碎裂的面具，面具后露出一个阴影般的身形，戏剧化的红黑打光，裂纹向四周辐射。顶部是巨大标题「他骗了所有人」，黄红撞色，一支红箭头指向碎裂的面具，配一个锯齿状的惊叹爆点。火花与碎玻璃四溅。紧张、爆料，强对比的戏剧反应氛围。

prompt_en: A wide-eyed reactor covers their mouth in disbelief, leaning back from a glowing screen showing a blurred chaotic scene marked with a red 'WHAT?!'. Dark background with a harsh spotlight on the face. Huge text 'THIS WENT TOO FAR' in white with a red outline across the top, a red arrow at the shocking screen and a warning triangle. Sweat drop and bulging eyes. Over-the-top, gripping, high-contrast reaction energy.
prompt_zh: 一位睁大双眼的反应者不敢置信地捂住嘴，从一块发光屏幕前向后仰去，屏幕上是一段被打码的混乱画面，标着红色「什么？！」。昏暗背景，一束刺眼聚光灯打在脸上。顶部是巨大标题「这次玩太过了」，白字红边，一支红箭头指向惊悚的屏幕，配一个警告三角。一滴冷汗、暴凸的双眼。夸张、抓人，强对比的反应视频氛围。

prompt_en: A dramatic thumbnail styled like grainy security footage: a suspicious figure freezes as a glowing red 'REC' dot and timestamp overlay flash, a spotlight circle catching them in the act. Dark grungy background with scan lines. Huge text 'CAUGHT ON CAMERA' in white with a red outline across the top, a red circle-and-arrow zooming on the figure and a magnifier. Suspenseful, viral, high-contrast expose-reaction energy.
prompt_zh: 一张模仿颗粒感监控画面的戏剧化封面：一个可疑身影僵在原地，一颗发光的红色「REC」点和时间戳叠加闪烁，一圈聚光灯当场逮住了他。昏暗粗粝的背景带扫描线。顶部是巨大标题「被镜头拍下了」，白字红边，一个红圈加箭头放大那个身影，配一只放大镜。悬念、易传播，强对比的曝光反应氛围。

prompt_en: A stunned host with jaw dropped and hands on cheeks stares at a glowing floating object wrapped in a giant red question mark and radiating shock lines. Bright explosive yellow-and-red background with a starburst. Huge text 'YOU WON'T BELIEVE THIS' in white with a red outline across the top, a red arrow at the mystery object and multiple exclamation marks. Pure clickbait shock. Loud, gripping, high-contrast reaction energy.
prompt_zh: 一位惊呆的主持人下巴掉下来、双手捧脸，盯着一个悬浮的发光物体，物体被一个巨大的红色问号缠绕并向外辐射震惊线条。明亮爆炸感的黄红背景带星芒。顶部是巨大标题「你绝对不敢信」，白字红边，一支红箭头指向神秘物体，配一连串惊叹号。纯粹的标题党震撼。响亮、抓人，强对比的反应氛围。

prompt_en: A distraught figure stands amid crumbling, glowing fragments of a collapsing structure that spells trouble, hands in hair, everything breaking apart in slow motion. Dark stormy background with red cracks spreading. Huge text 'IT ALL FELL APART' in white with a red outline across the top, a red down-arrow on a plummeting graph and a broken-heart-style crack. Dust and debris. Emotional, dramatic, high-contrast downfall-reaction energy.
prompt_zh: 一个心烦意乱的身影站在一片崩塌、发光的碎片之中，一座象征麻烦的结构正在坍塌，他双手抓头，一切在慢镜头中支离破碎。昏暗风暴背景，红色裂纹向四周蔓延。顶部是巨大标题「一切都崩了」，白字红边，一支红色下降箭头位于暴跌曲线上，配一道类似碎裂的裂痕。尘土与残骸飞扬。情绪化、戏剧性，强对比的崩塌反应氛围。

prompt_en: A serious figure pulls back a glowing curtain of shadow to reveal a bright beam of light and a floating document stamped 'TRUTH' in gold, dramatic contrast between dark and light halves. Moody spotlight. Huge text 'THE TRUTH COMES OUT' in white with a gold outline across the top, a green arrow toward the revealed light and a magnifier over a hidden detail. Suspenseful, revealing, high-contrast expose-reaction energy.
prompt_zh: 一个神情严肃的身影拉开一道发光的阴影帷幕，露出一束明亮的光和一份漂浮的、盖着金色「真相」印章的文件，昏暗与明亮两半形成戏剧化反差。氛围聚光灯。顶部是巨大标题「真相浮出水面」，白字金边，一支绿箭头指向显露的光，配一只放大镜圈住一处隐藏细节。悬念、揭露，强对比的曝光反应氛围。

prompt_en: A humbled young man in a plain gray tee presses both palms to his temples with a pained, wide-eyed 'oops' expression, a glowing red X crashing over an old prediction chart behind him. Split lighting: harsh red on the mistake, soft blue on his face. Huge text 'I WAS SO WRONG' in white with a red outline across the top, a red down-arrow and a facepalm icon. Honest, dramatic, high-contrast confession-reaction energy.
prompt_zh: 一位服气的年轻男子穿着朴素灰T恤，双掌按住太阳穴，露出痛苦又睁大眼的「糟糕」表情，身后一个发光红叉砸在一张旧预测图表上。分区打光：错误处刺眼红光，脸上柔和蓝光。顶部是巨大标题「我大错特错」，白字红边，一支红色下降箭头和一个捂脸图标。坦诚、戏剧化，强对比的认错反应氛围。

prompt_en: A dramatic thumbnail of a shadowy figure caught in a sudden harsh spotlight, shielding their face, as a glowing red 'EXPOSED' stamp slams diagonally across the frame with cracks radiating. Dark red-and-black background. Huge text 'FINALLY EXPOSED' in white with a red outline across the top, a red arrow at the cornered figure and an alert icon. Dust and light beams. Confrontational, viral, high-contrast drama-reaction energy.
prompt_zh: 一张戏剧化封面：一个阴影般的身影被一束突如其来的刺眼聚光灯逮个正着，抬手遮脸，一枚发光的红色「曝光」印章斜砸过画面，裂纹四射。暗红配黑的背景。顶部是巨大标题「终于被扒了」，白字红边，一支红箭头指向被逼到角落的身影，配一个警报图标。尘埃与光束交织。对峙感、易传播，强对比的戏剧反应氛围。

prompt_en: A somber figure stands as glowing trophy and award icons crack and fall to the ground around them, a red 'GAME OVER' style banner flickering behind. Dark moody background with a single cold spotlight. Huge text 'THIS ENDED CAREERS' in white with a red outline across the top, a red down-arrow on a plummeting reputation graph and a broken-crown icon. Falling debris. Serious, dramatic, high-contrast downfall-reaction energy.
prompt_zh: 一个神情黯然的身影站着，周围发光的奖杯和奖项图标纷纷碎裂坠地，身后一条「GAME OVER」风格的红色横幅忽明忽暗。昏暗氛围背景，一束冷调孤光。顶部是巨大标题「这断送了前程」，白字红边，一支红色下降箭头位于暴跌的声誉曲线上，配一个破碎的皇冠图标。碎片坠落。严肃、戏剧化，强对比的崩塌反应氛围。

prompt_en: A gasping reactor whips their head around with a shocked 'no way' face as a glowing storyline arrow suddenly u-turns behind them, everything flipping upside down. Explosive purple-and-orange background with a swirl. Huge text 'PLOT TWIST!!!' in white with a magenta outline across the top, a green arrow doubling back on itself and a spiral burst. Confetti of question marks. Chaotic, thrilling, high-contrast reaction energy.
prompt_zh: 一位倒吸凉气的反应者猛地扭头，露出震惊的「不会吧」表情，身后一支发光的剧情箭头突然掉头U型逆转，一切天翻地覆。爆炸感的紫橙背景带漩涡。顶部是巨大标题「神级大反转！！！」，白字配洋红描边，一支绿箭头自我折返，配一团螺旋爆点。问号如彩纸般飞洒。混乱、刺激，强对比的反应氛围。

prompt_en: Vertical poster for an electronic music festival titled 'NEON TIDE' at Harbor Bowl Amphitheater, August 22-24. Hero visual: a colossal cresting ocean wave dissolving into glowing pink and cyan sound-wave ribbons, silhouetted crowd raising hands at the base. Composition: wave arcs from bottom-left sweeping to top-right, title set in a bold condensed sans-serif with a chrome liquid finish across the center. Palette: deep indigo night, hot magenta, electric teal, splashes of UV violet. Small clean lineup list and date bar along the bottom. Mood: euphoric, wet, luminous, high-energy nightlife.
prompt_zh: 电子音乐节竖版海报,标题「霓虹潮汐 NEON TIDE」,地点海湾露天剧场,8月22至24日。主视觉:一道巨浪在浪尖处化作粉色与青色的发光声波丝带,底部是举手欢呼的人群剪影。构图:巨浪从左下向右上斜扫,标题用粗压缩无衬线字体、表面呈液态铬金属质感横贯画面中央。配色:深靛蓝夜色、艳品红、电光青,点缀紫外线紫。底部有干净的演出阵容小字和日期条。氛围:狂喜、湿润、通透、极具夜场能量。

prompt_en: Rustic music festival poster for 'GOLDEN FIELDS COUNTRY FEST', Willow Creek Ranch, September 6-7. Hero: warm sunset over rolling wheat fields, a lone acoustic guitar leaning on a weathered fence post, hot-air balloon drifting in an amber sky. Composition: wide horizon at lower third, big hand-lettered serif title arched across the sky like a banner. Palette: burnt orange, honey gold, dusty rose, sage green. Vintage screen-print texture with subtle paper grain. Lineup in a distressed western slab font at the bottom, small ticket info tag. Mood: nostalgic, warm, wholesome, open-air.
prompt_zh: 质朴风乡村音乐节海报,标题「金色麦田 GOLDEN FIELDS」,柳溪牧场,9月6至7日。主视觉:金色麦浪上方是温暖的落日,一把木吉他斜靠在风化的木栅栏柱上,琥珀色天空中飘着一只热气球。构图:地平线压在下三分之一,手写衬线大标题像旗帜一样弧形横跨天空。配色:焦橙、蜜金、灰玫瑰、鼠尾草绿。复古丝网印刷质感,带轻微纸张颗粒。底部用做旧西部厚板字体列出阵容,附小票务信息标签。氛围:怀旧、温暖、治愈、户外。

prompt_en: Elegant jazz concert poster for 'MIDNIGHT SESSIONS' at The Velvet Room, every Friday this winter, doors 9PM. Hero: a solitary brass trumpet emitting curling smoke that morphs into a treble clef, dramatic single-source amber spotlight from upper right. Composition: instrument off-center left, deep negative space, title in a refined high-contrast serif with thin italic subtitle. Palette: near-black charcoal, warm brass gold, oxblood red accents. Subtle film noir grain and vignette. Small venue address and cover-charge line at the base. Mood: smoky, intimate, sophisticated, after-hours.
prompt_zh: 优雅爵士音乐会海报,标题「午夜现场 MIDNIGHT SESSIONS」,天鹅绒厅,整个冬季每周五晚9点开场。主视觉:一支黄铜小号吐出袅袅烟雾,烟雾盘旋化作高音谱号,右上方单一光源投下戏剧性的琥珀色聚光。构图:乐器偏左,大量留白,标题用精致的高对比衬线体,配纤细斜体副标题。配色:近黑炭灰、温暖黄铜金、牛血红点缀。带细腻的黑色电影颗粒与暗角。底部有场馆地址与入场费小字。氛围:烟雾缭绕、私密、考究、深夜。

prompt_en: Dreamy indie-pop tour poster for the band 'ECHO BLOOM', North American Tour spring 2027. Hero: an oversized vintage cassette tape sprouting wildflowers and butterflies from its reels, floating in a pastel gradient sky. Composition: cassette centered, blooms spilling upward, band name in a soft rounded retro script, tour dates listed as a vertical strip of cities on the right. Palette: peach, lavender, mint, buttercream yellow. Halftone dots and risograph texture. Mood: whimsical, tender, lo-fi, springtime.
prompt_zh: 梦幻独立流行巡演海报,乐队「回声花开 ECHO BLOOM」,2027春季北美巡演。主视觉:一盒放大的复古卡带,磁带轮盘处长出野花与蝴蝶,漂浮在柔和渐变的天空中。构图:卡带居中,花朵向上蔓延,乐队名用柔软圆润的复古手写体,右侧竖排列出各巡演城市与日期。配色:蜜桃、薰衣草、薄荷、奶油黄。带半调网点与理光孔版印刷质感。氛围:异想天开、温柔、Lo-Fi、春日气息。

prompt_en: Vibrant reggae concert poster for 'THUNDER ROOTS' feat. The Kingston Lions, Palm Grove Beach Stage, July 19, 6PM. Hero: a stylized lion head made of layered tropical leaves and lightning bolts, radiating sun rays. Composition: lion centered like an emblem, title in a bold reggae-style rounded display font arched above, wavy dub-echo lines below. Palette: emerald green, gold, ruby red, black. Woodcut poster texture and worn edges. Ticket and lineup info in a clean band at the bottom. Mood: warm, rebellious, joyful, roots-vibration.
prompt_zh: 活力雷鬼音乐会海报,标题「雷霆之根 THUNDER ROOTS」,特邀金斯敦雄狮乐队,棕榈林海滩舞台,7月19日晚6点。主视觉:一个由层叠热带叶片与闪电组成的风格化狮头,四周放射太阳光芒。构图:狮头居中如徽章,标题用粗壮圆润的雷鬼风格展示字体弧形置于上方,下方是波浪状回响线条。配色:祖母绿、金、宝石红、黑。木刻海报质感与磨损边缘。底部用干净色带排布票务与阵容信息。氛围:温暖、叛逆、欢快、根源律动。

prompt_en: Aggressive heavy-metal gig poster for 'VOLTAGE UPRISING', four bands one night, Iron Hall, October 31, 8PM. Hero: a cracked skull wrapped in barbed electric cables, sparks flying, set against a shattered lightning-torn sky. Composition: skull dead center, jagged blackletter title above, band names stacked in razor-sharp metal font, all framed by a distressed border. Palette: matte black, blood crimson, steel silver, sickly acid green sparks. Heavy grunge texture, xerox photocopy grit. Age and ticket line at the base. Mood: brutal, electric, chaotic, apocalyptic.
prompt_zh: 凶悍重金属演出海报,标题「电压崛起 VOLTAGE UPRISING」,四支乐队同台,铁厅,10月31日晚8点。主视觉:一颗龟裂的骷髅被带刺电缆缠绕,火花四溅,背景是被闪电撕裂的破碎天空。构图:骷髅正中,尖锐哥特体标题置于上方,乐队名以锋利如刀的金属字体堆叠,四周环绕做旧边框。配色:哑光黑、血红、钢银、病态酸绿火花。厚重垃圾摇滚质感、复印机粗粝纹理。底部标注年龄与票务信息。氛围:残暴、带电、混乱、末日感。

prompt_en: Refined classical open-air concert poster for 'SUNSET SYMPHONY' by the Riverside Philharmonic, Grand Lawn, June 14, 7:30PM. Hero: a violin silhouette dissolving into a flock of birds against a gradient dusk sky, faint gold constellations of musical notes. Composition: violin rising from lower center, elegant thin serif title with generous letter-spacing at the top, program details centered below in a delicate line. Palette: rose gold, dusk purple, soft coral, cream. Minimal, airy, watercolor wash background. Mood: graceful, serene, uplifting, cultured.
prompt_zh: 精致古典露天音乐会海报,标题「日落交响 SUNSET SYMPHONY」,河畔爱乐乐团,大草坪,6月14日晚7点30。主视觉:一把小提琴的剪影在渐变的黄昏天空中化作一群飞鸟,淡金色的音符如星座般点缀。构图:小提琴自下方中央升起,顶部是纤细优雅、字距宽松的衬线标题,下方居中以细线排布节目详情。配色:玫瑰金、暮紫、柔珊瑚、奶白。极简、通透、水彩晕染背景。氛围:优雅、宁静、振奋、有文化气息。

prompt_en: High-octane techno rave poster for 'BASS REACTOR', warehouse takeover, District 9, November 15, midnight till dawn. Hero: a glowing nuclear-reactor core of concentric pulsing rings emitting radioactive light beams and floating geometric particles. Composition: reactor core centered and hypnotic, title in a distorted glitchy techno font wrapping the top arc, DJ lineup in a monospaced strip below. Palette: toxic lime, deep purple, electric orange, black void. Chromatic aberration and scanline glitch effects. Mood: hypnotic, industrial, relentless, underground.
prompt_zh: 高能锐舞海报,标题「低音反应堆 BASS REACTOR」,仓库占领派对,九号区,11月15日午夜至黎明。主视觉:一个发光的核反应堆核心,由层层脉动的同心圆环组成,射出放射性光束与漂浮的几何粒子。构图:反应堆核心居中且极具催眠感,标题用扭曲故障风的电子乐字体沿顶部弧线环绕,下方以等宽字体条列出DJ阵容。配色:毒液绿、深紫、电光橙、纯黑虚空。带色差与扫描线故障效果。氛围:催眠、工业、无休止、地下。

prompt_en: Warm community choir gala poster for 'HARMONY HILLS ANNUAL GALA', St. Bede's Cathedral, December 18, 7PM. Hero: rows of glowing candle flames arranged like a rising staircase of light toward a stained-glass rose window. Composition: symmetrical vertical build with candles rising to the top, title in a stately illuminated-manuscript-inspired serif centered, snowflake motifs in the corners. Palette: deep burgundy, candle gold, midnight blue, ivory. Soft glow and gentle bokeh. Concert program and donation line at the base. Mood: reverent, festive, heartwarming, holiday spirit.
prompt_zh: 温馨社区合唱盛会海报,标题「和声之丘年度盛会」,圣贝德大教堂,12月18日晚7点。主视觉:一排排发光的烛焰如通往彩绘玫瑰窗的光之阶梯般层层向上。构图:对称竖向构建,烛火升向顶部,标题居中,采用庄重的、灵感源自泥金装饰手稿的衬线体,四角点缀雪花纹样。配色:深勃艮第红、烛光金、午夜蓝、象牙白。柔和光晕与温柔散景。底部排布演出节目单与捐赠信息。氛围:虔敬、节日、暖心、圣诞氛围。

prompt_en: Bohemian desert music festival poster for 'DESERT MIRAGE', Dune Valley, April 25-27. Hero: a giant setting sun over sculptural sand dunes, a lone figure in flowing garments walking toward it, distant stage rigs shimmering in heat haze. Composition: vast horizon centered, huge circular sun as backdrop, title in an art-deco geometric display font placed inside the sun. Palette: terracotta, dusty pink, ochre, faded turquoise sky. Grainy 70s film wash, sun-bleached tones. Weekend passes and lineup at the bottom. Mood: free-spirited, expansive, sun-drenched, mystical.
prompt_zh: 波西米亚沙漠音乐节海报,标题「沙漠幻境 DESERT MIRAGE」,沙丘谷,4月25至27日。主视觉:雕塑般的沙丘之上是一轮巨大的落日,一个身着飘逸长袍的身影朝它走去,远处的舞台桁架在热浪中闪烁。构图:辽阔地平线居中,巨大圆日作为背景,标题用装饰艺术几何展示字体嵌在太阳之内。配色:陶土红、灰粉、赭黄、褪色青绿天空。带颗粒的70年代胶片色调、日晒褪色感。底部排布周末通票与阵容。氛围:自由奔放、辽阔、阳光炙烤、神秘。

prompt_en: Psychological thriller movie poster for 'THE SILENT HOUR', in theaters March 13. Hero: a lone woman standing at the end of a long, dim hallway, her elongated shadow stretching unnaturally toward the viewer, a single flickering ceiling light. Composition: strong one-point perspective drawing the eye down the corridor, title in a stark thin sans-serif at the bottom, tagline 'Some doors should stay closed' above it. Palette: cold desaturated teal-grey, muted amber light, deep black shadows. Cinematic film grain, subtle vignette. Credits block in tiny condensed type at the very bottom. Mood: dread, isolation, suspense, quiet menace.
prompt_zh: 心理惊悚片电影海报,标题「寂静时刻 THE SILENT HOUR」,3月13日上映。主视觉:一名孤身女子站在昏暗长廊的尽头,她被拉长的影子不自然地朝观众延伸,天花板上唯一一盏灯忽明忽暗。构图:强烈的一点透视将视线引向走廊深处,标题以冷峻纤细的无衬线体置于底部,上方是宣传语「有些门应该永远关着」。配色:冷调去饱和的青灰、暗淡琥珀灯光、深黑阴影。电影胶片颗粒、轻微暗角。最底部以极小压缩字体排演职员表。氛围:恐惧、孤立、悬疑、静默的威胁。

prompt_en: Epic sci-fi movie poster for 'STARFALL ODYSSEY', coming summer 2027. Hero: a lone astronaut standing on a cracked alien cliff edge gazing up at two enormous ringed planets and a cascade of falling meteors. Composition: low-angle heroic framing, astronaut tiny against colossal cosmic scale, title in a wide chrome metallic display font across the lower third. Palette: deep cosmic navy, molten orange nebula, cyan starlight, silver. Lens flares and volumetric god rays. Studio credits and release date in small caps at the base. Mood: awe, adventure, vastness, wonder.
prompt_zh: 史诗科幻电影海报,标题「星陨奥德赛 STARFALL ODYSSEY」,2027年夏季上映。主视觉:一名孤独的宇航员站在龟裂的外星悬崖边,仰望两颗巨大的环状行星与倾泻而下的流星雨。构图:低角度英雄式取景,宇航员在浩瀚宇宙尺度前显得渺小,标题以宽体铬金属展示字体横贯下三分之一。配色:深邃宇宙藏青、熔岩橙星云、青色星光、银。带镜头光晕与体积光。底部以小型大写字母排出品方与上映日期。氛围:敬畏、冒险、浩瀚、奇观。

prompt_en: Quirky comedy-mystery movie poster for 'CROISSANT & CRIME', a whodunit in a Paris bakery, opening April 1. Hero: a flat-lay overhead of a marble counter with a rolling pin as a murder weapon, spilled flour forming a chalk-outline body, magnifying glass, and scattered pastries. Composition: top-down flat design, playful title in a bouncy hand-drawn serif at top, cast names in a curved ribbon. Palette: buttery cream, cherry red, mint green, chocolate brown. Clean illustrative vector style with subtle paper texture. Mood: charming, witty, cozy, tongue-in-cheek.
prompt_zh: 古灵精怪的喜剧悬疑电影海报,标题「可颂与谋杀 CROISSANT & CRIME」,一桩发生在巴黎面包房的推理案,4月1日上映。主视觉:俯拍大理石台面的平铺构图,一根擀面杖化作凶器,撒落的面粉勾勒出粉笔人形轮廓,还有放大镜与散落的糕点。构图:顶视平面设计,俏皮标题用弹跳感十足的手绘衬线体置于顶部,演员名排在弧形丝带上。配色:黄油奶白、樱桃红、薄荷绿、巧克力棕。干净的插画矢量风格,带轻微纸张质感。氛围:迷人、机智、温馨、俏皮。

prompt_en: Atmospheric indie drama movie poster for 'THE LAST LIGHTHOUSE', a festival selection, in select cinemas October 10. Hero: a weathered lighthouse on a stormy cliff, its beam cutting through heavy fog and crashing waves, a small boat far below. Composition: vertical, lighthouse slightly right of center, huge moody sky above, title in a hand-etched narrow serif near the bottom. Palette: stormy slate blue, foam white, warm beacon yellow, charcoal. Painterly oil-texture rendering, soft grain. Laurel award badges and credits at the base. Mood: melancholic, solitary, poetic, weathered.
prompt_zh: 氛围感独立文艺片海报,标题「最后的灯塔 THE LAST LIGHTHOUSE」,电影节入围作品,10月10日部分影院上映。主视觉:一座饱经风霜的灯塔矗立在暴风雨中的悬崖上,光束穿透浓雾与拍岸巨浪,远处底下有一叶小舟。构图:竖版,灯塔略偏右,上方是大片阴郁天空,标题以手刻般的窄衬线体置于底部附近。配色:暴风雨石板蓝、泡沫白、温暖灯塔黄、炭灰。油画笔触质感渲染,柔和颗粒。底部有电影节桂冠奖章与演职员表。氛围:忧郁、孤独、诗意、饱经沧桑。

prompt_en: Bold anime film poster for 'NEON SAMURAI', a cyberpunk feature premiering December 5. Hero: a masked samurai in a rain-soaked neon alley, drawing a glowing katana that streaks light, holographic signs in a fictional script overhead. Composition: dynamic diagonal action pose, character lower-center facing away, huge katana slash cutting across, title in a sharp brush-stroke display font upper right. Palette: hot pink, cyber cyan, deep violet night, wet asphalt reflections. Cel-shaded anime rendering with dramatic rim light. Studio and date banner at the base. Mood: cool, kinetic, futuristic, stylish.
prompt_zh: 张力十足的动画电影海报,标题「霓虹武士 NEON SAMURAI」,赛博朋克剧场版12月5日首映。主视觉:一名戴面具的武士立于雨水浸透的霓虹小巷,拔出一柄拖曳光痕的发光武士刀,头顶是虚构文字的全息招牌。构图:富有动感的对角线动作姿态,角色背对置于下方中央,巨大的刀光横斩而过,标题以锐利的毛笔笔触展示字体置于右上。配色:艳粉、赛博青、深紫夜色、湿沥青反光。赛璐璐动画渲染,带戏剧性轮廓光。底部有制作方与日期横幅。氛围:酷、动感、未来、时髦。

prompt_en: Unsettling horror movie poster for 'WHISPERING PINES', do not go past the tree line, in theaters Friday the 13th. Hero: a dense dark pine forest at night with countless pale glowing eyes hidden among the trunks, a single flashlight beam from below. Composition: vertical wall of trees filling the frame, symmetrical and claustrophobic, title dripping in a distressed serif at the top, tagline below. Palette: black-green forest, sickly moonlight silver, cold blue mist, one drop of red. Heavy grain, deep shadow crush. Small credits at the base. Mood: primal fear, creeping dread, watched, inescapable.
prompt_zh: 令人不安的恐怖片海报,标题「低语松林 WHISPERING PINES」,别越过树线,黑色星期五上映。主视觉:夜晚一片幽暗浓密的松林,无数苍白发光的眼睛藏在树干之间,一束手电光从下方射出。构图:竖向的树墙填满整个画面,对称而幽闭,标题以滴血般做旧衬线体置于顶部,下方是宣传语。配色:黑绿森林、病态月光银、冷蓝薄雾,一点血红。厚重颗粒、深黑压暗。底部小字演职员表。氛围:原始恐惧、渐生的惊悚、被窥视感、无处可逃。

prompt_en: Slick heist-action movie poster for 'GRAND HEIST GETAWAY', the biggest job of their lives, opening July 4. Hero: five silhouetted crew members walking away from an exploding vault in a confident line, golden coins and cash raining around them. Composition: horizontal hero row along the center, dramatic backlight explosion behind, title in a bold beveled gold display font at the top, character names in a strip below. Palette: black, molten gold, ember orange, smoke grey. Glossy cinematic finish with lens flare. Credits at the base. Mood: cool, confident, explosive, glamorous.
prompt_zh: 精致利落的劫案动作片海报,标题「世纪大劫案 GRAND HEIST GETAWAY」,他们这辈子最大的一票,7月4日上映。主视觉:五个剪影般的团队成员自信地一字排开、背对一个正在爆炸的金库走来,金币与钞票如雨般散落四周。构图:英雄横排位于中央,身后是戏剧性的逆光爆炸,标题用粗壮的斜角描金展示字体置于顶部,下方色条列出角色名。配色:黑、熔金、余烬橙、烟灰。光泽电影质感,带镜头光晕。底部演职员表。氛围:酷、自信、爆裂、华丽。

prompt_en: Tender romance movie poster for 'LETTERS TO THE SEA', a love story across an ocean, in cinemas February 14. Hero: a young couple's silhouettes on opposite ends of a curved sandy beach at golden hour, a paper boat carrying a letter drifting on the tide between them. Composition: wide low horizon, warm sky filling the top, title in a flowing romantic script across the center sky, tagline below. Palette: golden peach sunset, soft coral, seafoam, warm cream sand. Dreamy soft focus and gentle lens bloom. Release date at the base. Mood: wistful, tender, hopeful, bittersweet.
prompt_zh: 温柔爱情电影海报,标题「寄往海洋的信 LETTERS TO THE SEA」,一段横跨海洋的爱情,2月14日上映。主视觉:黄金时刻,一对年轻恋人的剪影分立弧形沙滩的两端,一只载着信的纸船在潮水中漂向彼此。构图:低地平线宽幅取景,温暖天空占据上方,标题以流畅浪漫的手写体横书于中央天空,下方为宣传语。配色:金桃色落日、柔珊瑚、海沫绿、温暖奶白沙滩。梦幻柔焦与温柔镜头光晕。底部标注上映日期。氛围:惆怅、温柔、充满希望、苦乐参半。

prompt_en: Rugged documentary film poster for 'IRON PEAK', one mountain, one impossible climb, streaming November 22. Hero: a tiny lone climber on a razor-thin ice ridge dwarfed by a monstrous granite summit piercing the clouds. Composition: extreme vertical scale, climber near the bottom, colossal mountain filling the frame, title in a bold industrial condensed sans at the top, tagline below. Palette: icy blue-white, granite grey, cold shadow navy, a warm speck of the climber's red jacket. Crisp high-altitude clarity with subtle grain. Award laurels and credits at the base. Mood: heroic, brutal, awe-inspiring, human against nature.
prompt_zh: 粗犷纪录片海报,标题「铁峰 IRON PEAK」,一座山,一次不可能的攀登,11月22日流媒体上线。主视觉:一名渺小的孤独攀登者立于刀锋般的冰脊上,被穿云而出的巨大花岗岩峰顶衬得微不足道。构图:极端的竖向尺度对比,攀登者靠近底部,巨山填满画面,标题以粗壮工业压缩无衬线体置于顶部,下方为宣传语。配色:冰蓝白、花岗岩灰、冷调阴影藏青,攀登者红色冲锋衣的一抹暖色。高海拔般清冽通透,带细微颗粒。底部有获奖桂冠与演职员表。氛围:英勇、残酷、令人敬畏、人与自然的对抗。

prompt_en: Ornate fantasy-adventure movie poster for 'CLOCKWORK KINGDOM', the gears of destiny are turning, in theaters this holiday. Hero: a floating steampunk city of brass gears and airships orbiting a giant glowing pocket watch, a young hero standing on a gear-bridge in the foreground. Composition: grand vertical build with layered depth, hero small at bottom center, colossal city rising above, title in an ornate engraved gold-filigree serif across the lower third. Palette: brass gold, deep teal sky, copper, warm amber glow. Intricate detail, painterly matte-painting style. Credits at the base. Mood: wondrous, epic, inventive, magical.
prompt_zh: 华丽奇幻冒险电影海报,标题「发条王国 CLOCKWORK KINGDOM」,命运的齿轮正在转动,本假期上映。主视觉:一座由黄铜齿轮与飞艇构成的悬浮蒸汽朋克城市,环绕着一枚发光的巨大怀表,前景中一位年轻主角站在齿轮桥上。构图:宏大的竖向层次构建、纵深分明,主角渺小地立于底部中央,巨城在上方升起,标题以华丽的雕花描金花体衬线体横贯下三分之一。配色:黄铜金、深青绿天空、赤铜、温暖琥珀光。细节繁复,油画数字绘景风格。底部演职员表。氛围:奇妙、史诗、充满想象、魔幻。

prompt_en: Minimalist contemporary art exhibition poster for 'FRACTURED LIGHT', a group show at Meridian Gallery, March 8 to May 20. Hero: a single crisp prism refracting a white beam into a clean rainbow spectrum across a vast empty off-white field. Composition: prism placed on the left third, spectrum fanning to the right, exhibition title in a large modern grotesque sans at the top with tight tracking, artist names in a small tidy column bottom-left. Palette: gallery off-white, pure spectrum hues, thin black type. Extreme negative space, Swiss editorial precision. Venue and dates at the base. Mood: intellectual, clean, luminous, refined.
prompt_zh: 极简当代艺术展海报,标题「碎光 FRACTURED LIGHT」,子午线画廊群展,3月8日至5月20日。主视觉:一块清晰的棱镜将一束白光折射成一道干净的彩虹光谱,横越大片空旷的米白背景。构图:棱镜置于左三分之一,光谱向右扇形展开,展览标题以大号现代无衬线体置于顶部、字距紧凑,艺术家名以整齐小字栏排于左下。配色:画廊米白、纯净光谱色、纤细黑字。极致留白,瑞士编辑式精准。底部标注场馆与日期。氛围:智性、干净、通透、考究。

prompt_en: Elegant ink-art retrospective poster for 'INK & SILENCE', a solo retrospective of painter Mei Anlan, Eastgate Museum, September 3 to December 1. Hero: a single expressive black brushstroke sweeping diagonally across a raw rice-paper background, one red seal stamp in the corner. Composition: dramatic negative space, brushstroke as the sole gesture, vertical title in a refined thin serif on the right edge, dates in delicate small type at the base. Palette: rice-paper cream, deep ink black, cinnabar red seal, faint grey wash. Authentic paper grain and bleeding ink edges. Mood: contemplative, serene, masterful, timeless.
prompt_zh: 典雅水墨回顾展海报,标题「墨与静 INK & SILENCE」,画家梅安澜个人回顾展,东门美术馆,9月3日至12月1日。主视觉:一道富有表现力的黑色笔触斜扫过生宣纸背景,一角钤一枚红色印章。构图:戏剧性留白,笔触是唯一的姿态,竖排标题以精致纤细的衬线体置于右侧边缘,底部以精巧小字标注日期。配色:宣纸米白、深墨黑、朱砂红印、淡灰晕染。真实纸张纹理与洇墨边缘。氛围:沉思、宁静、大师级、隽永。

prompt_en: Vibrant abstract art exhibition poster for 'CHROMATIC DREAMS', an immersive color installation at The Prism Space, June 1 to August 30. Hero: swirling liquid pools of poured acrylic paint blending in hypnotic marbled ribbons of saturated color. Composition: full-bleed abstract fluid art filling the frame, title knocked out in clean white bold sans centered inside a floating rounded panel, details below it. Palette: electric magenta, cobalt blue, tangerine, emerald, violet. Glossy wet paint texture, rich depth. Venue and hours in small white type at the base. Mood: joyful, immersive, sensory, exuberant.
prompt_zh: 缤纷抽象艺术展海报,标题「斑斓之梦 CHROMATIC DREAMS」,棱镜空间沉浸式色彩装置,6月1日至8月30日。主视觉:泼洒的丙烯颜料汇成漩涡般的液体池,以催眠般的大理石纹丝带交融出高饱和色彩。构图:满版抽象流体艺术填满画面,标题以干净白色粗无衬线体反白居中置于一块悬浮圆角面板内,详情列于其下。配色:电光品红、钴蓝、橘、祖母绿、紫罗兰。光泽湿颜料质感,层次丰富。底部以白色小字标注场馆与开放时间。氛围:欢快、沉浸、感官、丰沛。

prompt_en: Museum sculpture exhibition poster for 'BRONZE & BONE', figurative works by Tobias Rennick, Halcyon Institute, October 15 to January 12. Hero: a dramatically side-lit bronze torso sculpture emerging from deep shadow, its patinated surface catching a single warm rim light. Composition: sculpture on the right two-thirds, vast black negative space on the left holding the title in a classical engraved serif stacked vertically, artist and dates small at the bottom. Palette: rich bronze, warm gold highlight, deep museum black, patina teal-green. Fine-art photographic lighting, subtle grain. Mood: solemn, sculptural, timeless, dignified.
prompt_zh: 博物馆雕塑展海报,标题「青铜与骨 BRONZE & BONE」,托拜厄斯·雷尼克具象雕塑作品,海尔西恩学院,10月15日至次年1月12日。主视觉:一尊侧光强烈的青铜躯干雕塑从深邃阴影中浮现,其铜绿表面捕捉到一束温暖的轮廓光。构图:雕塑占据右侧三分之二,左侧大片黑色留白容纳竖排的古典雕刻衬线体标题,艺术家与日期以小字置于底部。配色:浓郁青铜、暖金高光、深邃博物馆黑、铜绿青。美术摄影布光,细微颗粒。氛围:庄严、雕塑感、隽永、庄重。

prompt_en: Futuristic digital-media art exhibition poster for 'PIXEL FUTURES', a new-media art biennial at Node Center, July 20 to October 5. Hero: a fragmenting 3D human portrait dissolving into a cascade of glitching pixels and floating wireframe polygons against a dark grid void. Composition: portrait upper-center breaking apart downward, title in a futuristic monospaced tech font at the bottom with data-tag captions, exhibition info in a terminal-style block. Palette: black grid, neon cyan, magenta glitch, acid green, white. RGB channel shift and scanline artifacts. Mood: futuristic, provocative, digital, cerebral.
prompt_zh: 未来感数字新媒体艺术展海报,标题「像素未来 PIXEL FUTURES」,节点中心新媒体艺术双年展,7月20日至10月5日。主视觉:一张正在碎裂的3D人脸肖像向下瓦解成一串故障像素与漂浮的线框多边形,背景是深色网格虚空。构图:肖像位于上方中央并向下崩解,标题以未来感等宽科技字体置于底部,配数据标签式说明,展览信息排成终端命令行式区块。配色:黑色网格、霓虹青、品红故障、酸绿、白。带RGB通道偏移与扫描线伪影。氛围:未来、挑衅、数字、思辨。

prompt_en: Warm craft-focused exhibition poster for 'WOVEN WORLDS', contemporary textile art, Loom Gallery, April 12 to June 30. Hero: a lush macro close-up of intricately woven wool tapestry threads in earthy tones, real fiber texture, a few loose threads unraveling upward into a stylized flock of birds. Composition: textile filling the lower two-thirds, threads rising into empty warm space above, title hand-embroidered-look serif at the top, dates below. Palette: terracotta, mustard, sage, oatmeal, rust. Tactile handcrafted feel, soft natural light. Mood: cozy, tactile, artisanal, grounded.
prompt_zh: 温暖的手工艺主题展海报,标题「织界 WOVEN WORLDS」,当代纺织艺术,织机画廊,4月12日至6月30日。主视觉:一张微距特写,展示大地色系羊毛挂毯的繁复织线,真实纤维质感,几根松散的线头向上散开、化作风格化的鸟群。构图:纺织品填满下三分之二,线头升入上方温暖空白,标题采用手工刺绣质感的衬线体置于顶部,日期列于其下。配色:陶土红、芥末黄、鼠尾草绿、燕麦色、铁锈色。可触的手作质感,柔和自然光。氛围:温馨、触感、匠心、朴实。

prompt_en: Moody photography exhibition poster for 'SHADOW PLAY', black-and-white street photography by Lena Voss, Aperture Hall, February 5 to April 18. Hero: a single striking high-contrast monochrome photo of a lone figure crossing a sunlit street casting a long dramatic shadow across cobblestones. Composition: full-bleed photograph, title placed inside a clean white bar across the lower quarter in a bold modern sans, artist name and dates below. Palette: pure black-and-white, deep shadow blacks, bright highlight whites, one thin red accent line. Fine silver-gelatin grain. Mood: dramatic, timeless, human, decisive-moment.
prompt_zh: 氛围感摄影展海报,标题「影戏 SHADOW PLAY」,莱娜·沃斯黑白街头摄影,光圈厅,2月5日至4月18日。主视觉:一张极具张力的高对比黑白照片,一个孤独身影穿过洒满阳光的街道,在鹅卵石上投下长长的戏剧性影子。构图:满版照片,标题置于下四分之一的干净白色条内,采用粗壮现代无衬线体,下方为艺术家名与日期。配色:纯黑白、深阴影黑、明亮高光白,一条纤细红色点缀线。细腻银盐颗粒。氛围:戏剧性、隽永、人文、决定性瞬间。

prompt_en: Luminous exhibition poster for 'GARDEN OF GLASS', blown-glass botanical sculptures by Aurelia Finch, Solarium Museum, May 10 to August 24. Hero: a translucent glass flower glowing from within, backlit so its swirling colored core radiates jewel-like light, delicate glass petals catching rainbow refractions. Composition: single hero bloom centered on a dark gradient, title in an elegant light serif with generous spacing above, dates in fine type below. Palette: deep midnight teal background, glowing amber, emerald, sapphire, rose glass. Glossy refractive highlights, soft glow. Mood: delicate, magical, luminous, jewel-like.
prompt_zh: 璀璨的展览海报,标题「玻璃花园 GARDEN OF GLASS」,奥雷莉亚·芬奇吹制玻璃植物雕塑,日光馆,5月10日至8月24日。主视觉:一朵半透明的玻璃花从内部发光,逆光使其旋转的彩色花芯散发宝石般的光芒,纤薄玻璃花瓣捕捉到彩虹折射。构图:单朵主体花居中于深色渐变之上,标题以优雅纤细的衬线体、宽松字距置于上方,日期以精巧小字列于下方。配色:深午夜青绿背景、发光琥珀、祖母绿、蓝宝石、玫瑰玻璃色。光泽折射高光,柔和光晕。氛围:精致、魔幻、通透、宝石感。

prompt_en: Bold graphic-design exhibition poster for 'CONCRETE POETRY', a typography and letterpress show at Type Foundry Museum, November 2 to January 20. Hero: giant overlapping wooden-type letterforms in varied vintage typefaces arranged into an abstract collage that itself spells the exhibition title through negative space. Composition: full-bleed layered type composition, actual title emerging cleverly from the arrangement, small caption block and dates in a tidy corner. Palette: bold vermillion, ink black, cream paper, one steel blue. Authentic letterpress ink texture with slight registration offset. Mood: clever, tactile, design-forward, playful-serious.
prompt_zh: 大胆的平面设计展海报,标题「具象诗 CONCRETE POETRY」,字体与活版印刷展,字模博物馆,11月2日至次年1月20日。主视觉:巨大的、彼此重叠的木活字字形,采用多种复古字体拼成抽象拼贴,并通过负空间本身拼出展览标题。构图:满版层叠字体构成,真正的标题巧妙地从排布中浮现,一角以整齐小字块排出说明与日期。配色:醒目朱红、墨黑、奶白纸、一抹钢蓝。真实活版油墨质感,带轻微套印错位。氛围:巧妙、触感、设计感强、亦庄亦谐。

prompt_en: Serene exhibition poster for 'UNDERWATER VISIONS', large-scale oceanic paintings by Cassian Ng, Bluewater Gallery, June 7 to September 15. Hero: a dreamlike deep-sea scene of light rays piercing turquoise water, a graceful whale silhouette gliding through drifting particles and jellyfish. Composition: full immersive underwater field, whale crossing the center, title in a soft flowing sans at the top fading like sunlight through water, dates below. Palette: gradient turquoise to deep navy, aqua light shafts, soft teal, glowing white particles. Painterly luminous depth. Mood: tranquil, immersive, meditative, vast.
prompt_zh: 宁静的展览海报,标题「深海视界 UNDERWATER VISIONS」,卡西安·吴大幅海洋主题绘画,蓝水画廊,6月7日至9月15日。主视觉:一幅梦幻般的深海景象,光束穿透青绿色海水,一头优雅的鲸鱼剪影在漂浮的微粒与水母间滑行。构图:满版沉浸式水下场景,鲸鱼横越中央,标题以柔和流畅的无衬线体置于顶部、如阳光穿水般渐隐,日期列于下方。配色:由青绿渐变至深藏青、水色光柱、柔青、发光白色微粒。油画般通透的纵深。氛围:宁静、沉浸、冥想、浩瀚。

prompt_en: Sultry nightclub party poster for 'VELVET UNDERGROUND NIGHT' at Club Obsidian, Saturday March 21, doors 11PM. Hero: a glossy disco ball morphing into a blooming black rose, scattering shards of pink and gold light across a dark velvet backdrop. Composition: hero object centered and glamorous, title in a luxe retro chrome script arched above, DJ names and dress-code line below. Palette: deep burgundy velvet, rose gold, hot pink glints, black. Glossy reflective highlights, luxurious sheen. Guest list and door price in small elegant caps at the base. Mood: seductive, upscale, glamorous, late-night.
prompt_zh: 性感夜店派对海报,标题「天鹅绒地下之夜 VELVET UNDERGROUND」,黑曜石俱乐部,3月21日周六,晚11点开场。主视觉:一颗光泽迪斯科球正化作一朵盛开的黑玫瑰,将粉与金的光碎片洒向深色天鹅绒背景。构图:主体居中华丽,标题以奢华复古铬金属手写体弧形置于上方,DJ名单与着装要求列于下方。配色:深勃艮第天鹅绒、玫瑰金、艳粉闪光、黑。光泽反射高光,奢华光泽。底部以优雅小型大写字母排出嘉宾名单与入场价。氛围:诱惑、高端、华丽、深夜。

prompt_en: High-energy club night poster for 'LASER JUNGLE' at Warehouse 88, Friday April 3, 10PM till late. Hero: dense neon-lit tropical foliage exploding with laser beams cutting through fog, a glowing panther prowling at the center with electric-green eyes. Composition: symmetrical jungle framing, panther head as focal point, title in a bold jungle-vine display font at the top, lineup in a glowing strip below. Palette: acid green, ultraviolet purple, hot pink lasers, black jungle. Fog haze, laser bloom, saturated glow. Ticket link and age line at the base. Mood: wild, electric, immersive, tribal-futuristic.
prompt_zh: 高能夜店之夜海报,标题「激光丛林 LASER JUNGLE」,88号仓库,4月3日周五晚10点至深夜。主视觉:霓虹照亮的浓密热带植被中激光束穿雾迸射,一头发光的黑豹在中央潜行,双眼是电光绿。构图:对称的丛林式取景,豹头为视觉焦点,标题以粗壮的丛林藤蔓展示字体置于顶部,下方是发光的阵容色条。配色:酸绿、紫外线紫、艳粉激光、丛林黑。雾霾、激光光晕、饱和辉光。底部有购票链接与年龄提示。氛围:狂野、带电、沉浸、部落未来主义。

prompt_en: Fun retro party poster for 'RETRO ROLLER DISCO', an 80s skate night at Starlite Rink, Saturday May 16, 8PM. Hero: a pair of glowing roller skates leaving neon light trails looping across a purple grid horizon under a chrome sunset. Composition: skates zooming from lower-left to upper-right, big chunky 80s outrun display font title with a chrome-and-magenta gradient, event details in a neon strip below. Palette: synthwave purple, hot magenta, cyan, chrome, sunset orange. Retro grid, laser lines, VHS grain glow. Dress-code line and price at the base. Mood: nostalgic, fun, energetic, neon-80s.
prompt_zh: 欢乐复古派对海报,标题「复古轮滑迪斯科 RETRO ROLLER DISCO」,80年代轮滑之夜,星光滑冰场,5月16日周六晚8点。主视觉:一双发光的旱冰鞋拖曳着霓虹光轨,在紫色网格地平线上盘旋,上方是铬金属落日。构图:旱冰鞋从左下飞驰向右上,粗壮的80年代Outrun展示字体标题带铬金属与品红渐变,活动详情列于下方霓虹色条。配色:合成波紫、艳品红、青、铬、落日橙。复古网格、激光线、VHS颗粒辉光。底部有着装要求与票价。氛围:怀旧、欢乐、活力、霓虹80年代。

prompt_en: Mysterious masquerade party poster for 'MIDNIGHT MASQUERADE', a masked ball at The Grand Aviary, New Year's Eve, 9PM. Hero: an ornate feathered Venetian mask floating in darkness, surrounded by drifting golden feathers and soft candlelight sparkles. Composition: mask centered and gleaming, deep black surround, title in an ornate gold engraved script arched above, 'masks required' line and dress code below. Palette: black velvet, antique gold, champagne, deep emerald accents. Rich metallic filigree detail, warm glow. RSVP and ticket line in small caps at the base. Mood: enigmatic, opulent, romantic, secretive.
prompt_zh: 神秘的假面派对海报,标题「午夜假面 MIDNIGHT MASQUERADE」,大鸟舍假面舞会,除夕夜晚9点。主视觉:一副华丽的威尼斯羽毛面具漂浮在黑暗中,周围环绕着飘落的金色羽毛与柔和的烛光闪烁。构图:面具居中且熠熠生辉,四周深黑,标题以华丽的描金雕花手写体弧形置于上方,「须佩戴面具」提示与着装要求列于下方。配色:黑天鹅绒、古董金、香槟色、深祖母绿点缀。丰富的金属花丝细节,温暖光晕。底部以小型大写字母排出预约与购票信息。氛围:神秘、奢华、浪漫、隐秘。

prompt_en: Bright daytime pool party poster for 'TROPICAL SPLASH', a summer rooftop pool rave at Azure Deck, Sunday July 12, 2PM till sunset. Hero: a crystal-clear turquoise pool with an inflatable flamingo, splashing water frozen mid-air, palm shadows and bright sun overhead. Composition: overhead-ish angle of the sparkling pool, playful bold rounded title floating on the water surface, DJ lineup on a beach-towel-striped banner below. Palette: bright turquoise, sunshine yellow, hot coral, white foam, palm green. Crisp sunny high-key lighting, glossy water sparkle. Ticket and cabana info at the base. Mood: fun, refreshing, sun-soaked, carefree.
prompt_zh: 明媚的日间泳池派对海报,标题「热带飞溅 TROPICAL SPLASH」,蔚蓝甲板屋顶夏日泳池锐舞,7月12日周日下午2点至日落。主视觉:清澈见底的青绿泳池里有一只充气火烈鸟,飞溅的水花凝固在半空,棕榈树影与头顶烈日。构图:略带俯视角度的波光泳池,俏皮粗壮的圆润标题漂浮在水面上,DJ阵容排在下方沙滩巾条纹横幅上。配色:亮青绿、阳光黄、艳珊瑚、白泡沫、棕榈绿。清爽阳光高调布光,光泽水面闪烁。底部有票务与凉亭信息。氛围:欢乐、清爽、阳光浸润、无忧无虑。

prompt_en: Moody speakeasy night poster for 'NEON NOIR', a secret jazz-house party at The Cellar Door, Thursday June 4, entry by password only. Hero: a neon cocktail glass sign glowing in a rain-streaked window, a silhouetted figure in a fedora reflected in the wet glass. Composition: window-frame framing with rain streaks, title in a flickering neon-tube script diagonally across, 'password: nightingale' whispered in small type, details below. Palette: deep teal night, hot pink and cyan neon, amber reflections, black. Wet reflective surfaces, neon bloom, film noir mood. Address hint and dress code at the base. Mood: secretive, cool, atmospheric, underground-chic.
prompt_zh: 氛围感地下酒吧之夜海报,标题「霓虹暗夜 NEON NOIR」,地窖门秘密爵士浩室派对,6月4日周四,仅凭暗号入场。主视觉:一块霓虹鸡尾酒杯招牌在雨痕斑驳的窗上发光,一个戴礼帽的身影倒映在湿玻璃中。构图:以窗框与雨痕取景,标题以闪烁的霓虹灯管手写体斜贯画面,小字轻声写着「暗号:夜莺」,详情列于下方。配色:深青绿夜色、艳粉与青霓虹、琥珀反光、黑。湿润反光表面、霓虹光晕、黑色电影氛围。底部有地址暗示与着装要求。氛围:隐秘、酷、氛围感、地下时髦。

prompt_en: Vibrant glow party poster for 'COSMIC GLOW', a UV blacklight paint rave at Nebula Dome, Saturday August 8, 10PM. Hero: splatters and handprints of glowing UV-reactive paint exploding outward from a central dancing silhouette, forming a galaxy of neon splashes. Composition: energetic radial splash burst from center, title in a hand-painted dripping glow font at the top, lineup in a UV strip below. Palette: blacklight black, electric UV green, neon pink, cyan, orange splatter. Glowing paint texture, dark backdrop, luminous splashes. Ticket and 'wear white' note at the base. Mood: wild, playful, luminous, high-energy.
prompt_zh: 炫彩荧光派对海报,标题「宇宙荧光 COSMIC GLOW」,星云穹顶UV黑光颜料锐舞,8月8日周六晚10点。主视觉:发光的UV反应颜料泼溅与手印从中央一个跳舞剪影向外炸开,形成一片霓虹泼洒的银河。构图:富有能量的放射状泼溅自中心爆发,标题以手绘滴落荧光字体置于顶部,下方是UV阵容色条。配色:黑光黑、电光UV绿、霓虹粉、青、橙泼溅。发光颜料质感,深色背景,发光泼溅。底部有票务与「请穿白色」提示。氛围:狂野、俏皮、发光、高能。

prompt_en: Chic sunset rooftop party poster for 'GOLDEN HOUR SESSIONS' at Skyline 27, every Sunday, 5PM till midnight. Hero: a stylish city skyline silhouette at sunset with a cocktail glass in the foreground catching warm golden light, string lights and lens flare. Composition: low skyline horizon, warm gradient sky, cocktail on the right third, elegant thin modern sans title with wide tracking at the top, weekly detail line below. Palette: golden peach, warm coral, dusty lavender, city silhouette navy. Soft warm glow, gentle grain, upscale editorial feel. Reservation line at the base. Mood: relaxed, chic, warm, sophisticated.
prompt_zh: 雅致的日落天台派对海报,标题「黄金时刻 GOLDEN HOUR SESSIONS」,天际线27,每周日下午5点至午夜。主视觉:落日下时尚的城市天际线剪影,前景一杯鸡尾酒捕捉温暖金光,还有串灯与镜头光晕。构图:低天际线地平线,温暖渐变天空,鸡尾酒置于右三分之一,优雅纤细的现代无衬线体标题、宽字距置于顶部,每周详情列于下方。配色:金桃色、暖珊瑚、灰薰衣草、城市剪影藏青。柔和暖光、轻微颗粒、高端编辑感。底部有预约信息。氛围:放松、雅致、温暖、考究。

prompt_en: Gritty underground drum-and-bass night poster for 'BASSLINE BUNKER', Sub Level Nine, Friday October 9, 11PM. Hero: a massive brutalist concrete speaker stack pulsing with visible sound-pressure waves distorting the air, a single warning-red strobe. Composition: monolithic speaker wall filling the frame, sound waves rippling outward, title in a heavy stenciled industrial font stamped across, DJ lineup in a spray-paint strip below. Palette: raw concrete grey, warning red, black, one strip of sodium-orange. Rough concrete texture, distressed stencil grit. Age and ticket line at the base. Mood: heavy, raw, underground, industrial.
prompt_zh: 粗粝的地下鼓打贝斯之夜海报,标题「贝斯地堡 BASSLINE BUNKER」,地下九层,10月9日周五晚11点。主视觉:一座巨大的野兽派混凝土音箱墙脉动着可见的声压波,扭曲着空气,一盏警示红频闪灯。构图:巨石般的音箱墙填满画面,声波向外扩散,标题以厚重的镂空工业字体压印其上,DJ阵容排在下方喷漆色条。配色:原始混凝土灰、警示红、黑,一条钠灯橙。粗糙混凝土质感、做旧镂空粗粝。底部有年龄与票务信息。氛围:厚重、粗粝、地下、工业。

prompt_en: Warm autumn food festival poster for 'HARVEST FLAVORS FEST', a farm-to-table celebration at Maple Commons, October 4-5. Hero: an abundant rustic wooden table overflowing with seasonal produce, pumpkins, artisan bread, grapes, and steaming pies from an overhead flat-lay. Composition: top-down bountiful spread filling the frame, hand-lettered warm serif title arched at the top, event details on a kraft-paper banner at the bottom. Palette: burnt orange, deep red, golden yellow, olive green, cream. Cozy natural light, rich food photography warmth, subtle paper texture. Ticket and vendor info at the base. Mood: abundant, cozy, wholesome, appetizing.
prompt_zh: 温暖的秋日美食节海报,标题「丰收风味 HARVEST FLAVORS」,枫叶广场从农场到餐桌盛会,10月4至5日。主视觉:俯拍平铺,一张丰盛的乡村木桌上堆满当季农产、南瓜、手工面包、葡萄与冒着热气的派。构图:顶视丰盛铺陈填满画面,手写温暖衬线体标题弧形置于顶部,活动详情排在底部牛皮纸横幅上。配色:焦橙、深红、金黄、橄榄绿、奶白。温馨自然光、丰富美食摄影的暖意、轻微纸张质感。底部有票务与摊位信息。氛围:丰盛、温馨、治愈、诱人。

prompt_en: Cozy Japanese street-food fair poster for 'RAMEN & RAIN', a night market at Lantern Alley, November 14-16, 5PM till late. Hero: a steaming bowl of ramen glowing under red paper lanterns on a rainy night, chopsticks lifting noodles, warm stall light and rain streaks. Composition: bowl centered and inviting, lanterns strung across the top, title in a brushy Japanese-inspired display font, stall map and details below. Palette: warm lantern red, broth amber, night blue rain, steam white, neon accents. Cinematic night-market glow, wet reflections. Entry and food-stall info at the base. Mood: cozy, atmospheric, mouthwatering, nostalgic.
prompt_zh: 温馨的日式街头美食市集海报,标题「拉面与雨 RAMEN & RAIN」,灯笼巷夜市,11月14至16日,傍晚5点至深夜。主视觉:雨夜里,一碗冒着热气的拉面在红纸灯笼下发光,筷子夹起面条,温暖的摊位光与雨痕。构图:面碗居中诱人,灯笼横串于顶部,标题采用毛笔风的日式展示字体,摊位地图与详情列于下方。配色:温暖灯笼红、汤色琥珀、夜蓝雨、蒸汽白、霓虹点缀。电影感夜市辉光,湿润反光。底部有入场与美食摊信息。氛围:温馨、氛围感、令人垂涎、怀旧。

prompt_en: Bold and spicy food event poster for 'CHILI FIRE COOK-OFF', a chili championship at Rodeo Grounds, August 15, noon till 8PM. Hero: a cast-iron pot of bubbling red chili erupting with cartoonish flames, glossy red chili peppers flying around it. Composition: fiery pot centered and explosive, big chunky western slab title blazing at the top, competition rules and prize line below. Palette: fiery red, orange, charcoal black, chili green, warning yellow. Bold vector illustration with heat-haze glow and flame texture. Entry fee and tasting-pass info at the base. Mood: hot, competitive, fun, mouth-scorching.
prompt_zh: 火辣大胆的美食活动海报,标题「辣火厨艺对决 CHILI FIRE COOK-OFF」,牛仔竞技场辣椒锦标赛,8月15日中午至晚8点。主视觉:一口铸铁锅里咕嘟冒泡的红辣椒炖菜喷出卡通火焰,光泽的红辣椒在四周飞舞。构图:烈焰炖锅居中且极具爆发力,粗壮的西部厚板标题在顶部燃烧,比赛规则与奖项信息列于下方。配色:烈焰红、橙、炭黑、辣椒绿、警示黄。粗犷矢量插画,带热浪辉光与火焰质感。底部有报名费与品尝券信息。氛围:火辣、竞技、欢乐、辣到冒汗。

prompt_en: Playful pastel dessert expo poster for 'SWEET TOOTH EXPO', a dessert and pastry fair at Sugar Hall, April 18-19. Hero: a towering fantasy layer cake dripping with pastel frosting, macarons, sprinkles, cherries, and floating candy clouds. Composition: whimsical vertical candy-land build, cake centered and towering, bubbly rounded title in glossy 3D icing letters at the top, details on a candy-ribbon banner below. Palette: cotton-candy pink, mint, lavender, cream, cherry red. Glossy 3D candy render, sugary highlights, soft dreamy glow. Ticket and workshop info at the base. Mood: sweet, playful, dreamy, indulgent.
prompt_zh: 俏皮的粉彩甜点博览会海报,标题「甜牙齿 SWEET TOOTH EXPO」,糖厅甜点与烘焙集市,4月18至19日。主视觉:一座高耸的梦幻多层蛋糕淋着粉彩糖霜,配马卡龙、糖粒、樱桃与漂浮的糖果云朵。构图:异想天开的竖向糖果王国构建,蛋糕居中高耸,泡泡感圆润标题以光泽3D糖霜字母置于顶部,详情排在下方糖果丝带横幅上。配色:棉花糖粉、薄荷、薰衣草、奶白、樱桃红。光泽3D糖果渲染、甜蜜高光、柔和梦幻辉光。底部有票务与工作坊信息。氛围:甜蜜、俏皮、梦幻、放纵。

prompt_en: Elegant wine festival poster for 'GRAPE & GRAIN', a vineyard tasting festival at Hillcrest Estate, September 20-21. Hero: a single glass of red wine held up against a golden vineyard sunset, swirling wine catching warm backlight, grape vines framing the edges. Composition: wine glass slightly off-center on the right, sun-drenched vineyard rows receding, refined thin serif title with tasteful spacing at the top, details in a delicate line below. Palette: deep burgundy, golden hour amber, sage vine green, cream. Warm cinematic backlight, soft grain, upscale elegance. Tasting-pass and venue info at the base. Mood: refined, warm, indulgent, pastoral.
prompt_zh: 优雅的葡萄酒节海报,标题「葡萄与谷物 GRAPE & GRAIN」,山脊庄园葡萄园品鉴节,9月20至21日。主视觉:一杯红酒在金色葡萄园落日下被举起,旋转的酒液捕捉温暖逆光,葡萄藤在边缘勾勒画框。构图:酒杯略偏右,阳光浸染的葡萄园行列向远处延伸,精致纤细的衬线体标题、雅致字距置于顶部,详情以精巧细线列于下方。配色:深勃艮第、黄金时刻琥珀、鼠尾草藤绿、奶白。温暖电影逆光、柔和颗粒、高端优雅。底部有品鉴券与场馆信息。氛围:考究、温暖、放纵、田园。

prompt_en: Festive Mexican street-food poster for 'TACO FIESTA NIGHTS', a taco and margarita festival at Plaza del Sol, May 5, 6PM till late. Hero: a vibrant flat-lay of loaded tacos, lime wedges, salsa bowls, and a frosty margarita on a colorful papel-picado-draped table. Composition: overhead bright spread, festive title in a lively hand-drawn festival font at the top, papel picado bunting strung across, details below. Palette: fiesta red, marigold orange, lime green, turquoise, hot pink. Bright cheerful illustration mixed with vivid food photography, festive papercraft accents. Ticket and vendor info at the base. Mood: festive, lively, warm, celebratory.
prompt_zh: 喜庆的墨西哥街头美食海报,标题「塔可狂欢之夜 TACO FIESTA NIGHTS」,阳光广场塔可与玛格丽特美食节,5月5日傍晚6点至深夜。主视觉:一张鲜艳的平铺俯拍,满料塔可、青柠角、莎莎酱碗与一杯结霜玛格丽特,摆在铺着彩色剪纸旗的桌上。构图:俯视明亮铺陈,喜庆标题以活泼手绘节庆字体置于顶部,彩色剪纸小旗横串画面,详情列于下方。配色:节庆红、万寿菊橙、青柠绿、青绿、艳粉。明快欢乐插画混搭鲜明美食摄影,节日剪纸点缀。底部有票务与摊位信息。氛围:喜庆、热闹、温暖、欢庆。

prompt_en: Craft beer festival poster for 'BREW & BITES', a craft beer and food-truck fest at Dockyard Park, June 27, 1PM till 10PM. Hero: a frosty overflowing pint of golden craft beer with a thick foamy head, condensation droplets, backlit by warm afternoon sun with hop cones and barley framing it. Composition: hero pint centered, warm glow, bold hand-crafted vintage brewery serif title arched above, brewery lineup and food-truck list below. Palette: golden amber, foam cream, hop green, warm brown, sky blue. Vintage screen-print texture, warm sunlit sparkle. Ticket and tasting-token info at the base. Mood: refreshing, jovial, hoppy, laid-back.
prompt_zh: 精酿啤酒节海报,标题「啤酒与小食 BREW & BITES」,船坞公园精酿啤酒与餐车节,6月27日下午1点至晚10点。主视觉:一杯结霜满溢的金色精酿啤酒,厚厚的泡沫顶,凝结的水珠,午后暖阳逆光,啤酒花球果与大麦在四周勾勒。构图:主体啤酒杯居中,暖光笼罩,粗壮手工复古酿造厂衬线体标题弧形置于上方,酒厂阵容与餐车名单列于下方。配色:金琥珀、泡沫奶白、啤酒花绿、暖棕、天蓝。复古丝网印刷质感、暖阳闪烁。底部有票务与品尝代币信息。氛围:清爽、欢快、啤酒花香、悠闲。

prompt_en: Fresh coastal seafood festival poster for 'OCEAN HARVEST', a seaside seafood celebration at Harborfront Pier, July 25-26. Hero: a rustic tray of fresh oysters, lobster, and lemon on crushed ice with a splash of ocean spray, seagulls and a lighthouse in the misty background. Composition: seafood tray in the lower foreground, coastal horizon above, breezy nautical serif title at the top with a rope-knot flourish, details on a weathered-wood banner below. Palette: ocean teal, coral pink, lemon yellow, sea-foam white, driftwood grey. Bright fresh coastal light, crisp textures. Entry and vendor info at the base. Mood: fresh, breezy, coastal, appetizing.
prompt_zh: 清新的海岸海鲜节海报,标题「海洋丰收 OCEAN HARVEST」,港湾码头海边海鲜盛会,7月25至26日。主视觉:一个质朴托盘盛着碎冰上的新鲜生蚝、龙虾与柠檬,溅起一片海水浪花,雾蒙蒙的背景里有海鸥与灯塔。构图:海鲜托盘置于下方前景,海岸地平线在上,清爽航海风衬线体标题置于顶部、带绳结花饰,详情排在下方风化木横幅上。配色:海洋青绿、珊瑚粉、柠檬黄、海沫白、浮木灰。明亮清新的海岸光、清脆质感。底部有入场与摊位信息。氛围:清新、微风、海岸、诱人。

prompt_en: Rich, exotic food-market poster for 'GLOBAL SPICE BAZAAR', a world street-food festival at Old Mill Square, September 12-14. Hero: overhead rows of colorful spice mounds in burlap sacks, saffron, paprika, turmeric, cardamom, forming a mosaic of warm colors with a brass scoop. Composition: top-down vibrant spice-mound grid filling the frame, ornate hand-drawn title with intricate patterns at the top, food-country flags and details below. Palette: turmeric gold, paprika red, saffron orange, cumin brown, cardamom green. Rich saturated textures, warm market light, ornamental detailing. Ticket and cuisine-lineup info at the base. Mood: exotic, vibrant, aromatic, cultural.
prompt_zh: 浓郁异域风情的美食市集海报,标题「环球香料集市 GLOBAL SPICE BAZAAR」,老磨坊广场世界街头美食节,9月12至14日。主视觉:俯拍成排的彩色香料堆盛在麻袋里——藏红花、红椒粉、姜黄、豆蔻——组成暖色马赛克,配一把黄铜量勺。构图:顶视鲜艳的香料堆网格填满画面,华丽手绘标题带繁复纹样置于顶部,美食国别小旗与详情列于下方。配色:姜黄金、红椒红、藏红花橙、孜然棕、豆蔻绿。浓郁饱和质感、温暖市集光、装饰性细节。底部有票务与菜系阵容信息。氛围:异域、鲜活、芳香、多元文化。

prompt_en: Dynamic sports event poster for the 'IRON TRAIL MARATHON', a 42km mountain race, Summit Ridge, October 18, 7AM start. Hero: a lone runner in dynamic mid-stride silhouette powering up a mountain trail at sunrise, motion streaks trailing behind, distant peaks glowing. Composition: diagonal uphill energy from lower-left to upper-right, runner centered, bold italic condensed athletic title at the top, race distance and start-time badge below. Palette: sunrise orange, energetic red, deep mountain purple, cool dawn blue. Dynamic motion blur, high-energy gradient, crisp athletic feel. Registration and route info at the base. Mood: determined, energetic, triumphant, adrenaline.
prompt_zh: 充满动感的体育赛事海报,标题「铁径马拉松 IRON TRAIL MARATHON」,42公里山地赛,峰脊,10月18日早7点起跑。主视觉:一名孤独跑者以动感的跨步剪影在日出时分冲上山径,身后拖着动态光痕,远山泛光。构图:从左下到右上的对角线上坡能量,跑者居中,粗壮斜体压缩运动字体标题置于顶部,赛程距离与起跑时间徽章列于下方。配色:日出橙、活力红、深山紫、清冷黎明蓝。动感运动模糊、高能渐变、清爽运动感。底部有报名与路线信息。氛围:坚定、活力、凯旋、肾上腺素。

prompt_en: Explosive basketball championship poster for the 'THUNDER CUP FINALS', City Arena, December 6, 8PM tipoff. Hero: a dramatic low-angle shot of a basketball frozen mid-air soaring toward a glowing hoop, sparks and lightning crackling around it against a spotlit dark court. Composition: ball and hoop upper-center as focal point, dynamic lighting rays, bold aggressive slab title stamped across the center, teams and tipoff time below. Palette: electric orange, court hardwood amber, deep black, lightning blue-white. High-contrast dramatic arena lighting, energetic glow. Ticket and team info at the base. Mood: intense, electric, competitive, championship.
prompt_zh: 爆裂的篮球总决赛海报,标题「雷霆杯总决赛 THUNDER CUP FINALS」,城市球馆,12月6日晚8点开球。主视觉:一个戏剧性的低角度镜头,一颗篮球凝固在半空、飞向发光的篮筐,火花与闪电在球周围噼啪炸响,背景是聚光灯下的黑暗球场。构图:球与篮筐位于上方中央作为焦点,动感光线放射,粗壮凶悍的厚板标题压印于中央,参赛队伍与开球时间列于下方。配色:电光橙、球场硬木琥珀、深黑、闪电蓝白。高对比戏剧性球馆布光、活力辉光。底部有票务与球队信息。氛围:激烈、带电、竞技、冠军。

prompt_en: High-speed motorsport poster for the 'VELOCITY GRAND PRIX', Redstone Circuit, May 30, gates 10AM. Hero: a sleek fictional race car blazing around a curve with dramatic motion-blur speed lines, sparks off the track, heat-haze shimmer behind. Composition: car sweeping diagonally across the frame at speed, bold aggressive italic racing title with a checkered-flag motif, race schedule and grandstand info below. Palette: racing red, chrome silver, asphalt black, warning yellow, speed-streak white. Sharp dynamic motion blur, glossy metallic sheen, adrenaline energy. Ticket and circuit info at the base. Mood: fast, thrilling, sleek, high-octane.
prompt_zh: 高速赛车运动海报,标题「疾速大奖赛 VELOCITY GRAND PRIX」,赤石赛道,5月30日上午10点入场。主视觉:一辆流线型虚构赛车呼啸过弯,带戏剧性动态模糊速度线,赛道火花四溅,身后热浪闪烁。构图:赛车高速斜掠过画面,粗壮凶悍的斜体赛车标题带方格旗元素,赛程与看台信息列于下方。配色:赛车红、铬银、沥青黑、警示黄、速度线白。锐利动感运动模糊、光泽金属质感、肾上腺素能量。底部有票务与赛道信息。氛围:飞速、刺激、流线、高辛烷值。

prompt_en: Elegant rowing event poster for the 'RIVERSIDE REGATTA', an annual crew race on the Elden River, June 13, races from 9AM. Hero: a sleek rowing eight cutting cleanly through calm silver water at dawn, oars mid-stroke sending ripples, misty riverbank and willows behind. Composition: boat gliding along a low horizon, tranquil reflections, refined classic serif title with a rowing-oar crest at the top, race schedule below. Palette: dawn silver-blue, soft sage, warm cream, navy accents. Serene misty morning light, gentle reflections, timeless collegiate elegance. Spectator and entry info at the base. Mood: graceful, disciplined, serene, traditional.
prompt_zh: 典雅的赛艇活动海报,标题「河畔赛艇会 RIVERSIDE REGATTA」,埃尔登河年度赛艇比赛,6月13日,上午9点起赛。主视觉:一艘流线型八人赛艇在黎明平静如银的水面上干净划过,船桨划到一半激起涟漪,背后是雾蒙蒙的河岸与垂柳。构图:赛艇沿低地平线滑行,宁静倒影,精致古典衬线体标题带船桨纹章置于顶部,赛程列于下方。配色:黎明银蓝、柔鼠尾草绿、暖奶白、藏青点缀。宁静雾晨光、温柔倒影、隽永的学院式优雅。底部有观赛与报名信息。氛围:优雅、自律、宁静、传统。

prompt_en: Bold bouldering competition poster for the 'SUMMIT CLIMB CHALLENGE', an indoor climbing comp at Apex Gym, March 28, 11AM. Hero: a powerful climber mid-dyno lunge on a colorful overhanging climbing wall studded with vivid holds, chalk dust bursting in the air, viewed from a dramatic low angle. Composition: climber reaching upward-right, colorful holds scattered, chunky dynamic athletic title at the top, categories and prize info below. Palette: chalk white, bright climbing-hold red, yellow, teal, deep grey wall. Gritty energetic feel, chalk-dust texture, bold color pops. Registration and category info at the base. Mood: powerful, focused, gritty, adventurous.
prompt_zh: 大胆的抱石比赛海报,标题「峰顶攀岩挑战赛 SUMMIT CLIMB CHALLENGE」,顶点馆室内攀岩赛,3月28日上午11点。主视觉:一名强壮的攀岩者在缀满鲜艳岩点的彩色仰角攀岩墙上做出腾跃动作,镁粉在空中迸散,以戏剧性低角度呈现。构图:攀岩者向右上方伸展,彩色岩点散布,粗壮动感的运动字体标题置于顶部,组别与奖项信息列于下方。配色:镁粉白、亮岩点红、黄、青、深灰墙。粗粝有活力的质感、镁粉尘埃纹理、大胆撞色。底部有报名与组别信息。氛围:强劲、专注、粗粝、冒险。

prompt_en: Sleek figure-skating championship poster for the 'ICE BLADES CHAMPIONSHIP', Crystal Dome, January 24, 6PM. Hero: a graceful skater mid-spin silhouette on glowing ice, a spray of ice crystals fanning outward and freezing into sparkling snowflakes under a spotlight. Composition: skater centered in a dynamic spin, radiating ice sparkle, elegant thin sculpted title with a frost-etched texture at the top, event details below. Palette: icy white, glacial blue, silver sparkle, soft violet, spotlight glow. Cold crystalline shimmer, elegant motion, luminous frost detail. Ticket and schedule info at the base.
