prompt_zh: 大胆的当代话剧海报,标题「叛逆之声 REBEL VOICES」,地下舞台一部挑衅性的政治新剧,3月6日起预演。主视觉:一只高举的拳头攥着一面撕裂的红旗,背景是贴满层叠抗议海报碎片与颜料滴痕的斑驳墙面。构图:拳头与红旗自下方中央升起,粗粝质感的墙面填满画面,粗壮压缩的行动主义镂空字体标题压印其上,卡司与日期以粗粝色条列于下方。配色:原始混凝土灰、革命红、黑镂空、做旧纸奶白,一抹醒目黄。粗粝的街头海报拼贴、撕裂边缘、紧迫的镂空能量。底部有票务与演出信息。氛围:反抗、紧迫、粗粝、有力。

prompt_en: Graceful ballet poster for 'SWAN LAKE', a classical ballet gala at The Grand Opera House, running May 8 to May 24. Hero: an elegant ballerina in a flowing white tutu mid-arabesque, her form dissolving into rippling water and drifting white feathers under a soft moonlit spotlight. Composition: dancer centered in a graceful pose, feathers rising, refined elegant thin serif title with generous spacing at the top, run dates in delicate type below. Palette: moonlit silver-blue, soft white, warm champagne glow, deep midnight, faint gold. Ethereal graceful lighting, soft feather detail, timeless classical elegance. Ticket and performance info at the base. Mood: graceful, ethereal, elegant, timeless.
prompt_zh: 优雅的芭蕾舞海报,标题「天鹅湖 SWAN LAKE」,大歌剧院古典芭蕾盛演,5月8日至5月24日上演。主视觉:一位优雅的芭蕾舞者身着飘逸白色芭蕾裙做阿拉贝斯克舞姿,身形在柔和月光聚光下化作荡漾的水波与飘散的白羽。构图:舞者居中做优雅姿态,羽毛升腾,考究优雅的纤细衬线体标题、宽松字距置于顶部,演出日期以精巧小字列于下方。配色:月光银蓝、柔白、暖香槟辉光、深午夜、淡金。空灵优雅的布光、柔和羽毛细节、隽永的古典优雅。底部有票务与演出信息。氛围:优雅、空灵、精致、隽永。

prompt_en: Intimate memory-play theater poster for 'THE GLASS MENAGERIE', a delicate revival at Chamber Theatre, opening October 3. Hero: a fragile glass unicorn figurine glowing softly on a windowsill, warm nostalgic light filtering through a lace curtain, dust motes drifting in the beam. Composition: glass figurine in the lower foreground, soft-focus window light above, delicate refined serif title with gentle spacing at the top, run dates in fine type below. Palette: warm sepia amber, soft dusty rose, faded cream, gentle grey-green, nostalgic gold. Soft memory-play haze, gentle bokeh, tender vintage warmth. Ticket and season info at the base. Mood: nostalgic, fragile, tender, wistful.
prompt_zh: 私密的记忆之剧海报,标题「玻璃动物园 THE GLASS MENAGERIE」,室内剧院细腻复排,10月3日首演。主视觉:一只脆弱的玻璃独角兽小摆件在窗台上柔柔发光,温暖怀旧的光透过蕾丝窗帘洒入,光束中浮动着尘埃。构图:玻璃摆件置于下方前景,柔焦窗光在上,细腻考究的衬线体标题、温柔字距置于顶部,演出日期以精巧小字列于下方。配色:暖褐琥珀、柔灰玫瑰、褪色奶白、温柔灰绿、怀旧金。柔和的记忆之剧薄雾、温柔散景、细腻复古暖意。底部有票务与演季信息。氛围:怀旧、脆弱、温柔、惆怅。

prompt_en: Playful comedy theater poster for 'A COMEDY OF ERRORS', a farcical romp at The Jester Playhouse, previews from July 2. Hero: two identical jester masks mixed up mid-air amid a chaotic swirl of flying hats, tangled ribbons, and juggling pins, a wink of mischief. Composition: energetic circular chaos radiating from center, bouncy playful hand-drawn title with a mismatched bounce at the top, cast and dates on a curling ribbon below. Palette: bright harlequin red, sunny yellow, cobalt blue, mischievous green, cream. Lively theatrical illustration, playful energy, comedic bounce. Ticket and run info at the base. Mood: hilarious, chaotic, playful, mischievous.
prompt_zh: 俏皮的喜剧话剧海报,标题「错中错 A COMEDY OF ERRORS」,弄臣剧院一场闹剧狂欢,7月2日起预演。主视觉:两副一模一样的小丑面具在半空中被弄混,四周是飞舞的帽子、缠绕的丝带与杂耍瓶组成的混乱漩涡,一记调皮的眨眼。构图:富有能量的环形混乱自中心放射,弹跳俏皮的手绘标题带错落跳动感置于顶部,卡司与日期排在下方卷曲丝带上。配色:明亮丑角红、阳光黄、钴蓝、调皮绿、奶白。活泼的戏剧插画、俏皮能量、喜剧弹跳。底部有票务与演出信息。氛围:爆笑、混乱、俏皮、调皮。

prompt_en: Grand opera poster for 'THE PHANTOM'S OPERA', a lavish gothic-romantic spectacle at The Majestic Opera House, running February 6 to March 30. Hero: an ornate half-mask floating before a cascading crimson velvet curtain, a single red rose and a flickering candelabra below, grand chandelier glinting above. Composition: mask centered and commanding, luxurious curtain draping the frame, ornate elegant engraved serif title in gold at the top, run dates in refined type below. Palette: deep crimson velvet, antique gold, ivory mask white, black shadow, candle amber. Opulent gothic-romantic drama, rich velvet texture, gilded detail. Ticket and season info at the base. Mood: dramatic, romantic, opulent, mysterious.
prompt_zh: 华丽的歌剧海报,标题「魅影歌剧 THE PHANTOM'S OPERA」,雄伟歌剧院一场奢华的哥特浪漫盛演,2月6日至3月30日上演。主视觉:一副华丽的半脸面具漂浮在垂落的深红天鹅绒幕布前,下方是一朵红玫瑰与一盏摇曳的烛台,头顶巨大水晶吊灯闪烁。构图:面具居中且极具气场,奢华幕布垂覆画框,华丽优雅的雕花衬线体金色标题置于顶部,演出日期以考究小字列于下方。配色:深红天鹅绒、古董金、象牙面具白、黑影、烛光琥珀。奢华的哥特浪漫戏剧感、丰富天鹅绒质感、鎏金细节。底部有票务与演季信息。氛围:戏剧、浪漫、奢华、神秘。

prompt_en: Enchanting shadow-play theater poster for 'THE MOON RABBIT', a shadow-puppet folk tale at Willow Lantern Theatre, running August 20 to September 10. Hero: intricate paper-cut shadow-puppet silhouettes of a rabbit, moon, and blossoming trees backlit in warm amber against a translucent screen, delicate lace-like cut detail. Composition: layered shadow-puppet scene, glowing moon centered, delicate hand-cut style title with folk-ornament flourishes at the top, run dates below. Palette: warm amber backlight, deep silhouette black, soft red accent, cream screen glow. Authentic paper-cut shadow-play aesthetic, translucent glow, intricate folk detail. Ticket and season info at the base. Mood: enchanting, delicate, folkloric, warm.
prompt_zh: 迷人的皮影戏话剧海报,标题「月兔 THE MOON RABBIT」,柳灯剧院皮影民间故事剧,8月20日至9月10日上演。主视觉:精巧的剪纸皮影剪影——兔子、月亮与盛开的树木——在半透明幕布上被温暖琥珀光逆照,细腻如蕾丝的镂刻细节。构图:层叠的皮影场景,发光的月亮居中,精巧手刻风格标题带民间纹样花饰置于顶部,演出日期列于下方。配色:暖琥珀逆光、深剪影黑、柔红点缀、奶白幕布辉光。地道的剪纸皮影美学、半透明辉光、繁复的民间细节。底部有票务与演季信息。氛围:迷人、精巧、民俗、温暖。

prompt_en: Vibrant contemporary musical poster for 'NEON CITY', an electrifying urban song-and-dance musical at The Boulevard Theatre, opening November 20. Hero: a dazzling ensemble of dancer silhouettes leaping in unison against a glowing neon city skyline, streaks of stage light and confetti bursting overhead. Composition: dynamic dancer line across the center, neon skyline behind, bold vibrant retro-marquee title with glowing bulb lettering at the top, cast and dates below. Palette: hot pink, electric blue, neon purple, gold marquee glow, deep night black. Dazzling marquee glow, dynamic stage energy, glossy showbiz sparkle. Ticket and run info at the base. Mood: dazzling, energetic, glamorous, uplifting.
prompt_zh: 活力四射的当代音乐剧海报,标题「霓虹之城 NEON CITY」,大道剧院一部炫目的都市歌舞音乐剧,11月20日首演。主视觉:一群炫目的舞者剪影在发光的霓虹城市天际线前齐声跃起,舞台光束与彩纸在头顶迸射。构图:动感的舞者一字排开横贯中央,霓虹天际线在后,粗壮鲜艳的复古剧院招牌标题带发光灯泡字母置于顶部,卡司与日期列于下方。配色:艳粉、电光蓝、霓虹紫、金色招牌辉光、深夜黑。炫目的招牌辉光、动感的舞台能量、光泽的演艺闪耀。底部有票务与演出信息。氛围:炫目、活力、华丽、振奋。

prompt_en: Cool upscale winter club poster for 'AURORA ICE LOUNGE', a frozen-themed party at Club Glacier, Saturday January 17, 10PM. Hero: a glowing ice crystal cocktail bar shimmering with shifting aurora-borealis light ribbons overhead, frosted geometric facets refracting cold neon. Composition: crystalline bar centered, aurora waves sweeping the top, sleek thin modern sans title with an icy metallic sheen, DJ lineup and dress-code line below. Palette: glacial blue, aurora green-violet, silver frost, deep icy navy. Cold crystalline shimmer, refractive glints, upscale frozen glamour. Guest list and door info at the base. Mood: cool, glamorous, frosty, hypnotic.
prompt_zh: 清冷高端的冬季夜店海报,标题「极光冰吧 AURORA ICE LOUNGE」,冰川俱乐部冰雪主题派对,1月17日周六晚10点。主视觉:一座发光的冰晶鸡尾酒吧闪烁着头顶流转的极光光带,磨砂的几何切面折射冷调霓虹。构图:冰晶酒吧居中,极光波纹横扫顶部,流线型纤细现代无衬线体标题带冰冷金属光泽,DJ阵容与着装要求列于下方。配色:冰川蓝、极光绿紫、银霜、深冰藏青。冷冽水晶微光、折射闪烁、高端冰雪魅惑。底部有嘉宾名单与入场信息。氛围:清冷、华丽、冰霜、催眠。

prompt_en: Indulgent chocolate festival poster for 'COCOA CARNIVAL', a chocolate and cacao fair at Cocoa Square, February 21-22. Hero: a decadent chocolate fountain cascading glossy molten chocolate over fresh strawberries and truffles, cocoa beans and dark cacao pods scattered around. Composition: rich flowing chocolate fountain centered, glossy indulgent close-up, warm ornate vintage-confectionery serif title at the top, vendor and ticket details on a chocolate-brown ribbon below. Palette: deep chocolate brown, caramel gold, strawberry red, cream, cocoa cream. Glossy molten texture, warm indulgent light, rich decadent detail. Entry and tasting info at the base. Mood: indulgent, rich, warm, mouthwatering.
prompt_zh: 令人沉醉的巧克力节海报,标题「可可嘉年华 COCOA CARNIVAL」,可可广场巧克力与可可豆集市,2月21至22日。主视觉:一座奢华的巧克力喷泉将光泽的熔岩巧克力浇淋在新鲜草莓与松露上,可可豆与深色可可荚散落四周。构图:丰盈流动的巧克力喷泉居中,光泽诱人的特写,温暖华丽的复古糖果店衬线体标题置于顶部,摊位与票务详情排在下方巧克力棕丝带上。配色:深巧克力棕、焦糖金、草莓红、奶白、可可奶油色。光泽熔岩质感、温暖诱人光线、丰富奢华细节。底部有入场与品尝信息。氛围:沉醉、浓郁、温暖、令人垂涎。

prompt_en: Energetic beach-sports poster for the 'SANDLINE BEACH VOLLEYBALL CLASSIC', a pro sand tournament at Sunset Cove, August 9-10. Hero: a dynamic mid-air spike silhouette against a bright volleyball soaring, sand spraying dramatically, sparkling blue ocean and clear sky behind. Composition: leaping player upper-right, ball as focal point, dynamic energy, bold italic athletic sans title at the top, bracket and schedule info below. Palette: bright sky blue, warm sand gold, ocean turquoise, sunny yellow, coral accent. Bright sunny beach light, dynamic sand-spray motion, crisp summer energy. Entry and spectator info at the base. Mood: energetic, sunny, competitive, coastal.
prompt_zh: 充满活力的沙滩运动海报,标题「沙线沙滩排球赛 SANDLINE BEACH VOLLEYBALL」,日落湾职业沙滩锦标赛,8月9至10日。主视觉:一个动感的空中扣球剪影迎着高飞的明亮排球,沙粒戏剧性地四溅,身后是波光粼粼的蓝色海洋与晴朗天空。构图:腾跃的球员位于右上,排球为视觉焦点,动感十足,粗壮斜体运动无衬线体标题置于顶部,赛程分组信息列于下方。配色:明亮天蓝、暖沙金、海洋青绿、阳光黄、珊瑚点缀。明媚阳光沙滩光、动感扬沙、清爽夏日能量。底部有报名与观赛信息。氛围:活力、阳光、竞技、海岸。

prompt_en: Inspiring aerospace conference poster for 'ORBITLAUNCH SPACE EXPO', a commercial-space and exploration summit at Skyport Center, June 12-14. Hero: a sleek fictional rocket ascending on a plume of light through wispy clouds toward a star-filled sky, an orbital station and glowing blue Earth curve on the horizon. Composition: rocket rising diagonally from bottom, cosmic horizon above, confident modern geometric sans title at the top, tracks and speakers in a clean grid below. Palette: deep space navy, rocket-plume orange, cosmic violet, Earth-glow cyan, white. Sleek aspirational glow, cinematic space clarity, premium futuristic polish. Registration and venue at the base. Mood: inspiring, ambitious, visionary, expansive.
prompt_zh: 鼓舞人心的航天大会海报,标题「轨道发射太空博览会 ORBITLAUNCH SPACE EXPO」,天港中心商业航天与探索峰会,6月12至14日。主视觉:一枚流线型虚构火箭乘着一道光焰穿过缕缕云层、飞向繁星密布的天空,地平线上有一座轨道空间站与发光的蓝色地球弧线。构图:火箭从底部斜向升起,宇宙地平线在上,自信的现代几何无衬线体标题置于顶部,分论坛与讲者以干净网格列于下方。配色:深空藏青、火箭尾焰橙、宇宙紫罗兰、地球辉光青、白。流线进取的辉光、电影般的太空通透、高端未来精致感。底部有报名与场馆。氛围:鼓舞、雄心、有远见、辽阔。

prompt_en: A minimalist typographic poster on a warm bone-white background. The single phrase 'SILENCE SPEAKS' set in a heavy condensed grotesque, stacked as two lines and cropped so the ascenders bleed off the top edge. Negative space dominates the lower two-thirds. One thin charcoal underline sits beneath the word 'LOUD' printed small at bottom-left. Palette of ink black on cream, a single burnt-orange dot as punctuation. Flat matte print texture, precise kerning, gallery-quiet mood.
prompt_zh: 极简排版海报,暖骨白色背景。仅有短语「SILENCE SPEAKS」采用粗窄无衬线字体,叠成两行并让字母上缘裁切溢出顶边。下方三分之二留白主导画面。左下角小字印着「LOUD」,下方一条细炭灰下划线。配色为奶油底墨黑字,一个烧橙圆点作标点。哑光平印质感,精准字距,画廊般安静的氛围。

prompt_en: A minimalist typographic poster exploring emptiness. On a pale grey field, the word 'ROOM' is set enormous in a thin geometric sans, letters spaced far apart so wide gaps open between each character. Below, in tiny caps, runs 'to breathe, to think, to begin again.' A single hairline vertical rule divides the sheet at the golden ratio. Palette limited to soft grey and deep navy ink. Museum-poster restraint, generous margins, calm and contemplative.
prompt_zh: 探索空无的极简排版海报。淡灰底色上,「ROOM」一词以纤细几何无衬线巨大呈现,字母间距极宽,每个字符之间敞开大片空隙。下方以极小的大写字排着「to breathe, to think, to begin again.」。一条发丝般的竖线在黄金分割处分割画面。配色仅限柔灰与深藏青墨。美术馆海报的克制,宽裕边距,沉静而内省。

prompt_en: A minimalist design poster reading 'LESS, BUT BETTER' in a precise neutral sans-serif, left-aligned and set in three tight lines high on the sheet. The rest is untouched off-white paper. A comma is rendered oversized in a muted mustard, becoming the only graphic element, floating mid-page. Subtle letterpress deboss texture around the type. Palette of paper white, graphite type, one mustard accent. Cool, deliberate, design-studio elegance.
prompt_zh: 极简设计海报,以精准中性无衬线字体写着「LESS, BUT BETTER」,左对齐分三行紧密排在纸面上方。其余部分是未经修饰的米白纸张。一个逗号被放大成柔和芥末黄,成为唯一图形元素,悬浮在页面中部。字体周围有细微凸版压印质感。配色为纸白、石墨字与一抹芥末点缀。冷静、审慎、设计工作室般的优雅。

prompt_en: A minimalist typographic poster built from a single word 'FLOW' repeated vertically nine times down the center, each repetition in a lighter tint of teal until it fades to nearly white at the bottom. The topmost word is bold and saturated; the type is a clean humanist sans. Thin baseline grid faintly visible. Background is warm ivory. Palette of graduated teals on ivory. Rhythmic, meditative, precise, poster-as-object.
prompt_zh: 由单词「FLOW」构成的极简排版海报,该词沿中央竖向重复九次,每一次都以更浅的青色调呈现,直到底部几近纯白。最上方的字最粗最饱和;字体为干净的人文无衬线体。隐约可见细基线网格。背景为暖象牙白。配色是渐变青色叠在象牙白上。富有韵律、冥想感、精准,海报即物件。

prompt_en: A bold minimalist poster dominated by a single giant question mark rendered as pure geometry, its dot a perfect circle at the base. Inside the curve of the mark, in tiny justified type, sits the line 'what if the answer was never the point.' Stark black form on a saturated cadmium-yellow field. No other elements. Flat vector cleanliness, extreme scale contrast, confident and conceptual, gallery print aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 以单个巨大问号主导的醒目极简海报,问号以纯几何呈现,底部圆点是完美圆形。在问号弧线内侧,以极小的两端对齐字排着「what if the answer was never the point.」。饱和镉黄底色上是纯黑造型。别无他物。平面矢量的干净利落,极端的尺度反差,自信而具观念性,画廊印刷美学。

prompt_en: A minimalist typographic poster imitating a manuscript page. A wide left margin holds a single vertical red rule; the body area carries one centered sentence, 'the best ideas live in the empty spaces,' set in an elegant serif. A handwritten-style asterisk floats near the top corner. Vast cream paper untouched below. Palette of warm cream, black serif, one vermilion rule. Quiet literary sophistication, refined margins, understated.
prompt_zh: 模仿手稿页的极简排版海报。宽阔的左侧页边只有一条竖直红线;正文区居中排着一句「the best ideas live in the empty spaces」,采用优雅衬线体。一个手写风格的星号飘在顶角附近。下方大片奶油纸张未经触碰。配色为暖奶油、黑衬线字与一条朱红线。安静的文学式精致,考究的页边留白,含蓄内敛。

prompt_en: A minimalist poster where two words 'STAY' and 'GO' overlap at the center, printed in translucent inks so the intersection blends into a third muddy tone. Set in a heavy modern sans, one word horizontal, the other rotated ninety degrees. Everything else is bare warm-white. Palette of transparent cyan and magenta overlapping into violet. Screen-print registration feel, clever conceptual tension, minimal and smart.
prompt_zh: 极简海报,两个词「STAY」与「GO」在中央交叠,以半透明油墨印刷,使交叉处混成第三种浑浊色调。采用粗现代无衬线体,一词横排,另一词旋转九十度。其余皆为裸露的暖白。配色是透明青与品红交叠成紫。丝网印刷的套版感,巧妙的观念张力,极简而聪慧。

prompt_en: An ultra-minimal poster carrying a single long sentence set very small and centered on a huge empty charcoal-black sheet: 'we spent the whole summer learning how to do nothing well.' The type is a refined light sans in warm off-white, letter-spaced generously. A faint thin frame of the same off-white borders the page far inside the edges. Palette of near-black and soft ivory. Cinematic emptiness, intimate, poetic minimalism.
prompt_zh: 超极简海报,在巨大空旷的炭黑纸面上居中排着一句极小的长句:「we spent the whole summer learning how to do nothing well.」。字体是精致纤细无衬线,暖米白色,字距舒朗。同色米白的一圈纤细边框落在远离页缘的内部。配色为近黑与柔象牙白。电影般的空旷,私密而诗意的极简。

prompt_en: A minimalist typographic poster over a faint regular dot grid. In the upper third, 'BEGIN' is set in bold rounded sans, its counter-spaces filled with a single coral hue. The rest of the grid stays untouched pale beige. A tiny arrow icon points from the last letter toward the empty lower field. Palette of beige ground, near-black type, coral fill. Clean Scandinavian minimalism, airy, optimistic, precise alignment.
prompt_zh: 叠在淡淡规则点阵上的极简排版海报。上三分之一处,「BEGIN」以粗圆润无衬线呈现,字腔内填入单一珊瑚色。其余点阵保持未触碰的淡米色。一个小箭头图标从最后一个字母指向下方空旷区域。配色为米色底、近黑字、珊瑚填充。干净的北欧极简,通透、乐观、对齐精准。

prompt_en: A minimalist poster split precisely into two horizontal halves, top pure warm white, bottom deep forest green. The word 'BALANCE' straddles the dividing line, its top half black on white, bottom half white on green, set in a tall condensed sans. No other elements but the clean seam. Palette of forest green and warm white with black type. Bold color-block minimalism, perfect symmetry, confident restraint.
prompt_zh: 精准分成上下两半的极简海报,上半纯暖白,下半深森林绿。「BALANCE」一词横跨分界线,上半部白底黑字,下半部绿底白字,采用高瘦窄无衬线体。除干净的接缝外别无他物。配色为森林绿与暖白配黑字。醒目的色块极简,完美对称,自信的克制。

prompt_en: A motivational quote poster with the line 'FALL SEVEN TIMES, RISE ANYWAY' set in a confident bold slab serif, stacked in three lines and centered. Behind the text, a soft sunrise gradient climbs from deep plum at the bottom to warm apricot at the top. A thin gold horizontal line underscores the word 'RISE'. Small caption at base: 'a note to your future self.' Uplifting, warm, cinematic glow, poster-print polish.
prompt_zh: 励志语录海报,句子「FALL SEVEN TIMES, RISE ANYWAY」以自信的粗板衬线体呈现,叠成三行居中。文字后方,柔和的日出渐变从底部深梅红升至顶部暖杏色。一条细金线为「RISE」一词加下划。底部小字注解:「a note to your future self.」。振奋、温暖、电影般的光晕,海报印刷般的精致。

prompt_en: A motivational poster reading 'DO IT SCARED' in enormous hand-painted brush lettering, ink strokes rough and energetic, dripping slightly at the ends. The background is a textured concrete grey. Below, a neat line of small sans caps: 'courage is not the absence of fear.' A single splash of electric red frames the word 'SCARED'. Palette of concrete grey, black brush ink, electric red. Raw, gritty, urban-motivational energy.
prompt_zh: 励志海报,「DO IT SCARED」以巨大手绘毛笔字呈现,笔触粗犷有力,末端略有滴垂。背景是有肌理的水泥灰。下方一行工整的小无衬线大写字:「courage is not the absence of fear.」。一抹电光红框住「SCARED」一词。配色为水泥灰、黑毛笔墨、电光红。原始、粗粝、都市励志的能量。

prompt_en: A motivational quote poster with 'GROW THROUGH WHAT YOU GO THROUGH' arranged as playful stacked lines, mixing a rounded script for 'grow' with clean caps for the rest. Botanical line-art vines curl up the left edge, sprouting tiny leaves that weave between the letters. Soft sage-green background with cream type. A small watering-can icon sits bottom-right. Fresh, hopeful, hand-crafted, botanical-motivational aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 励志语录海报,「GROW THROUGH WHAT YOU GO THROUGH」排成俏皮的叠行,「grow」用圆润手写体,其余用干净大写。植物线描藤蔓从左缘蜿蜒而上,抽出小叶片在字母间穿织。柔和鼠尾草绿背景配奶油色字。右下角有个小洒水壶图标。清新、充满希望、手作感,植物系励志美学。

prompt_en: A clean motivational poster stating 'PROGRESS OVER PERFECTION' in bold geometric sans, centered on a bright canary-yellow field. The word 'PERFECTION' is crossed out with a single confident diagonal black stroke, and 'PROGRESS' glows above it in white. A dotted upward path line curves through the lower half. Small tagline: 'keep going, one percent at a time.' Bright, energetic, modern coaching-poster mood, high contrast.
prompt_zh: 简洁励志海报,「PROGRESS OVER PERFECTION」以粗几何无衬线呈现,居中于明亮的鹅黄底色。「PERFECTION」被一道自信的黑色斜线划掉,「PROGRESS」在其上以白色发亮。虚线上升路径在下半部弯曲穿过。小标语:「keep going, one percent at a time.」。明亮、有活力、现代教练海报风,高对比。

prompt_en: A motivational poster with 'STAY HUNGRY, STAY CURIOUS' set in a tall elegant serif reversed out of a deep midnight-blue background scattered with faint constellation dots and thin star lines. A single golden shooting-star streak underlines the phrase. Small caps footer: 'the horizon is only the beginning.' Palette of midnight blue, warm gold, soft white. Aspirational, celestial, sophisticated, dreamy nighttime elegance.
prompt_zh: 励志海报,「STAY HUNGRY, STAY CURIOUS」以高雅衬线体从深午夜蓝背景中反白呈现,背景散布着淡淡星座点与细星线。一道金色流星轨迹为短语加下划。小写页脚:「the horizon is only the beginning.」。配色为午夜蓝、暖金、柔白。有抱负、天际感、精致、梦幻的夜色优雅。

prompt_en: A motivational typographic poster posing the choice 'ONE DAY or DAY ONE — you decide.' The two phrases sit on opposing sides of a bold vertical divider, left half in muted grey, right half in vivid tangerine. The word 'decide' is handwritten in a casual marker script at the bottom, underlined twice. Textured paper background. Palette of grey, tangerine, ink black. Decisive, punchy, split-screen motivational design.
prompt_zh: 励志排版海报,抛出抉择「ONE DAY or DAY ONE — you decide.」。两个短语分列于一道粗竖分隔线两侧,左半灰调,右半鲜橘。底部「decide」以随性马克笔手写体呈现,加双下划线。纸质肌理背景。配色为灰、橘、墨黑。果断、有冲击力的分屏励志设计。

prompt_en: A motivational poster illustrating 'SMALL STEPS EVERY DAY' with a staircase of block letters that literally climb from bottom-left to top-right, each word on a rising step. Warm gradient sky from peach to lavender behind. A tiny minimalist figure silhouette stands at the top step. Footer reads 'the summit is closer than you think.' Palette of peach, lavender, deep plum type. Encouraging, illustrative, gentle motivational storytelling.
prompt_zh: 励志海报,以块状字母搭成的楼梯诠释「SMALL STEPS EVERY DAY」,字母从左下向右上真正地攀升,每个词落在一级上升的台阶上。背后是从桃色到薰衣草的暖渐变天空。一个极简人物剪影站在最高一级台阶。页脚写着「the summit is closer than you think.」。配色为桃、薰衣草、深梅红字。鼓舞人心、插画式、温柔的励志叙事。

prompt_en: A motivational quote poster with 'BLOOM WHERE IT'S HARD' set in a graceful contrasting serif over a moody dark-teal watercolor wash. A single vivid orange poppy pushes up through a crack rendered in white line-art at the base. The word 'BLOOM' is the largest, in warm peach. Small italic footer: 'roots grow deepest in rough ground.' Palette of dark teal, peach, burnt orange. Resilient, painterly, emotionally warm.
prompt_zh: 励志语录海报,「BLOOM WHERE IT'S HARD」以优雅的对比衬线体呈现于阴郁的深青水彩晕染之上。一朵鲜橙罂粟从底部白色线描的裂缝中顶出。「BLOOM」一词最大,呈暖桃色。斜体小页脚:「roots grow deepest in rough ground.」。配色为深青、桃、烧橙。坚韧、绘画感、情感温暖。

prompt_en: A calm motivational poster reading 'TRUST THE TIMING OF YOUR LIFE' set in a soft rounded serif, centered over a large minimal line drawing of a crescent moon and a single orbiting dot. Warm sand-beige background with muted terracotta type. Thin concentric circles ripple outward from the center. Tiny footer: 'nothing blooms all year.' Palette of sand, terracotta, dusty rose. Serene, reassuring, boho-minimal, meditative.
prompt_zh: 沉静的励志海报,「TRUST THE TIMING OF YOUR LIFE」以柔和圆润衬线体居中呈现于一幅极简线描弦月与一枚环绕圆点之上。暖沙米背景配柔和赤陶色字。细同心圆自中心向外荡开涟漪。小页脚:「nothing blooms all year.」。配色为沙色、赤陶、灰玫瑰。宁静、抚慰人心、波西米亚极简、冥想感。

prompt_en: An energetic motivational poster shouting 'MAKE IT HAPPEN' in a chunky retro-italic display face, letters outlined with a double drop-shadow in cyan and magenta for a vibrating pop effect. Bold diagonal speed lines rush across a warm cream background. A starburst badge in the corner reads 'no more someday.' Palette of cream, hot magenta, electric cyan, black outline. Loud, kinetic, retro-motivational, high-octane.
prompt_zh: 充满能量的励志海报,以粗壮复古斜体展示字大喊「MAKE IT HAPPEN」,字母用青与品红的双重投影描边,产生震动般的波普效果。粗斜速度线在暖奶油背景上飞驰。角落一枚星爆徽章写着「no more someday.」。配色为奶油、亮品红、电光青、黑描边。喧闹、动感、复古励志、高能。

prompt_en: A Swiss International Style concert poster on stark white. A rigid modular grid organizes everything: 'NEUE KLANG FESTIVAL' set in Helvetica-like bold sans, flush-left, ranged along a strict baseline system. A single large red rectangle anchors the upper right; event details in tiny justified columns below. Ample white space, mathematical alignment, no decoration. Palette of white, black, one signal red. Objective, rational, classic 1960s Swiss design.
prompt_zh: 纯白底的瑞士国际主义风格音乐会海报。严谨的模块网格统御一切:「NEUE KLANG FESTIVAL」以类赫尔维提卡粗无衬线体左对齐,沿严格基线系统排列。一个大红矩形锚定右上;下方是极小两端对齐的分栏活动信息。大量留白,数学般对齐,毫无装饰。配色为白、黑、一抹信号红。客观、理性、经典1960年代瑞士设计。

prompt_en: A Bauhaus-inspired poster built from primary geometric shapes: a bold blue triangle, a yellow circle, and a red square arranged in dynamic diagonal tension. The title 'FORM FOLLOWS JOY' is set in a lowercase geometric sans, rotated ninety degrees up the left side. Thin black rules connect the shapes. Warm off-white paper background. Palette of primary red, blue, yellow, black. Playful yet rigorous, 1920s Weimar modernism, iconic and balanced.
prompt_zh: 包豪斯风格海报,由三原色几何形构成:一个醒目的蓝三角、一个黄圆、一个红方块以动态斜向张力排布。标题「FORM FOLLOWS JOY」以小写几何无衬线体呈现,旋转九十度沿左侧向上排列。细黑线连接各形状。暖米白纸背景。配色为原色红、蓝、黄、黑。既俏皮又严谨,1920年代魏玛现代主义,标志性而均衡。

prompt_en: A Swiss-style typographic poster where the headline 'MOTION IN ORDER' is set on a bold forty-five degree diagonal, cutting across a strict underlying column grid rendered in faint cyan guidelines. Text blocks in small Akzidenz-style sans cling to the grid modules. A solid black bar runs along the bottom edge with white event dates. Palette of white, black, faint cyan grid. Precise, dynamic, grid-visible experimental Swiss modernism.
prompt_zh: 瑞士风格排版海报,主标题「MOTION IN ORDER」沿醒目的四十五度斜向排列,切过以淡青参考线呈现的严格底层分栏网格。小Akzidenz风格无衬线文本块贴附于网格模块。底缘一条实心黑条载有白色活动日期。配色为白、黑、淡青网格。精准、动感、显露网格的实验性瑞士现代主义。

prompt_en: A Bauhaus theatre poster announcing 'MECHANIK BALLET' in stacked geometric caps, letters constructed from perfect circles and straight strokes. A large half-red half-black circle sits behind the title. Thin concentric arcs and a lone yellow bar radiate outward. Everything aligns to an implied diagonal axis. Warm paper texture. Palette of red, black, yellow, cream. Constructivist energy, machine-age geometry, bold and theatrical.
prompt_zh: 包豪斯剧场海报,以叠置几何大写字宣告「MECHANIK BALLET」,字母由完美圆形与直笔画构成。一个半红半黑的大圆坐落于标题后方。细同心弧与一条孤零的黄条向外放射。一切对齐于一条隐含的斜轴。暖纸肌理。配色为红、黑、黄、奶油。构成主义能量,机械时代几何,醒目而戏剧化。

prompt_en: A restrained Swiss-style lecture poster. Ninety percent white space; a single tight cluster of information sits low in the left column: 'DESIGN & SYSTEMS — a public talk by studio Verold' in graded sizes of a neutral grotesque, flush-left, ranged-right ragged. One thin horizontal hairline separates title from body. A small solid orange square marks the RSVP line. Palette of white, black type, one orange square. Ultra-minimal, ordered, intellectual Swiss clarity.
prompt_zh: 克制的瑞士风格讲座海报。九成留白;唯一紧凑的信息簇落在左栏靠下位置:「DESIGN & SYSTEMS — a public talk by studio Verold」,以中性无衬线体的分级字号左对齐、右侧参差排列。一条细横发丝线分隔标题与正文。一个小实心橘方标记RSVP行。配色为白、黑字、一个橘方。极简、有序、知性的瑞士清晰感。

prompt_en: A Bauhaus exhibition poster with 'WERK UND WEISE' set in a strict geometric grotesque, letters slightly extended and left-aligned. A grid of nine equal squares fills the right two-thirds, each square a flat block of primary color or black-and-white, forming a modular quilt. Thin registration crosses mark the corners. Palette of red, blue, yellow, black, white. Systematic, colorful, museum-modernist, precise modular composition.
prompt_zh: 包豪斯展览海报,「WERK UND WEISE」以严格几何无衬线体呈现,字母略微加宽并左对齐。右侧三分之二填满九个等大方块组成的网格,每个方块是一块三原色或黑白平色,构成模块化拼被。细套版十字标记着四角。配色为红、蓝、黄、黑、白。系统化、色彩丰富、美术馆现代主义、精准的模块化构图。

prompt_en: A Swiss modernist manifesto poster. A single thick red horizontal bar slices the sheet a third of the way down, carrying reversed-out white sans caps: 'GOOD DESIGN IS INVISIBLE.' Below, a dense justified paragraph of tiny grey body text fills a narrow left column, leaving the right side empty. Strict baseline grid. Palette of white, signal red bar, cool grey type. Editorial rigor, hierarchy through scale, classic International Typographic Style.
prompt_zh: 瑞士现代主义宣言海报。一条粗红横条在页面三分之一处切过,承载反白的白色无衬线大写字:「GOOD DESIGN IS INVISIBLE.」。下方,一段密实两端对齐的极小灰正文填满窄窄的左栏,右侧留空。严格基线网格。配色为白、信号红条、冷灰字。编辑式严谨,以尺度构建层级,经典国际主义字体风格。

prompt_en: A Bauhaus-flavored music poster where concentric semicircles in alternating blue and red pulse outward from the bottom-left corner like sound waves. The title 'RADIO MODERN' sits in a bold lowercase geometric sans across the top, a yellow circle dotting the 'i'. Thin black lines tangent the arcs. Cream background with visible paper grain. Palette of blue, red, yellow, cream, black. Rhythmic, constructive, warm vintage modernism.
prompt_zh: 包豪斯风味的音乐海报,蓝红交替的同心半圆如声波般自左下角向外脉动。标题「radio modern」以粗小写几何无衬线体横排于顶部,一个黄圆点缀「i」上。细黑线与各弧相切。奶油背景带可见纸纹。配色为蓝、红、黄、奶油、黑。富有韵律、构成感、温暖的复古现代主义。

prompt_en: A Swiss-style poster where a single word 'STRUKTUR' is deconstructed across a visible six-column grid, each letter placed in its own module at varying baselines, some cropped by the module edge. A pale grey grid stays visible behind the black type. One module is filled solid warm-yellow, framing the letter 'U'. Palette of white, black, one yellow module. Systematic, experimental, grid-driven typographic architecture.
prompt_zh: 瑞士风格海报,单词「STRUKTUR」被拆解于一个可见的六栏网格中,每个字母置于各自模块内、落在不同基线,部分被模块边缘裁切。淡灰网格保留在黑字后方可见。一个模块填满暖黄实色,框住字母「U」。配色为白、黑、一个黄模块。系统化、实验性、网格驱动的字体建筑。

prompt_en: A joyful Bauhaus-style poster for a children's design workshop, 'KLEINE FORMEN.' Big flat shapes — a bouncing red ball, a blue zigzag, a yellow triangle — scatter playfully across an off-white sheet with slight overlap. Rounded geometric caps for the title curve along the top. A thin black baseline anchors small workshop details at the bottom. Palette of primary red, blue, yellow, black on cream. Cheerful, tactile, educational modernism.
prompt_zh: 欢快的包豪斯风格海报,为儿童设计工作坊而作,「KLEINE FORMEN」。大块平面形状——一颗弹跳的红球、一道蓝折线、一个黄三角——俏皮地散落在米白纸面上并略有重叠。圆润几何大写标题沿顶部弯曲。一条细黑基线在底部锚定小号工作坊信息。配色为原色红、蓝、黄、黑叠奶油。愉悦、有触感、教育性现代主义。

prompt_en: A vintage travel poster in 1930s railway style advertising 'VISIT MONT AVELINE.' A stylized cog railway climbs snow-capped peaks under a graduated sky of teal to gold. Bold streamlined art-deco lettering arcs across the top; a small crest reads 'Northern Alpine Line.' Flat screen-print color separations, subtle paper aging, sharp geometric mountains. Palette of teal, cream, warm gold, deep navy. Nostalgic, elegant, golden-age-of-travel romance.
prompt_zh: 1930年代铁路风格的复古旅行海报,宣传「VISIT MONT AVELINE」。一列风格化齿轨列车在青金渐变天空下攀登雪峰。粗壮流线型装饰艺术字沿顶部弧排;一枚小徽章写着「Northern Alpine Line」。平面丝网印刷分色,微妙纸张做旧,锐利几何山峰。配色为青、奶油、暖金、深藏青。怀旧、优雅、旅行黄金时代的浪漫。

prompt_en: A retro seaside travel poster for the invented resort town 'PORTO SELENE.' A striped beach umbrella, a curved white promenade, and turquoise water rendered in flat gouache-style blocks under a hot coral sun. The town name is set in a rounded 1950s script across the sky. A small ribbon banner reads 'the sunlit coast.' Palette of turquoise, coral, sand, cream. Cheerful mid-century travel-brochure warmth, sun-faded charm.
prompt_zh: 复古海滨旅行海报,为虚构度假小镇「PORTO SELENE」而作。条纹沙滩伞、弯曲的白色海滨步道、以平涂水粉风格块面呈现的绿松石海水,都沐浴在炽热珊瑚色太阳下。镇名以圆润的1950年代手写体横越天空。一条小丝带横幅写着「the sunlit coast.」。配色为绿松石、珊瑚、沙、奶油。愉悦的中世纪旅行手册般的温暖,阳光褪色的魅力。

prompt_en: A vintage American road-trip travel poster for the fictional 'RED MESA HIGHWAY.' A long empty desert road recedes to a horizon of layered orange-and-purple buttes under a big graphic sun with radiating rays. Chunky retro serif lettering across the top; a small route shield reads 'Scenic Byway 12.' Halftone dot shading, aged cream borders. Palette of burnt orange, dusty purple, ochre, cream. Warm, adventurous, mid-century Americana nostalgia.
prompt_zh: 复古美式公路旅行海报,为虚构的「RED MESA HIGHWAY」而作。一条空旷长路退向由橙紫层叠方山构成的地平线,大幅图形化太阳射出放射状光线。粗壮复古衬线字横排于顶部;一枚小公路盾牌写着「Scenic Byway 12」。半调网点阴影,做旧奶油边框。配色为烧橙、灰紫、赭石、奶油。温暖、冒险、中世纪美式怀旧。

prompt_en: A retro airline travel poster promoting the invented destination 'ISLA CORVELA.' A propeller plane banks over a lush volcanic island ringed by reef-blue lagoons, palm fronds framing the corners. Elegant vintage sans caps spell the name; a small winged badge reads 'Trans-Pacific Air.' Flat lithograph color, subtle grain, soft sun haze. Palette of jade green, sky blue, coral, ivory. Exotic, glamorous, 1950s jet-age travel optimism.
prompt_zh: 复古航空旅行海报,推介虚构目的地「ISLA CORVELA」。一架螺旋桨飞机倾侧飞越被礁蓝潟湖环绕的葱郁火山岛,棕榈叶框住四角。优雅的复古无衬线大写字拼出岛名;一枚小翼徽写着「Trans-Pacific Air」。平面石版印刷色彩,微妙颗粒,柔和阳光薄雾。配色为翡翠绿、天蓝、珊瑚、象牙。异域、迷人、1950年代喷气时代的旅行乐观。

prompt_en: A vintage European city travel poster for the fictional town 'BELLARIVE.' Steep pastel rooftops, a clock tower, and a winding cobbled lane rendered in warm flat blocks descend toward a river. A tram curves through the foreground. Graceful art-nouveau lettering along the base; a small crest reads 'Old Quarter.' Aged litho texture, muted sun. Palette of terracotta, sage, cream, dusty blue. Charming, romantic, hand-illustrated European nostalgia.
prompt_zh: 复古欧洲城市旅行海报,为虚构小镇「BELLARIVE」而作。陡峭的粉彩屋顶、一座钟楼、一条蜿蜒鹅卵石小巷以暖色平块呈现,朝一条河流铺展而下。一辆电车在前景弯行。优雅新艺术字沿底部排列;一枚小徽章写着「Old Quarter」。做旧石版肌理,柔和阳光。配色为赤陶、鼠尾草、奶油、灰蓝。迷人、浪漫、手绘的欧洲怀旧。

prompt_en: A classic WPA-style national park travel poster for the invented 'CEDAR HOLLOW PARK.' A towering waterfall plunges between granite cliffs into a pine valley, an elk silhouette on a foreground ridge. Screen-print flat colors with bold shadow shapes. Sturdy block-serif title arcs at top; a ranger badge reads 'Est. 1938.' Palette of forest green, slate blue, warm tan, cream. Grand, adventurous, heritage-poster craftsmanship.
prompt_zh: 经典WPA风格的国家公园旅行海报,为虚构的「CEDAR HOLLOW PARK」而作。一道高耸瀑布在花岗岩峭壁间倾泻入松林山谷,前景山脊上一头麋鹿剪影。丝网印刷平色配醒目阴影块面。厚实块衬线标题在顶部弧排;一枚护林员徽章写着「Est. 1938」。配色为森林绿、石板蓝、暖褐、奶油。宏伟、冒险、传承海报的工艺感。

prompt_en: An art-deco ocean-liner travel poster for the fictional line 'AURELIA CROSSINGS.' A colossal steamship cuts diagonally across the sheet, twin funnels trailing stylized smoke, seen from a low heroic angle. Bold geometric deco lettering spells the line name; a small banner reads 'to the New World in five days.' Metallic gold accents, flat two-tone sea. Palette of navy, gold, cream, teal. Opulent, streamlined, 1930s luxury-travel grandeur.
prompt_zh: 装饰艺术风格的远洋邮轮旅行海报,为虚构船运公司「AURELIA CROSSINGS」而作。一艘巨型蒸汽船以低视角英雄式构图斜切过画面,双烟囱拖曳风格化烟雾。粗壮几何装饰艺术字拼出公司名;一条小横幅写着「to the New World in five days」。金属金点缀,平涂双色海面。配色为藏青、金、奶油、青。奢华、流线、1930年代豪华旅行的恢弘。

prompt_en: A vintage winter-sports travel poster for the invented resort 'GLACIER PLATEAU.' A stylized skier carves down a bright white slope under crisp blue skies and geometric snowy peaks, a plume of powder trailing behind. Bold condensed deco caps arc across the top; a small crest reads 'winter season.' Flat lithograph blocks, subtle grain. Palette of ice blue, crimson, white, warm cream. Crisp, energetic, alpine mid-century glamour.
prompt_zh: 复古冬季运动旅行海报,为虚构度假地「GLACIER PLATEAU」而作。一位风格化滑雪者在清爽蓝天与几何雪峰下沿明亮雪坡切下,身后拖着一缕粉雪。粗壮窄装饰艺术大写字沿顶部弧排;一枚小徽章写着「winter season」。平面石版块色,微妙颗粒。配色为冰蓝、绯红、白、暖奶油。清爽、有活力、阿尔卑斯中世纪魅力。

prompt_en: A retro travel poster for the fictional wine region 'VAL DORINE.' Rolling terraced vineyards recede in warm golden bands under a low amber sun, a stone farmhouse and cypress trees dotting the hills. Elegant vintage serif title curves at top; a small ribbon reads 'harvest festival.' Soft grain, flat sun-warmed blocks. Palette of golden ochre, olive green, wine red, cream. Warm, pastoral, romantic countryside nostalgia.
prompt_zh: 复古旅行海报,为虚构葡萄酒产区「VAL DORINE」而作。层叠梯田葡萄园在低垂琥珀色太阳下以暖金色带退向远方,石砌农舍与柏树点缀山丘。优雅复古衬线标题在顶部弯排;一条小丝带写着「harvest festival」。柔和颗粒,平涂的阳光暖块。配色为金赭、橄榄绿、酒红、奶油。温暖、田园、浪漫的乡野怀旧。

prompt_en: A retro travel poster for the fictional metropolis 'NEO HAVANA' by night. A grid of glowing skyscraper windows, a vintage convertible on a palm-lined boulevard, and a magenta-and-teal neon skyline reflected on wet asphalt. Chrome-style script spells the city name; a small tagline reads 'the city that never dims.' Halftone glow, faint film grain. Palette of magenta, teal, midnight blue, electric yellow. Vibrant, dreamy, retro-futuristic nightlife.
prompt_zh: 夜色中虚构大都会「NEO HAVANA」的复古旅行海报。发光摩天楼窗格阵列、棕榈林荫大道上的复古敞篷车、映在湿沥青上的品红与青霓虹天际线。铬金属风格手写体拼出城市名;一句小标语写着「the city that never dims」。半调光晕,淡淡胶片颗粒。配色为品红、青、午夜蓝、电光黄。绚丽、梦幻、复古未来主义夜生活。

prompt_en: A high-impact gym promo poster for 'IRON WILL FITNESS.' A dramatic low-key photograph feel of a barbell loaded with plates against dark concrete, rim-lit in cold blue, sweat particles catching light. Aggressive slanted condensed caps shout 'FORGE YOUR LIMITS'; a bright orange flash-badge reads '6-WEEK STRENGTH CHALLENGE — JOIN NOW.' Small details list class times. Palette of charcoal, steel blue, molten orange. Intense, muscular, motivational gym energy.
prompt_zh: 高冲击力的健身房宣传海报,为「IRON WILL FITNESS」而作。深色水泥前一根杠铃满载杠铃片,冷蓝轮廓光勾勒,汗珠微粒捕捉光线,呈现低调摄影质感。激进的倾斜窄大写字高喊「FORGE YOUR LIMITS」;一枚亮橘闪光徽章写着「6-WEEK STRENGTH CHALLENGE — JOIN NOW」。小字列出课程时间。配色为炭黑、钢蓝、熔橙。强烈、力量感、励志的健身能量。

prompt_en: A calming fitness promo poster for 'LUMEN YOGA STUDIO.' A serene silhouette of a person in a standing stretch against a soft peach-to-lavender sunrise gradient, thin sun rays behind. Light airy sans-serif reads 'MORNING FLOW — 6AM SESSIONS'; a gentle rounded badge notes 'first class free.' Small footer lists a fictional address. Palette of peach, lavender, soft gold, cream. Peaceful, wellness-focused, elegant and inviting.
prompt_zh: 沉静的健身宣传海报,为「LUMEN YOGA STUDIO」而作。一个人做站立伸展的宁静剪影,映衬柔和的桃色到薰衣草日出渐变,背后有细日光。轻盈通透的无衬线字写着「MORNING FLOW — 6AM SESSIONS」;一枚柔和圆徽注明「first class free」。小页脚列出虚构地址。配色为桃、薰衣草、柔金、奶油。平和、注重身心、优雅诱人。

prompt_en: A gritty boxing club promo flyer for 'SOUTHPAW BOXING CO.' A weathered pair of red boxing gloves hangs against a distressed brick wall, harsh top light casting deep shadow. Heavy vintage-athletic block letters read 'STEP INTO THE RING'; a torn-ticket badge shouts 'FREE TRIAL WEEK.' Bold grunge textures and paint-splatter accents. Palette of blood red, charcoal, dusty white. Raw, tough, old-school combat-gym attitude.
prompt_zh: 粗粝的拳击俱乐部宣传传单,为「SOUTHPAW BOXING CO.」而作。一对饱经风霜的红拳套挂在斑驳砖墙前,刺目顶光投下深影。厚重复古运动块字写着「STEP INTO THE RING」;一枚撕票造型徽章高喊「FREE TRIAL WEEK」。醒目垃圾摇滚肌理与颜料飞溅点缀。配色为血红、炭黑、灰白。原始、硬朗、老派格斗馆的态度。

prompt_en: An energetic HIIT bootcamp promo poster for 'PULSE BOOTCAMP.' Diagonal neon-green speed streaks cut across a dark athletic background; a dynamic dumbbell icon bursts from the center. Bold italic sans reads 'BURN. BUILD. REPEAT.'; a lightning-bolt badge announces '45-MIN GROUP SESSIONS.' Small schedule grid at the bottom. Palette of black, neon green, hot white, slate grey. Explosive, high-energy, modern group-fitness hype.
prompt_zh: 充满活力的高强度间歇训练营宣传海报,为「PULSE BOOTCAMP」而作。霓虹绿斜向速度光条切过深色运动背景;一个动感哑铃图标从中央迸发。粗斜无衬线写着「BURN. BUILD. REPEAT.」;一枚闪电徽章宣布「45-MIN GROUP SESSIONS」。底部有小课表网格。配色为黑、霓虹绿、亮白、石板灰。爆发力、高能量、现代团体健身的热潮。

prompt_en: A bold powerlifting meet poster for the 'STEEL SUMMIT OPEN.' A dramatic silhouette of a lifter locking out a heavy deadlift under stark spotlight, chalk dust rising in the beam. Massive stencil-military caps read 'STEEL SUMMIT OPEN'; a plate-shaped badge lists 'SEP 14 — 3 WEIGHT CLASSES.' Distressed metal texture. Palette of gunmetal grey, safety yellow, black. Heavy, competitive, industrial strength-sport intensity.
prompt_zh: 醒目的力量举比赛海报,为「STEEL SUMMIT OPEN」而作。一位举重者在刺目聚光下锁定硬拉的戏剧剪影,镁粉在光束中扬起。巨大军事模板大写字写着「STEEL SUMMIT OPEN」;一枚杠铃片形徽章列出「SEP 14 — 3 WEIGHT CLASSES」。做旧金属肌理。配色为枪灰、安全黄、黑。厚重、竞技、工业力量运动的强度。

prompt_en: A vibrant indoor-cycling studio promo poster for 'REVOLVE RIDE.' A stylized spin bike glows in a dark studio pierced by pink and violet stage lights, motion blur on the wheel. Sleek rounded caps read 'RIDE TO THE BEAT'; a neon disc badge announces 'THURSDAY GLOW RIDE — 7PM.' Small pricing note below. Palette of hot pink, deep violet, cyan, black. Electric, rhythmic, nightclub-style fitness excitement.
prompt_zh: 活力四射的室内动感单车工作室宣传海报,为「REVOLVE RIDE」而作。一辆风格化动感单车在被粉紫舞台灯穿透的暗室中发光,车轮带运动模糊。流线圆润大写字写着「RIDE TO THE BEAT」;一枚霓虹圆盘徽章宣布「THURSDAY GLOW RIDE — 7PM」。下方有小号价格提示。配色为亮粉、深紫、青、黑。电感、韵律、夜店风的健身兴奋。

prompt_en: A tough functional-fitness promo poster for 'FORGE FUNCTIONAL.' A chalk-dusted kettlebell and battle ropes mid-swing frozen against raw industrial concrete, dramatic side light. Aggressive stencil caps read 'EARN YOUR STRENGTH'; a hazard-stripe badge reads 'ONBOARDING CLASS — SATURDAYS 9AM.' Grunge splatter and rivet details. Palette of concrete grey, safety orange, matte black. Rugged, no-excuses, functional-training grit.
prompt_zh: 硬朗的功能性健身宣传海报,为「FORGE FUNCTIONAL」而作。沾满镁粉的壶铃与甩动中定格的战绳映衬原始工业水泥,戏剧性侧光。激进模板大写字写着「EARN YOUR STRENGTH」;一枚警示条纹徽章写着「ONBOARDING CLASS — SATURDAYS 9AM」。垃圾摇滚飞溅与铆钉细节。配色为水泥灰、安全橙、哑黑。粗犷、无借口、功能训练的坚毅。

prompt_en: A refined pilates studio promo poster for 'CORE & COMPOSURE.' A minimal line illustration of a reformer machine sits on a warm blush background, thin elegant strokes. Light modern serif reads 'STRENGTH IN STILLNESS'; a slim capsule badge notes 'INTRO OFFER — 3 CLASSES FOR $39.' Generous white space and delicate detailing. Palette of blush pink, soft taupe, deep plum type. Elegant, calm, boutique-wellness sophistication.
prompt_zh: 精致的普拉提工作室宣传海报,为「CORE & COMPOSURE」而作。一台器械床的极简线描落在暖腮红背景上,笔触纤细优雅。轻盈现代衬线写着「STRENGTH IN STILLNESS」;一枚纤长胶囊徽章注明「INTRO OFFER — 3 CLASSES FOR $39」。宽裕留白与精细细节。配色为腮红粉、柔灰褐、深梅红字。优雅、沉静、精品身心美学的精致。

prompt_en: A dynamic running-club promo poster for 'STRIDE COLLECTIVE.' A stylized runner mid-stride is composed of overlapping orange and teal motion trails against a bright dawn sky. Bold sporty italic reads 'RUN FURTHER TOGETHER'; a route-marker badge announces 'FREE SATURDAY LONG RUN — 7AM.' A small dotted map line curves below. Palette of sunrise orange, teal, sky blue, white. Motivating, communal, fresh outdoor-running vibe.
prompt_zh: 动感的跑步俱乐部宣传海报,为「STRIDE COLLECTIVE」而作。一位跨步中的风格化跑者由橙青交叠的运动拖尾构成,映衬明亮的破晓天空。粗壮运动斜体写着「RUN FURTHER TOGETHER」;一枚路标造型徽章宣布「FREE SATURDAY LONG RUN — 7AM」。下方一条小虚线地图路径弯曲。配色为日出橙、青、天蓝、白。激励、社群感、清新的户外跑步氛围。

prompt_en: A punchy grand-opening promo poster for '24 FLEX GYM.' A bold burst-ray background in electric blue radiates from a central dumbbell icon; a giant ribbon banner shouts 'NOW OPEN 24/7.' Heavy athletic caps read 'FLEX ON YOUR SCHEDULE'; a starburst badge screams 'FOUNDING MEMBERS — NO JOINING FEE.' Small terms line at the bottom. Palette of electric blue, bright yellow, white, black. Loud, promotional, high-energy launch buzz.
prompt_zh: 有冲击力的开业宣传海报,为「24 FLEX GYM」而作。电光蓝的醒目放射光条背景从中央哑铃图标射出;一条巨大丝带横幅高喊「NOW OPEN 24/7」。厚重运动大写字写着「FLEX ON YOUR SCHEDULE」;一枚星爆徽章尖叫「FOUNDING MEMBERS — NO JOINING FEE」。底部有小号条款行。配色为电光蓝、亮黄、白、黑。喧闹、促销、高能量的开业热潮。

prompt_en: A modern 'WE'RE HIRING' recruitment flyer for the invented startup 'Brightloop Studio.' A friendly flat-illustration scene of diverse abstract figures collaborating around a glowing lightbulb. Bold cheerful sans reads 'WE'RE HIRING — JOIN OUR TEAM'; role tags in rounded pills list 'Product Designer · Frontend Dev · Marketer.' A dotted arrow points to a fake QR-style square labeled 'apply here.' Palette of coral, teal, sunny yellow, white. Warm, inviting, upbeat startup culture.
prompt_zh: 现代「WE'RE HIRING」招聘传单,为虚构初创公司「Brightloop Studio」而作。一幅友好的平面插画场景:多元抽象人物围绕发光灯泡协作。粗壮欢快无衬线写着「WE'RE HIRING — JOIN OUR TEAM」;圆润药丸标签列出职位「Product Designer · Frontend Dev · Marketer」。一条虚线箭头指向标注「apply here」的仿二维码方块。配色为珊瑚、青、明黄、白。温暖、诱人、积极向上的初创文化。

prompt_en: A charming 'NOW HIRING' flyer for the fictional coffee shop 'Maple & Steam.' A hand-drawn latte cup with steam curling into the words 'JOIN THE CREW' on a warm kraft-paper background. Chalkboard-style lettering reads 'BARISTAS WANTED — PART TIME & FULL TIME.' A small tear-off strip row at the bottom shows repeated phone tabs. Palette of kraft brown, cream, sage green, espresso black. Cozy, handcrafted, neighborhood-cafe warmth.
prompt_zh: 迷人的「NOW HIRING」传单,为虚构咖啡馆「Maple & Steam」而作。一只手绘拿铁杯,蒸汽卷曲成「JOIN THE CREW」字样,置于暖牛皮纸背景。黑板风格字写着「BARISTAS WANTED — PART TIME & FULL TIME」。底部一排小号可撕电话条。配色为牛皮棕、奶油、鼠尾草绿、浓缩咖啡黑。温馨、手作、街坊咖啡馆的暖意。

prompt_en: A sleek tech recruitment poster for the invented company 'NovaGrid Labs.' A dark navy background with a subtle glowing circuit-line pattern; a bright gradient headline reads 'BUILD THE FUTURE WITH US.' Below, clean white type lists 'Now hiring engineers, data scientists, and designers.' A neon capsule badge notes 'remote-friendly · flexible hours.' A minimalist rocket icon ascends the right edge. Palette of navy, cyan, magenta gradient, white. Futuristic, professional, aspirational tech-brand tone.
prompt_zh: 时尚的科技招聘海报,为虚构公司「NovaGrid Labs」而作。深藏青背景带微妙发光电路线纹样;明亮渐变主标题写着「BUILD THE FUTURE WITH US」。下方干净白字列出「Now hiring engineers, data scientists, and designers」。一枚霓虹胶囊徽章注明「remote-friendly · flexible hours」。极简火箭图标沿右缘上升。配色为藏青、青、品红渐变、白。未来感、专业、有抱负的科技品牌调性。

prompt_en: A bright, friendly hiring flyer for the fictional boutique 'Petal & Thread.' A flat pastel illustration of a shop counter with hanging plants and folded clothes. Playful rounded lettering reads 'WE'RE LOOKING FOR YOU!'; a speech-bubble badge lists 'Weekend Sales Associates — flexible shifts, staff discount.' A cheerful arrow points to 'ask inside for details.' Palette of blush pink, mint, butter yellow, warm white. Sunny, approachable, small-boutique friendliness.
prompt_zh: 明亮友好的招聘传单,为虚构精品店「Petal & Thread」而作。一幅平面粉彩插画:挂着植物与叠放衣物的店铺柜台。俏皮圆润字写着「WE'RE LOOKING FOR YOU!」;一枚对话气泡徽章列出「Weekend Sales Associates — flexible shifts, staff discount」。一个欢快箭头指向「ask inside for details」。配色为腮红粉、薄荷、黄油黄、暖白。阳光、亲和、小精品店的友善。

prompt_en: A bold 'NOW HIRING' flyer for the invented restaurant 'Ember & Oak Kitchen.' A dramatic dark background with warm flame-orange glow; a chef's knife and whisk crossed like a crest at the top. Rustic slab-serif reads 'JOIN OUR KITCHEN BRIGADE'; a chalk-panel lists 'Line Cooks · Dishwashers · Servers wanted.' A footer notes 'walk-in interviews Mon–Thu, 2–4pm.' Palette of charcoal, ember orange, cream, deep red. Warm, appetizing, hospitality-industry energy.
prompt_zh: 醒目的「NOW HIRING」传单,为虚构餐厅「Ember & Oak Kitchen」而作。戏剧性深色背景带暖火橙光晕;顶部一把厨刀与打蛋器如徽章般交叉。质朴板衬线写着「JOIN OUR KITCHEN BRIGADE」;一块黑板面板列出「Line Cooks · Dishwashers · Servers wanted」。页脚注明「walk-in interviews Mon–Thu, 2–4pm」。配色为炭黑、余烬橙、奶油、深红。温暖、诱人、餐饮业的活力。

prompt_en: A warm community recruitment flyer for the fictional nonprofit 'Green Roots Collective.' A hopeful flat illustration of hands planting a young tree under a soft sunrise. Friendly humanist sans reads 'VOLUNTEERS WANTED — GROW WITH US.' A leaf-shaped badge lists 'weekend planting days · community garden · no experience needed.' A footer invites 'sign up at the info table.' Palette of leaf green, sky blue, warm sand, cream. Heartfelt, communal, purpose-driven positivity.
prompt_zh: 温暖的社区招募传单,为虚构公益组织「Green Roots Collective」而作。一幅充满希望的平面插画:双手在柔和日出下栽种小树。友好人文无衬线写着「VOLUNTEERS WANTED — GROW WITH US」。一枚叶形徽章列出「weekend planting days · community garden · no experience needed」。页脚邀请「sign up at the info table」。配色为叶绿、天蓝、暖沙、奶油。真挚、社群感、使命驱动的正能量。

prompt_en: A bold, design-forward hiring poster for the invented agency 'Studio Halcyon.' A big overprinted collage of overlapping geometric shapes in risograph pink and blue on off-white. Oversized condensed type reads 'WANTED: MAKERS & DREAMERS.' Below, small mono-spaced type lists 'Art Director · Copywriter · Motion Designer.' A stamped circle badge reads 'send us your best work.' Palette of riso pink, riso blue, off-white, black. Artsy, confident, creative-studio edge.
prompt_zh: 醒目、设计感十足的招聘海报,为虚构机构「Studio Halcyon」而作。米白底上一大幅叠印拼贴:里索印刷粉与蓝的交叠几何形。超大窄字写着「WANTED: MAKERS & DREAMERS」。下方小等宽字列出「Art Director · Copywriter · Motion Designer」。一枚盖章圆徽写着「send us your best work」。配色为里索粉、里索蓝、米白、黑。艺术范、自信、创意工作室的锋芒。

prompt_en: A clear, high-visibility hiring flyer for the fictional logistics firm 'PrimeMove Logistics.' A bold safety-yellow and black diagonal-stripe header shouts 'NOW HIRING.' Clean industrial sans lists 'Warehouse Associates & Forklift Operators — $22/hr starting.' Bullet points note 'weekly pay · health benefits · overtime available.' A large arrow and 'apply today' fill the bottom. Palette of safety yellow, black, white, steel grey. Direct, practical, no-nonsense industrial recruitment.
prompt_zh: 清晰、高辨识度的招工传单,为虚构物流公司「PrimeMove Logistics」而作。醒目的安全黄与黑斜条纹页眉高喊「NOW HIRING」。干净工业无衬线列出「Warehouse Associates & Forklift Operators — $22/hr starting」。要点注明「weekly pay · health benefits · overtime available」。底部一个大箭头与「apply today」。配色为安全黄、黑、白、钢灰。直接、务实、干脆利落的工业招聘。

prompt_en: A playful summer-camp recruitment flyer for the fictional 'Camp Willow Creek.' A hand-drawn scene of pine trees, a canoe on a lake, and a campfire under a starry evening sky. Bouncy varsity-style lettering reads 'CAMP COUNSELORS WANTED'; a wooden-sign badge lists 'June–August · lakeside cabins · make summer magic.' A footer notes 'applications open now.' Palette of forest green, lake blue, campfire orange, cream. Nostalgic, cheerful, outdoorsy adventure spirit.
prompt_zh: 俏皮的夏令营招募传单,为虚构的「Camp Willow Creek」而作。一幅手绘场景:松树、湖上独木舟、星空夜幕下的营火。跳动的校队风格字写着「CAMP COUNSELORS WANTED」;一枚木牌造型徽章列出「June–August · lakeside cabins · make summer magic」。页脚注明「applications open now」。配色为森林绿、湖蓝、营火橙、奶油。怀旧、欢快、户外冒险的精神。

prompt_en: An elegant hiring flyer for the fictional salon 'Vellour Hair Studio.' A luxe blush-and-gold background with a fine line-art illustration of scissors and a comb crossed like a monogram. Sophisticated modern serif reads 'JOIN OUR CHAIR — HAIRSTYLIST WANTED.' A gold-foil-look badge notes 'commission + booth rental options.' A footer invites 'portfolio drop-off welcome.' Palette of blush, champagne gold, deep charcoal, ivory. Chic, upscale, beauty-industry refinement.
prompt_zh: 优雅的招聘传单,为虚构沙龙「Vellour Hair Studio」而作。奢华腮红与金色背景,一幅精细线描:剪刀与梳子如花押字般交叉。精致现代衬线写着「JOIN OUR CHAIR — HAIRSTYLIST WANTED」。一枚仿金箔徽章注明「commission + booth rental options」。页脚邀请「portfolio drop-off welcome」。配色为腮红、香槟金、深炭、象牙。别致、高端、美业的精致。

prompt_en: A clean real-estate open-house flyer for a modern property. A bright photo-style render of a sleek two-story house with large glass windows and a manicured lawn at golden hour. Elegant sans headline reads 'OPEN HOUSE — SATURDAY 1–4PM'; a slim info bar lists '4 Bed · 3 Bath · 2,400 sq ft · $685,000.' A gold banner names the agent 'Priya Malhotra, Crestline Realty.' Palette of warm white, sage green, gold, charcoal. Polished, aspirational, upscale property marketing.
prompt_zh: 简洁的房地产开放看房传单,为一处现代住宅而作。一张明亮照片风格渲染图:金色时分,一栋带大玻璃窗与修剪草坪的时尚两层住宅。优雅无衬线主标题写着「OPEN HOUSE — SATURDAY 1–4PM」;一条纤细信息栏列出「4 Bed · 3 Bath · 2,400 sq ft · $685,000」。一条金色横幅标出经纪人「Priya Malhotra, Crestline Realty」。配色为暖白、鼠尾草绿、金、炭黑。精致、有抱负、高端的房产营销。

prompt_en: A warm real-estate open-house flyer for a charming cottage. A cozy render of a brick cottage with a red front door, flower boxes, and an autumn maple. Friendly rounded serif reads 'JUST LISTED — COME SEE IT SUNDAY.' A ribbon strip lists '3 Bed · 2 Bath · large garden · $429,000.' A round photo-badge names 'Daniel Ortiz, Hearthstone Homes.' Palette of warm brick red, cream, forest green, gold. Inviting, homey, heartfelt residential appeal.
prompt_zh: 温暖的房地产开放看房传单,为一栋迷人小屋而作。一张温馨渲染图:红色前门、花箱与秋日枫树的砖砌小屋。友好圆润衬线写着「JUST LISTED — COME SEE IT SUNDAY」。一条丝带列出「3 Bed · 2 Bath · large garden · $429,000」。一枚圆形照片徽章标出「Daniel Ortiz, Hearthstone Homes」。配色为暖砖红、奶油、森林绿、金。诱人、居家、真挚的住宅吸引力。

prompt_en: A sophisticated luxury-condo open-house flyer. A dramatic dusk render of a glass high-rise skyline with warm interior lights glowing, viewed across a reflecting pool. Refined thin serif reads 'PRIVATE VIEWING — BY APPOINTMENT.' A minimal gold-line divider precedes '2 Bed Penthouse · floor-to-ceiling views · $1.2M.' A subtle monogram names 'The Aurelian Residences.' Palette of midnight blue, warm gold, charcoal, ivory. Elegant, exclusive, premium real-estate luxury.
prompt_zh: 精致的豪华公寓开放看房传单。一张戏剧性黄昏渲染图:玻璃高层天际线,暖色室内灯光透亮,越过一池倒影望去。考究纤细衬线写着「PRIVATE VIEWING — BY APPOINTMENT」。一条极简金线分隔符引出「2 Bed Penthouse · floor-to-ceiling views · $1.2M」。一枚含蓄花押标出「The Aurelian Residences」。配色为午夜蓝、暖金、炭黑、象牙。优雅、专属、顶级的房产奢华。

prompt_en: A bright, family-friendly open-house flyer for a suburban home. A cheerful daytime render of a two-car garage house with a swing set in the backyard and a blue sky. Approachable bold sans reads 'OPEN HOUSE THIS WEEKEND!' A clean spec strip lists '4 Bed · 2.5 Bath · great school district · $549,900.' A photo-circle names 'Karen Whitfield, Bluebird Realty.' Palette of sky blue, fresh green, warm white, sunny yellow. Wholesome, welcoming, family-oriented marketing.
prompt_zh: 明亮、亲家庭的开放看房传单,为一栋郊区住宅而作。一张欢快日间渲染图:带双车库的住宅、后院秋千架、蓝天。亲和的粗无衬线写着「OPEN HOUSE THIS WEEKEND!」。一条干净规格条列出「4 Bed · 2.5 Bath · great school district · $549,900」。一个照片圆圈标出「Karen Whitfield, Bluebird Realty」。配色为天蓝、清新绿、暖白、明黄。健康、亲切、面向家庭的营销。

prompt_en: A stylish open-house flyer for an urban loft. A moody render of an exposed-brick loft with tall industrial windows, polished concrete floors, and hanging Edison bulbs. Bold uppercase condensed type reads 'LOFT LIVING — OPEN FRIDAY 5–7PM.' A thin rule precedes 'open-plan · 1,100 sq ft · $410,000.' A stamp-style badge names 'Marcus Lin, Ironworks Property Group.' Palette of warm brick, charcoal, amber light, off-white. Trendy, industrial-chic, young-urban appeal.
prompt_zh: 时尚的开放看房传单,为一处城市阁楼而作。一张氛围感渲染图:裸砖阁楼、高工业窗、抛光混凝土地面、悬挂爱迪生灯泡。醒目大写窄字写着「LOFT LIVING — OPEN FRIDAY 5–7PM」。一条细线引出「open-plan · 1,100 sq ft · $410,000」。一枚印章风格徽章标出「Marcus Lin, Ironworks Property Group」。配色为暖砖、炭黑、琥珀光、米白。潮流、工业别致、年轻都市的吸引力。

prompt_en: A breezy coastal open-house flyer for a beachfront property. A sunlit render of a white-and-teal beach house on stilts, palm trees, and turquoise ocean behind. Airy light script reads 'BEACHFRONT OPEN HOUSE — SUN 12–3.' A shell-motif divider precedes '3 Bed · ocean views · private deck · $875,000.' A soft badge names 'Sofia Reyes, Tidewater Realty.' Palette of turquoise, sandy beige, white, coral. Relaxed, sunny, dreamy coastal-lifestyle marketing.
prompt_zh: 清爽的海滨开放看房传单,为一处海滩房产而作。一张阳光渲染图:白青相间的高脚海滩别墅、棕榈树、背后绿松石海洋。通透轻盈手写体写着「BEACHFRONT OPEN HOUSE — SUN 12–3」。一个贝壳纹样分隔符引出「3 Bed · ocean views · private deck · $875,000」。一枚柔和徽章标出「Sofia Reyes, Tidewater Realty」。配色为绿松石、沙米、白、珊瑚。放松、阳光、梦幻的海滨生活方式营销。

prompt_en: A celebratory 'JUST SOLD' real-estate flyer. A crisp render of a handsome craftsman house with a bold red 'SOLD' rider clipped over a for-sale sign in the yard. Confident bold serif reads 'ANOTHER HOME SOLD!' A clean line notes 'sold in 6 days, above asking.' A round headshot-style badge names 'Elena Farrow, Summit Group Realty' with the tagline 'thinking of selling? let's talk.' Palette of crisp white, deep red, navy, gold. Proud, trustworthy, results-driven agent branding.
prompt_zh: 喜庆的「JUST SOLD」房产传单。一张清晰渲染图:一栋英俊的工匠风住宅,院中待售牌上夹着醒目的红色「SOLD」标牌。自信粗衬线写着「ANOTHER HOME SOLD!」。一行干净文字注明「sold in 6 days, above asking」。一枚圆形头像风徽章标出「Elena Farrow, Summit Group Realty」并配标语「thinking of selling? let's talk.」。配色为清爽白、深红、藏青、金。自豪、可信、结果导向的经纪人品牌。

prompt_en: A rustic open-house flyer for a mountain cabin. A warm render of a log cabin nestled among snow-dusted pines with smoke rising from the chimney at dusk. Woodsy slab-serif reads 'MOUNTAIN RETREAT — OPEN SAT.' A carved-wood divider precedes '2 Bed · wood stove · 5 acres · $335,000.' A pinecone badge names 'Jesse Blackwood, Timberline Realty.' Palette of pine green, warm log brown, snow white, amber. Cozy, escapist, rustic-getaway charm.
prompt_zh: 质朴的开放看房传单,为一栋山间木屋而作。一张温暖渲染图:黄昏时分,一栋原木小屋依偎在覆雪松林间,烟囱升起炊烟。林野板衬线写着「MOUNTAIN RETREAT — OPEN SAT」。一个雕木分隔符引出「2 Bed · wood stove · 5 acres · $335,000」。一枚松果徽章标出「Jesse Blackwood, Timberline Realty」。配色为松绿、暖原木棕、雪白、琥珀。温馨、逃离尘嚣、质朴度假的魅力。

prompt_en: A polished pre-construction real-estate flyer for a new development. A crisp architectural render of a row of modern townhomes with landscaped courtyards and clean geometric facades under a clear sky. Sleek uppercase sans reads 'NOW SELLING — PHASE ONE.' A gradient bar lists 'from the low $400s · move in spring · 12 homes remaining.' A monogram names 'The Marlowe Collection.' Palette of soft grey, sage, warm white, deep teal. Modern, aspirational, developer-grade presentation.
prompt_zh: 精致的期房房产传单,为一处新开发项目而作。一张清晰建筑渲染图:晴空下一排现代联排别墅,带景观庭院与简洁几何立面。时尚大写无衬线写着「NOW SELLING — PHASE ONE」。一条渐变栏列出「from the low $400s · move in spring · 12 homes remaining」。一枚花押标出「The Marlowe Collection」。配色为柔灰、鼠尾草、暖白、深青。现代、有抱负、开发商级别的呈现。

prompt_en: An elegant open-house flyer for a country farmhouse estate. A golden-hour render of a white farmhouse with a wraparound porch, a red barn, and rolling green pasture behind a wooden fence. Graceful serif reads 'COUNTRY ESTATE — OPEN SUNDAY.' A wheat-motif divider precedes '5 Bed · 10 acres · barn & stables · $920,000.' A crest badge names 'William Hart, Meadowlane Estates.' Palette of warm cream, barn red, meadow green, gold. Refined, pastoral, luxury-country lifestyle appeal.
prompt_zh: 优雅的开放看房传单,为一处乡村农舍庄园而作。一张金色时分渲染图:带环绕门廊的白色农舍、红色谷仓、木栅栏后起伏的绿色牧场。优美衬线写着「COUNTRY ESTATE — OPEN SUNDAY」。一个麦穗纹样分隔符引出「5 Bed · 10 acres · barn & stables · $920,000」。一枚徽章标出「William Hart, Meadowlane Estates」。配色为暖奶油、谷仓红、草地绿、金。精致、田园、奢华乡村生活方式的吸引力。

prompt_en: A vibrant restaurant menu-special flyer for 'Casa Verde Cantina.' A hand-drawn illustration of three loaded street tacos with lime wedges and cilantro on a warm terracotta background with painted folk-art borders. Bold festive display type reads 'TACO TUESDAY — $2 EACH.' A chalk panel lists 'al pastor · carnitas · grilled veggie · 5–9pm.' A sombrero-shaped badge notes 'margaritas half off.' Palette of terracotta, lime green, marigold, chili red. Lively, appetizing, festive Latin-eatery energy.
prompt_zh: 活力四射的餐厅菜品特惠传单,为「Casa Verde Cantina」而作。暖赤陶背景上一幅手绘插画:三个配青柠角与香菜的丰盛街头塔可,配民俗艺术彩绘边框。醒目喜庆展示字写着「TACO TUESDAY — $2 EACH」。一块黑板面板列出「al pastor · carnitas · grilled veggie · 5–9pm」。一枚草帽形徽章注明「margaritas half off」。配色为赤陶、青柠绿、万寿菊、辣椒红。热闹、诱人、喜庆的拉美餐馆能量。

prompt_en: A sleek restaurant menu-special flyer for 'Sakura Nine Sushi.' A minimalist dark slate background with an elegant illustration of a nigiri set and a single pink cherry blossom branch. Refined thin sans reads 'HAPPY HOUR — 4 TO 6PM.' A clean list shows 'select rolls $6 · sake flight $12 · edamame free.' A brush-stroke badge notes 'weekdays only.' Palette of slate black, salmon pink, seaweed green, gold. Elegant, minimal, upscale-Japanese refinement.
prompt_zh: 时尚的餐厅菜品特惠传单,为「Sakura Nine Sushi」而作。极简深石板背景上一幅优雅插画:一套握寿司与一枝粉樱。考究纤细无衬线写着「HAPPY HOUR — 4 TO 6PM」。干净列表显示「select rolls $6 · sake flight $12 · edamame free」。一枚笔触徽章注明「weekdays only」。配色为石板黑、三文鱼粉、海苔绿、金。优雅、极简、高端日式的精致。

prompt_en: A fun restaurant menu-special flyer for 'Nonna's Wood-Fired Pizza.' A mouthwatering top-down illustration of a bubbling margherita pizza with fresh basil on a checkered red-and-white tablecloth. Chunky retro script reads 'FAMILY NIGHT DEAL.' A bright starburst shouts 'LARGE PIZZA + 2 SIDES — $24.99.' A small list notes 'garlic knots · house salad · every Wednesday.' Palette of tomato red, cream, basil green, mozzarella white. Warm, hearty, family-pizzeria comfort.
prompt_zh: 有趣的餐厅菜品特惠传单,为「Nonna's Wood-Fired Pizza」而作。红白格子桌布上一幅诱人俯拍插画:冒着热气、点缀新鲜罗勒的玛格丽特披萨。粗壮复古手写体写着「FAMILY NIGHT DEAL」。一个亮星爆高喊「LARGE PIZZA + 2 SIDES — $24.99」。小列表注明「garlic knots · house salad · every Wednesday」。配色为番茄红、奶油、罗勒绿、马苏里拉白。温暖、丰盛、家庭披萨店的慰藉。

prompt_en: A charming restaurant brunch-special flyer for 'The Copper Spoon.' A soft watercolor illustration of pancakes with berries, a poached egg on toast, and a latte on a pastel peach background. Elegant handwritten script reads 'WEEKEND BRUNCH.' A tidy menu lists 'buttermilk stack $9 · avocado toast $11 · bottomless mimosas $15 · Sat & Sun 9–2.' A small sprig badge decorates the corner. Palette of peach, sage, cream, soft gold. Cozy, delightful, artisan-cafe brunch charm.
prompt_zh: 迷人的餐厅早午餐特惠传单,为「The Copper Spoon」而作。淡粉桃背景上一幅柔和水彩插画:配莓果的松饼、吐司上的水波蛋、一杯拿铁。优雅手写体写着「WEEKEND BRUNCH」。整齐菜单列出「buttermilk stack $9 · avocado toast $11 · bottomless mimosas $15 · Sat & Sun 9–2」。一枚小枝叶徽章点缀角落。配色为桃、鼠尾草、奶油、柔金。温馨、愉悦、手作咖啡馆的早午餐魅力。

prompt_en: A bold restaurant menu-special flyer for 'Grind House Burgers.' A juicy illustrated double cheeseburger with dripping cheese and crispy fries on a gritty dark background with halftone accents. Heavy impact type shouts 'BURGER COMBO BLOWOUT.' A price flash reads 'DOUBLE + FRIES + SHAKE — $12.' A ticket badge notes 'daily till 10pm.' Palette of charcoal, mustard yellow, ketchup red, cream. Loud, craveable, gritty street-food energy.
prompt_zh: 醒目的餐厅菜品特惠传单,为「Grind House Burgers」而作。粗粝深色背景配半调点缀,一幅多汁插画:流淌芝士的双层芝士汉堡与酥脆薯条。厚重冲击字高喊「BURGER COMBO BLOWOUT」。一个价格闪标写着「DOUBLE + FRIES + SHAKE — $12」。一枚票券徽章注明「daily till 10pm」。配色为炭黑、芥末黄、番茄酱红、奶油。喧闹、令人垂涎、粗粝的街头美食能量。

prompt_en: An atmospheric restaurant menu-special flyer for 'Midnight Bowl Ramen.' A steamy illustration of a rich tonkotsu ramen bowl with soft egg, nori, and scallions, rising steam curling upward against a deep indigo background with red lantern glow. Bold brush-style caps read 'RAMEN NIGHT.' A list shows 'signature bowl $11 · gyoza $5 · Fri & Sat till late.' A lantern badge glows in the corner. Palette of indigo, lantern red, warm cream, gold. Moody, comforting, late-night noodle-bar vibe.
prompt_zh: 氛围感十足的餐厅菜品特惠传单,为「Midnight Bowl Ramen」而作。深靛蓝背景配红灯笼光晕,一幅热气腾腾的插画:浓郁豚骨拉面配溏心蛋、海苔、葱花,蒸汽向上卷起。醒目毛笔风大写字写着「RAMEN NIGHT」。列表显示「signature bowl $11 · gyoza $5 · Fri & Sat till late」。一枚灯笼徽章在角落发光。配色为靛蓝、灯笼红、暖奶油、金。氛围感、慰藉、深夜面馆的调性。

prompt_en: A festive restaurant menu-special flyer for 'Bayou Shell Shack.' A vibrant illustration of a Cajun seafood boil — crab, shrimp, corn, and sausage spilled on newspaper — on a rustic wood background. Bold cajun-style display type reads 'SEAFOOD BOIL FRIDAYS.' A pot-shaped badge shouts 'ALL YOU CAN EAT — $29.' A list notes 'crab · shrimp · crawfish · Fri 5–10pm.' Palette of boil red, corn yellow, rustic brown, sea green. Hearty, festive, southern-comfort feast energy.
prompt_zh: 喜庆的餐厅菜品特惠传单,为「Bayou Shell Shack」而作。质朴木背景上一幅活力插画:卡真海鲜煮——蟹、虾、玉米、香肠散铺在报纸上。醒目卡真风格展示字写着「SEAFOOD BOIL FRIDAYS」。一枚锅形徽章高喊「ALL YOU CAN EAT — $29」。列表注明「crab · shrimp · crawfish · Fri 5–10pm」。配色为水煮红、玉米黄、质朴棕、海绿。丰盛、喜庆、南方慰藉盛宴的能量。

prompt_en: A sweet restaurant menu-special flyer for 'Velvet & Sugar Dessert Bar.' A delicate illustration of a tiered cake, macarons, and a swirl of gelato on a soft pastel-pink background with gold flecks. Elegant flowing script reads 'SWEET HOUR.' A dainty list shows 'macaron trio $6 · lava cake $8 · gelato scoop $4 · daily 2–5pm.' A tiny bow badge decorates the corner. Palette of pastel pink, mint, cream, champagne gold. Dainty, indulgent, boutique-patisserie sweetness.
prompt_zh: 甜蜜的餐厅菜品特惠传单,为「Velvet & Sugar Dessert Bar」而作。柔粉彩背景带金箔点,一幅精致插画:多层蛋糕、马卡龙、一卷意式冰淇淋。优雅流畅手写体写着「SWEET HOUR」。精致列表显示「macaron trio $6 · lava cake $8 · gelato scoop $4 · daily 2–5pm」。一枚小蝴蝶结徽章点缀角落。配色为粉彩粉、薄荷、奶油、香槟金。精致、纵享、精品甜点店的甜美。

prompt_en: A warm restaurant lunch-special flyer for 'Golden Turmeric Curry House.' A rich illustration of a thali platter — curry, rice, naan, and chutneys — with warm spice-toned patterns bordering a deep saffron background. Ornate display type reads 'LUNCH THALI SPECIAL.' A mandala badge shows '$10 — WEEKDAYS 11–3.' A list notes 'butter chicken · dal · veg curry · fresh naan.' Palette of saffron, deep red, turmeric gold, cream. Warm, aromatic, richly-spiced South-Asian appeal.
prompt_zh: 温暖的餐厅午市特惠传单,为「Golden Turmeric Curry House」而作。深藏红花背景配暖香料色调纹样边框,一幅丰盛插画:塔利拼盘——咖喱、米饭、印度飞饼、酸辣酱。华丽展示字写着「LUNCH THALI SPECIAL」。一枚曼陀罗徽章显示「$10 — WEEKDAYS 11–3」。列表注明「butter chicken · dal · veg curry · fresh naan」。配色为藏红花、深红、姜黄金、奶油。温暖、芳香、浓郁香料的南亚风情。

prompt_en: A cozy cafe menu-special flyer for 'The Daily Grind Cafe.' A warm hand-drawn illustration of a flat white with latte art and a flaky croissant on a rustic kraft-paper background. Friendly chalkboard lettering reads 'MORNING COMBO.' A stamp badge shows 'COFFEE + CROISSANT — $6.' A tidy note lists 'every morning till 11am · add pastry $2.' A small coffee-bean border frames the edge. Palette of kraft brown, cream, muted teal, espresso. Cozy, wholesome, neighborhood-cafe warmth.
prompt_zh: 温馨的咖啡馆菜品特惠传单,为「The Daily Grind Cafe」而作。质朴牛皮纸背景上一幅温暖手绘插画:带拉花的馥芮白与酥脆牛角包。友好黑板字写着「MORNING COMBO」。一枚印章徽章显示「COFFEE + CROISSANT — $6」。整齐提示列出「every morning till 11am · add pastry $2」。一圈小咖啡豆边框环绕。配色为牛皮棕、奶油、柔青、浓缩咖啡。温馨、健康、街坊咖啡馆的暖意。

prompt_en: A clean flat-design infographic titled 'Global Coffee Consumption 2015-2024', 4:5 portrait. A single hero line chart fills the upper two-thirds, plotting cups per capita rising from 2.1 to 3.4 over ten years with a smooth mint-green line, soft gradient fill beneath, and circular data markers labeled at 2020 (2.7) and 2024 (3.4). Thin grey axis grid, sans-serif labels. Three stat chips below read '+62% growth', '78 countries', '2.1B cups/day'. Warm cream background, coffee-brown headline, generous white space, modern editorial style.
prompt_zh: 干净扁平风信息图,标题《全球咖啡消费 2015-2024》,4:5竖版。上方三分之二是一张主视觉折线图,人均杯数十年间从2.1平滑升到3.4,薄荷绿曲线配下方柔和渐变填充,圆形数据点在2020(2.7)与2024(3.4)处标出数值。细灰色坐标网格、无衬线标签。下方三枚数据小卡:'增长62%''78个国家''每日20亿杯'。米白背景、咖啡棕标题、大面积留白,现代杂志编排风。

prompt_en: A flat vector infographic, 2:3 portrait, titled 'Share of Renewable Electricity, 2024'. A horizontal bar chart lists eight invented countries (Nordheim 71%, Valcoria 63%, Sunnara 58%, Tereska 49%, Mora 41%, Delphia 33%, Kestral 27%, Auland 19%), each bar a teal-to-lime gradient with the percentage in bold white inside. Small circular country flag icons sit at each row's left. Header band in deep navy, light grey background, a footnote 'Source: Global Energy Panel'. Balanced grid, crisp typography, plenty of margin.
prompt_zh: 扁平矢量信息图,2:3竖版,标题《2024年可再生能源发电占比》。横向条形图列出八个虚构国家(诺德海姆71%、瓦尔科里亚63%、桑纳拉58%、特蕾斯卡49%、莫拉41%、德尔菲亚33%、凯斯特拉27%、奥兰19%),每根条采用青到黄绿渐变,百分比以粗体白字压在条内。每行左侧配圆形小国旗图标。深藏青标题栏、浅灰背景,脚注'来源:全球能源观察'。网格平衡、字体清爽、留白充足。

prompt_en: A minimalist infographic, 4:5, titled 'Where a Household Budget Goes'. A large centered donut chart splits monthly spending into six segments: Housing 32% (slate blue), Food 21% (coral), Transport 14% (amber), Savings 12% (green), Utilities 11% (teal), Fun 10% (violet). The donut's hollow center shows total '$4,200 / month'. A neat legend with color dots and labels sits to the right. Soft off-white background, thin dividing lines, rounded sans-serif type, subtle drop shadow under the donut, tidy modern layout.
prompt_zh: 极简信息图,4:5,标题《家庭预算都花在哪》。画面居中一张大环形图,把月支出分成六块:住房32%(石板蓝)、饮食21%(珊瑚)、交通14%(琥珀)、储蓄12%(绿)、水电11%(青)、娱乐10%(紫)。圆环中心留白处写总额'每月4200美元'。右侧是配色点加标签的整齐图例。柔白背景、细分隔线、圆润无衬线字体,环形下方带淡淡投影,整洁现代排版。

prompt_en: An educational infographic, 2:3 portrait, titled 'Age Structure of Meridian City, 2025'. A back-to-back population pyramid: male bars in cool blue on the left, female bars in warm rose on the right, stacked in 5-year age bands from 0-4 up to 85+. Widest bars sit at 25-39, tapering at the top. Percentage axis labeled at each side, thin centered age labels. Below, three summary stats: 'Median age 34', 'Total 1.8M', 'Under 15: 18%'. Clean white background, flat design, restrained two-color palette.
prompt_zh: 科普信息图,2:3竖版,标题《子午城 2025 年龄结构》。一张背靠背人口金字塔:左侧男性用冷蓝、右侧女性用暖玫红,按每5岁一档从0-4叠到85岁以上。25-39档最宽,越往顶越窄。两侧标注百分比刻度,中间是细体年龄标签。下方三条汇总:'中位年龄34''总人口180万''15岁以下18%'。纯白背景、扁平设计、克制的双色系。

name_zh: 学习时长与成绩散点图
prompt_en: A data infographic, 4:5, titled 'Study Time vs Exam Score'. A scatter plot dominates: roughly 40 dots scattered upward-right, each a small teal circle, with a dashed orange trend line rising through them and a label 'r = 0.71'. X-axis 'Weekly study hours (0-20)', Y-axis 'Score (0-100)', light grid. A highlighted cluster near the top-right is circled with a callout 'high effort, high score'. Header on a mustard band, pale grey plot background, clean sans-serif, small legend explaining dot size equals class section.
prompt_zh: 数据信息图,4:5,标题《学习时长 vs 考试成绩》。主体是一张散点图:约40个青色小圆点向右上方分布,一条橙色虚线趋势线穿过,标注'r = 0.71'。X轴'每周学习小时(0-20)',Y轴'分数(0-100)',浅网格。右上一簇点被圈出并引出说明'投入高、分数高'。芥末黄标题栏、淡灰绘图区、清爽无衬线,小图例说明点大小代表班级。

name_zh: 流媒体订阅增长面积图
prompt_en: A modern infographic, 9:16 vertical, titled 'Streaming Subscribers Keep Climbing'. A layered area chart shows three invented services stacking: StreamNest (bottom, indigo), PixelPlay (middle, magenta), LumaTV (top, cyan), total climbing from 40M in 2019 to 210M in 2025. Smooth curves with soft transparency, year labels along the base, a single annotation arrow marking '2022 price cut'. Big top headline, a right-column mini legend, and a bottom ribbon with '+425% in 6 years'. Dark charcoal background, neon accent lines, glowing edges, sleek tech aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 现代信息图,9:16竖版,标题《流媒体订阅一路走高》。分层面积图叠出三个虚构平台:StreamNest(底层,靛蓝)、PixelPlay(中层,品红)、LumaTV(顶层,青),总量从2019年的4000万升到2025年的2.1亿。曲线顺滑带半透明,底部标年份,一支注释箭头标出'2022年降价'。顶部大标题,右栏迷你图例,底部色带写'6年增长425%'。深炭黑背景、霓虹强调线、发光边缘,利落科技美学。

prompt_en: A flat infographic, 4:5, titled 'How the City Commutes, by Year'. A vertical stacked bar chart with five bars (2021-2025), each divided into Car (grey), Bus (blue), Bike (green), Walk (yellow), Rail (purple). Over the years the grey car segment shrinks from 54% to 39% while green bike grows from 6% to 17%. Percentage labels inside each segment, a tidy legend row at the bottom with transport icons. Soft mint background, rounded bar corners, clean geometric sans type, subtle grid lines behind bars.
prompt_zh: 扁平信息图,4:5,标题《城市通勤方式逐年变化》。纵向堆叠条形图共五根(2021-2025),每根分为小汽车(灰)、公交(蓝)、自行车(绿)、步行(黄)、轨道(紫)。逐年灰色小汽车段从54%缩到39%,绿色自行车段从6%涨到17%。每段内标百分比,底部一行整齐图例配交通图标。柔薄荷绿背景、条角圆润、几何无衬线字体,条形后有淡淡网格。

prompt_en: A health infographic, 2:3, titled 'How Many Steps Do People Really Take?'. A histogram of daily step counts across 12 buckets from 0 to 24,000, bars in a coral-to-teal gradient, the tallest bar peaking around the 6,000-8,000 range. A dashed vertical line marks the '10,000 goal' with 31% of people beyond it shaded darker. X-axis step buckets, Y-axis 'share of people', light grid. Three highlight chips: 'Median 7,400', 'Goal reached 31%', 'Sample 12,000'. White background, flat, friendly rounded type.
prompt_zh: 健康信息图,2:3,标题《人们每天到底走多少步》。一张每日步数直方图,横向12个区间从0到24000,条形采用珊瑚到青的渐变,最高峰落在6000-8000区间。一条竖直虚线标出'10000步目标',超过目标的31%人群区段用更深色。X轴步数区间,Y轴'人群占比',浅网格。三枚高亮小卡:'中位7400''达标31%''样本1.2万'。白背景、扁平、友好圆润字体。

prompt_en: A weather infographic, 4:5, titled 'Rainfall & Temperature: Rivendale, One Year'. A combo chart: twelve blue bars for monthly rainfall (mm) peaking at 190 in July, plus an overlaid orange line for average temperature curving from 4C in January to 26C in July. Dual axes (mm left, C right), month abbreviations along the base, faint grid. A small legend distinguishes 'Rainfall' and 'Avg Temp'. Pale sky-blue header band, clean white plot, rounded sans-serif, tidy educational layout with a raindrop and sun motif in corners.
prompt_zh: 气象信息图,4:5,标题《里文戴尔全年降雨与气温》。组合图:12根蓝色柱表示月降雨量(毫米),7月最高达190;叠加一条橙色折线表示平均气温,从1月的4℃弯升到7月的26℃。左右双轴(左毫米、右摄氏度),底部月份缩写,淡网格。小图例区分'降雨'与'平均气温'。天蓝色标题栏、纯白绘图区、圆润无衬线,教学式整洁排版,四角点缀雨滴与太阳图案。

prompt_en: A tech infographic, 4:5, titled 'Full-Stack Skill Profile'. A hexagonal radar chart with six axes: Frontend, Backend, Databases, DevOps, Testing, Design, scored 0-10. A translucent purple polygon connects values (Frontend 9, Backend 8, Databases 7, DevOps 5, Testing 6, Design 4), vertices marked with dots and numeric labels. Concentric grid rings in light grey, axis labels in bold. Below, three progress mini-bars for 'React', 'Node', 'SQL'. Dark slate background, neon-violet accents, thin glowing lines, modern portfolio-card aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 技术信息图,4:5,标题《全栈技能画像》。一张六轴六边形雷达图:前端、后端、数据库、运维、测试、设计,评分0-10。半透明紫色多边形连接各值(前端9、后端8、数据库7、运维5、测试6、设计4),顶点带圆点与数字标注。浅灰同心网格环,轴标签用粗体。下方三条迷你进度条:'React''Node''SQL'。深石板背景、霓虹紫强调、细发光线条,现代作品卡片风。

prompt_en: A product comparison infographic, 4:5, titled 'Flagship Phones Compared'. A three-column table for invented brands: Vela X9, Kestrel Pro, Orbita 12. Rows list Display (6.7in vs 6.5in vs 6.8in), Chip (V-Core 3 vs K8 vs Orbit-X), Camera (50MP vs 48MP vs 108MP), Battery (5000 vs 4600 vs 5200 mAh), Price ($899 vs $799 vs $999). The middle column is highlighted as 'Best Value' with a green ribbon. Alternating light-grey row bands, small check and cross icons, product silhouettes at column tops. Clean white, bold header row, crisp sans-serif.
prompt_zh: 产品对比信息图,4:5,标题《旗舰手机横评》。三列表格,虚构品牌:Vela X9、Kestrel Pro、Orbita 12。行项包括屏幕(6.7英寸 vs 6.5英寸 vs 6.8英寸)、芯片(V-Core 3 vs K8 vs Orbit-X)、相机(5000万 vs 4800万 vs 1.08亿像素)、电池(5000 vs 4600 vs 5200 mAh)、价格(899 vs 799 vs 999美元)。中间列以绿色缎带标为'最超值'。行间浅灰交替底色,配对勾叉小图标,列顶放手机剪影。纯白背景、粗体表头、清爽无衬线。

prompt_en: A spec-comparison infographic, 2:3, titled 'Ultrabook Spec Showdown'. Three laptop cards side by side for invented brands AeroBook Air, NovaSlim 14, ZephyrEdge. Each card shows a top-down laptop illustration, then a spec stack: weight (1.1 vs 1.3 vs 1.2 kg), RAM (16 vs 32 vs 16 GB), storage (512GB vs 1TB vs 512GB), battery life (14 vs 11 vs 16 hrs), price ($1,199 vs $1,499 vs $1,099). Star ratings under each. Middle card sits raised with a 'Editor's Pick' tag. Soft gradient background from lavender to white, rounded cards, subtle shadows, clean modern UI style.
prompt_zh: 参数对比信息图,2:3,标题《轻薄本参数对决》。三张笔记本卡并排,虚构品牌AeroBook Air、NovaSlim 14、ZephyrEdge。每张卡顶部是俯视笔记本插画,下面是参数栈:重量(1.1 vs 1.3 vs 1.2 公斤)、内存(16 vs 32 vs 16 GB)、存储(512GB vs 1TB vs 512GB)、续航(14 vs 11 vs 16 小时)、价格(1199 vs 1499 vs 1099美元),卡底配星级评分。中间卡略微抬高,带'编辑推荐'标签。薰衣草到白的柔和渐变背景、圆角卡片、淡投影,清爽现代UI风。

prompt_en: A vehicle comparison infographic, 4:5, titled 'Electric SUVs Head to Head'. A four-column table for invented EVs: Volt Ridge, Aurora E7, Terra Volt, Comet EX. Side-profile car illustrations top each column in matching accent colors. Rows: Range (410 vs 380 vs 450 vs 340 mi), 0-60 (4.9 vs 5.6 vs 5.1 vs 6.8 s), Charge to 80% (28 vs 35 vs 25 vs 40 min), Seats (5 vs 7 vs 5 vs 5), Price ($52k vs $61k vs $58k vs $44k). Best-in-row values glow with a small trophy icon. Clean white background, electric-blue and green palette, bold headers, sharp modern typography.
prompt_zh: 车辆对比信息图,4:5,标题《电动SUV正面对决》。四列表格,虚构车型:Volt Ridge、Aurora E7、Terra Volt、Comet EX。每列顶部是同色系侧面车身插画。行项:续航(410 vs 380 vs 450 vs 340 英里)、0-60加速(4.9 vs 5.6 vs 5.1 vs 6.8 秒)、充至80%(28 vs 35 vs 25 vs 40 分钟)、座位(5 vs 7 vs 5 vs 5)、价格(5.2万 vs 6.1万 vs 5.8万 vs 4.4万美元)。每行最优值发光并配小奖杯图标。纯白背景、电光蓝与绿配色、粗体表头、锐利现代字体。

prompt_en: A kitchen-gadget comparison infographic, 2:3, titled 'Home Espresso Machines Compared'. Three tall columns for invented brands: CremaOne, BaristaPro M2, SteamCraft. Each has a flat illustration of the machine and a feature grid: pressure (15 vs 9 vs 20 bar), water tank (1.4 vs 2.0 vs 1.8 L), milk frother (yes/manual/auto), warm-up (25 vs 45 vs 18 s), price ($229 vs $349 vs $459). Feature checkmarks in green, missing features in soft grey. Warm caramel-and-cream palette, coffee-bean corner motifs, rounded cards, cozy modern kitchen aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 厨房家电对比信息图,2:3,标题《家用意式咖啡机横评》。三列高卡,虚构品牌:CremaOne、BaristaPro M2、SteamCraft。每列有咖啡机扁平插画和功能表:压力(15 vs 9 vs 20 bar)、水箱(1.4 vs 2.0 vs 1.8 升)、奶泡(有/手动/自动)、预热(25 vs 45 vs 18 秒)、价格(229 vs 349 vs 459美元)。功能齐全打绿勾,缺失项浅灰。焦糖奶油暖色系、四角咖啡豆点缀、圆角卡片,温馨现代厨房美学。

prompt_en: A gadget comparison infographic, 4:5, titled 'Robot Vacuum Feature Matrix'. A checkbox matrix table: rows are features (LiDAR mapping, mop function, auto-empty dock, obstacle avoidance, app control, 3hr runtime), columns are invented models SweepBot S1, PureGlide 3, NimbusClean X. Cells filled with green check circles or grey dashes; SweepBot has the most greens and a corner 'Top Rated' badge. Top-down robot vacuum icons head each column. Light grey background, teal accent header, rounded table cells, clean minimalist tech style.
prompt_zh: 数码对比信息图,4:5,标题《扫地机器人功能矩阵》。一张打勾矩阵表:行为功能(激光雷达建图、拖地、自动集尘座、避障、App控制、3小时续航),列为虚构型号SweepBot S1、PureGlide 3、NimbusClean X。单元格填绿色对勾圆圈或灰色横线;SweepBot绿勾最多并带角标'最佳评分'。每列顶部是俯视扫地机图标。浅灰背景、青色标题栏、圆角单元格,简约科技风。

prompt_en: An audio comparison infographic, 2:3, titled 'Noise-Cancelling Headphones Compared'. Three product cards for invented brands: SonicVeil Q, AuraWave Pro, EchoNest 900. Each card shows a headphone illustration and specs: battery (32 vs 40 vs 28 hrs), ANC depth (rated 8.5 vs 9.2 vs 7.8 /10), weight (250 vs 270 vs 240 g), Bluetooth (5.3 vs 5.4 vs 5.2), price ($279 vs $349 vs $199). A tiny horizontal bar visualizes each ANC score. Middle card marked 'Best ANC'. Deep indigo-to-purple gradient background, glossy cards, white text, premium tech vibe.
prompt_zh: 音频对比信息图,2:3,标题《降噪耳机横评》。三张产品卡,虚构品牌:SonicVeil Q、AuraWave Pro、EchoNest 900。每卡有耳机插画和参数:续航(32 vs 40 vs 28 小时)、降噪深度(评分8.5 vs 9.2 vs 7.8 /10)、重量(250 vs 270 vs 240 克)、蓝牙(5.3 vs 5.4 vs 5.2)、价格(279 vs 349 vs 199美元)。每项降噪分用小横条可视化。中间卡标'最佳降噪'。靛蓝到紫渐变背景、光泽卡片、白字,高端科技感。

prompt_en: A wearable comparison infographic, 4:5, titled 'Fitness Trackers Face-Off'. A clean three-column table for invented bands: PulseBand Lite, VitaFit 2, StriveOne Max. Rows: battery (7 vs 10 vs 5 days), heart-rate accuracy (rated 8 vs 9 vs 9.5), GPS (no/yes/yes), water resistance (5ATM vs 3ATM vs 10ATM), sleep tracking (basic/advanced/advanced), price ($59 vs $99 vs $149). Small watch-face icons top each column. Green checks and grey dashes for yes/no rows. Mint-and-white palette, rounded corners, energetic coral accent header, friendly modern style.
prompt_zh: 可穿戴对比信息图,4:5,标题《运动手环对决》。清爽三列表格,虚构品牌:PulseBand Lite、VitaFit 2、StriveOne Max。行项:续航(7 vs 10 vs 5 天)、心率精度(评分8 vs 9 vs 9.5)、GPS(无/有/有)、防水(5ATM vs 3ATM vs 10ATM)、睡眠监测(基础/进阶/进阶)、价格(59 vs 99 vs 149美元)。每列顶部是表盘小图标。是/否行用绿勾灰横线。薄荷加白配色、圆角、活力珊瑚标题栏,亲切现代风。

name_zh: 通勤电助力自行车对比
prompt_en: An e-bike comparison infographic, 2:3, titled 'Commuter E-Bikes Compared'. Three columns for invented brands GlideCycle C1, UrbanVolt Step, FernRide Pro, each topped with a side-view bike illustration. Rows: range (45 vs 60 vs 55 mi), motor (250 vs 500 vs 350 W), weight (22 vs 26 vs 24 kg), fold (yes/no/yes), top speed (20 vs 28 vs 25 mph), price ($1,199 vs $1,799 vs $1,499). Best value per row circled in leaf-green. Warm off-white background, earthy green and slate palette, rounded cards, eco-modern flat illustration style.
prompt_zh: 电助力车对比信息图,2:3,标题《通勤电助力车横评》。三列,虚构品牌GlideCycle C1、UrbanVolt Step、FernRide Pro,每列顶部是侧视整车插画。行项:续航(45 vs 60 vs 55 英里)、电机(250 vs 500 vs 350 W)、重量(22 vs 26 vs 24 公斤)、可折叠(可/否/可)、最高时速(20 vs 28 vs 25 mph)、价格(1199 vs 1799 vs 1499美元)。每行最优值用叶绿色圈出。暖白背景、大地绿与石板灰配色、圆角卡片,环保现代扁平插画风。

prompt_en: A camera comparison infographic, 4:5, titled 'Mirrorless Cameras for Creators'. Three columns for invented models: Lumira Z6, FocalPoint A2, ClarusMark IV. Each with a front-view camera illustration. Rows: sensor (24 vs 33 vs 45 MP), video (4K60 vs 4K30 vs 8K30), stabilization (5-axis vs none vs 5-axis), burst (11 vs 8 vs 20 fps), weight (486 vs 520 vs 658 g), price ($1,399 vs $999 vs $2,299). A small radar-style icon rates 'photo' vs 'video' strength. Charcoal header, clean white body, orange accent highlights, sharp editorial layout.
prompt_zh: 相机对比信息图,4:5,标题《创作者微单横评》。三列,虚构型号:Lumira Z6、FocalPoint A2、ClarusMark IV,每列配正面相机插画。行项:传感器(2400 vs 3300 vs 4500 万像素)、视频(4K60 vs 4K30 vs 8K30)、防抖(五轴/无/五轴)、连拍(11 vs 8 vs 20 fps)、重量(486 vs 520 vs 658 克)、价格(1399 vs 999 vs 2299美元)。用小雷达图标评'拍照'与'视频'侧重。炭灰标题栏、纯白正文、橙色高亮,锐利编辑排版。

prompt_en: An appliance comparison infographic, 2:3, titled 'Air Purifiers for Every Room'. Three cards for invented brands: PureAir Mini, FreshVault 300, CleanBreeze Max. Each shows a purifier illustration and specs: coverage (250 vs 500 vs 800 sq ft), CADR (150 vs 300 vs 450), filter type (HEPA vs HEPA+carbon vs HEPA+carbon+UV), noise (48 vs 52 vs 55 dB), price ($119 vs $229 vs $349). A small leaf-scaled bar shows relative coverage. Fresh mint-green and white palette, soft rounded cards, floating airflow swirl motifs, calm clean-air aesthetic.
