prompt_zh: DIY教程信息图,2:3,标题《搭建抬高花圃》。六个纵向步骤配等距插画:1 划出4x8英尺区域,2 裁切并拼装雪松木板,3 把四角拧到立柱上,4 底部铺纸板,5 填入土壤堆肥混合物,6 种苗并覆盖。侧边工具材料栏列出木板、螺丝、电钻、土壤、手套。暖木棕与绿叶配色、蓝图式虚线尺寸标注、圆角面板,亲切实操的园艺项目美学,粗体清爽标题。

prompt_en: A checklist infographic, 9:16, titled 'Moving Day Checklist'. A tall list of 10 rounded checkbox rows grouped in three sections: Before (confirm movers, label boxes, forward mail), During (photo of meters, first-night bag, check every room), After (test utilities, update address, unpack essentials). Each item has a green check circle and a small line icon. A progress bar at top shows '7 of 10 done'. Fresh teal-and-white palette, cardboard-box motifs in corners, rounded cards, friendly organized modern planner aesthetic, clean sans-serif.
prompt_zh: 清单信息图,9:16,标题《搬家日清单》。一列高高的10行圆角复选框,分三段:搬家前(确认搬家公司、给箱子贴标签、办理邮件转寄)、搬家中(拍抄水电表、准备第一晚应急包、逐间检查)、搬家后(测试水电、更新地址、拆开必需品)。每项配绿色对勾圆圈和线描小图标。顶部进度条显示'已完成7/10'。清新青绿加白配色、四角纸箱点缀、圆角卡片,亲切有条理的现代规划美学,清爽无衬线。

prompt_en: A checklist infographic, 4:5, titled 'Weekend Trip Packing List'. An open-suitcase layout divided into four labeled compartments: Clothes (3 tops, 1 jacket, socks), Toiletries (toothbrush, sunscreen, mini shampoo), Tech (charger, power bank, earbuds), Documents (ID, tickets, cash). Each item is a small flat icon with a checkbox, some ticked green. A luggage-tag header and a 'don't forget!' sticky note in the corner. Sunny coral, turquoise, and cream palette, rounded icons, playful travel-doodle aesthetic, cheerful clean modern layout.
prompt_zh: 清单信息图,4:5,标题《周末出行打包清单》。以打开的行李箱为版式,分四个带标签的隔层:衣物(3件上衣、1件外套、袜子)、洗漱(牙刷、防晒、迷你洗发水)、数码(充电器、充电宝、耳机)、证件(身份证、机票、现金)。每项是带复选框的扁平小图标,部分打绿勾。行李牌样式标题,角落一张'别忘了!'便利贴。阳光珊瑚、绿松石与米白配色、圆角图标,俏皮旅行涂鸦美学,欢快清爽的现代排版。

prompt_en: A tips infographic, 2:3, titled '7 Habits for a Productive Morning'. Seven numbered tip cards stacked vertically, each with a flat icon and a short line: 1 Wake at a fixed time, 2 Drink a glass of water, 3 No phone for 30 minutes, 4 Move your body 10 min, 5 Write your top 3 tasks, 6 Eat a protein breakfast, 7 Start the hardest task first. Numbered sun-shaped badges, a rising-sun gradient header. Warm sunrise palette of peach, gold, and soft blue, rounded cards, uplifting friendly self-improvement aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 贴士信息图,2:3,标题《高效晨间的7个习惯》。七张编号贴士卡纵向堆叠,每张配扁平图标和一句话:1 固定时间起床,2 先喝一杯水,3 30分钟内不碰手机,4 活动身体10分钟,5 写下当天最重要的3件事,6 吃高蛋白早餐,7 先做最难的任务。太阳形编号徽章,日出渐变标题栏。暖日出配色(桃、金、柔蓝)、圆角卡片,积极亲切的自我提升美学。

prompt_en: A security tips infographic, 4:5, titled '8 Ways to Secure Your Home Network'. Eight rounded tip tiles in a 2x4 grid, each with a shield-themed line icon and short text: use unique passwords, enable two-factor, update router firmware, hide your SSID, set up a guest network, encrypt with WPA3, back up weekly, beware phishing links. A padlock header emblem and a small 'stay safe' footer. Cool cyber palette of deep navy, electric teal, and white, glowing icons, rounded tiles, clean confident tech-security aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 安全贴士信息图,4:5,标题《守护家庭网络的8个方法》。八块圆角贴士砖排成2x4网格,每块配盾牌主题线描图标和短句:使用独立密码、开启双重验证、更新路由固件、隐藏SSID、设立访客网络、用WPA3加密、每周备份、警惕钓鱼链接。挂锁标题徽标,页脚小字'保持安全'。冷调网络配色(深藏青、电光青、白)、发光图标、圆角砖块,清爽自信的科技安全美学。

prompt_en: A pet checklist infographic, 9:16, titled 'New Puppy Starter Checklist'. A vertical list grouped into Gear (crate, bed, collar, leash, bowls), Health (vet visit, vaccines, microchip), Daily (food, treats, potty pads, chew toys). Each item has a paw-print checkbox, some ticked. A cute puppy illustration peeks at the top and a bone-shaped progress bar shows '9 of 14 ready'. Warm cream and soft caramel palette, playful paw and bone doodles, rounded cards, adorable friendly pet-care aesthetic, bubbly rounded headings.
prompt_zh: 宠物清单信息图,9:16,标题《新养幼犬入门清单》。纵向列表分为用品(航空箱、狗窝、项圈、牵引绳、食碗)、健康(看兽医、疫苗、植芯片)、日常(狗粮、零食、尿垫、磨牙玩具)。每项是爪印复选框,部分已勾。顶部探出一只可爱幼犬插画,骨头形进度条显示'已备好9/14'。暖米白与柔焦糖配色、俏皮爪印与骨头涂鸦、圆角卡片,萌趣亲切的宠物护理美学,圆滚滚的标题。

prompt_en: A wedding checklist infographic, 2:3, titled 'Wedding Countdown Checklist'. A timeline of four milestones down the page: 12 months (set budget, book venue), 6 months (choose caterer, send save-the-dates), 3 months (finalize invites, cake tasting), 1 month (confirm headcount, final fitting). Each milestone is a rounded card with checkbox items and a small elegant icon. A ribbon-and-ring motif header. Soft blush pink, sage green, and gold palette, delicate floral line art, thin elegant serif headings, refined romantic modern-wedding aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 婚礼清单信息图,2:3,标题《婚礼倒计时清单》。自上而下四个里程碑时间线:12个月前(定预算、订场地)、6个月前(选餐饮、寄存档卡)、3个月前(敲定请柬、试蛋糕)、1个月前(确认人数、最后试衣)。每个里程碑是带复选项和优雅小图标的圆角卡。缎带与戒指主题标题。柔腮红粉、鼠尾草绿与金色配色、精致花卉线描、细体衬线标题,考究浪漫的现代婚礼美学。

prompt_en: A preparedness checklist infographic, 4:5, titled 'Build a 72-Hour Emergency Kit'. A grid of item icons with checkboxes grouped by category: Water (1 gal/person/day), Food (non-perishable, 3 days), Light (flashlight, batteries), First Aid (kit, meds), Comms (radio, whistle), Docs (copies, cash). Each category has a colored header band and 3-4 checkable items. A red cross emblem header and a bold '72 HRS' badge. High-contrast safety palette of red, charcoal, and yellow, thick rounded icons, clear organized emergency-guide aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 防灾清单信息图,4:5,标题《备好72小时应急包》。带复选框的物资图标网格按类分组:水(每人每天1加仑)、食物(耐存、够3天)、照明(手电、电池)、急救(急救包、常备药)、通讯(收音机、哨子)、证件(复印件、现金)。每类有彩色标题栏和3-4个可勾项。红十字标题徽标,醒目'72小时'角标。高对比安全配色(红、炭灰、黄)、粗圆图标,清晰有条理的应急指南美学。

prompt_en: A career tips infographic, 2:3, titled 'Ace Your Next Interview: 6 Tips'. Six numbered tip cards with flat icons: 1 Research the company, 2 Prepare STAR stories, 3 Dress one level up, 4 Arrive 10 minutes early, 5 Ask 3 smart questions, 6 Send a thank-you note. Each card has a briefcase-toned badge and one supporting line. A confidence meter at the bottom fills to 'Ready'. Professional navy, teal, and white palette, rounded cards, clean line icons, motivating polished career-guide aesthetic, crisp modern sans-serif.
prompt_zh: 职场贴士信息图,2:3,标题《拿下下一场面试:6个技巧》。六张编号贴士卡配扁平图标:1 研究公司,2 准备STAR故事,3 着装略高一档,4 提前10分钟到,5 问3个有深度的问题,6 发感谢信。每卡有公文包色徽章和一句补充。底部信心刻度条填满到'就绪'。专业藏青、青绿与白配色、圆角卡片、清爽线描图标,励志精致的求职指南美学,利落现代无衬线。

prompt_en: An eco tips infographic, 4:5, titled '10 Small Steps to Greener Living'. Ten rounded tip tiles in a 2x5 grid, each with a leaf-toned icon and short text: carry a reusable bottle, switch to LED bulbs, shop local produce, compost scraps, air-dry laundry, unplug idle devices, bike short trips, cut single-use plastic, meat-free Mondays, plant native flowers. A globe-and-leaf header emblem and a footer '~1.2 tons CO2 saved/yr'. Fresh green and cream palette, hand-drawn botanical doodles, rounded tiles, wholesome friendly sustainability aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 环保贴士信息图,4:5,标题《更绿色生活的10个小步骤》。十块圆角贴士砖排成2x5网格,每块配叶色图标和短句:自带可重复水瓶、换LED灯泡、买本地果蔬、厨余堆肥、晾晒衣物、拔掉待机设备、短途骑行、少用一次性塑料、周一无肉日、种本地花卉。地球加叶片标题徽标,页脚'每年约减碳1.2吨'。清新绿加米白配色、手绘植物涂鸦、圆角砖块,亲切治愈的可持续美学。

prompt_en: A baby checklist infographic, 9:16, titled 'Newborn Essentials Checklist'. A soft vertical list grouped by category: Feeding (bottles, burp cloths, bibs), Sleep (crib, swaddles, sound machine), Diapering (diapers, wipes, cream), Clothing (onesies, socks, hats), Health (thermometer, nail file). Each item has a rounded checkbox with a pastel icon, several ticked. A cute crescent-moon and cloud header and a progress bar 'stocked 11/16'. Gentle pastel palette of powder blue, soft pink, and cream, rounded cards, tender nursery aesthetic, soft bubbly headings.
prompt_zh: 母婴清单信息图,9:16,标题《新生儿必备清单》。柔和纵向列表按类分组:喂养(奶瓶、拍嗝巾、围兜)、睡眠(婴儿床、包被、助眠白噪音)、换尿布(纸尿裤、湿巾、护臀膏)、衣物(连体衣、袜子、帽子)、健康(体温计、指甲锉)。每项是带粉彩图标的圆角复选框,部分已勾。可爱月牙与云朵标题,进度条'已备11/16'。柔粉彩配色(粉蓝、柔粉、米白)、圆角卡片,温柔婴儿房美学,软萌标题。

prompt_en: A versus infographic, 4:5, titled 'Cats vs Dogs'. A split-screen layout: left half cool blue for Cats, right half warm orange for Dogs, divided by a bold central 'VS' badge. Each side lists matched stats with icons: sleep hours (15 vs 12), avg lifespan (15 vs 11 yrs), daily walk (no vs yes), grooming (self vs owner), independence rating (9 vs 5 /10). Small facing cat and dog silhouettes at top. Clean flat design, playful pet-paw doodles, bold rounded headings, symmetrical balanced comparison layout.
prompt_zh: 对比信息图,4:5,标题《猫 vs 狗》。左右分屏版式:左半冷蓝代表猫,右半暖橙代表狗,中间一枚醒目'VS'徽章分隔。每侧用图标列出对应数据:睡眠时长(15 vs 12小时)、平均寿命(15 vs 11年)、每日遛弯(否 vs 是)、梳理毛发(自理 vs 靠主人)、独立性评分(9 vs 5 /10)。顶部是相向的猫狗剪影。清爽扁平设计、俏皮爪印涂鸦、粗体圆润标题,对称平衡的对比版式。

name_zh: 咖啡 vs 茶对比图
prompt_en: A versus infographic, 2:3, titled 'Coffee vs Tea'. Vertical split: top warm coffee-brown for Coffee, bottom soft sage-green for Tea, meeting at a central 'VS' seal. Matched rows compare caffeine (95mg vs 40mg per cup), antioxidants (moderate vs high), prep time (4 vs 3 min), calories black (2 vs 0), mood effect (alert vs calm). A steaming cup icon crowns each section. Cozy flat illustration style, warm cream background, hand-drawn steam swirls, rounded typography, balanced symmetrical head-to-head layout.
prompt_zh: 对比信息图,2:3,标题《咖啡 vs 茶》。上下分屏:上半暖咖啡棕代表咖啡,下半柔鼠尾草绿代表茶,中间一枚'VS'印章相接。对应行对比咖啡因(每杯95mg vs 40mg)、抗氧化物(中等 vs 高)、冲泡时间(4 vs 3分钟)、纯饮热量(2 vs 0千卡)、情绪作用(提神 vs 舒缓)。每段顶部冒热气的杯子图标。温馨扁平插画风、暖米白背景、手绘蒸汽漩涡、圆润字体,对称平衡的正面对决版式。

prompt_en: A tech versus infographic, 4:5, titled 'AuroraOS vs NebulaOS'. A sleek split-screen for two invented mobile operating systems: left purple AuroraOS, right teal NebulaOS, split by a glowing 'VS' node. Matched spec rows: app store size (2.1M vs 1.8M apps), customization (medium vs high), update years (5 vs 4), default assistant (Aura vs Neb), privacy score (8.7 vs 9.1 /10). Small phone mockups top each side. Dark charcoal background, neon accent gradients, glowing rounded icons, futuristic clean tech aesthetic, bold white type.
prompt_zh: 科技对比信息图,4:5,标题《AuroraOS vs NebulaOS》。两款虚构手机系统的利落分屏:左紫色AuroraOS、右青绿NebulaOS,中间一枚发光'VS'节点。对应参数行:应用商店规模(210万 vs 180万款)、可定制性(中 vs 高)、更新年限(5 vs 4年)、默认助手(Aura vs Neb)、隐私评分(8.7 vs 9.1 /10)。每侧顶部放手机模型。深炭黑背景、霓虹渐变强调、发光圆角图标,未来感清爽科技美学,粗体白字。

name_zh: 远程 vs 办公室办公
prompt_en: A workplace versus infographic, 2:3, titled 'Remote vs Office Work'. Split layout: left soft teal 'Remote', right warm amber 'Office', divided by a central 'VS' circle. Matched rows with flat icons: commute (0 vs 52 min/day), collaboration (rated 6 vs 9), focus time (8 vs 5), flexibility (9 vs 4), team bonding (5 vs 8). A small house icon vs an office-building icon at top. Clean modern flat design, off-white background, rounded stat chips, subtle drop shadows, balanced professional comparison aesthetic, crisp sans-serif.
prompt_zh: 职场对比信息图,2:3,标题《远程 vs 办公室办公》。分屏版式:左柔青绿'远程'、右暖琥珀'办公室',中间一枚'VS'圆形分隔。配扁平图标的对应行:通勤(0 vs 每天52分钟)、协作(评分6 vs 9)、专注时间(8 vs 5)、灵活度(9 vs 4)、团队凝聚(5 vs 8)。顶部是小房子图标对办公楼图标。清爽现代扁平设计、米白背景、圆角数据卡、淡投影,平衡专业的对比美学,利落无衬线。

name_zh: 燃油车 vs 电动车
prompt_en: An auto versus infographic, 4:5, titled 'Gas vs Electric Cars'. A split screen: left slate-grey 'Gas', right green 'Electric', joined by a bold 'VS' emblem. Matched rows with icons: cost per 100 mi ($14 vs $4), 0-60 (7.5 vs 5.2 s), refuel/charge time (5 min vs 40 min), CO2 per mile (410g vs 120g), maintenance/yr ($1,200 vs $500). Small side-view car silhouettes top each half. Clean flat design, white background, fuel-drop and lightning-bolt motifs, rounded stat bars, balanced modern comparison aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 汽车对比信息图,4:5,标题《燃油车 vs 电动车》。分屏画面:左石板灰'燃油'、右绿色'电动',中间一枚醒目'VS'徽标相连。配图标的对应行:每百英里成本(14 vs 4美元)、0-60加速(7.5 vs 5.2秒)、加油/充电时间(5分钟 vs 40分钟)、每英里碳排(410g vs 120g)、年保养(1200 vs 500美元)。每半顶部放侧视车身剪影。清爽扁平设计、白背景、油滴与闪电点缀、圆角数据条,平衡现代的对比美学。

name_zh: 有氧 vs 力量训练
prompt_en: A fitness versus infographic, 2:3, titled 'Cardio vs Strength'. Vertical split: top coral 'Cardio', bottom deep-blue 'Strength', meeting at a central 'VS' badge. Matched stats with icons: calories/30min (300 vs 180), heart health (high vs medium), muscle gain (low vs high), afterburn (low vs high), best for (endurance vs power). Running-figure vs dumbbell icons crown each section. Energetic flat design, white background, bold motivational headings, rounded progress bars, dynamic balanced fitness-comparison aesthetic, strong sans-serif.
prompt_zh: 健身对比信息图,2:3,标题《有氧 vs 力量》。上下分屏:上半珊瑚'有氧'、下半深蓝'力量',中间一枚'VS'徽章相接。配图标对应数据:每30分钟消耗(300 vs 180千卡)、心脏健康(高 vs 中)、增肌(低 vs 高)、后燃效应(低 vs 高)、擅长(耐力 vs 爆发)。跑步小人图标对哑铃图标各居一段顶部。活力扁平设计、白背景、励志粗体标题、圆角进度条,动感平衡的健身对比美学,有力无衬线。

prompt_en: A finance versus infographic, 4:5, titled 'Renting vs Buying'. A split screen: left blue 'Rent', right green 'Buy', divided by a central 'VS' seal. Matched rows: upfront cost ($3,000 vs $60,000), monthly ($1,600 vs $2,100), flexibility (high vs low), builds equity (no vs yes), maintenance (landlord vs you). A tiny key vs house icon top each half, plus a break-even note '~6 years to break even'. Clean flat design, off-white background, rounded stat chips, calm trustworthy finance-comparison aesthetic, crisp modern type.
prompt_zh: 理财对比信息图,4:5,标题《租房 vs 买房》。分屏画面:左蓝'租房'、右绿'买房',中间一枚'VS'印章分隔。对应行:首付成本(3000 vs 60000美元)、月供(1600 vs 2100美元)、灵活度(高 vs 低)、积累资产(否 vs 是)、维修责任(房东 vs 自己)。每半顶部是钥匙对房子小图标,并附回本提示'约6年回本'。清爽扁平设计、米白背景、圆角数据卡,沉稳可信的理财对比美学,利落现代字体。

prompt_en: An energy versus infographic, 2:3, titled 'Solar vs Wind'. Vertical split: top gold 'Solar', bottom sky-blue 'Wind', joined by a central 'VS' emblem. Matched rows with icons: cost per kWh (4.2c vs 3.8c), land use (medium vs low), works at night (no vs yes), install time (fast vs slow), lifespan (25 vs 22 yrs). Sun-panel vs turbine icons top each half. Clean flat design, soft gradient sky background, rounded stat bars, hopeful bright renewable-energy aesthetic, balanced symmetrical layout, bold clean headings.
prompt_zh: 能源对比信息图,2:3,标题《太阳能 vs 风能》。上下分屏:上半金色'太阳能'、下半天蓝'风能',中间一枚'VS'徽标相接。配图标对应行:每度电成本(4.2 vs 3.8美分)、占地(中 vs 低)、夜间可用(否 vs 是)、安装周期(快 vs 慢)、寿命(25 vs 22年)。光伏板对风机图标各居一段顶部。清爽扁平设计、柔和渐变天空背景、圆角数据条,明亮向上的清洁能源美学,对称平衡版式,粗体清爽标题。

prompt_en: A personality versus infographic, 4:5, titled 'Introvert vs Extrovert'. Split screen: left calm indigo 'Introvert', right sunny yellow 'Extrovert', divided by a central 'VS' circle. Matched traits with playful icons: recharge (alone vs with people), ideal weekend (book vs party), thinking (reflect first vs speak first), energy source (inward vs outward), meetings (drain vs energize). Two friendly abstract head silhouettes top each half. Soft flat illustration style, cream background, hand-drawn doodles, rounded cards, warm approachable psychology-infographic aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 性格对比信息图,4:5,标题《内向 vs 外向》。分屏画面:左沉静靛蓝'内向'、右阳光黄'外向',中间一枚'VS'圆形分隔。配俏皮图标的对应特质:充电方式(独处 vs 与人相处)、理想周末(读书 vs 派对)、思考习惯(先沉思 vs 先开口)、能量来源(向内 vs 向外)、开会感受(耗电 vs 充电)。两个友好的抽象头部剪影各居一段顶部。柔和扁平插画风、米白背景、手绘涂鸦、圆角卡片,温暖亲和的心理科普美学。

name_zh: 自由职业 vs 全职
prompt_en: A career versus infographic, 2:3, titled 'Freelance vs Full-Time'. Vertical split: top teal 'Freelance', bottom navy 'Full-Time', meeting at a central 'VS' badge. Matched rows with icons: schedule (flexible vs fixed), income stability (variable vs steady), benefits (self vs employer), growth (self-driven vs structured), vacation (unpaid vs paid). Laptop-on-beach vs office-desk icons top each section. Clean modern flat design, off-white background, rounded stat chips, subtle shadows, balanced professional career-comparison aesthetic, crisp confident type.
prompt_zh: 职业对比信息图,2:3,标题《自由职业 vs 全职》。上下分屏:上半青绿'自由职业'、下半藏青'全职',中间一枚'VS'徽章相接。配图标对应行:时间安排(灵活 vs 固定)、收入稳定性(浮动 vs 稳定)、福利(自理 vs 雇主)、成长(自驱 vs 体系)、休假(无薪 vs 带薪)。海边笔记本对办公桌图标各居一段顶部。清爽现代扁平设计、米白背景、圆角数据卡、淡投影,平衡专业的职业对比美学,利落自信字体。

prompt_en: A dashboard-style infographic, 4:5, titled 'TaskFlow Q3 Metrics'. A clean report slide with a top KPI row of four cards: MRR $284K (+12%), Active Users 41,200 (+8%), Churn 2.3% (-0.4%), NPS 62. Below, a two-column layout: left a line chart of revenue climbing over 6 months, right a donut of plan mix (Starter 44%, Pro 38%, Business 18%). A small horizontal bar of top features by usage. Light dashboard-grey background, indigo and mint accents, rounded card widgets, subtle shadows, modern analytics-UI aesthetic, tidy sans-serif.
prompt_zh: 看板式信息图,4:5,标题《TaskFlow 第三季度指标》。一张整洁的报告幻灯:顶部一行四张KPI卡:月经常性收入28.4万美元(+12%)、活跃用户41200(+8%)、流失率2.3%(-0.4%)、NPS 62。下方两栏:左侧是6个月营收上升的折线图,右侧是套餐占比环形图(入门44%、专业38%、商业18%)。下方一条按使用量排序的功能横条。浅看板灰背景、靛蓝与薄荷强调、圆角卡片组件、淡投影,现代分析UI美学,整洁无衬线。

prompt_en: A dashboard infographic, 4:5, titled 'ShopWave Sales Overview'. A report slide with four top stat tiles: Revenue $1.24M, Orders 8,540, Avg Order $145, Conversion 3.2%. A central bar chart shows monthly sales rising Jan-Jun, a side donut splits categories (Apparel 40%, Home 28%, Tech 22%, Other 10%), and a small ranked list of top 3 products with mini sparklines. A green up-arrow trend badge '+18% MoM'. Clean white-and-slate dashboard palette, teal and coral accents, rounded widgets, soft shadows, sleek e-commerce analytics aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 看板信息图,4:5,标题《ShopWave 销售总览》。一张报告幻灯,顶部四块数据砖:营收124万美元、订单8540、客单价145美元、转化率3.2%。中部柱状图显示1-6月销售上升,侧边环形图划分品类(服饰40%、家居28%、数码22%、其他10%),下方小排行列出Top3商品配迷你走势线。绿色上升箭头徽章'环比+18%'。清爽白灰看板配色、青绿与珊瑚强调、圆角组件、柔投影,利落电商分析美学。

prompt_en: A dashboard infographic, 9:16, titled 'BrightSocial Monthly Report'. A vertical report with a KPI strip: Followers 128K (+5.4%), Reach 940K, Engagement 6.1%, Posts 42. Below, a line chart of follower growth, a horizontal bar of engagement by content type (Reels 48%, Photos 30%, Stories 22%), and a top-3 posts card with tiny thumbnails and like counts. A calendar heatmap shows best posting days. Vibrant magenta-and-purple gradient accents, dark card backgrounds, rounded widgets, glowing highlights, trendy social-analytics dashboard aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 看板信息图,9:16,标题《BrightSocial 月度报告》。纵向报告顶部KPI条:粉丝12.8万(+5.4%)、触达94万、互动率6.1%、发帖42。下方是粉丝增长折线图、按内容类型的互动横条(短视频48%、图片30%、快拍22%),以及Top3帖子卡配小缩略图和点赞数。日历热力图显示最佳发帖日。鲜亮品红紫渐变强调、深色卡片背景、圆角组件、发光高亮,潮流社媒分析看板美学。

prompt_en: A dashboard infographic, 4:5, titled 'FitPulse Weekly Summary'. A friendly report slide: a top ring-chart trio shows Steps 68,400 (98% of goal), Active min 312, Calories 14,200. A weekly bar chart plots steps Mon-Sun peaking Saturday, a small line shows resting heart rate trending down 62-58 bpm, and three badge chips: '5-day streak', 'New PB 12km', 'Sleep avg 7h20m'. Energetic coral, lime, and white palette, rounded progress rings, soft shadows, motivating clean fitness-app dashboard aesthetic, bubbly headings.
prompt_zh: 看板信息图,4:5,标题《FitPulse 每周总结》。友好的报告幻灯:顶部三个环形图显示步数68400(达标98%)、活动312分钟、消耗14200千卡。周柱状图显示周一到周日步数、周六最高,小折线显示静息心率从62降到58 bpm,三枚徽章卡:'连续5天''新纪录12公里''平均睡眠7小时20分'。活力珊瑚、柠檬绿与白配色、圆角进度环、柔投影,励志清爽的健身App看板美学,圆润标题。

prompt_en: A finance dashboard infographic, 4:5, titled 'WealthGrid Portfolio'. A report slide with a header value 'Total $248,300 (+6.2% YTD)'. A donut shows allocation (Stocks 55%, Bonds 20%, Crypto 10%, Cash 15%), a line chart tracks portfolio value over 12 months, and a ranked holdings list of five invented tickers (NRDX +14%, VELA +9%, KSTL -3%, ORBT +21%, TERA +4%) with green/red arrows. A risk gauge points to 'Moderate'. Deep navy-and-white palette, gold and teal accents, rounded widgets, subtle glow, premium clean fintech-dashboard aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 理财看板信息图,4:5,标题《WealthGrid 投资组合》。报告幻灯顶部总额'合计248300美元(年内+6.2%)'。环形图显示配置(股票55%、债券20%、加密10%、现金15%),折线图追踪12个月组合价值,持仓排行列出五个虚构代码(NRDX +14%、VELA +9%、KSTL -3%、ORBT +21%、TERA +4%)配红绿箭头。风险仪表指向'中等'。深藏青加白配色、金色与青绿强调、圆角组件、淡发光,高端清爽金融科技看板美学。

prompt_en: A dashboard infographic, 4:5, titled 'Spring Launch Campaign Report'. A results slide with four KPI tiles: Impressions 2.4M, Clicks 96K, CTR 4.0%, ROAS 3.8x. A funnel chart narrows from Reach to Conversion, a channel-split bar compares Email 34%, Search 28%, Social 24%, Display 14%, and a small line shows daily spend vs revenue. A green highlight banner 'Goal exceeded by 27%'. Clean corporate palette of navy, teal, and coral, rounded widgets on a light grid, soft shadows, polished professional report-slide aesthetic, crisp sans-serif.
prompt_zh: 看板信息图,4:5,标题《春季上新活动报告》。成果幻灯顶部四块KPI砖:曝光240万、点击9.6万、点击率4.0%、广告支出回报3.8倍。漏斗图从触达收窄到转化,渠道占比条对比邮件34%、搜索28%、社媒24%、展示14%,小折线显示每日花费对营收。绿色高亮横幅'超额完成27%'。清爽商务配色(藏青、青绿、珊瑚)、浅网格上的圆角组件、柔投影,精致专业的报告幻灯美学,利落无衬线。

prompt_en: A dashboard infographic, 9:16, titled 'PageVault Traffic Report'. A vertical analytics slide: top tiles show Sessions 312K, Users 214K, Bounce 38%, Avg Time 2m47s. An area chart plots daily sessions over 30 days, a horizontal bar ranks traffic sources (Organic 46%, Direct 24%, Social 18%, Referral 12%), and a small world-map dot cluster highlights top regions. A device-split mini donut (Mobile 61%, Desktop 33%, Tablet 6%). Cool blue-and-white palette, rounded card widgets, faint grid, clean modern web-analytics dashboard aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 看板信息图,9:16,标题《PageVault 流量报告》。纵向分析幻灯:顶部数据砖显示会话31.2万、用户21.4万、跳出率38%、平均停留2分47秒。面积图绘出30天每日会话,横条排列流量来源(自然46%、直接24%、社媒18%、引荐12%),小世界地图点簇高亮重点地区。设备占比迷你环形(移动61%、桌面33%、平板6%)。冷蓝加白配色、圆角卡片组件、淡网格,清爽现代的网站分析看板美学。

prompt_en: A dashboard infographic, 4:5, titled 'HelpDesk Q2 Performance'. A report slide with four KPI cards: Tickets 12,480, Avg Response 1h12m, Resolution 94%, CSAT 4.6/5. A line chart tracks daily ticket volume, a stacked bar splits ticket type (Billing 32%, Technical 41%, Account 18%, Other 9%), and a gauge shows SLA compliance at 96%. A small agent-leaderboard card lists three top performers with star ratings. Calm teal-and-white palette, rounded widgets on a light grid, green trend badges, tidy professional support-dashboard aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 看板信息图,4:5,标题《HelpDesk 第二季度绩效》。报告幻灯四张KPI卡:工单12480、平均响应1小时12分、解决率94%、满意度4.6/5。折线图追踪每日工单量,堆叠条划分工单类型(账单32%、技术41%、账户18%、其他9%),仪表盘显示SLA达成96%。小坐席排行卡列出三名优秀客服配星级。沉稳青绿加白配色、浅网格上的圆角组件、绿色趋势徽章,整洁专业的客服看板美学。

prompt_en: A dashboard infographic, 4:5, titled 'Project Atlas: Status Report'. A management slide: a top progress bar shows 68% complete with an 'On Track' green pill. A mini Gantt chart lists five phases (Discovery done, Design done, Build in progress, Test upcoming, Launch upcoming) with colored timeline bars. Three stat tiles: Budget 62% used, Tasks 214/312, Risks 3 open. A small stacked bar of task status (Done, Doing, To-do) and a next-milestone callout 'Beta July 30'. Clean corporate palette of navy, green, amber, rounded widgets, polished PM-report aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 看板信息图,4:5,标题《Atlas 项目:状态报告》。管理幻灯:顶部进度条显示完成68%,配绿色'进度正常'胶囊。迷你甘特图列出五个阶段(调研已完成、设计已完成、开发进行中、测试待开始、上线待开始)配彩色时间条。三块数据砖:预算已用62%、任务214/312、未解风险3项。小堆叠条展示任务状态(已完成、进行中、待办),下一里程碑提示'Beta 7月30日'。清爽商务配色(藏青、绿、琥珀)、圆角组件,精致的项目管理报告美学。

prompt_en: An HR dashboard infographic, 9:16, titled 'TalentHub Hiring Report'. A vertical slide with top tiles: Applicants 1,840, Interviews 312, Offers 64, Hires 48. A hiring funnel narrows from Applied to Hired with percentage drop-offs labeled. A horizontal bar ranks sources (Referral 38%, Job Board 30%, LinkedIn-style network 22%, Career Page 10%), and a small line shows time-to-hire dropping from 42 to 31 days. A donut of hires by department (Eng 40%, Sales 25%, Ops 20%, Design 15%). Fresh green-and-white palette, rounded widgets, clean modern HR-analytics aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 人力看板信息图,9:16,标题《TalentHub 招聘报告》。纵向幻灯顶部数据砖:应聘1840、面试312、发offer 64、入职48。招聘漏斗从'投递'收窄到'入职',各层标注流失百分比。横条排列来源(内推38%、招聘网站30%、职场社交22%、招聘主页10%),小折线显示招聘周期从42天降到31天。入职部门环形图(工程40%、销售25%、运营20%、设计15%)。清新绿加白配色、圆角组件,清爽现代的人力分析美学。

prompt_en: A market-share infographic, 4:5, titled 'Mobile OS Market Share 2025'. A large donut chart splits the market between invented systems: AuroraOS 52% (purple), NebulaOS 34% (teal), LumaLite 9% (amber), Others 5% (grey). The donut center reads 'Global 4.1B devices'. A legend with color dots and exact percentages sits below, plus a small year-over-year change note ('AuroraOS +3pts'). A tiny regional split bar shows differing leaders by continent. Clean white background, flat design, bold rounded headline, subtle shadows, modern data-report aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 市场份额信息图,4:5,标题《2025 手机系统市场份额》。一张大环形图把市场分给虚构系统:AuroraOS 52%(紫)、NebulaOS 34%(青)、LumaLite 9%(琥珀)、其他 5%(灰)。环形中心写'全球41亿设备'。下方是配色点加精确百分比的图例,以及同比变化小注('AuroraOS +3个百分点')。一条迷你区域条显示各大洲不同领跑者。纯白背景、扁平设计、粗体圆润标题、淡投影,现代数据报告美学。

prompt_en: A market-share infographic, 2:3, titled 'Electric Car Market Share 2025'. A horizontal bar chart ranks invented EV makers: VoltRidge 28%, Aurora Motors 21%, Comet EV 17%, TerraVolt 13%, NovaDrive 11%, Others 10%, each bar in a distinct color with the percentage in bold. Small car-badge icons head each row. A side donut echoes the split, and a footer stat reads 'Total 14.2M units sold'. Clean flat design, electric-blue and green palette, white background, rounded bars, thin grid, modern automotive data-report aesthetic, crisp sans-serif.
prompt_zh: 市场份额信息图,2:3,标题《2025 电动车市场份额》。横向条形图给虚构电动车厂排名:VoltRidge 28%、Aurora Motors 21%、Comet EV 17%、TerraVolt 13%、NovaDrive 11%、其他 10%,每根条用不同颜色并粗体标百分比。每行左侧配车徽小图标。侧边环形图呼应占比,页脚数据'全年销量1420万辆'。清爽扁平设计、电光蓝与绿配色、白背景、圆角条、细网格,现代汽车数据报告美学,利落无衬线。

prompt_en: A tech market-share infographic, 4:5, titled 'Cloud Infrastructure Market Share'. A treemap-style block layout sizes invented providers by share: SkyForge 34% (large blue block), NimbusCloud 28% (teal), CoreStack 19% (indigo), Vantage Cloud 11% (purple), Others 8% (grey). Each block shows the name and percentage in white. A small side note '$310B annual market' and a mini arrow list of YoY movers. Dark charcoal background, neon-accent blocks with glowing edges, clean white type, sleek modern tech data-report aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 科技份额信息图,4:5,标题《云基础设施市场份额》。矩形树图版式按份额划分虚构厂商:SkyForge 34%(大蓝块)、NimbusCloud 28%(青)、CoreStack 19%(靛蓝)、Vantage Cloud 11%(紫)、其他 8%(灰)。每块以白字标名称和百分比。侧边小注'年市场规模3100亿美元',迷你箭头列出同比变动者。深炭黑背景、霓虹强调块配发光边缘、清爽白字,利落现代科技数据报告美学。

A vertical stacked-column layout where one tall bar splits into invented services: StreamNest 31%, PixelPlay 24%, LumaTV 18%, CineWave 15%, Others 12%, each segment labeled with a percentage and a tiny logo shape. Beside it, a ranked mini-card list repeats the numbers with subscriber counts (e.g., StreamNest 210M). A footer '680M total subscribers'. Deep midnight-blue background, magenta-cyan gradient segments, glowing edges, sleek streaming-brand data aesthetic, bold white type.
prompt_zh: 媒体份额信息图,9:16,标题《各平台流媒体订阅份额》。纵向堆叠柱版式,一根高柱分成虚构平台:StreamNest 31%、PixelPlay 24%、LumaTV 18%、CineWave 15%、其他 12%,每段标百分比和一个小标志形状。旁边迷你卡片列表重复数字并附订阅数(如StreamNest 2.1亿)。页脚'总订阅6.8亿'。午夜蓝背景、品红青渐变分段、发光边缘,利落流媒体品牌数据美学,粗体白字。

prompt_en: A retail market-share infographic, 2:3, titled 'Coffee Chain Market Share'. A horizontal bar ranking of invented chains: BeanHaus 30%, Cup&Co 22%, RoastRoom 17%, DailyGrind 14%, MugLane 9%, Others 8%, each bar in a warm brown-to-caramel gradient with bold percentages. Small coffee-cup badge icons head each row. A side donut mirrors the shares and a footer reads '48,000 stores worldwide'. Warm cream background, coffee-brown headline, hand-drawn steam swirls in corners, rounded bars, cozy modern retail-data aesthetic, clean type.
prompt_zh: 零售份额信息图,2:3,标题《咖啡连锁市场份额》。横向条形排名,虚构连锁:BeanHaus 30%、Cup&Co 22%、RoastRoom 17%、DailyGrind 14%、MugLane 9%、其他 8%,每根条用暖棕到焦糖渐变并粗体标百分比。每行左侧配咖啡杯徽标图标。侧边环形图呼应份额,页脚'全球48000家门店'。暖米白背景、咖啡棕标题、四角手绘蒸汽漩涡、圆角条,温馨现代零售数据美学,清爽字体。

A donut chart splits invented consoles: NovaBox 44% (green), PulseStation 39% (blue), PixelCube 12% (orange), Others 5% (grey). Center label 'Active consoles: 210M'. A legend with controller-shaped color chips and percentages, plus three mini stat tiles: 'Top seller: NovaBox', 'Handheld growth +22%', 'Avg price $449'. Dark gamer palette of black, neon-green, and electric-blue, glowing donut edges, angular futuristic accents, bold arcade-style headline, sleek gaming data aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 游戏份额信息图,4:5,标题《2025 主机市场份额》。环形图划分虚构主机:NovaBox 44%(绿)、PulseStation 39%(蓝)、PixelCube 12%(橙)、其他 5%(灰)。中心标注'在用主机2.1亿台'。配手柄形色块与百分比的图例,加三块迷你数据砖:'销量冠军:NovaBox''掌机增长+22%''均价449美元'。深玩家配色(黑、霓虹绿、电光蓝)、发光环形边缘、棱角未来感点缀,粗体街机风标题,利落游戏数据美学。

prompt_en: A mobility market-share infographic, 4:5, titled 'Ride-Hailing Market Share'. A donut chart divides invented apps: ZipRide 41% (green), CityHop 29% (yellow), GoCab 18% (blue), FleetGo 7% (purple), Others 5% (grey). Center reads '2.8B rides/yr'. A legend with car-pin color chips and percentages, plus three mini tiles: 'Fastest grower: CityHop +6pts', 'Avg fare $12.40', 'Cities served 640'. Clean white background, flat design, map-route line motifs faintly in the background, rounded widgets, modern mobility data-report aesthetic, bold headline.
prompt_zh: 出行份额信息图,4:5,标题《网约车市场份额》。环形图划分虚构App:ZipRide 41%(绿)、CityHop 29%(黄)、GoCab 18%(蓝)、FleetGo 7%(紫)、其他 5%(灰)。中心写'年订单28亿次'。配车辆定位色块与百分比的图例,加三块迷你砖:'增长最快:CityHop +6个百分点''平均车费12.40美元''覆盖640城'。纯白背景、扁平设计、背景淡淡的地图路线motif、圆角组件,现代出行数据报告美学,粗体标题。
