A vertical ranked layout: horizontal bubble bars for invented platforms sized by users: Chirp 1.9B (blue), Snapgram 1.4B (magenta), Vibe 980M (purple), LoopIt 620M (teal), Others 540M (grey), each with a percentage of total. A small age-split mini bar shows which platform each generation prefers. A footer 'Total 5.4B social users'. Bright gradient palette on a dark background, glowing rounded bubbles, playful bold headline, trendy modern social-data aesthetic, clean white type.
prompt_zh: 社媒份额信息图,9:16,标题《按用户数的社交平台份额》。纵向排名版式:按用户数缩放的横向气泡条,虚构平台:Chirp 19亿(蓝)、Snapgram 14亿(品红)、Vibe 9.8亿(紫)、LoopIt 6.2亿(青)、其他 5.4亿(灰),每个标出占总量的百分比。小年龄分布条显示各世代偏好的平台。页脚'社交用户共54亿'。深色背景上的明亮渐变配色、发光圆润气泡、俏皮粗体标题,潮流现代社媒数据美学,清爽白字。

prompt_en: A botanical infographic explaining photosynthesis through a magnified leaf cross-section. Center: a detailed cutaway showing the waxy cuticle, palisade and spongy mesophyll layers, a stoma with guard cells, and green chloroplasts. Blue curved arrows trace incoming water and CO2; orange arrows show released oxygen; a yellow sunbeam strikes the top. Flat vector illustration with soft gradients on a cream background. Bold sans-serif title 'How a Leaf Makes Food', numbered callout boxes, and the equation 6CO2 + 6H2O to C6H12O6 + 6O2 along the base. Botanical green and amber palette.
prompt_zh: 一张植物学信息图,通过放大的叶片横切面讲解光合作用。中央详细剖开叶子,展示蜡质角质层、栅栏组织与海绵组织、带保卫细胞的气孔以及绿色叶绿体。蓝色弧形箭头表示水和二氧化碳进入,橙色箭头表示释放的氧气,顶部一道黄色阳光斜射而下。扁平矢量插画,柔和渐变,米白背景。粗体无衬线标题「叶子如何制造养分」,配编号说明框,底部标注反应式 6CO2 + 6H2O to C6H12O6 + 6O2。植物绿与琥珀色配色。

prompt_en: An earth-science infographic of the water cycle drawn as one continuous landscape scene. A mountain, forest, lake and ocean sit under a cloud-filled sky, connected by looping arrows labeled 'evaporation', 'condensation', 'precipitation', 'collection' and 'transpiration'. Tiny sun, raindrops and vapor swirls act as icons. Hand-illustrated storybook style with textured watercolor washes in teal, sky blue and moss green. Rounded title banner 'The Water Cycle' across the top, short caption paragraphs pinned beside each stage. Playful, kid-friendly composition.
prompt_zh: 一张地球科学信息图,把水循环画成一幅连续的风景场景。山脉、森林、湖泊与海洋位于布满云朵的天空下,由环形箭头串联,标注「蒸发」「凝结」「降水」「汇集」「蒸腾」。小太阳、雨滴与水汽漩涡作为图标。手绘绘本风格,水彩晕染质感,青绿、天蓝与苔藓绿。顶部圆角标题横幅「水循环」,每个阶段旁配简短说明段落。活泼、亲切、适合儿童的构图。

prompt_en: A biology diagram of a labeled animal cell shown as a large translucent sphere filling the frame. Inside, clearly rendered organelles - nucleus, mitochondria, ribosomes, Golgi apparatus, endoplasmic reticulum, lysosome and cell membrane - are color-coded with thin leader lines pointing to right-aligned label chips. Clean flat vector style with a subtle inner glow, on a dark navy background for contrast. Neon-pastel palette with a magenta nucleus and cyan mitochondria. Title 'Inside an Animal Cell' top-left in a heavy geometric font, a small legend grid bottom-right.
prompt_zh: 一张生物学示意图,把带标注的动物细胞画成一个占满画面的半透明大球体。内部清晰呈现各个细胞器——细胞核、线粒体、核糖体、高尔基体、内质网、溶酶体与细胞膜——分别用颜色区分,细引线指向右对齐的标签块。干净的扁平矢量风格,带轻微内发光,深藏青背景形成对比。霓虹柔彩配色,品红色细胞核、青色线粒体。左上角粗重几何字体标题「动物细胞内部结构」,右下角一个小图例网格。

prompt_en: A life-cycle infographic showing the four stages of a monarch-style butterfly's metamorphosis arranged in a clockwise circle. An egg on a leaf, a striped caterpillar, a green chrysalis, and an emerged orange-and-black butterfly each sit in a circular vignette linked by curved directional arrows. Numbered 1-4 with stage names 'egg', 'larva', 'pupa', 'adult'. Detailed naturalistic illustration with fine linework, warm meadow-green and marigold palette on ivory. Central title medallion 'Metamorphosis'. Decorative leaves fill the corners.
prompt_zh: 一张生命周期信息图,把君主斑蝶式蝴蝶的四个变态阶段按顺时针排成一圈。叶上的卵、带条纹的毛毛虫、绿色的蛹,以及羽化后的橙黑色蝴蝶,各自置于圆形小画框中,由弯曲的方向箭头相连。标号 1 至 4,阶段名为「卵」「幼虫」「蛹」「成虫」。写实细腻插画,细线条勾勒,暖草地绿与万寿菊黄配色,象牙白底。中央圆形徽章标题「变态发育」,四角以装饰性叶片点缀。

prompt_en: A geology cutaway infographic of a stratovolcano sliced in half. The cross-section reveals the magma chamber, central conduit, side vent, layered lava and ash strata, and an erupting summit with a smoke plume and lava bombs. A red-orange gradient marks molten rock; layered browns show cooled deposits. Thin white leader lines connect to label boxes: 'magma chamber', 'conduit', 'crater', 'ash cloud', 'lava flow'. Semi-realistic textured illustration under a dramatic dark sky. Bold title 'Anatomy of a Volcano' upper-left. Warm ember palette.
prompt_zh: 一张地质剖切信息图,将成层火山从中劈开。横切面显示岩浆房、中央火山道、侧向喷口、层叠的熔岩与火山灰地层,以及正在喷发、带烟柱和火山弹的山顶。红橙渐变表示熔融岩石,层叠棕色表示冷却沉积。细白引线连向标签框:「岩浆房」「火山道」「火山口」「火山灰云」「熔岩流」。半写实带肌理插画,戏剧化暗色天空。左上角粗体标题「火山剖面解析」。暖余烬色调。

prompt_en: An astronomy infographic lining up the eight planets of a solar system by size against a starry deep-space background. From a glowing sun on the left edge, planets increase then decrease in diameter, each labeled with name, diameter and orbital distance in a compact data strip below. Realistic rendered planet textures with soft rim light. Numbered order 1-8, a faint dotted orbit ruler running beneath. Title 'The Planets to Scale' in a futuristic thin uppercase font. Cosmic navy-to-violet gradient with cyan accent lines.
prompt_zh: 一张天文信息图,在星光深空背景前按大小排列一个太阳系的八颗行星。从左缘发光的太阳出发,行星直径先增后减,每颗下方以紧凑数据条标注名称、直径与轨道距离。写实渲染的行星纹理,柔和轮廓光。编号 1 至 8,下方一条淡淡的虚线轨道标尺。标题「行星大小对比」采用未来感的纤细大写字体。宇宙藏青到紫罗兰渐变,青色点缀线条。

prompt_en: A molecular-biology infographic of a DNA double helix rising vertically through the center of the frame. The twisted ladder shows color-coded base pairs (A-T in red-yellow, C-G in blue-green) with a zoomed inset revealing the sugar-phosphate backbone and hydrogen bonds. Clean 3D-render style with soft studio lighting on a pale grey gradient. A right column holds a tidy legend and three short fact cards. Title 'The Code of Life' set vertically along the left in a modern serif. Cool scientific palette with vivid base-pair accents.
prompt_zh: 一张分子生物学信息图,DNA 双螺旋从画面中央竖直升起。扭转的梯状结构展示按颜色区分的碱基对(A-T 为红黄,C-G 为蓝绿),配一个放大插图揭示糖-磷酸骨架与氢键。干净的三维渲染风格,柔和棚拍打光,浅灰渐变底。右侧一列排放整齐的图例与三张简短知识卡。标题「生命的密码 DNA」以现代衬线字体竖排于左侧。冷调科学配色,碱基对以鲜亮色点缀。

prompt_en: An ecology infographic combining a food chain and an energy pyramid for an African savanna. A four-tier pyramid on the left labels 'producers', 'primary consumers', 'secondary consumers', 'apex predator' with grass, gazelle, cheetah and lion illustrations; energy-transfer percentages (100%, 10%, 1%, 0.1%) sit on each tier. To the right, a horizontal chain with arrows repeats the flow. Warm ochre, savanna-gold and acacia-green palette, flat illustration with grain texture. Bold title 'Who Eats Whom' top-center.
prompt_zh: 一张生态学信息图,把非洲草原的食物链与能量金字塔结合。左侧的四层金字塔标注「生产者」「初级消费者」「次级消费者」「顶级掠食者」,配草、瞪羚、猎豹与狮子插画;每层标注能量传递百分比(100%、10%、1%、0.1%)。右侧一条带箭头的横向链条重复这一流向。暖赭石、草原金与相思树绿配色,扁平插画带颗粒质感。粗体标题「谁吃谁:食物链」居于顶部中央。

prompt_en: A geology infographic of the rock cycle drawn as a circular flow diagram. Three labeled nodes - igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic rock - sit around a ring connected by arrows tagged 'weathering', 'compaction', 'heat and pressure', 'melting' and 'cooling'. Each node shows a stylized rock sample and a mini cross-section. Isometric mineral illustrations in slate grey, rust and sandstone tones on a chalkboard-dark background with faint chalk texture. Clean white leader labels, title 'The Rock Cycle' arced along the top of the ring.
prompt_zh: 一张地质学信息图,把岩石循环画成环形流程图。三个带标注的节点——火成岩、沉积岩与变质岩——围绕圆环排列,由标注「风化」「压实」「高温高压」「熔融」「冷却」的箭头相连。每个节点展示一块风格化岩石标本与一个微型剖面。等距矿物插画,板岩灰、锈红与砂岩色,黑板深色背景带淡淡粉笔质感。干净的白色引线标签,标题「岩石循环图」沿圆环顶部弧形排列。

prompt_en: A nature infographic explaining honeybee castes and hive roles. Center: a hexagonal honeycomb grid; three enlarged bees - queen, worker, drone - sit in their own hex cells with size comparison and a bullet list of duties beside each. Border hexes hold icons for nectar, pollen, wax and larvae. Detailed entomological illustration with soft amber lighting, honey-gold, black and warm brown palette on cream. Bold rounded title 'Life Inside the Hive' at the top, a small waggle-dance diagram in the lower corner.
prompt_zh: 一张自然科普信息图,讲解蜜蜂的品级与蜂巢分工。中央是六边形蜂巢网格;三只放大的蜜蜂——蜂后、工蜂、雄蜂——各占一个六角巢室,配大小对比与旁边的职责要点列表。边缘六角格放置花蜜、花粉、蜂蜡与幼虫的图标。细腻的昆虫学插画,柔和琥珀光,蜜金、黑与暖棕配色,米白底。顶部粗体圆角标题「蜂巢里的生活」,右下角一个小小的摇摆舞示意图。

prompt_en: A history timeline infographic tracing ancient Egyptian kingdoms along a vertical papyrus scroll. Milestone markers for the Old, Middle and New Kingdoms note the pyramids at Giza, hieroglyphic writing, and the reign of a fictional pharaoh 'Nebkara II', each with a date band in BCE and a small illustrated icon (pyramid, sphinx, ankh, sarcophagus). Aged-parchment texture with a hieroglyph-inspired border, terracotta, lapis-blue and gold-leaf palette. Serif display title 'Kingdoms of the Nile' at the top. Hand-drawn artifact illustrations.
prompt_zh: 一张历史时间轴信息图,沿一卷竖向的莎草纸梳理古埃及各王朝。古王国、中王国与新王国的里程碑标注了吉萨金字塔、象形文字,以及虚构法老「奈布卡拉二世」的统治,每项配公元前年代条与一个小插画图标(金字塔、狮身人面像、生命符、石棺)。做旧羊皮纸质感,象形文字风格边框,赤陶红、天青蓝与金箔配色。顶部衬线展示体标题「尼罗河王朝纪年」。手绘文物插画。

prompt_en: An infographic timeline of how writing evolved, laid out as a left-to-right horizontal band. Stops show cave pictographs, cuneiform tablets, Egyptian hieroglyphs, a Phoenician alphabet, and a printing press, each with an approximate date and a sample glyph. A connecting dotted line carries era labels. Muted archival palette of ink-black, aged-paper beige and sepia, engraving-style illustrations. A strong serif title 'From Marks to Words' upper-left, compact caption blocks under each milestone, a faint quill motif in the background.
prompt_zh: 一张文字演变的时间轴信息图,以从左到右的横向长条排布。各节点展示洞穴象形图、楔形文字泥板、埃及象形文字、腓尼基字母,以及印刷机,每项配大致年代与一个字符样例。相连的虚线上标注各个时代。低饱和档案色调,墨黑、旧纸米黄与棕褐,版画风格插画。左上角有力的衬线标题「从符号到文字」,每个里程碑下方紧凑的说明块,背景一支淡淡的羽毛笔纹样。

prompt_en: An aviation timeline infographic climbing diagonally upward like a flight path from bottom-left to top-right. Milestones - hot-air balloon, glider, first powered biplane, propeller airliner, jet airliner, and rocket - sit along a dashed ascending arc, each tagged with a year and a one-line note. Blueprint aesthetic: white line-art on a deep navy grid background with cyan highlights. Bold uppercase title 'A Century of Flight' top-left, with a compass rose and a small altitude ruler as accents.
prompt_zh: 一张航空时间轴信息图,像飞行航迹一样从左下向右上斜向攀升。各里程碑——热气球、滑翔机、首架动力双翼机、螺旋桨客机、喷气客机与火箭——沿一条虚线上升弧线排布,每项标注年份与一句说明。蓝图美学:深藏青网格背景上的白色线稿,青色高光点缀。左上角粗体大写标题「飞行百年史」,以罗盘玫瑰与一根小高度标尺作点缀。

prompt_en: A history infographic timeline of Industrial Revolution breakthroughs arranged as a horizontal factory conveyor belt. Illustrated icons - steam engine, spinning machine, locomotive, telegraph, electric lightbulb - ride the belt, each labeled with an approximate decade and an inventor role (fictional names). Vintage engraving illustration style with cross-hatching, muted brass, coal-grey and cream palette, a gear-and-cog decorative border. Title 'The Age of Machines' in a bold slab-serif banner across the top, riveted-metal caption plates.
prompt_zh: 一张历史信息图,把工业革命的突破排成一条横向的工厂传送带。插画图标——蒸汽机、纺纱机、蒸汽机车、电报机、电灯泡——在传送带上前行,每项标注大致年代与一位发明者角色(虚构姓名)。复古版画插画风格,交叉排线,低调黄铜色、煤灰与米白配色,齿轮装饰边框。顶部粗体粗衬线横幅标题「机器的时代」,铆钉金属质感的说明牌。

name_en: Rise and Fall of an Empire
prompt_en: A history timeline infographic charting the rise and fall of a Roman-style empire as a mountain-shaped line graph. The ascending slope marks founding, republic and expansion; the peak marks golden-age territory; the descent marks division, invasions and collapse - each event pinned with a laurel medallion and a year. Marble-white and imperial-purple palette with gold accents, classical column motifs framing the sides. Engraved-relief illustration style. Title 'Rise and Fall of an Empire' carved into a stone banner at the top.
prompt_zh: 一张历史时间轴信息图,用山形折线图勾勒一个罗马式帝国的兴衰。上升坡段标注建国、共和与扩张;顶峰标注黄金时代的疆域;下降段标注分裂、入侵与崩溃——每个事件以桂冠徽章与年份标记。大理石白与帝王紫配色,金色点缀,两侧以古典立柱纹样为框。浮雕雕刻插画风格。标题「帝国的兴衰」镌刻在顶部的石质横幅上。

prompt_en: A technology history timeline of how the internet grew, drawn as glowing nodes on a network graph flowing top to bottom. Milestones - packet switching, first network link, email, the world wide web, search engines, social media, and mobile web - each sit in a circular node with a year and a short caption, connected by luminous data lines. Dark-mode design, electric blue and magenta gradients, a subtle circuit-board texture. Monospace accents, bold title 'How the Internet Grew' at the top, small pixel icons per node.
prompt_zh: 一张科技史时间轴信息图,把互联网的成长画成网络图上自上而下流动的发光节点。各里程碑——分组交换、首次网络连接、电子邮件、万维网、搜索引擎、社交媒体与移动网络——各占一个圆形节点,配年份与简短说明,由发光的数据线相连。暗色模式设计,电光蓝与品红渐变,隐约的电路板纹理。等宽字体点缀,顶部粗体标题「互联网成长史」,每个节点配小像素图标。

prompt_en: A space-exploration timeline infographic rising vertically like a rocket trajectory. Markers for the first satellite, first human in orbit, first moon landing, a space station, a Mars rover and a fictional 'Ares Deep-Space Mission' each carry a year, an invented agency and a small spacecraft illustration. A star-field background with a dotted ascending flight path and faint orbital rings. Retro-futurist palette of charcoal, atomic orange and pale gold. Condensed uppercase title 'Reaching for the Stars', mission patches as decorative badges.
prompt_zh: 一张太空探索时间轴信息图,像火箭轨迹般竖直上升。首颗卫星、首位入轨宇航员、首次登月、空间站、火星车,以及虚构的「阿瑞斯深空任务」的标记,各自标注年份、虚构机构与一个小飞船插画。星空背景配一条虚线上升航迹与淡淡的轨道环。复古未来主义配色,炭黑、原子橙与淡金。窄体大写标题「迈向群星:太空探索」,任务徽章作装饰。

prompt_en: A history infographic mapping the classical Seven Wonders of the ancient world as illustrated cards arranged in two rows over a stylized Mediterranean map. Each card shows a monument - a great pyramid, hanging gardens, a colossal statue, a lighthouse and more - with a location pin, an approximate build date and a height figure. Warm antique palette of sandstone, olive and aegean blue, engraving-meets-flat illustration. An ornamental compass and a scroll title 'Wonders of the Ancient World' banner across the top, dotted travel routes linking the sites.
prompt_zh: 一张历史信息图,把古典的古代世界七大奇迹以插画卡片排成两行,叠放在一张风格化的地中海地图上。每张卡片展示一处遗迹——大金字塔、空中花园、巨型雕像、灯塔等——配地点标记、大致建造年代与高度数字。暖复古配色,砂岩色、橄榄绿与爱琴蓝,版画结合扁平的插画。装饰罗盘与卷轴横幅标题「古代世界七大奇迹」贯穿顶部,虚线旅行路线连接各遗址。

prompt_en: A history infographic of the Silk Road shown as a stylized trade-route map stretching east to west across a parchment background. A dotted caravan line links illustrated waypoint cities with icons for silk, spices, tea, glass and paper traded at each; a side timeline strip lists key eras. Camel, ship and market-stall spot illustrations. Warm cartographic palette of tea-brown, jade and saffron, faux-aged paper with a compass rose and a decorative border. Serif title 'The Silk Road' with a subtitle ribbon 'Trade Across Continents'.
prompt_zh: 一张历史信息图,把丝绸之路画成一张风格化的贸易路线图,在羊皮纸背景上自东向西延展。一条虚线驼队路线串联起插画式的沿途城市,并以图标标出各地交易的丝绸、香料、茶叶、玻璃与纸张;侧边时间条列出关键时代。骆驼、帆船与集市摊位的点缀插画。暖地图配色,茶棕、翡翠绿与藏红,做旧纸张配罗盘玫瑰与装饰边框。衬线标题「丝绸之路」,副标题绶带「贯通大陆的贸易」。

prompt_en: A finance-history timeline infographic showing how money evolved, laid out as a left-to-right coin-trail. Stages - barter goods, cowrie shells, metal coins, paper banknotes, bank cards, and a glowing digital-wallet phone - each sit above a dated plinth with a one-line description. Flat vector illustration with long soft shadows, a mint-green, gold and slate palette on off-white. Bold geometric title 'The Story of Money' top-center, a small trend arrow threading through all stages, coin-stack icons as bullet markers.
prompt_zh: 一张货币史时间轴信息图,把货币的演变排成一条从左到右的硬币轨迹。各阶段——以物易物、贝币、金属钱币、纸币、银行卡,以及一部发光的数字钱包手机——各自立于带年代的基座上,配一句说明。扁平矢量插画,长而柔和的投影,薄荷绿、金色与石板灰配色,米白底。顶部中央粗体几何标题「货币的故事」,一条趋势箭头贯穿所有阶段,硬币堆图标作为项目符号。

prompt_en: A civics flow-diagram infographic explaining how a bill becomes law in the fictional Republic of Valen. Boxes connected by arrows trace 'idea', 'drafting', 'lower house vote', 'upper house vote', 'president signs', 'becomes law', with a branching 'veto' loop back. Numbered steps and small icons (quill, ballot, gavel, seal). Clean flat vector style, a civic red-white-and-blue palette on light grey, rounded rectangular nodes with subtle shadows. Strong sans-serif title 'How a Bill Becomes Law' at the top, a decision diamond for the veto branch.
prompt_zh: 一张公民教育流程图信息图,讲解在虚构的「瓦伦共和国」里法案如何成为法律。方框由箭头相连,依次为「提案」「起草」「下议院表决」「上议院表决」「总统签署」「成为法律」,并有一条「否决」的分支回环。编号步骤与小图标(羽毛笔、选票、法槌、印章)。干净的扁平矢量风格,公民感的红白蓝配色,浅灰底,圆角矩形节点带轻微投影。顶部有力的无衬线标题「法案如何成为法律」,否决分支用一个判断菱形表示。

prompt_en: A supply-chain flow infographic tracing coffee from farm to cup. A left-to-right path with illustrated stops - cherry picking, washing, drying, roasting, grinding, brewing - each numbered with a short caption and an icon. An invented brand 'Cerro Verde Coffee' appears on a roasting bag. Warm earthy palette of coffee-brown, leaf-green and cream, hand-drawn flat illustration with grain texture. A curved dotted route connects the stages, with small mountain and truck icons for transport. Rounded title banner 'From Bean to Cup' at the top.
prompt_zh: 一张供应链流程信息图,追踪咖啡从农场到杯中的旅程。一条从左到右的路径串联插画式站点——采摘咖啡果、水洗、晾晒、烘焙、研磨、冲煮——每站编号并配简短说明与图标。虚构品牌「Cerro Verde Coffee」出现在一只烘焙豆袋上。暖大地色调,咖啡棕、叶绿与奶白,手绘扁平插画带颗粒质感。弯曲虚线路线连接各阶段,配小山与卡车图标表示运输。顶部圆角标题横幅「从咖啡豆到一杯咖啡」。

name_en: The Life of a Plastic Bottle
prompt_en: A process-flow infographic of how a plastic bottle gets recycled, drawn as a circular loop diagram. Six numbered stages - collect, sort, shred, wash, melt, remould - sit around a ring linked by green arrows, each with a simple line icon and a one-line caption. Clean eco-modern style on a recycled-paper texture background, forest-green, aqua and kraft-brown palette. A central recycling emblem, a bold title 'The Life of a Plastic Bottle' arced above it, a small stat callout '1 bottle equals new fibre in 6 weeks'.
prompt_zh: 一张流程信息图,讲解一只塑料瓶如何被回收,画成环形闭环图。六个编号阶段——收集、分拣、粉碎、清洗、熔化、重塑——围绕圆环排列,由绿色箭头相连,每阶段配简单线条图标与一句说明。干净的环保现代风格,再生纸质感背景,森林绿、水绿与牛皮纸棕配色。中央一个回收标志,上方弧形粗体标题「一只塑料瓶的一生」,一个小数据标注「1 只瓶 6 周变新纤维」。

prompt_en: A tech process infographic of the software development lifecycle shown as a horizontal pipeline. Stages - plan, design, build, test, deploy, monitor - appear as connected hexagonal nodes with matching icons and a one-line goal each, plus a feedback arrow looping from monitor back to plan. Modern dark-UI aesthetic, indigo-and-teal gradient nodes on charcoal, monospace labels. Title 'The Software Development Lifecycle' top-left in a clean geometric font, a subtle grid and code-bracket motif in the background.
prompt_zh: 一张技术流程信息图,把软件开发生命周期画成横向流水线。各阶段——规划、设计、开发、测试、部署、监控——呈现为相连的六边形节点,配对应图标与一句目标,并有一条反馈箭头从监控回环到规划。现代暗色 UI 美学,靛蓝与青色渐变节点,炭黑底,等宽字体标签。左上角干净几何字体标题「软件开发生命周期」,背景是隐约的网格与代码括号纹样。

prompt_en: A logistics flow infographic showing an online order's journey from click to doorstep. An isometric path links 'order placed', 'payment', 'warehouse pick', 'pack', 'ship', 'out for delivery', 'delivered', each on a small 3D platform with an icon and a step number. A bright friendly palette of coral, sky-blue and mint on white, soft isometric illustration with long shadows. A dotted conveyor route with a moving parcel motif. Bold rounded title 'Where's My Order?' upper-left, a small map pin at the final step.
prompt_zh: 一张物流流程信息图,展示网购订单从下单到送达门口的旅程。等距路径串联「下单」「支付」「仓库拣货」「打包」「发货」「派送中」「已送达」,每步立于一个小型三维平台上,配图标与步骤编号。明快友好的配色,珊瑚红、天蓝与薄荷绿,白底,柔和等距插画带长投影。虚线传送路线配一个移动的包裹图案。左上角粗体圆角标题「我的包裹到哪了」,最后一步处配一个小地图标记。

prompt_en: A gardening process infographic explaining home composting as a layered cutaway of a compost bin plus a circular flow. The bin cross-section shows alternating 'greens' and 'browns' layers, worms, and finished dark compost at the base; a surrounding loop diagram labels 'collect scraps', 'layer', 'aerate', 'decompose', 'harvest'. Hand-drawn earthy illustration, soil-brown, leaf-green and sunny-yellow palette on recycled-paper beige. Friendly rounded title 'Turn Scraps into Soil' at the top, small icons for a banana peel, leaves and an eggshell.
prompt_zh: 一张园艺流程信息图,以堆肥箱的分层剖面加环形流程讲解家庭堆肥。堆肥箱剖面展示交替的「绿料」与「棕料」层、蚯蚓,以及底部已成熟的深色堆肥;外围一圈闭环图标注「收集厨余」「分层」「通气」「分解」「收获」。手绘大地色插画,土棕、叶绿与阳光黄配色,再生纸米色底。顶部友好的圆角标题「厨余变沃土:堆肥指南」,配香蕉皮、落叶与蛋壳的小图标。

prompt_en: A manufacturing process infographic of how paper is made, shown as a factory line flowing left to right. Illustrated stages - logs, wood chips, a pulping vat, screening, pressing rollers, drying, and a finished paper roll - connect via a conveyor with numbered steps and short captions. Clean industrial flat style, muted teal machinery, kraft-brown and grey palette on off-white, thin blueprint accent lines. Title 'How Paper Is Made' bold at top-left, small water-drop and heat icons marking key inputs.
prompt_zh: 一张制造流程信息图,讲解纸张的生产,画成从左到右流动的工厂生产线。插画式阶段——原木、木片、制浆槽、筛选、压榨辊、烘干,以及成品纸卷——通过一条传送带相连,配编号步骤与简短说明。干净的工业扁平风格,低调青色机械,牛皮纸棕与灰配色,米白底,细蓝图点缀线条。左上角粗体标题「纸是怎么造出来的」,小水滴与热量图标标出关键投入。

prompt_en: An education flowchart infographic of the scientific method drawn as a top-to-bottom decision diagram. Rounded boxes read 'ask a question', 'do background research', 'form a hypothesis', 'test with an experiment', 'analyze data', then a decision diamond 'hypothesis supported?' branching to 'report results' or looping back to refine. Crisp flat vector, a chalkboard-teal background with white and lemon-yellow nodes, playful science icons (flask, magnifier, lightbulb). Bold title 'The Scientific Method' at the top, dashed arrows between steps.
prompt_zh: 一张教育流程图信息图,把科学方法画成自上而下的决策图。圆角框依次写着「提出问题」「查阅背景资料」「提出假设」「实验验证」「分析数据」,随后一个判断菱形「假设成立吗?」,分支到「报告结果」或回环去修正。清爽扁平矢量,黑板青色背景配白色与柠檬黄节点,俏皮的科学图标(烧瓶、放大镜、灯泡)。顶部粗体标题「科学方法流程」,步骤之间用虚线箭头连接。

prompt_en: A civil-engineering process infographic of how a water treatment plant cleans water, drawn as a stepped cutaway flowing left to right and slightly downhill. Stages - intake screen, coagulation, sedimentation, filtration, disinfection, storage, tap - each show a labeled tank illustration and a one-line note. Cool clean palette of aqua, deep-blue and white on pale grey, semi-technical flat illustration with cross-section tanks. Bold title 'From River to Tap' top-left, a small droplet quality-meter improving along the path.
prompt_zh: 一张土木工程流程信息图,讲解自来水厂如何净水,画成从左到右、略微向下流动的阶梯剖面。各阶段——进水格栅、混凝、沉淀、过滤、消毒、储水、龙头——各配带标注的水池插画与一句说明。冷调干净配色,水绿、深蓝与白,浅灰底,半技术扁平插画,剖面式水池。左上角粗体标题「从河流到水龙头」,一个小水滴水质表沿途逐步变好。

prompt_en: A UX process infographic laid out as a customer-support decision tree for a fictional app 'BrightDesk'. A top question 'What's your issue?' branches through diamonds - 'account?', 'billing?', 'bug?' - into rounded outcome cards with recommended actions and an icon each. Clean modern flat style, a soft lavender-and-white palette with a coral accent for endpoints, connector lines with directional arrows. Monospace step labels, bold title 'Support Decision Tree' upper-left, a small chat-bubble mascot in the corner.
prompt_zh: 一张用户体验流程信息图,为虚构应用「BrightDesk」画一棵客服决策树。顶部问题「你遇到什么问题?」经由菱形——「账号?」「账单?」「故障?」——分支到圆角结果卡片,每张配推荐操作与一个图标。干净的现代扁平风格,柔和薰衣草紫与白配色,终点用珊瑚色点缀,连接线带方向箭头。等宽字体步骤标签,左上角粗体标题「客服问题决策树」,角落一个小聊天气泡吉祥物。

prompt_en: A medical infographic of a human heart shown in labeled cross-section, filling the center of the frame. Chambers, valves, the aorta and the vena cava are clearly rendered; blue arrows trace deoxygenated blood and red arrows trace oxygenated flow through the four chambers. Thin leader lines connect to a right-hand label column. Clean anatomical-illustration style with soft shading, a crimson and cobalt palette on a warm off-white background. Bold title 'How the Heart Pumps' top-left, a small pulse-line and BPM stat as accents.
prompt_zh: 一张医学信息图,展示带标注的人体心脏剖面,占据画面中央。心房心室、瓣膜、主动脉与腔静脉清晰呈现;蓝色箭头示意缺氧血,红色箭头示意含氧血在四个腔室间的流向。细引线连向右侧标签列。干净的解剖插画风格,柔和明暗,绯红与钴蓝配色,暖米白背景。左上角粗体标题「心脏如何泵血」,以一条脉搏线与心率数值作点缀。

prompt_en: A health infographic of the human respiratory system centered on a front-facing torso showing the nasal passage, trachea, bronchi and detailed lungs, with a zoomed inset of an alveolus and gas exchange (O2 in, CO2 out) using colored arrows. Numbered labels run along both sides. Soft flat medical illustration, coral-pink lungs on a calm mint background, thin teal leader lines. A rounded title 'How You Breathe' at the top, a small diaphragm-motion diagram bottom-center.
prompt_zh: 一张健康信息图,以正面躯干为中心展示人体呼吸系统,呈现鼻腔、气管、支气管与细致的肺,并配一个肺泡放大插图,用彩色箭头示意气体交换(氧气进,二氧化碳出)。编号标签沿两侧排列。柔和的扁平医学插画,珊瑚粉色的肺置于平静的薄荷绿背景上,细青色引线。顶部圆角标题「呼吸的原理」,画面底部中央一个小小的膈肌运动示意图。

prompt_en: A health infographic tracing the journey of food through the digestive system as a numbered vertical path over a semi-transparent body silhouette. Stops - mouth, esophagus, stomach, small intestine, large intestine - each carry a short caption on what happens and an icon, plus an average transit-time badge. Friendly flat illustration, warm peach, olive and cream palette, rounded organs with subtle texture. Bold title 'The Journey of a Meal' upper-left, a small apple icon marking the start.
prompt_zh: 一张健康信息图,以叠在半透明人体轮廓上的编号竖向路径,追踪食物穿过消化系统的旅程。各站点——口腔、食道、胃、小肠、大肠——各配一句「这里发生了什么」的说明与图标,以及一个平均通过时间的标签。友好的扁平插画,暖桃色、橄榄绿与奶白配色,圆润的器官带轻微质感。左上角粗体标题「一餐饭的旅程」,起点处以一个小苹果图标标记。

prompt_en: An anatomy infographic of the human skeleton shown full-length and front-facing, with major bones labeled - skull, clavicle, ribcage, humerus, spine, pelvis, femur, tibia - via thin leader lines to left and right label chips. A small inset zooms into bone layers (compact and spongy). Clean textbook illustration style, bone-ivory on a slate-blue background, coral accent for highlighted bones. Bold serif title 'The Human Skeleton' at the top, a mini joint-type legend (hinge, ball-and-socket) in the corner.
prompt_zh: 一张解剖信息图,展示全身正面的人体骨骼,主要骨骼——颅骨、锁骨、胸廓、肱骨、脊柱、骨盆、股骨、胫骨——通过细引线连向左右两侧的标签块。一个小插图放大展示骨的分层(密质骨与松质骨)。干净的教科书插画风格,骨白色置于石板蓝背景上,重点骨骼以珊瑚色点缀。顶部粗体衬线标题「人体骨骼图」,角落一个小小的关节类型图例(屈戍关节、球窝关节)。

prompt_en: A medical infographic of the human eye in labeled cross-section explaining how vision works. Light rays enter through the cornea and lens, focus onto the retina (shown inverted), and travel via the optic nerve to a small brain icon. Parts - cornea, iris, pupil, lens, retina, optic nerve - are labeled with leader lines. Detailed anatomical illustration, amber-and-teal iris detail on a deep charcoal background, a glowing light-ray path. Bold title 'How We See' top-left, a compact ray-diagram inset.
prompt_zh: 一张医学信息图,以带标注的人眼剖面讲解视觉如何形成。光线经角膜与晶状体进入,聚焦在视网膜上(呈倒像),再经视神经传向一个小脑图标。各部位——角膜、虹膜、瞳孔、晶状体、视网膜、视神经——以引线标注。细腻的解剖插画,琥珀与青色的虹膜细节,深炭黑背景,一条发光的光线路径。左上角粗体标题「我们如何看见」,配一个紧凑的光路示意插图。

prompt_en: A fitness infographic of major muscle groups mapped over front-and-back athletic body outlines shown side by side. Color-coded regions - chest, biceps, abs, quads on the front; back, triceps, glutes, calves on the rear - link to label chips with a sample exercise each. A bold energetic palette of electric blue, orange and slate, clean flat illustration with subtle muscle striations. A strong uppercase title 'Know Your Muscles' at the top, a small dumbbell icon legend.
prompt_zh: 一张健身信息图,把主要肌肉群标注在并排的正面与背面运动体型轮廓上。分色区域——正面的胸肌、二头肌、腹肌、股四头肌;背面的背肌、三头肌、臀肌、小腿——各连向标签块,配一个示例训练动作。有力而活力的配色,电光蓝、橙与石板灰,干净的扁平插画带隐约肌肉纹理。顶部有力的大写标题「认识你的肌肉群」,配一个小哑铃图标图例。

prompt_en: A neuroscience infographic of the human brain shown in side profile, divided into color-coded regions - the frontal, parietal, temporal and occipital lobes plus the cerebellum and brain stem - each with a leader line to a card listing its main function. Clean flat medical illustration with soft gradients, pastel multicolor lobes on a deep indigo background. Bold title 'Map of the Brain' top-left, a small neuron icon and a 'left vs right hemisphere' mini-legend in the lower corner.
prompt_zh: 一张神经科学信息图,以侧面轮廓展示人脑,分为按颜色区分的区域——额叶、顶叶、颞叶、枕叶,以及小脑与脑干——每个区域以引线连向一张卡片,列出其主要功能。干净的扁平医学插画,柔和渐变,粉彩多色脑叶置于深靛蓝背景上。左上角粗体标题「大脑功能分区图」,右下角一个小神经元图标与「左右半球」的小图例。

prompt_en: A health infographic of the nightly sleep cycle drawn as a wavy line graph across an 8-hour axis. The curve dips through stages - light sleep, deep sleep, REM - repeating in cycles, with shaded bands and moon-phase icons marking each stage; side cards explain what the body does in each. A calm nocturnal palette of midnight-blue, lavender and soft gold, minimal flat style with a starry background. Bold rounded title 'Inside a Night's Sleep' at the top, a small alarm-clock icon at the wake point.
prompt_zh: 一张健康信息图,把一整夜的睡眠周期画成横跨 8 小时坐标轴的波浪折线图。曲线在各阶段间起伏——浅睡、深睡、快速眼动——循环往复,以阴影带与月相图标标记每个阶段;侧边卡片说明每个阶段身体在做什么。宁静的夜间配色,午夜蓝、薰衣草紫与柔金,极简扁平风格配星空背景。顶部粗体圆角标题「一夜睡眠的秘密」,醒来处配一个小闹钟图标。

prompt_en: A nutrition infographic built around a top-down 'balanced plate' divided into wedges - half vegetables and fruit, a quarter whole grains, a quarter protein - plus a side circle for dairy and a small oil dispenser. Each section is labeled with example foods and a macro tag (carbs, protein, fat). Fresh flat illustration, an appetizing tomato-red, broccoli-green and grain-gold palette on cream. Bold rounded title 'Build a Balanced Plate' at the top, a small water-glass icon and a portion-size hand guide beside it.
prompt_zh: 一张营养信息图,以俯视的「均衡餐盘」为核心,分成几块——一半蔬菜与水果、四分之一全谷物、四分之一蛋白质——外加一个乳制品的配盘小圆与一个小油壶。每一块标注示例食物与营养素标签(碳水、蛋白质、脂肪)。清新的扁平插画,诱人的番茄红、西兰花绿与谷物金配色,奶白底。顶部粗体圆角标题「搭配均衡餐盘」,旁边一个小水杯图标与「用手估份量」的指南。

prompt_en: A health infographic explaining how a vaccine trains the immune system, drawn as a four-panel numbered sequence. Panels show the injection of a harmless antigen, immune cells detecting it, antibody production, and memory cells ready for the real pathogen. Simple friendly cell characters with icons, arrows linking the panels. Clean flat medical style, a calming teal, coral and white palette on light grey. Bold title 'How Vaccines Work' upper-left, a small shield motif and a one-line takeaway caption at the base.
prompt_zh: 一张健康信息图,讲解疫苗如何训练免疫系统,画成四格编号序列。四格分别展示注射无害的抗原、免疫细胞识别它、产生抗体,以及记忆细胞随时应对真正的病原体。简单友好的细胞角色配图标,箭头串联各格。干净的扁平医学风格,舒缓的青色、珊瑚色与白配色,浅灰底。左上角粗体标题「疫苗的工作原理」,底部一个小盾牌图案与一句要点说明。

prompt_en: A geography infographic showing world climate zones on a simplified flat world map. Horizontal color bands mark tropical, arid, temperate, continental and polar zones, each with a legend swatch, a short description and a representative icon (palm, cactus, oak, pine, snowflake). A muted cartographic palette of teal ocean and warm-to-cool land bands, clean flat vector with thin latitude lines and a labeled equator and tropics. Bold title 'Climate Zones of the World' at the top, a compact legend panel in the lower corner.
prompt_zh: 一张地理信息图,在简化的平面世界地图上展示世界气候带。水平色带标示热带、干旱带、温带、大陆性与极地气候,每条配图例色块、简短说明与代表图标(棕榈、仙人掌、橡树、松树、雪花)。低饱和地图配色,青色海洋配从暖到冷的陆地色带,干净的扁平矢量,细纬线并标注赤道与回归线。顶部粗体标题「世界气候带」,右下角一块紧凑的图例面板。

prompt_en: A geology infographic mapping Earth's major tectonic plates on a flat world map. Plate boundaries are drawn as bold outlines with arrows showing convergent, divergent and transform motion; hotspots and a labeled fault appear as icons. Each major plate is a distinct muted color with its name. A cross-section inset shows subduction and a mid-ocean ridge. Earthy palette of ochre, slate and deep-blue ocean, clean flat style. Bold title 'Earth's Tectonic Plates' top-left, a small boundary-type legend.
prompt_zh: 一张地质信息图,在平面世界地图上标出地球的主要构造板块。板块边界以粗轮廓绘出,箭头表示汇聚、离散与转换运动;热点与一处标注的断层以图标呈现。每块主要板块用一种低饱和颜色区分并标名。一个剖面插图展示俯冲作用与大洋中脊。大地色调,赭石、石板灰与深蓝海洋,干净的扁平风格。左上角粗体标题「地球板块构造」,配一个小小的边界类型图例。

prompt_en: A geography infographic of global ocean currents drawn over a flat world map. Warm currents are red-orange arrows, cold currents are blue arrows, looping in great circular gyres across the oceans; key currents carry small labels. Continents are rendered in flat pale sand, ocean in a gradient teal. Clean cartographic vector style with a subtle wave texture. Bold title 'Rivers in the Ocean' at the top, a legend distinguishing warm and cold flow, small thermometer and compass icons as accents.
prompt_zh: 一张地理信息图,在平面世界地图上绘出全球洋流。暖流为红橙箭头,寒流为蓝色箭头,在各大洋中盘绕成巨大的环形洋流圈;主要洋流配小标签。大陆以扁平的浅沙色呈现,海洋为青色渐变。干净的地图矢量风格,隐约的波浪质感。顶部粗体标题「海洋中的洋流」,一个区分冷暖流向的图例,以温度计与罗盘小图标作点缀。

prompt_en: An earth-science infographic showing the layers of the Earth as a cutaway quarter-sphere wedge. Concentric bands - crust, upper mantle, lower mantle, outer core, inner core - are color-coded from cool crust-grey to a glowing white-hot core, each labeled with depth, temperature and state (solid or liquid). Thin white leader lines connect to a right-hand data column. Semi-realistic gradient illustration on a dark starry background. Bold title 'Inside Our Planet' top-left, a small scale bar in kilometers.
prompt_zh: 一张地球科学信息图,把地球的分层画成四分之一球体的剖切楔形。同心色带——地壳、上地幔、下地幔、外核、内核——从冷灰的地壳渐变到炽热发白的地核,每层标注深度、温度与状态(固态或液态)。细白引线连向右侧数据列。半写实渐变插画,深色星空背景。左上角粗体标题「地球的内部结构」,配一根以千米为单位的小比例尺。

prompt_en: A geography infographic mapping the world's biomes on a simplified flat map. Regions are filled with distinct colors and mini pattern icons for rainforest, desert, grassland, tundra, temperate forest and taiga, each keyed to a legend with a short climate note and a representative animal. A rich natural palette of jungle-green, sand, savanna-gold and icy-blue, flat vector with a soft paper texture. Bold rounded title 'Biomes of the World' at the top, small thermometer-and-rain icons per biome in the legend.
prompt_zh: 一张地理信息图,在简化的平面地图上标出世界的生物群系。各区域以不同颜色与小图案填充,代表雨林、沙漠、草原、苔原、温带森林与针叶林,每种对应图例中的一段简短气候说明与一种代表动物。丰富的自然配色,丛林绿、沙色、草原金与冰蓝,扁平矢量带柔和纸质感。顶部粗体圆角标题「世界生物群系」,图例中每种群系配温度计与降雨的小图标。

prompt_en: A geography infographic of world time zones shown as a flat world map sliced into vertical colored bands, each labeled with its UTC offset (minus 3, minus 2, minus 1, 0, plus 1, plus 2 and so on). The prime meridian and the international date line are highlighted; small clock faces sit atop several bands showing the hour when it is noon at UTC. A cool blue-grey map with alternating soft band tints. Clean flat vector, bold title 'A World of Time Zones' at the top, a compact 'how to read this' legend below.
prompt_zh: 一张地理信息图,把世界时区画成切成竖向彩带的平面世界地图,每条标注其 UTC 偏移(减 3、减 2、减 1、0、加 1、加 2 等)。本初子午线与国际日期变更线被高亮;若干色带顶部放置小钟面,显示当 UTC 为正午时各地的时刻。冷蓝灰地图配交替的柔和色带。干净的扁平矢量,顶部粗体标题「世界时区图」,下方一个紧凑的「如何阅读」图例。

prompt_en: A playful illustrated tourist map of the fictional tropical island 'Marisol'. A top-down stylized map shows beaches, a volcano, rainforest trails, a harbor town and coral snorkel spots, each with a cute icon, a name label and a numbered legend of attractions. Hand-drawn cartographic style, vibrant turquoise sea, sandy coast and jungle-green, with a compass rose, scale bar and dotted ferry routes. A decorative title banner 'Welcome to Marisol Island' at the top, tiny palm and sailboat doodles scattered around.
prompt_zh: 一张俏皮的插画式旅游地图,描绘虚构的热带岛屿「马里索尔岛」。俯视风格化地图展示海滩、一座火山、雨林步道、一座港口小镇与珊瑚浮潜点,每处配可爱图标、名称标签与编号的景点图例。手绘地图风格,鲜亮的绿松石色海面、沙色海岸与丛林绿,配罗盘玫瑰、比例尺与虚线渡轮航线。顶部装饰性标题横幅「欢迎来到马里索尔岛」,四周点缀小棕榈与帆船涂鸦。

prompt_en: A geography infographic of mountain altitude zones drawn as a single tall cross-section of a peak from base to summit. Horizontal bands mark deciduous forest, coniferous forest, the tree line, alpine meadow, and permanent snow, each labeled with elevation in meters, a typical temperature and a plant or animal icon. Layered flat illustration in a gradient from valley-green up to snow-white against a blue sky. Bold vertical title 'Life by Altitude' along the left, a small elevation ruler up the right edge.
prompt_zh: 一张地理信息图,把山地的海拔分带画成一座从山脚到山顶的高大剖面。水平色带标示落叶林、针叶林、林线、高山草甸与终年积雪,每带标注以米为单位的海拔、典型气温与一个植物或动物图标。分层扁平插画,从谷底绿渐变到雪白,衬以蓝天。左侧粗体竖排标题「海拔与生命分带」,右缘一根小海拔标尺向上延伸。

prompt_en: A geography infographic explaining a river system from source to sea, drawn as a top-down flowing map. Labeled features - source, tributaries, meanders, floodplain, oxbow lake and a branching delta - trace the blue river across green land into a teal ocean. Icons for rainfall, a dam and a riverside town appear along the way. Clean flat cartographic style, a fresh green-and-blue palette on cream, thin contour lines. Bold title 'Journey of a River' top-left, a small arrow legend for upstream and downstream, a cross-section inset of the riverbank.
prompt_zh: 一张地理信息图,讲解一条河流从源头到入海的过程,画成俯视的流动地图。带标注的地貌——源头、支流、河曲、洪泛平原、牛轭湖与分汊三角洲——沿着蓝色河流穿过绿色土地注入青色海洋。沿途出现降雨、水坝与河畔小镇的图标。干净的扁平地图风格,清新的绿蓝配色,米白底,细等高线。左上角粗体标题「一条河的旅程」,一个上下游方向的小箭头图例,以及一个河岸剖面插图。

prompt_en: A geology infographic showing continental drift across three stacked world maps. The top map shows the supercontinent Pangaea, the middle shows it splitting, and the bottom shows today's continents, each with an era label in millions of years and directional drift arrows. Matching puzzle-piece coastlines are color-coded to show former neighbors. An earthy muted palette of moss-green land and slate ocean, flat vector with a faint parchment texture. Bold title 'The Drifting Continents' at the top, a small timeline arrow linking the three stages.
prompt_zh: 一张地质信息图,用三张上下叠放的世界地图展示大陆漂移。上图为超大陆盘古大陆,中图为其分裂,下图为今日的各大洲,每张配以百万年为单位的时代标签与方向漂移箭头。彼此契合的拼图状海岸线以颜色区分,显示曾经的相邻关系。大地色低饱和配色,苔藓绿陆地与石板灰海洋,扁平矢量带淡淡羊皮纸质感。顶部粗体标题「漂移的大陆」,一个小时间轴箭头串联三个阶段。

prompt_en: A clean-tech infographic explaining how a solar panel powers a home, drawn as a left-to-right energy flow. Sunlight hits a rooftop panel (a zoomed inset shows photovoltaic cells knocking electrons loose), current runs to an inverter converting DC to AC, then to a house and a battery, with excess feeding the grid. A bright optimistic palette of sky-blue, sunny-yellow and slate, flat vector with soft gradients. Numbered steps 1-5, bold title 'How Solar Panels Work' top-left, a glowing arrow flow, a small kWh meter icon.
prompt_zh: 一张清洁能源信息图,讲解太阳能板如何为家庭供电,画成从左到右的能量流。阳光照到屋顶太阳能板上(放大插图展示光伏电池把电子敲出),电流流向把直流变交流的逆变器,再送往房屋与电池,多余电量回馈电网。明快乐观的配色,天蓝、阳光黄与石板灰,扁平矢量带柔和渐变。编号步骤 1 至 5,左上角粗体标题「太阳能板如何工作」,发光的箭头流向,一个小的千瓦时电表图标。

prompt_en: A technology infographic explaining how Wi-Fi delivers internet, shown as a layered flow from the internet cloud to a phone. Stages - a fiber line, a modem, a router broadcasting radio waves, and connecting devices - each carry an icon, with concentric signal-wave rings radiating from the router. Clean modern flat style, a cool blue-and-teal palette with a magenta signal accent on light grey. Numbered captions, bold title 'How Wi-Fi Works' upper-left, a small frequency badge (2.4 vs 5 GHz) and a range diagram in the corner.
prompt_zh: 一张技术信息图,讲解 Wi-Fi 如何传送网络,呈现为从互联网云到手机的分层流程。各阶段——光纤线路、调制解调器、广播无线电波的路由器,以及连接的设备——各配图标,信号波环从路由器同心扩散。干净的现代扁平风格,冷调蓝青配色,品红信号点缀,浅灰底。编号说明,左上角粗体标题「Wi-Fi 是怎么工作的」,角落一个频段标签(2.4 与 5 GHz)与一个覆盖范围示意图。

prompt_en: A technology infographic of how an electric car works, drawn as a cutaway side view of a stylized EV (invented brand 'Voltano'). Labeled components - a battery pack under the floor, an electric motor, an inverter, a charging port, and regenerative brakes - connect with colored energy-flow arrows from plug to wheels. Sleek modern flat illustration, an electric-teal, graphite and lime-accent palette on white. Numbered leader labels, bold title 'How an Electric Car Works' top-left, a small battery-charge gauge and range figure as accents.
prompt_zh: 一张技术信息图,讲解电动汽车如何运转,画成风格化电动车的剖面侧视图(虚构品牌「Voltano」)。带标注的部件——地板下的电池组、电动机、逆变器、充电口与再生制动——用彩色能量流箭头从插头连到车轮。时尚的现代扁平插画,电光青、石墨灰配柠檬绿点缀,白底。编号引线标签,左上角粗体标题「电动汽车如何运转」,以一个小电量表与续航数字作点缀。

prompt_en: A technology infographic explaining how GPS finds your location, drawn as a scene with three or four satellites beaming signals down to a phone on a stylized globe. Dotted signal lines and expanding range circles illustrate trilateration; numbered captions explain 'satellites broadcast time', 'phone measures delay', 'overlap pinpoints you'. A space-dark background with earth-blue and orange signal accents, clean flat vector. Bold title 'How GPS Locates You' at the top, a small crosshair pin and accuracy-meter icon.
prompt_zh: 一张技术信息图,讲解 GPS 如何找到你的位置,画成三四颗卫星向风格化地球上的一部手机发射信号的场景。虚线信号线与不断扩大的范围圆示意三点定位;编号说明写着「卫星广播时间」「手机测量延迟」「交叠锁定你」。太空深色背景,地球蓝与橙色信号点缀,干净的扁平矢量。顶部粗体标题「GPS 如何定位你」,一个小十字准星标记与精度表图标。

prompt_en: A technology infographic explaining how a capacitive touchscreen works, shown as an exploded layer stack of a phone screen. Labeled layers - protective glass, a transparent electrode grid, a sensor layer, and the display - separate vertically; a fingertip touches the top, and a zoomed inset shows the electrical charge change detected at the grid. A clean tech aesthetic, a cool grey-and-cyan palette with a coral touch-point accent on dark charcoal. Bold title 'How a Touchscreen Senses You' top-left, numbered layer labels, a small grid-coordinate readout.
prompt_zh: 一张技术信息图,讲解电容式触摸屏如何工作,呈现为手机屏幕的分层爆炸图。带标注的各层——保护玻璃、透明电极网格、传感层与显示屏——竖向分开;一根指尖触碰顶层,一个放大插图展示网格处被检测到的电荷变化。干净的科技美学,冷灰与青配色,珊瑚色触点点缀,深炭黑底。左上角粗体标题「触摸屏如何感知触碰」,编号的层级标签,一个小的网格坐标读数。

prompt_en: An engineering infographic of how a jet engine works, drawn as a detailed cutaway of a turbofan flowing left to right. Labeled stages - intake fan, compressor, combustion chamber, turbine, exhaust nozzle - are color-zoned from cool intake-blue to hot combustion-orange, with airflow arrows and a fuel-injection icon. Semi-technical flat illustration with thin blueprint accents on a dark navy background. Bold uppercase title 'Inside a Jet Engine' top-left, numbered callouts, a small thrust arrow at the nozzle.
prompt_zh: 一张工程信息图,讲解喷气发动机如何工作,画成涡扇发动机从左到右的细致剖面。带标注的各段——进气风扇、压气机、燃烧室、涡轮、尾喷管——按颜色分区,从冷调进气蓝到炽热燃烧橙,配气流箭头与一个燃油喷射图标。半技术扁平插画,细蓝图点缀,深藏青背景。左上角粗体大写标题「喷气发动机内部」,编号说明,尾喷管处一个小推力箭头。

name_zh: 固态硬盘如何存储数据
prompt_en: A technology infographic explaining how a solid-state drive stores data, contrasting it with a spinning hard drive. Left: a stylized SSD chip grid with a zoomed inset of memory cells holding 1s and 0s as trapped charge; right: a mini comparison table of SSD vs HDD (speed, moving parts, noise). A clean tech palette of electric blue, slate and lime on dark grey, flat vector with circuit accents. Bold title 'How an SSD Remembers' top-left, numbered captions, small bit-grid animation-style icons.
prompt_zh: 一张技术信息图,讲解固态硬盘如何存储数据,并与传统机械硬盘对比。左侧:风格化的固态硬盘芯片网格,配一个放大插图展示以被困电荷保存 1 与 0 的存储单元;右侧:一个固态硬盘对比机械硬盘的小表格(速度、机械部件、噪音)。干净的科技配色,电光蓝、石板灰与柠檬绿,深灰底,扁平矢量配电路点缀。左上角粗体标题「固态硬盘如何存储数据」,编号说明,小小的位网格动画风格图标。

prompt_en: A home-tech infographic explaining how a heat pump heats and cools a house, drawn as a looping refrigerant cycle between an outdoor and indoor unit. Labeled stages - evaporator, compressor, condenser, expansion valve - carry colored arrows (blue for cold, red for warm) around the loop, with a summer/winter toggle showing reversed flow. Clean flat illustration, a cool-and-warm split palette of teal and coral on off-white. Bold rounded title 'How a Heat Pump Works' at the top, numbered steps, a small efficiency (COP) badge.
prompt_zh: 一张家居科技信息图,讲解热泵如何为房屋供暖与制冷,画成室外机与室内机之间循环的制冷剂回路。带标注的各阶段——蒸发器、压缩机、冷凝器、膨胀阀——用彩色箭头(蓝为冷,红为热)绕回路流动,并有一个夏季/冬季切换显示流向反转。干净的扁平插画,冷暖分色配色,青与珊瑚色,米白底。顶部粗体圆角标题「热泵的工作原理」,编号步骤,一个小的能效(COP)标签。

prompt_en: A maker-tech infographic explaining how an FDM 3D printer builds an object, drawn as a labeled machine diagram with a step flow. Components - a filament spool, an extruder hot-end, a heated bed, a moving gantry - are labeled; a numbered sequence shows 'model sliced into layers', 'filament melted', 'deposited layer by layer', 'object cools'. Clean flat illustration, a friendly orange-teal-and-grey palette on white, a half-printed object on the bed. Bold title 'How 3D Printing Works' top-left, a small layer-stack inset and a nozzle close-up.
prompt_zh: 一张创客科技信息图,讲解 FDM 3D 打印机如何构建物体,画成带标注的机器示意图配步骤流程。部件——耗材线轴、挤出热端、加热平台、移动龙门——均有标注;一个编号序列展示「模型切成层」「耗材熔化」「逐层堆积」「物体冷却」。干净的扁平插画,友好的橙青灰配色,白底,平台上摆着一个打印到一半的物体。左上角粗体标题「3D 打印如何成型」,一个小层叠插图与喷嘴特写。

prompt_en: A technology infographic explaining active noise cancelling in headphones, drawn as a cross-section of an ear cup around an ear. Incoming ambient sound waves meet an inverted 'anti-noise' wave generated by the headphone, and the two flatten to silence - shown with layered blue and orange waveforms plus a small mic and speaker icon inside. Sleek modern flat style, a deep-navy, cyan and coral palette on light grey. Bold title 'How Noise Cancelling Works' top-left, numbered captions, a waveform legend.
prompt_zh: 一张技术信息图,讲解耳机的主动降噪,画成一只耳罩围绕耳朵的剖面。外界的环境声波遇上耳机生成的反相「反噪声」波,两者相互抵消归于安静——以叠加的蓝橙波形加耳罩内一个小麦克风与扬声器图标表现。时尚的现代扁平风格,深藏青、青与珊瑚色配色,浅灰底。左上角粗体标题「降噪耳机的原理」,编号说明,一个波形图例。

prompt_en: A finance-literacy infographic explaining compound interest, built around a snowball rolling downhill that grows bigger at each step. A companion line graph contrasts simple vs compound growth over 30 years, with milestone dollar figures for a savings of $200/month at 7%. Callout cards define 'principal', 'interest', and 'compounding'. Friendly flat illustration, a mint-green, gold and slate palette on off-white. Bold rounded title 'The Magic of Compounding' at the top, an upward arrow motif, a small 'start early' tip card.
prompt_zh: 一张金融素养信息图,讲解复利,以一个滚下坡、每一步都越滚越大的雪球为核心。旁边一张折线图对比 30 年间的单利与复利增长,标注每月存 200 美元、年利率 7% 的各阶段金额。说明卡片定义「本金」「利息」「复利」。友好的扁平插画,薄荷绿、金色与石板灰配色,米白底。顶部粗体圆角标题「复利的魔力」,向上箭头图案,一张「越早开始越好」的小提示卡。

prompt_en: A personal-finance infographic explaining the 50/30/20 budgeting rule as a large donut chart split into three wedges - 50% needs, 30% wants, 20% savings - each labeled with example categories and icons (a house, a coffee cup, a piggy bank). A sample monthly income of $3,000 shows the dollar split beside each slice. Clean modern flat style, a teal, coral and gold palette on white. Bold title 'Budget with 50/30/20' upper-left, a small checklist of tips and a legend along the base.
prompt_zh: 一张个人理财信息图,把 50/30/20 预算法讲解成一个分成三块的大环形图——50% 必需、30% 想要、20% 储蓄——每块标注示例类别与图标(房子、咖啡杯、储蓄罐)。以每月 3000 美元的示例收入,在每块旁标出金额分配。干净的现代扁平风格,青、珊瑚与金色配色,白底。左上角粗体标题「50/30/20 预算法」,底部一份小提示清单与图例。

prompt_en: A finance-literacy infographic contrasting bull and bear markets side by side. The left half, in green, shows a charging bull with a rising line graph and the words 'prices up', 'optimism', 'buying'; the right half, in red, shows a bear with a falling graph and 'prices down', 'caution', 'selling'. A dividing zig-zag line separates the two moods. Bold flat illustration, a confident green-and-red palette on charcoal, clean data-line accents. Strong uppercase title 'Bull vs Bear' at the top, small definition cards and an arrow legend beneath each animal.
prompt_zh: 一张金融素养信息图,把牛市与熊市并排对比。左半部为绿色,是一头冲锋的公牛配上升折线图,以及「价格上涨」「乐观」「买入」;右半部为红色,是一头熊配下跌折线图,以及「价格下跌」「谨慎」「卖出」。一条锯齿分割线区隔两种情绪。有力的扁平插画,自信的绿红配色,炭黑底,干净的数据线点缀。顶部有力的大写标题「牛市与熊市」,每只动物下方配小定义卡片与箭头图例。

prompt_en: A finance-literacy infographic breaking down what makes up a credit score, built around a semicircular gauge from 'poor' to 'excellent' with a needle pointing at a sample 720. A donut beside it splits the factors - payment history 35%, amounts owed 30%, length of history 15%, new credit 10%, credit mix 10% - each with an icon and a one-line tip. Clean flat style, a trust-blue, green and amber palette on white. Bold title 'What Builds Your Credit Score' top-left, a small do-and-don't list.
prompt_zh: 一张金融素养信息图,拆解信用分的构成,以一个从「差」到「优」的半圆仪表盘为核心,指针指向示例的 720。旁边一个环形图分解各项因素——还款记录 35%、欠款金额 30%、账龄长度 15%、新增信用 10%、信用类型 10%——每项配一个图标与一句提示。干净的扁平风格,信任蓝、绿与琥珀配色,白底。左上角粗体标题「信用分由什么构成」,一份小小的宜与忌清单。

prompt_en: An investing infographic mapping risk versus return as a rising diagonal scatter chart. Asset types - a savings account, bonds, index funds, stocks, crypto - are plotted as labeled dots from low-risk/low-return to high-risk/high-return, each with a small icon and a one-line note. Clean flat financial style, a cool-blue-to-warm-red gradient axis on off-white, gridlines and a trend arrow. Bold title 'Risk vs Return' upper-left, a compact legend and a reminder card 'higher potential reward means higher risk'.
prompt_zh: 一张投资信息图,把风险与回报画成一张向上倾斜的散点图。各资产类型——储蓄账户、债券、指数基金、股票、加密货币——作为带标注的圆点,从低风险低回报排到高风险高回报,每个配小图标与一句说明。干净的扁平金融风格,坐标轴从冷蓝渐变到暖红,米白底,网格线与一条趋势箭头。左上角粗体标题「风险与回报」,一个紧凑图例与一张提示卡「潜在收益越高,风险越高」。

prompt_en: A finance-literacy infographic explaining how a mortgage is paid off over time, built around a stacked area chart across 30 years. Two bands - interest (shrinking) and principal (growing) - show how early payments are mostly interest while later ones build equity, using a sample $300,000 loan at 6%. Callouts mark 'year 1', 'the crossover point', 'paid off'. Clean flat style, a navy, teal and gold palette on light grey. Bold title 'How a Mortgage Gets Paid' at the top, a small house-equity fill icon.
prompt_zh: 一张金融素养信息图,讲解房贷如何随时间还清,以横跨 30 年的堆叠面积图为核心。两条色带——利息(逐渐缩小)与本金(逐渐增大)——展示早期还款大多是利息、后期则积累房产净值,采用 30 万美元、年利率 6% 的示例贷款。标注点标出「第 1 年」「交叉点」「还清」。干净的扁平风格,藏青、青与金色配色,浅灰底。顶部粗体标题「房贷是如何还清的」,一个逐渐填满的房屋净值小图标。

prompt_en: A personal-finance infographic explaining the emergency fund, drawn as a staircase leading up to a safe umbrella. Steps mark savings milestones - a $500 starter, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months of expenses - each with a short reason and an icon (a car, a medical cross, a job-loss symbol). A side jar fills up as a progress meter. A warm reassuring palette of teal, sunny-yellow and slate, friendly flat illustration on cream. Bold rounded title 'Build Your Safety Net' top-left, a small monthly-savings tip card at the base.
prompt_zh: 一张个人理财信息图,讲解应急储备金,画成一段通往一把安全雨伞的楼梯。台阶标出储蓄里程碑——500 美元启动、1 个月、3 个月、6 个月的开支——每级配一句原因与一个图标(汽车、医疗十字、失业符号)。侧边一个罐子逐渐填满,充当进度条。暖而安心的配色,青、阳光黄与石板灰,友好的扁平插画,奶白底。左上角粗体圆角标题「建立你的应急储备」,底部一张每月储蓄的小提示卡。

prompt_en: A finance-literacy infographic explaining inflation, shown as a shopping basket whose contents shrink while the price tag climbs over years. A line graph tracks a rising price index; a shrinking coin visualizes falling purchasing power. Callouts define 'inflation rate', 'purchasing power', and 'cost of living'. Clean flat illustration, a warm coral, mustard and slate palette on off-white, an upward price-arrow motif. Bold title 'What Is Inflation?' at the top, a before/after 'a dollar then vs now' mini-panel.
prompt_zh: 一张金融素养信息图,讲解通货膨胀,画成一个购物篮,里面的东西逐年变少而价签逐年升高。一张折线图追踪不断上涨的物价指数;一枚缩小的硬币直观呈现购买力下降。说明标注定义「通胀率」「购买力」「生活成本」。干净的扁平插画,暖珊瑚、芥末黄与石板灰配色,米白底,向上物价箭头图案。顶部粗体标题「什么是通货膨胀」,一个「一美元当年与如今」的前后对比小面板。

prompt_en: An investing infographic explaining diversification through a sample asset-allocation pie chart. Wedges - 60% stocks, 25% bonds, 10% real estate, 5% cash - are each labeled with a percentage, an icon and a one-line role. A companion 'don't put all eggs in one basket' visual shows eggs spread across several baskets. Clean flat financial style, a balanced palette of navy, teal, gold and grey on white. Bold title 'Why Diversify?' upper-left, a small risk-smoothing note and a legend along the base.
prompt_zh: 一张投资信息图,通过一个示例资产配置饼图讲解分散投资。各扇区——股票 60%、债券 25%、房地产 10%、现金 5%——分别标注百分比、一个图标与一句作用说明。旁边一个「不要把鸡蛋放在同一个篮子里」的图示,画着鸡蛋分放在几只篮子中。干净的扁平金融风格,均衡的配色,藏青、青、金与灰,白底。左上角粗体标题「为什么要分散投资」,一段风险平滑的小说明与底部图例。

prompt_en: A finance-literacy infographic comparing two debt-payoff methods side by side. Left: the 'snowball' - pay the smallest balance first, shown as growing snowballs and a motivation curve; right: the 'avalanche' - pay the highest interest first, shown as descending mountain steps that save the most money. A small table lists sample debts, the payoff order and total interest for each. Clean flat style, a cool-blue vs warm-orange split palette on off-white. Bold title 'Snowball vs Avalanche' at the top, a takeaway card 'pick the one you'll stick to'.
prompt_zh: 一张金融素养信息图,把两种还债方法并排对比。左侧:「雪球法」——先还最小的欠款,以越滚越大的雪球与一条动力曲线表现;右侧:「雪崩法」——先还利率最高的欠款,以逐级下降、最省钱的山形台阶表现。一个小表格列出示例债务、还款顺序与各自的总利息。干净的扁平风格,冷蓝对暖橙分色配色,米白底。顶部粗体标题「雪球法与雪崩法还债」,一张要点卡「选一个你能坚持的」。

prompt_en: A cooking infographic laying out how to bake sourdough bread as a numbered 6-step grid. Illustrated steps - feed the starter, mix and autolyse, stretch and fold, bulk ferment, shape and proof, score and bake - each carry a small hand-drawn icon, a one-line instruction and a timing badge. A warm artisan palette of wheat-gold, crust-brown and cream on a linen-textured background. A rounded chalk-style title 'Sourdough, Step by Step' at the top, a finished crackly loaf illustration and a baker's-percentage note in the corner.
prompt_zh: 一张烹饪信息图,把烤制酸种面包排成编号的六步网格。插画式步骤——喂养酵种、混合与自解、拉伸折叠、基础发酵、整形与醒发、割包与烘烤——每步配一个小手绘图标、一句说明与一个时间标签。暖手工感配色,麦金、面包壳棕与奶白,亚麻质感背景。顶部圆角粉笔风格标题「酸种面包分步图」,角落一个烤好的开裂面包插画与一段烘焙百分比说明。

prompt_en: A food infographic exploding a ramen bowl into its labeled components, drawn as a top-down bowl with leader lines pointing to each ingredient - broth, wavy noodles, chashu pork, a soft-boiled egg, nori, scallions, corn and bamboo shoots. A side column notes broth types (shoyu, miso, tonkotsu). Appetizing flat illustration with soft shadows, a warm cream, ramen-gold and nori-green palette. Bold hand-lettered title 'Anatomy of a Ramen Bowl' upper-left, small chopsticks and steam-swirl accents.
prompt_zh: 一张美食信息图,把一碗拉面拆解成各个带标注的组成部分,画成俯视的碗,引线分别指向每样食材——汤底、波浪面条、叉烧、溏心蛋、海苔、葱花、玉米与笋干。侧边一列注明汤底种类(酱油、味噌、豚骨)。诱人的扁平插画带柔和投影,暖奶白、拉面金与海苔绿配色。左上角粗体手写标题「一碗拉面的构成」,以小筷子与蒸汽漩涡作点缀。

prompt_en: A cooking infographic showing how to brew pour-over coffee as a clean numbered sequence. Steps - rinse the filter, add 20g ground coffee, bloom with 40g water, pour in slow circles to 320g, let it draw down, serve - each carry a minimalist line icon, a ratio note and a small timer. A modern minimalist palette of coffee-brown, cream and sage on off-white, crisp flat illustration of a dripper and a gooseneck kettle. Bold title 'Pour-Over, Step by Step' at the top, a 1:16 ratio badge and a total-time chip.
prompt_zh: 一张烹饪信息图,以干净的编号序列展示如何冲煮手冲咖啡。各步骤——润湿滤纸、加入 20 克咖啡粉、用 40 克水焖蒸、缓慢画圈注水至 320 克、等待滴滤、出杯——每步配一个极简线条图标、一句比例说明与一个小计时器。现代极简配色,咖啡棕、奶白与鼠尾草绿,米白底,清爽的滤杯与鹅颈壶扁平插画。顶部粗体标题「手冲咖啡分步图」,一个 1:16 比例标签与总时长的小色块。

prompt_en: A cooking infographic teaching how to roll a maki sushi roll in a 6-panel numbered sequence. Panels - lay nori on the mat, spread the rice, add the filling, lift and roll, seal the edge, slice into pieces - each carry a clean overhead illustration and a short caption. A fresh palette of nori-green, rice-white, salmon-pink and bamboo-tan on light grey, tidy flat vector style. Bold rounded title 'Roll Your Own Sushi' upper-left, a small bamboo-mat and knife icon, a tip note 'wet your knife between cuts'.
prompt_zh: 一张烹饪信息图,用六格编号序列教如何卷制寿司卷。各格——把海苔铺在竹帘上、铺米饭、放馅料、掀起卷紧、封口、切段——每格配一幅干净的俯视插画与简短说明。清新的配色,海苔绿、米白、三文鱼粉与竹色浅褐,浅灰底,整洁的扁平矢量风格。左上角粗体圆角标题「自己动手卷寿司」,一个小竹帘与刀的图标,一条提示「每切一刀就把刀沾一下水」。

prompt_en: A cooking infographic showing how to make pizza from scratch as a numbered 6-step flow. Steps - knead the dough, let it rise, stretch the base, add sauce and toppings, bake hot, slice and serve - each carry a warm hand-drawn illustration, a one-line instruction and a time or temperature badge (for example, bake at 250C for 10 min). A rustic trattoria palette of tomato-red, basil-green and dough-cream on a floured-board texture. Bold title 'Homemade Pizza, Step by Step' at the top, small flour and rolling-pin doodles.
prompt_zh: 一张烹饪信息图,以编号的六步流程展示如何从零做披萨。各步骤——揉面、发酵、擀开饼底、加酱料与配料、高温烘烤、切块上桌——每步配一幅暖色手绘插画、一句说明与一个时间或温度标签(例如 250C 烤 10 分钟)。质朴的小餐馆配色,番茄红、罗勒绿与面团奶白,撒了面粉的案板质感。顶部粗体标题「手工披萨分步图」,配面粉与擀面杖的小涂鸦。

prompt_en: A food infographic showing how to build a smoothie bowl, drawn as a labeled cross-section of a bowl in layers plus a numbered assembly guide. From the base blend up through banana coins, granola, berries, chia and a drizzle, each layer is labeled with a leader line and a nutrition tag. A bright fresh palette of berry-purple, mango-orange and leafy-green on cream, playful flat illustration with soft shadows. Bold rounded title 'Build a Smoothie Bowl' upper-left, small icons for a blender, fruit and seeds, a 'ratio 2:1 fruit to liquid' note.
prompt_zh: 一张美食信息图,展示如何搭配一碗奶昔碗,画成分层的碗身剖面配编号组装指南。从底部的奶昔基底往上,依次是香蕉片、格兰诺拉麦片、莓果、奇亚籽与淋酱,每层用引线标注并配一个营养标签。明快清新的配色,莓紫、芒果橙与叶绿,奶白底,俏皮的扁平插画带柔和投影。左上角粗体圆角标题「搭配一碗奶昔碗」,配搅拌机、水果与种子的小图标,一条「水果与液体 2:1」的说明。

prompt_en: A cooking infographic teaching the classic French omelette as a numbered 5-step sequence. Steps - beat the eggs with a pinch of salt, melt butter in a warm pan, pour and stir constantly, tilt and roll, plate seam-side down - each carry a clean side-view illustration and a short technique tip. A soft culinary palette of butter-yellow, cream and slate on off-white, elegant flat vector style. Bold title 'The Perfect French Omelette' at the top, small pan and whisk icons, a 'low heat, keep it pale' caution note.
prompt_zh: 一张烹饪信息图,以编号的五步序列教做经典法式蛋卷。各步骤——把蛋液加一撮盐打散、在温热的平底锅里融化黄油、倒入并不停搅动、倾斜锅子卷起、封口朝下装盘——每步配一幅干净的侧视插画与一句技巧提示。柔和的烹饪配色,黄油黄、奶白与石板灰,米白底,优雅的扁平矢量风格。顶部粗体标题「完美法式蛋卷」,配平底锅与打蛋器的小图标,一条「小火,保持浅色」的注意说明。

prompt_en: A cooking infographic guide to steeping tea by type, laid out as a comparison chart of five cups in a row. Columns for green, white, oolong, black and herbal tea each list water temperature, steep time and a color swatch of the brew, topped by a small leaf icon. A calm natural palette of sage, amber and cream on a soft linen texture, tidy flat illustration. Bold title 'A Guide to Steeping Tea' at the top, a small teapot and thermometer motif, a 'don't over-steep' tip along the base.
prompt_zh: 一张烹饪信息图,按茶类给出泡茶指南,排成一行五只茶杯的对比图。绿茶、白茶、乌龙、红茶与花草茶各占一列,列出水温、浸泡时间与一块茶汤颜色色块,上方配一个小叶片图标。宁静的自然配色,鼠尾草绿、琥珀与奶白,柔和亚麻质感,整洁的扁平插画。顶部粗体标题「泡茶时间温度指南」,一个小茶壶与温度计图案,底部一条「不要泡过头」的提示。

prompt_en: A cooking-skills infographic illustrating basic knife cuts as a labeled grid of six vegetable examples. Cells show julienne, brunoise, dice, chiffonade, batonnet and rondelle, each with a neat overhead illustration of the cut, its name, dimensions and a one-line use. A clean culinary palette of carrot-orange, cucumber-green and cream on light grey, precise flat vector style. Bold title 'A Guide to Knife Cuts' upper-left, a small chef's-knife icon and a cutting-board texture accent, a safety 'claw grip' mini-note.
prompt_zh: 一张厨艺信息图,把基础刀工画成带标注的六格蔬菜示例网格。各格展示细丝、细粒、方丁、切丝、粗条与圆片,每格配一幅整洁的俯视切法插画、名称、尺寸与一句用途。干净的烹饪配色,胡萝卜橙、黄瓜绿与奶白,浅灰底,精准的扁平矢量风格。左上角粗体标题「基础刀工图解」,一个小主厨刀图标与砧板质感点缀,一条「用手护成爪形」的安全小提示。

prompt_en: A cooking infographic showing how to build the perfect taco, drawn as an exploded stack of labeled layers plus a numbered assembly order. From a warm tortilla up through seasoned filling, salsa, shredded lettuce, cheese, avocado and a squeeze of lime, each layer has a leader line and a short note. A vibrant fiesta palette of tomato-red, lime-green, corn-yellow and cream, lively flat illustration with soft shadows. Bold hand-lettered title 'Build the Perfect Taco' at the top, small chili and lime doodles, a 'warm the tortilla first' tip.
prompt_zh: 一张烹饪信息图,展示如何搭出完美的塔可,画成带标注的分层爆炸叠图配编号组装顺序。从温热的玉米饼往上,依次是调味馅料、莎莎酱、生菜丝、奶酪、牛油果与一挤青柠汁,每层配引线与一句简短说明。鲜亮的节日配色,番茄红、青柠绿、玉米黄与奶白,活泼的扁平插画带柔和投影。顶部粗体手写标题「搭出完美塔可」,配辣椒与青柠的小涂鸦,一条「先把玉米饼加热」的提示。

prompt_en: A friendly 3D cartoon avatar of a young woman with curly copper hair tied in a messy bun, freckled cheeks, and round moss-green glasses. She wears denim overalls over a mustard tee and holds a tiny potted succulent near her shoulder. Soft studio clay-render style with smooth subsurface skin, gentle rim light from upper left, mint-and-terracotta color palette, blurred pastel background, centered square headshot, chunky rounded proportions, warm and approachable mood.
prompt_zh: 一位年轻女性的友好3D卡通头像，铜色卷发扎成松松的丸子头，脸颊有雀斑，戴圆形苔绿色眼镜。她穿着牛仔背带裤，内搭芥末黄T恤，肩旁捧着一盆迷你多肉。柔和的黏土渲染风格，皮肤有细腻的次表面散射，左上方柔和轮廓光，薄荷绿与陶土色搭配，背景为虚化的粉彩色，方形正面构图居中，圆润敦实的比例，温暖亲切的氛围。

prompt_en: An anime-style avatar of a stoic young swordsman with sharp silver eyes and a black topknot, a thin scar across one brow. He wears a deep-indigo haori with a subtle crane pattern, collar slightly open. Cel-shaded rendering with crisp lineart, dramatic magenta-and-cyan neon rim lighting on his face, dark rainy alley bokeh behind him, three-quarter angle, cool moody palette, square crop focused on head and shoulders, confident intense expression.
prompt_zh: 一位沉稳年轻剑客的动漫风格头像，银色锐利双眼，黑色发髻，一道眉间浅疤。他身穿深靛蓝羽织，暗纹为仙鹤图案，领口微敞。赛璐璐上色，线条干净利落，脸上打着戏剧化的品红与青色霓虹轮廓光，身后是雨夜暗巷的散景。四分之三侧角，冷调忧郁配色，方形构图聚焦头肩，神情自信而锐利。

prompt_en: A polished headshot-style illustration of a confident middle-aged Black woman executive with short natural coils and gold hoop earrings. She wears a tailored charcoal blazer over a cream blouse, soft warm smile, arms unseen. Semi-realistic vector portrait with smooth gradients, subtle cross-hatch shading, clean navy background with a faint circular halo, even soft key light, professional LinkedIn aesthetic, square framing, chest-up composition, trustworthy and warm tone.
prompt_zh: 一位自信中年黑人女性高管的精致插画头像，短款自然卷发，戴金色圆环耳环。她身穿剪裁利落的炭灰色西装外套，内搭奶油色衬衫，带着温暖微笑。半写实矢量肖像，渐变平滑，细腻的交叉排线阴影，干净的藏青背景配淡淡的圆形光晕，均匀柔和主光，专业的领英风格，方形构图，胸部以上取景，气质可靠温暖。

prompt_en: A 32x32 pixel-art avatar of a chubby orange tabby cat wearing a white astronaut helmet with a golden visor slightly tilted up. Tiny star reflections glint on the glass. The background is a deep-purple space grid with a few bright pixel stars. Limited retro palette of orange, cream, purple, and teal, crisp hard-edge pixels, clear dithering on shadows, centered square composition, playful nostalgic 8-bit game mood.
prompt_zh: 一只圆滚滚橘色虎斑猫的32x32像素艺术头像，戴着白色宇航头盔，金色面罩微微向上掀起，玻璃上闪着细小星光反射。背景是深紫色太空网格，点缀几颗明亮的像素星星。复古有限调色板，橘、奶油、紫、青绿配色，硬边像素清晰，阴影用抖动处理，方形构图居中，俏皮怀旧的8位游戏氛围。

prompt_en: A minimalist mascot avatar of a friendly fox face built from clean geometric shapes. Two triangular ears, a rounded muzzle, and simple dot eyes with a tiny highlight. Flat design with a warm coral body, cream cheek patch, and a single dark accent line for the smile. Solid soft-beige background inside a rounded square, no gradients, bold negative space, perfectly symmetrical, modern app-icon aesthetic, cheerful and clean.
prompt_zh: 一个友好狐狸脸的极简吉祥物头像，由干净的几何形状构成。两只三角形耳朵，圆润的口鼻，简单的点状眼睛带一点小高光。扁平设计，珊瑚暖色身体，奶油色脸颊斑块，仅用一条深色线条勾勒微笑。柔和米色纯背景，置于圆角方形内，无渐变，大胆留白，完全对称，现代应用图标美学，欢快而干净。

prompt_en: A cyberpunk character avatar of a young androgynous netrunner with an undercut and glowing teal circuit tattoos along the jaw. One eye is a golden cybernetic implant with a hexagonal iris. They wear a high-collared black techwear jacket with holographic trim. Digital-painting style, volumetric magenta haze, reflective wet-neon skin highlights, dark alley signage bokeh, three-quarter view, high contrast, square crop, edgy futuristic vibe.
prompt_zh: 一位年轻中性网客的赛博朋克角色头像，剃边发型，下颌沿线有发光的青色电路纹身。一只眼睛是金色义眼植入体，虹膜呈六边形。身穿高领黑色机能夹克，饰有全息镶边。数字绘画风格，体积感的品红雾气，湿润霓虹在皮肤上的反光高光，暗巷招牌散景，四分之三视角，高对比度，方形构图，前卫未来感。

prompt_en: A cute chibi avatar of a cheerful barista boy with big sparkling brown eyes, rosy cheeks, and fluffy chestnut hair under a tiny green apron cap. He holds an oversized latte with heart foam art up to his face.
