Rough grayscale storyboard sketch style, loose pencil lines, directional arrows and camera notes, cinematic composition.
prompt_zh: 一段三格横版飙车分镜序列。第一格：一辆流线型黑色逃逸车在湿滑弯道急转，动态模糊。第二格：越过肩膀视角，司机紧握方向盘，后视镜映出闪烁警灯。第三格：广角镜头，车辆飞跃升起的开合桥，身后是城市天际线。粗糙灰阶分镜草图风格，松散铅笔线条，方向箭头与运镜标注，电影感构图。

prompt_en: A retro American comic panel in 1960s Silver Age style of a caped hero named 'Captain Vireo' bursting through a brick wall, fist forward. Bold primary colors, halftone Ben-Day dots, thick black outlines, dramatic action pose. A yellow burst caption reads 'Nothing can stop justice!' Speed lines and rubble fly outward, cyan sky background, slightly faded vintage newsprint texture, punchy heroic energy.
prompt_zh: 一格复古美式漫画，1960年代白银时代风格，一位名叫「Captain Vireo」的披风英雄破砖墙而出，拳头前伸。大胆三原色，半调网点，粗黑轮廓，戏剧化动作姿态。一个黄色爆炸标题框写着「正义不可阻挡！」速度线与碎砖向外飞溅，青色天空背景，略带褪色的复古报纸质感，充满力量的英雄气概。

prompt_en: A vertical webtoon panel of a cozy corner cafe scene where a shy barista slides a latte with a hidden heart in the foam toward a customer reading a novel. Clean digital lineart, soft cel-shading, warm amber and cream palette, gentle window light, floating steam. A small thought bubble above the barista reads 'Maybe today...'. Tall vertical composition with soft depth-of-field background, tender slice-of-life mood.
prompt_zh: 一格竖版条漫，温馨咖啡馆角落场景，害羞的咖啡师把一杯拉花藏着爱心的拿铁推向一位正在读小说的顾客。干净数字线稿，柔和赛璐璐上色，暖琥珀与奶油配色，柔和窗光，漂浮蒸汽。咖啡师头顶一个小思绪气泡写着「也许就是今天……」高竖版构图，背景柔和景深，温柔的生活片段氛围。

prompt_en: A noir graphic-novel panel of a trench-coated detective lighting a cigarette in a rain-slick alley beneath a flickering streetlamp. High-contrast black-and-white with deep inky shadows, harsh chiaroscuro lighting, venetian-blind shadow stripes across his face. A narration box reads 'The city never sleeps, and neither do its secrets.' Wet cobblestones reflect the lamplight, cross-hatched textures, moody cinematic tension.
prompt_zh: 一格黑色风格图像小说画面，一位身穿风衣的侦探在雨后湿滑的暗巷里点烟，头顶闪烁的路灯忽明忽暗。高对比黑白，浓重墨色阴影，强烈明暗对照，百叶窗阴影条纹横过他的脸。一个旁白框写着「城市从不沉睡，它的秘密也是。」湿漉漉的鹅卵石反射着灯光，交叉排线质感，忧郁的电影感张力。

prompt_en: A kids' picture-book scene of a cheerful bunny family baking bread together in a sunny cottage kitchen. Mama bunny kneads dough while two baby bunnies decorate muffins, flour dusting the air. Soft watercolor style, warm buttery-yellow light, rounded cozy furniture, gentle textures, pastel palette with soft edges. A hanging sign reads 'The Hoppin' Oven'. Whimsical, warm, and heartwarming storybook mood, wide friendly composition.
prompt_zh: 一幅儿童绘本场景，一家欢乐的兔子在阳光洒满的乡村厨房一起烤面包。兔妈妈揉着面团，两只小兔子装饰玛芬蛋糕，空气中飘着面粉。柔和水彩风格，暖黄油色光线，圆润惬意的家具，温柔的质感，柔边粉彩配色。一块悬挂招牌写着「The Hoppin' Oven」。异想天开、温暖暖心的绘本氛围，友好的宽幅构图。

prompt_en: A single dramatic comic panel of a lone scientist standing in a glowing time-machine chamber, watching a holographic memory of a moment he can't change. Detailed sci-fi lineart, cool cyan and violet glow, screentone gradients, subtle particle effects swirling around him. A caption box reads 'Some doors, once open, cannot be closed.' Somber expression, dramatic backlight, emotionally heavy cinematic sci-fi mood.
prompt_zh: 一格戏剧性漫画，一位孤独科学家站在发光的时间机器舱内，望着一段他无法改变的全息记忆。精细科幻线稿，冷调青色与紫罗兰光辉，网点纸渐变，细微粒子效果在他周围旋绕。一个标题框写着「有些门一旦打开，便再也关不上。」神情沉郁，戏剧化逆光，情绪厚重的电影感科幻氛围。

prompt_en: A vertical 4-koma comic of a customer at a cat cafe. Panel 1: she reaches for her tea. Panel 2: a fluffy gray cat stealthily approaches the cup. Panel 3: the cat dips a paw in the tea, both freeze staring at each other. Panel 4: tea spilled everywhere, cat sitting proud, woman sighing with a tiny smile. Clean flat cartoon style, soft warm colors, expressive faces, small motion lines, cheerful lighthearted humor.
prompt_zh: 一条竖版四格漫画，描绘猫咖里的一位顾客。第一格：她伸手去拿茶。第二格：一只毛茸茸灰猫悄悄靠近杯子。第三格：猫用爪子伸进茶里，两者僵住对视。第四格：茶洒得到处都是，猫得意地坐着，女人叹气带着一丝微笑。干净扁平卡通风格，柔和暖色，表情生动，小动态线，欢快轻松的幽默。

prompt_en: A dynamic manga action panel of a young warrior riding a massive scaled dragon diving through storm clouds toward an enemy fortress. Wind whips her cloak, lightning cracks behind them, the dragon roars with fire building in its throat. Sharp detailed inking, dramatic screentone clouds, radiating speed lines, low heroic angle. A shout bubble reads 'Now, Ashwing—dive!' Slate and ember palette, epic kinetic fantasy energy.
prompt_zh: 一格动感漫画战斗画面，一位年轻战士骑着巨大鳞甲飞龙俯冲穿越风暴云层，扑向敌方要塞。风掀起她的斗篷，身后闪电炸裂，飞龙咆哮，喉间蓄着烈火。锐利精细的勾线，戏剧化网点纸云层，辐射状速度线，英雄式低角度。一个呼喊气泡写着「就是现在，灰翼——俯冲！」石板与余烬配色，史诗般动感的奇幻能量。

prompt_en: A three-frame horizontal storyboard of a spacecraft docking sequence. Frame 1: wide shot of a small shuttle approaching a rotating ring station against a starfield. Frame 2: close-up of the pilot's tense hands on the thruster controls, sweat on her brow. Frame 3: the docking clamps lock with a jolt, green lights confirming. Rough monochrome storyboard sketch style, loose lines, camera-movement arrows, timing notes, cinematic sci-fi framing.
prompt_zh: 一段三格横版飞船对接分镜。第一格：广角镜头，一艘小型穿梭机在星海中接近旋转环形空间站。第二格：特写飞行员紧张的双手放在推进器操控台上，额头渗汗。第三格：对接卡扣猛地锁定，绿灯确认。粗糙单色分镜草图风格，松散线条，运镜箭头，时间节点标注，电影感科幻构图。

prompt_en: A retro American comic panel in 1950s pulp sci-fi style of a brave astronaut named 'Rex Halloran' firing a glowing ray gun at a giant tentacled alien on a red-rock planet. Bold saturated colors, halftone dots, thick outlines, dramatic pose. A jagged burst reads 'ZAP!' beside the gun. A caption box declares 'Menace from Nebula Nine!' Faded newsprint texture, dynamic pulpy composition, campy heroic energy.
prompt_zh: 一格复古美式漫画，1950年代低俗科幻风格，一位名叫「Rex Halloran」的勇敢宇航员在红岩星球上朝一只巨大触手外星生物发射发光射线枪。大胆饱和色彩，半调网点，粗轮廓，戏剧化姿态。枪旁一个锯齿爆炸框写着「ZAP！」一个标题框宣告「星云九号的威胁！」褪色报纸质感，动感低俗构图，浮夸英雄能量。

prompt_en: A vertical webtoon panel of a tired college student slumped over textbooks at a desk near midnight, a single warm lamp glowing, empty energy-drink cans stacked nearby. Clean digital lineart, soft cel-shading, cool blue night tones with a warm lamp pool, gentle grain. A thought bubble reads 'Just five more pages...' A cat sleeps curled on the windowsill. Tall vertical composition, quiet relatable slice-of-life mood.
prompt_zh: 一格竖版条漫，一位疲惫大学生临近午夜趴在书桌的课本上，一盏温暖台灯亮着，旁边堆着空能量饮料罐。干净数字线稿，柔和赛璐璐上色，冷蓝夜色调配一圈暖灯光晕，柔和颗粒。一个思绪气泡写着「再看五页就好……」一只猫蜷在窗台上睡着。高竖版构图，安静而有共鸣的生活片段氛围。

prompt_en: A noir graphic-novel panel of two silhouetted figures facing off on a foggy rooftop at midnight, one with a raised pistol, the other calm with hands in coat pockets. High-contrast black-and-white, heavy ink shadows, moonlight cutting through fog, dramatic rim light on their edges. A narration box reads 'Between them lay ten years and one lie.' Cross-hatched textures, tense cinematic composition, brooding suspense.
prompt_zh: 一格黑色风格图像小说画面，午夜雾气弥漫的屋顶上两个剪影对峙，一人举枪，另一人镇定地把手插进大衣口袋。高对比黑白，浓重墨影，月光穿透雾气，人物边缘有戏剧化轮廓光。一个旁白框写着「他们之间隔着十年和一个谎言。」交叉排线质感，紧张的电影感构图，阴郁的悬疑感。

prompt_en: A kids' picture-book scene of a curious little girl in a yellow raincoat crouching at a rocky tidepool, discovering a bright orange starfish and a tiny green crab. Soft gouache style, gentle morning seaside light, rounded friendly rocks, sparkling clear water, pastel-and-teal palette. A small caption reads 'Tessa found a hidden ocean world.' Whimsical, curious, and gentle storybook mood, wide inviting composition.
prompt_zh: 一幅儿童绘本场景，一个好奇的小女孩穿着黄色雨衣蹲在礁石潮池边，发现一只鲜橙色海星和一只绿色小螃蟹。柔和水粉风格，温柔的清晨海边光线，圆润友好的礁石，波光粼粼的清水，粉彩与青绿配色。一个小标题写着「Tessa发现了一个隐藏的海洋世界。」异想天开、好奇温柔的绘本氛围，宽幅诱人构图。

prompt_en: A dynamic manga action panel of two samurai clashing swords at the moment of impact, sparks flying between crossed blades, cherry blossoms swirling around them at dusk. One leaps forward with a fierce cry, the other braces low. Sharp bold inking, radiating speed lines, screentone gradient sky. A sound-effect reads 'KIIN' near the blades. Crimson-and-indigo sunset palette, low dramatic angle, breathless kinetic tension.
prompt_zh: 一格动感漫画战斗画面，两名武士在刀刃相撞的瞬间交锋，交叉刀锋间火花四溅，黄昏中樱花在他们周围飞旋。一人纵身前扑发出凶猛怒吼，另一人压低身姿架挡。锐利粗犷的勾线，辐射状速度线，网点纸渐变天空。刀刃旁一个拟声词写着「铿」。深红与靛蓝日落配色，戏剧化低角度，令人屏息的动感张力。

prompt_en: A vertical 4-koma comic of a man's grocery trip gone wrong. Panel 1: he balances a towering armful of groceries, no basket. Panel 2: an orange rolls off the top. Panel 3: he lunges to catch it, everything wobbling. Panel 4: he sits on the floor buried in spilled produce, one orange perfectly balanced on his head, deadpan stare. Clean flat cartoon style, bright cheerful colors, expressive faces, comedic sweat drops, playful humor.
prompt_zh: 一条竖版四格漫画，描绘一位男子买菜出岔子。第一格：他没拿篮子，怀里抱着高高一摞杂货勉强平衡。第二格：一个橙子从顶上滚落。第三格：他猛地扑去接住，所有东西摇摇欲坠。第四格：他坐在地上被洒落的果蔬淹没，一个橙子完美地平衡在头顶，面无表情地瞪着。干净扁平卡通风格，明亮欢快色彩，表情夸张，喜剧汗滴，俏皮幽默。

prompt_en: A single atmospheric comic panel of two explorers holding flashlights as they push open a rusted vault door in an abandoned underground bunker, revealing rows of dusty machinery bathed in beams of light. Detailed cross-hatched inking, cool teal shadows with warm flashlight glow, floating dust motes. A caption box reads 'Nobody had opened this door in forty years.' Suspenseful discovery mood, dramatic depth, cinematic mystery.
prompt_zh: 一格富有氛围的漫画，两名探险者举着手电推开废弃地下掩体里一扇锈蚀的金库门，露出被光束照亮的一排排积尘机械。精细交叉排线勾勒，冷青阴影配暖调手电光晕，漂浮的尘埃颗粒。一个标题框写着「四十年来没人打开过这扇门。」悬疑发现的氛围，戏剧化纵深，电影感神秘。

prompt_en: A dramatic wide comic splash panel of a lone engineer standing defiant before an army of glowing-eyed rogue robots marching down a neon-lit factory corridor. Bold detailed lineart, cool cyan robot glow against warm orange emergency lights, heavy screentone shadows, dynamic perspective converging on the horizon. A caption box reads 'One switch stood between order and chaos.' High-stakes sci-fi tension, cinematic composition.
prompt_zh: 一格戏剧性宽幅漫画跨页，一位孤身工程师无畏地站在一支眼睛发光的失控机器人军团面前，机器人在霓虹工厂走廊中列队行进。粗犷精细的线稿，冷青机器人光辉映衬暖橙应急灯，浓重网点纸阴影，动感透视汇聚于地平线。一个标题框写着「一个开关横亘在秩序与混乱之间。」高风险科幻张力，电影感构图。

prompt_en: A retro American comic panel in classic western style of a lone gunslinger named 'Cass Redwood' walking down a deserted dusty main street at high noon, hand hovering over her holster. Bold sun-bleached colors, halftone shading, thick outlines, dramatic long shadows. A caption box reads 'The town of Dry Fork had one law left—her.' Tumbleweed rolling past weathered saloon fronts, tense standoff atmosphere, gritty heroic energy.
prompt_zh: 一格复古美式漫画，经典西部风格，一位名叫「Cass Redwood」的独行枪手在正午时分走过荒凉尘土飞扬的主街，手悬在枪套上方。大胆的日晒褪色色彩，半调阴影，粗轮廓，戏剧化长影。一个标题框写着「Dry Fork镇只剩下一条法律——她。」风滚草滚过风化的酒馆门面，紧张对峙氛围，粗粝的英雄能量。

prompt_en: A vertical webtoon panel of a young couple in an empty new apartment surrounded by cardboard boxes, sitting on the floor sharing takeout from paper cartons and laughing. Warm golden late-afternoon light streams through bare windows, a single potted plant on the sill. Clean digital lineart, soft cel-shading, cozy amber palette. A speech bubble reads 'Home already feels right.' Tall vertical composition, tender hopeful slice-of-life mood.
prompt_zh: 一格竖版条漫，一对年轻情侣在空荡荡的新公寓里被纸箱围绕，坐在地板上分享纸盒外卖，开怀大笑。温暖的金色午后阳光透过光秃的窗户洒进来，窗台上有一盆绿植。干净数字线稿，柔和赛璐璐上色，温馨琥珀配色。一个对话气泡写着「这里已经有家的感觉了。」高竖版构图，温柔充满希望的生活片段氛围。

prompt_en: A noir graphic-novel panel of a lone singer at a smoky 1940s jazz club microphone, a spotlight carving her silhouette from the darkness while a shadowy audience watches. High-contrast black-and-white, deep ink pools, cigarette smoke curling through the light beam, dramatic single-source spotlight. A narration box reads 'She sang like she had nothing left to lose.' Cross-hatched textures, sultry moody atmosphere, cinematic melancholy.
prompt_zh: 一格黑色风格图像小说画面，一位孤独歌手站在1940年代烟雾缭绕的爵士酒吧麦克风前，一束聚光灯从黑暗中勾出她的剪影，影影绰绰的观众注视着。高对比黑白，浓重墨块，香烟烟雾在光束中缭绕，戏剧化单光源聚光。一个旁白框写着「她唱得仿佛已一无所失。」交叉排线质感，性感忧郁的氛围，电影感的伤感。

prompt_en: A kids' picture-book scene of a tiny round green dragon curling up in a cozy cave nest lined with soft moss and glowing crystals, yawning as a little firefly tucks a leaf-blanket over him. Soft crayon-and-watercolor style, warm nighttime glow, rounded gentle shapes, pastel palette with cozy shadows. A caption reads 'Even little dragons need their rest.' Peaceful, tender, and dreamy bedtime-story mood, wide soft composition.
prompt_zh: 一幅儿童绘本场景，一只圆滚滚的绿色小龙蜷缩在铺满柔软苔藓和发光水晶的温馨洞穴巢里，打着哈欠，一只小萤火虫为他掖好叶子被。柔和蜡笔水彩风格，温暖夜光，圆润柔和的形状，粉彩配色带惬意阴影。一个标题写着「就连小龙也需要休息。」宁静温柔梦幻的睡前故事氛围，宽幅柔和构图。

prompt_en: A dynamic manga action panel of a young thief sprinting through a crowded outdoor bazaar, snatching an apple while dodging startled vendors, fabric awnings and spice baskets flying. A guard lunges after her a step behind. Sharp energetic inking, radiating motion lines, screentone crowd shadows, fisheye dynamic perspective. A shout bubble reads 'Stop that girl!' Warm sandy palette, chaotic playful kinetic energy.
prompt_zh: 一格动感漫画战斗画面，一名年轻小偷在拥挤的露天集市中飞奔，抓起一个苹果同时躲避受惊的摊贩，布制遮阳篷和香料筐四处翻飞。一名守卫紧追其后一步之遥。锐利有活力的勾线，辐射状动态线，网点纸人群阴影，鱼眼动感透视。一个呼喊气泡写着「拦住那女孩！」暖沙色系，混乱俏皮的动感能量。

prompt_en: A vertical webtoon panel of a nervous new student standing at the doorway of a bustling classroom, clutching a notebook to her chest as curious classmates glance over. Clean digital lineart, soft cel-shading, bright morning light through tall windows, warm pastel palette. A thought bubble reads 'Please let this go okay.' Small sweat drop, gentle blush. Tall vertical composition, relatable coming-of-age slice-of-life mood.
prompt_zh: 一格竖版条漫，一位紧张的转学新生站在热闹教室门口，把笔记本紧抱在胸前，好奇的同学们纷纷投来目光。干净数字线稿，柔和赛璐璐上色，明亮晨光透过高窗，温暖粉彩配色。一个思绪气泡写着「拜托一切顺利。」一滴小汗珠，轻微脸红。高竖版构图，有共鸣的青春成长生活片段氛围。

prompt_en: A three-frame horizontal storyboard of a character entering a haunted manor. Frame 1: wide establishing shot of a decrepit mansion under a stormy sky, lightning flashing. Frame 2: medium shot of a hand slowly pushing open a creaking front door, darkness beyond. Frame 3: low-angle interior shot of a shadowy figure at the top of a grand staircase, candle flickering. Rough grayscale storyboard sketch style, loose lines, camera arrows, spooky atmospheric notes.
prompt_zh: 一段三格横版鬼宅分镜。第一格：广角定场镜头，一座破败宅邸矗立在暴风雨天空下，闪电划过。第二格：中景，一只手缓缓推开吱嘎作响的大门，门后一片漆黑。第三格：室内低角度镜头，一个阴影人影立在气派楼梯顶端，烛火摇曳。粗糙灰阶分镜草图风格，松散线条，运镜箭头，阴森氛围标注。

prompt_en: A retro American comic panel in bold modern-classic style of a masked heroine named 'Nova Wren' landing in a dramatic three-point crouch, cracking the pavement, cape billowing behind her. Bold saturated colors, halftone dot shading, thick black outlines, radiating impact lines. A yellow burst caption reads 'The city's last hope had arrived.' Debris and dust erupt around her, cyan-and-magenta night sky, punchy heroic energy.
prompt_zh: 一格复古美式漫画，大胆的现代经典风格，一位名叫「Nova Wren」的蒙面女英雄以戏剧化的三点式蹲姿落地，震裂路面，披风在身后翻飞。大胆饱和色彩，半调网点阴影，粗黑轮廓，辐射状冲击线。一个黄色爆炸标题框写着「城市最后的希望已经降临。」碎片与尘土在她周围爆开，青品红夜空，充满力量的英雄能量。

prompt_en: A kids' picture-book scene of three young animal friends—a fox, a rabbit, and a hedgehog—sitting around a crackling campfire under a starry forest sky, roasting marshmallows and sharing a spooky story. Soft warm firelight glows on their faces, tall dark pines around them. Gentle gouache style, cozy orange-and-navy palette, rounded friendly shapes. A caption reads 'And then, they heard a rustle...' Whimsical cozy adventurous storybook mood, wide composition.
prompt_zh: 一幅儿童绘本场景，三个动物小伙伴——狐狸、兔子和刺猬——在星空森林下围坐在噼啪作响的篝火旁，烤棉花糖分享一个吓人的故事。温暖火光柔和地映在他们脸上，周围是高大幽暗的松树。柔和水粉风格，温馨橙色与藏青配色，圆润友好的形状。一个标题写着「然后，他们听见一阵沙沙声……」异想天开、温馨冒险的绘本氛围，宽幅构图。

prompt_en: A vertical 4-koma comic set in a cluttered robot repair shop. Panel 1: a mechanic girl tightens a bolt on a small round robot. Panel 2: the robot's eyes light up, it beeps happily. Panel 3: it enthusiastically hugs her, arms whirring. Panel 4: it accidentally squeezes too hard, she pops out flat like a pancake, robot looks worried. Clean flat cartoon style, bright cheerful colors, expressive faces, playful sci-fi humor.
prompt_zh: 一条竖版四格漫画，场景设在杂乱的机器人维修店。第一格：一位机械师女孩给一个圆滚滚小机器人拧螺栓。第二格：机器人眼睛亮起，开心地哔哔叫。第三格：它热情地抱住她，手臂嗡嗡转动。第四格：它不小心抱得太用力，她被压成薄薄的煎饼状弹出，机器人一脸担忧。干净扁平卡通风格，明亮欢快色彩，表情生动，俏皮科幻幽默。

prompt_en: A single atmospheric comic panel of a lone diver drifting through the sunken ruins of an ancient marble city, shafts of blue light piercing the water, schools of silver fish weaving between broken columns. Detailed lineart with flowing screentone gradients, cool teal-and-turquoise palette, floating particles and bubbles. A caption box reads 'The sea keeps its oldest secrets well.' Serene mysterious mood, dramatic underwater depth, cinematic wonder.
prompt_zh: 一格富有氛围的漫画，一位孤独潜水员漂浮着穿过一座古老大理石城市的沉没遗迹，蓝色光柱刺入水中，银色鱼群在断裂石柱间穿梭。精细线稿配流动的网点纸渐变，冷调青绿与绿松石配色，漂浮的颗粒和气泡。一个标题框写着「大海将它最古老的秘密守护得很好。」宁静神秘的氛围，戏剧化的水下纵深，电影感的奇幻。

prompt_en: A dynamic manga action panel of two futuristic hovercars racing neck-and-neck down a rain-soaked neon highway, sparks trailing, reflections streaking across wet asphalt. Sharp bold inking, intense speed lines, screentone motion blur, low chase-cam angle. A shout bubble reads 'You're not winning this one!' Electric magenta, cyan, and yellow neon palette, high-octane kinetic energy, cinematic cyber-racing tension.
prompt_zh: 一格动感漫画战斗画面，两辆未来悬浮赛车在被雨浸透的霓虹高速上并驾齐驱狂飙，火花拖曳，倒影在湿沥青上拉出光带。锐利粗犷的勾线，强烈速度线，网点纸动态模糊，低位追车镜头角度。一个呼喊气泡写着「这一局你赢不了！」电光品红、青色与黄色霓虹配色，高辛烷动感能量，电影感的赛博竞速张力。

prompt_en: A single emotional comic panel of two friends saying goodbye on a train platform as one leans out an open carriage window, their hands almost touching as the train begins to pull away. Soft detailed lineart, warm golden dusk light, gentle screentone shadows, drifting steam. A caption box reads 'Some goodbyes are just see-you-laters.' Bittersweet tender mood, shallow depth of field, cinematic emotional weight.
prompt_zh: 一格情感漫画，两位朋友在火车站台上告别，其中一人从敞开的车厢窗探出身，火车开始启动时两人的手几乎相触。柔和精细的线稿，温暖金色暮光，轻柔网点纸阴影，飘散的蒸汽。一个标题框写着「有些告别只是暂别。」苦乐参半的温柔氛围，浅景深，电影感的情绪重量。

prompt_en: A single humorous comic panel of a tired late-night diner waitress calmly taking an order from a small green three-eyed alien seated in a booth, its tentacle pointing at a menu, a flying saucer parked outside the window. Clean detailed lineart, warm diner lighting with a cool alien glow, retro-diner palette. A speech bubble from the alien reads 'I'll have the pancakes... all of them.' Deadpan comedic sci-fi mood, cozy cinematic framing.
prompt_zh: 一格幽默漫画，一位疲惫的深夜餐厅女招待镇定地为坐在卡座里的一只绿色三眼小外星人点单，它的触手指着菜单，窗外停着一架飞碟。干净精细的线稿，温暖餐厅灯光配冷调外星光晕，复古餐厅配色。外星人的对话气泡写着「我要煎饼……全部都要。」面无表情的喜剧科幻氛围，温馨的电影感构图。

prompt_en: A three-frame horizontal storyboard of a lighthouse keeper during a storm. Frame 1: wide shot of a lone lighthouse on a cliff, giant waves crashing, beam sweeping the dark sea. Frame 2: interior medium shot of the keeper cranking the lamp gears by lantern light, rain streaking the glass. Frame 3: point-of-view from the light out to a tiny ship spotted in the waves. Rough grayscale storyboard sketch style, loose energetic lines, camera-movement arrows, dramatic weather notes.
prompt_zh: 一段三格横版灯塔守护者风暴分镜。第一格：广角镜头，悬崖上一座孤零零的灯塔，巨浪拍击，光束扫过漆黑海面。第二格：室内中景，守塔人在灯笼光下摇动灯具齿轮，雨水在玻璃上流淌。第三格：从灯塔视角望向海浪中发现的一艘小船。粗糙灰阶分镜草图风格，松散有力的线条，运镜箭头，戏剧化天气标注。

prompt_en: A landing-page hero mockup for a sustainable travel brand called 'Wanderleaf'. Full-width hero with a lush misty mountain-forest photo backdrop, a bold serif headline 'Travel that gives back' in white, a short subheading, and a rounded emerald 'Start exploring' button beside a ghost 'Watch film' button. Top nav with wordmark left and four links right. Clean modern layout, generous whitespace, soft glassmorphic search bar overlapping the hero bottom, earthy green-and-cream palette, 16:9 desktop.
prompt_zh: 一个可持续旅行品牌「Wanderleaf」的落地页首屏设计稿。全宽首屏配以郁郁葱葱的薄雾山林照片背景，粗衬线白色大标题「回馈自然的旅行」，一行简短副标题，一个圆角祖母绿「开始探索」按钮，旁边是幽灵样式的「观看短片」按钮。顶部导航栏左侧为文字商标，右侧四个链接。干净现代的布局，充裕留白，柔和玻璃拟态搜索栏叠在首屏底部，大地绿与奶油配色，16:9桌面端。

prompt_en: A mobile app home screen mockup for a meditation app named 'Stilla'. Vertical phone frame with a soft dawn-gradient background from peach to lavender. Top shows a greeting 'Good morning, Aria' and a small streak counter. A large featured card 'Morning Calm · 10 min' with a play button, below it a horizontal row of session cards. Bottom tab bar with home, explore, timer, and profile icons. Rounded corners, gentle shadows, calming minimalist UI, soft sans-serif type.
prompt_zh: 一个名为「Stilla」的冥想App主页手机端设计稿。竖版手机框，柔和黎明渐变背景从桃色过渡到薰衣草色。顶部显示问候语「早安，Aria」和一个小小的连续打卡计数。一张大的精选卡片「晨间宁静·10分钟」配播放按钮，下方是一排横向课程卡片。底部标签栏有主页、探索、计时和个人四个图标。圆角，柔和阴影，宁静的极简UI，柔和无衬线字体。

prompt_en: A clean SaaS finance dashboard UI mockup for a tool called 'Ledgerly'. Left sidebar navigation with icons and labels, top bar with search and user avatar. Main area shows four KPI stat cards (balance, income, expenses, savings), a large line chart of monthly cash flow, a donut chart of spending categories, and a recent-transactions table. Light theme with a soft blue-gray background, indigo accent color, rounded cards, subtle shadows, crisp data-viz, 16:9 desktop layout.
prompt_zh: 一个名为「Ledgerly」的干净SaaS财务仪表盘界面设计稿。左侧边栏导航带图标和文字，顶栏有搜索框和用户头像。主区域显示四张KPI数据卡（余额、收入、支出、储蓄），一张大的月度现金流折线图，一张消费类别环形图，以及一张近期交易表格。浅色主题，柔和蓝灰背景，靛蓝强调色，圆角卡片，细腻阴影，清晰的数据可视化，16:9桌面布局。

prompt_en: An e-commerce product page mockup for a specialty coffee brand 'Emberhouse Roasters'. Left side shows a large product photo of a matte-black coffee bag with a gold seal, plus small thumbnail images below. Right side has the product title 'Sunrise Blend · Medium Roast', a star rating, price '$18.00', a grind-size selector, a quantity stepper, and a warm-orange 'Add to cart' button. Below, tasting-notes chips and a shipping accordion. Warm cream background, elegant serif headings, minimal clean layout, 3:2.
prompt_zh: 一个精品咖啡品牌「Emberhouse Roasters」的电商商品页设计稿。左侧是一张大的产品照片，哑光黑咖啡袋配金色封印，下方有小缩略图。右侧有产品标题「日出拼配·中度烘焙」、星级评分、价格「$18.00」、研磨度选择器、数量调节器，以及一个暖橙色「加入购物车」按钮。下方是风味标签胶囊和物流折叠面板。暖奶油背景，优雅衬线标题，简约干净布局，3:2。

prompt_en: A SaaS pricing page mockup for a project-management tool 'Taskloom'. Centered headline 'Plans that grow with your team' and a monthly/annual toggle above three pricing cards: Starter, Pro (highlighted with a 'Most popular' badge and elevated shadow), and Enterprise. Each card lists price, a feature checklist with checkmarks, and a call-to-action button. Below, a comparison table and an FAQ accordion. Clean light theme, purple accent, rounded cards, generous spacing, crisp sans-serif, 16:9 desktop.
prompt_zh: 一个项目管理工具「Taskloom」的SaaS定价页设计稿。居中标题「随团队成长的方案」，上方有月付/年付切换开关，下方是三张定价卡：入门版、专业版（用「最受欢迎」徽章和抬升阴影突出）、企业版。每张卡列出价格、带勾选标记的功能清单，以及一个行动号召按钮。下方是对比表格和FAQ折叠面板。干净浅色主题，紫色强调色，圆角卡片，充裕间距，清晰无衬线，16:9桌面端。

prompt_en: A mobile onboarding screen mockup for a fitness app 'Pulsefit'. Vertical phone frame, step 2 of 4 with a slim progress bar at top. A bold headline 'What's your goal?' and a stack of four large selectable option cards—Lose weight, Build muscle, Stay active, Improve endurance—each with a small line icon, one selected with a coral outline. A 'Continue' button pinned at the bottom, a 'Skip' link above it. Clean dark UI with charcoal background, coral accent, rounded cards, friendly bold sans-serif.
prompt_zh: 一个健身App「Pulsefit」的手机引导页设计稿。竖版手机框，第2步/共4步，顶部有细长进度条。粗体标题「你的目标是什么？」下方堆叠四张大的可选选项卡——减脂、增肌、保持活跃、提升耐力——每张配一个小线性图标，其中一张被选中带珊瑚色描边。底部固定一个「继续」按钮，上方有「跳过」链接。干净的深色UI，炭黑背景，珊瑚色强调色，圆角卡片，友好粗体无衬线字体。

prompt_en: A portfolio website homepage mockup for a graphic designer named 'Mara Voss'. Large minimalist hero with an oversized bold headline 'Designing calm into complex products' and a small circular portrait. Below, a masonry grid of project thumbnails with hover-lift shadows, each labeled with a project name and tag. Top nav with monogram logo left and Work / About / Contact right. Off-white background, single warm-red accent, lots of whitespace, refined editorial typography, 16:9 desktop.
prompt_zh: 一位平面设计师「Mara Voss」的作品集网站主页设计稿。大幅极简首屏，超大粗体标题「为复杂产品设计出平静」，配一张小圆形肖像。下方是瀑布流项目缩略图网格，悬停时有抬升阴影，每张标注项目名称和标签。顶部导航左侧为字母组合标志，右侧为作品/关于/联系。米白背景，单一暖红强调色，大量留白，考究的编辑排版，16:9桌面端。

prompt_en: A mobile food-delivery app screen mockup for an app called 'Nomly'. Vertical phone frame with a top location bar 'Deliver to · Maple Street', a rounded search field, and a horizontal scroll of cuisine category chips. Below, a promo banner 'Free delivery this week', then a vertical list of restaurant cards each showing a food photo, name, rating, delivery time, and price range. Bottom tab bar with home, search, orders, and account icons. Bright clean UI, warm orange accent, rounded cards, appetizing food imagery.
prompt_zh: 一个名为「Nomly」的外卖App界面设计稿。竖版手机框，顶部定位栏「配送至·枫叶街」，一个圆角搜索框，以及一排横向滚动的菜系分类标签。下方是一条促销横幅「本周免配送费」，接着是竖向餐厅卡片列表，每张显示食物照片、名称、评分、配送时间和价格区间。底部标签栏有主页、搜索、订单和账户图标。明亮干净的UI，暖橙强调色，圆角卡片，诱人的食物图片。

prompt_en: A dark-mode analytics dashboard UI mockup for a product named 'Metricly'. Left icon-rail navigation, top bar with global search and notification bell. Main grid: a large area chart of website traffic with a gradient fill, four small metric tiles (visitors, conversion, bounce rate, revenue) with tiny sparklines, a world map with glowing dots for user regions, and a bar chart of top pages. Charcoal background, neon-lime and cyan accents, glowing cards, crisp monospaced numbers, sleek modern data-viz, 16:9.
prompt_zh: 一个名为「Metricly」的深色模式数据分析仪表盘界面设计稿。左侧图标导航栏，顶栏有全局搜索和通知铃铛。主网格：一张带渐变填充的网站流量面积图，四个小指标磁贴（访客、转化、跳出率、营收）配迷你迷你折线图，一张标注用户地区发光点的世界地图，以及一张热门页面柱状图。炭黑背景，霓虹青柠与青色强调色，发光卡片，清晰的等宽数字，时尚现代的数据可视化，16:9。

prompt_en: A landing-page hero mockup for an indoor-plant shop 'Verdant & Co'. Split hero: left half has a bold headline 'Bring the outside in', a short paragraph, and a green 'Shop plants' button plus a 'Care guide' text link; right half shows a large photo of a monstera in a terracotta pot against a warm wall. Top nav with leaf logo, four links, a cart icon, and a small basket count. Soft sage-and-cream palette, rounded buttons, airy layout, friendly modern serif headline, 16:9 desktop.
prompt_zh: 一个室内植物店「Verdant & Co」的落地页首屏设计稿。左右分栏首屏：左半部分有粗体标题「把自然带进室内」、一段简短文字，一个绿色「选购植物」按钮外加一个「养护指南」文字链接；右半部分是一张大照片，陶土盆里的龟背竹映在暖色墙前。顶部导航有叶子标志、四个链接、购物车图标和一个小小的篮内数量。柔和鼠尾草绿与奶油配色，圆角按钮，通透布局，友好现代衬线标题，16:9桌面端。

prompt_en: A mobile banking app screen mockup for a neobank 'Cove'. Vertical phone frame, top shows account balance '$4,285.60' in large type with a small hide-balance eye icon. Below, a stylish 3D gradient debit card with the name 'Cove' and last four digits, then a row of quick-action buttons—Send, Request, Top up, Pay. A recent-transactions list with merchant icons, names, and amounts follows. Bottom tab bar. Clean modern fintech UI, deep-teal and mint palette, rounded cards, soft shadows, crisp sans-serif.
prompt_zh: 一个新型数字银行「Cove」的手机银行App界面设计稿。竖版手机框，顶部用大字号显示账户余额「$4,285.60」，旁边有一个隐藏余额的小眼睛图标。下方是一张时尚的3D渐变借记卡，印有「Cove」品牌名和末四位数字，接着是一排快捷操作按钮——转账、收款、充值、支付。随后是带商户图标、名称和金额的近期交易列表。底部标签栏。干净现代的金融科技UI，深青与薄荷配色，圆角卡片，柔和阴影，清晰无衬线字体。

prompt_en: A landing page mockup for an online learning platform 'Skillnest'. Hero with headline 'Learn anything, one lesson at a time', a search bar with category dropdown, and a bright button 'Browse courses'. Below, a section of course cards each with a thumbnail, instructor name, star rating, lesson count, and price. A trust row of muted invented company logos, then a testimonial band. Clean light theme, deep-blue accent, rounded cards, structured grid, modern friendly sans-serif, 16:9 desktop.
prompt_zh: 一个在线学习平台「Skillnest」的落地页设计稿。首屏配标题「一堂课，学会任何事」、一个带分类下拉菜单的搜索栏，以及一个亮色按钮「浏览课程」。下方是一片课程卡片区，每张带缩略图、讲师姓名、星级评分、课时数和价格。一排淡色的虚构公司标志作为信任背书，接着是一条用户评价栏。干净浅色主题，深蓝强调色，圆角卡片，结构化网格，现代友好无衬线字体，16:9桌面端。

prompt_en: A mobile recipe app detail screen mockup for an app 'Simmer'. Vertical phone frame, top shows a large appetizing photo of a bowl of ramen with a back arrow and bookmark icon overlaid. Below a rounded content sheet with the title 'Miso Butter Ramen', a row of meta chips (30 min · Easy · 520 kcal), tabbed sections for Ingredients and Steps, an ingredient checklist, and a sticky 'Start cooking' button. Warm inviting UI, cream background, tomato-red accent, rounded cards, clean readable type.
prompt_zh: 一个食谱App「Simmer」的手机详情页设计稿。竖版手机框，顶部是一张诱人的拉面大照片，叠加返回箭头和收藏图标。下方是一张圆角内容面板，标题「味噌黄油拉面」，一排信息标签（30分钟·简单·520千卡），「食材」和「步骤」的分页标签，一份食材清单，以及一个吸底「开始烹饪」按钮。温暖诱人的UI，奶油背景，番茄红强调色，圆角卡片，干净易读的字体。

prompt_en: A crypto wallet web dashboard UI mockup for a platform 'Cointrail'. Left sidebar nav, top bar with search and a green connect-wallet button. Main area shows a large portfolio value with a percentage change, a smooth area chart of portfolio history with a time-range toggle, a list of held assets with invented tokens (Aurora, Nimbus, Vela) showing icons, balances, and 24h change chips in green and red, and a right panel with a quick buy/sell card. Dark theme, violet-and-teal gradients, glowing cards, crisp mono numerals, 16:9.
prompt_zh: 一个加密钱包平台「Cointrail」的网页仪表盘界面设计稿。左侧边栏导航，顶栏有搜索框和一个绿色连接钱包按钮。主区域显示大的投资组合总值配百分比涨跌，一张平滑的组合历史面积图带时间区间切换，一份持仓资产列表，包含虚构代币（Aurora、Nimbus、Vela），显示图标、余额和绿红两色的24小时涨跌标签，右侧面板是一张快捷买卖卡片。深色主题，紫罗兰与青色渐变，发光卡片，清晰等宽数字，16:9。

prompt_en: A landing-page hero mockup for a wedding-planning service 'Everly Vows'. Elegant full-width hero with a soft-focus photo of a garden ceremony arch, an airy script-and-serif headline 'Your day, beautifully planned', a short line of copy, and a blush-pink 'Book a consultation' button. Below the hero, a three-column feature row with line icons—Venues, Design, Day-of coordination. Top nav with delicate serif wordmark. Soft dusty-rose and ivory palette, refined elegant typography, generous whitespace, 16:9 desktop.
prompt_zh: 一个婚礼策划服务「Everly Vows」的落地页首屏设计稿。优雅全宽首屏配一张柔焦的花园仪式拱门照片，一个飘逸的手写体与衬线体结合的标题「你的大日子，精心筹划」，一行简短文案，以及一个腮红粉「预约咨询」按钮。首屏下方是三栏功能区，配线性图标——场地、设计、当日统筹。顶部导航是精致的衬线文字商标。柔和的灰玫瑰与象牙配色，考究优雅的排版，充裕留白，16:9桌面端。

prompt_en: A mobile podcast app now-playing screen mockup for an app 'Airwave'. Vertical phone frame with a large rounded episode cover art in gradient purple, the episode title 'Building in Public · Ep. 47', the show name below, and a scrubber progress bar with timestamps. Large circular play button flanked by skip-back and skip-forward controls, plus speed and sleep-timer icons. A bottom row with download, share, and queue. Dark elegant UI, deep-violet background, soft glow, rounded controls, clean type.
prompt_zh: 一个播客App「Airwave」的手机正在播放页设计稿。竖版手机框，一张大的圆角单集封面为紫色渐变，单集标题「公开构建·第47期」，下方是节目名称，以及一条带时间戳的拖动进度条。大圆形播放按钮两侧是快退和快进控制，外加倍速和睡眠定时图标。底部一排下载、分享和播放队列。深色优雅UI，深紫罗兰背景，柔和光晕，圆角控件，干净字体。

prompt_en: An e-commerce-style real estate listing page mockup for a platform 'Nestwise'. Top is a large hero gallery of a modern house with a small thumbnail strip. Below, the listing title '3-Bed Modern Villa · Cedar Hills', price '$685,000', and a row of spec chips (3 beds · 2 baths · 2,100 sqft). A sticky right sidebar card has agent info and a 'Schedule a tour' button. Main column has an 'About this home' section, an amenities grid, and an embedded map placeholder. Clean light theme, teal accent, rounded cards, 3:2.
prompt_zh: 一个房产平台「Nestwise」的电商风格房源页设计稿。顶部是一座现代住宅的大幅首图画廊，配一条小缩略图带。下方是房源标题「三居现代别墅·雪松山」、价格「$685,000」，以及一排规格标签（3卧·2卫·2100平方英尺）。右侧吸顶侧栏卡片有中介信息和一个「预约看房」按钮。主栏有「关于此房」区块、设施网格，以及一个内嵌地图占位。干净浅色主题，青色强调色，圆角卡片，3:2。

prompt_en: A landing-page hero mockup for an AI writing assistant 'Quillby'. Centered hero with an eyebrow tag 'New', a big gradient headline 'Write faster, sound like you', a subheading, and two buttons—a solid 'Try it free' and an outline 'See how it works'. Below the fold, a floating product screenshot in a browser frame showing a text editor with AI suggestions. A logo strip of invented brands beneath. Modern light theme, indigo-to-pink gradient accents, soft shadows, rounded UI, crisp geometric sans-serif, 16:9.
prompt_zh: 一个AI写作助手「Quillby」的落地页首屏设计稿。居中首屏配一个小标签「新品」，一个大的渐变标题「写得更快，还是你的风格」，一行副标题，以及两个按钮——实心「免费试用」和描边「了解运作方式」。首屏下方是一张浮动的产品截图，置于浏览器框内，展示带AI建议的文本编辑器。下方是一排虚构品牌标志。现代浅色主题，靛蓝到粉色的渐变强调色，柔和阴影，圆角UI，清晰的几何无衬线字体，16:9。

prompt_en: A web travel-booking search-results page mockup for a site 'Skyhop'. Top has a compact search summary bar with origin, destination, dates, and a modify button. Left column is a filter sidebar with price slider, stops checkboxes, airline chips, and departure-time ranges. Main column lists flight result cards each showing invented airline name, times, duration, stops, and a price with a 'Select' button. A results count and sort dropdown sit above the list. Clean light UI, sky-blue accent, rounded cards, tidy spacing, 16:9.
prompt_zh: 一个旅行预订网站「Skyhop」的搜索结果页设计稿。顶部有一条紧凑的搜索摘要栏，含出发地、目的地、日期和修改按钮。左栏是筛选侧边栏，含价格滑块、经停复选框、航司标签和起飞时间区间。主栏列出航班结果卡片，每张显示虚构航司名称、时刻、时长、经停次数，以及带「选择」按钮的价格。列表上方有结果数量和排序下拉菜单。干净浅色UI，天蓝强调色，圆角卡片，整洁间距，16:9。

prompt_en: A mobile habit-tracker app screen mockup for an app 'Streakly'. Vertical phone frame, top greeting 'Keep it up, Jordan' with a small flame icon and a 12-day streak. Below, a weekly calendar strip with today highlighted, then a vertical list of habit cards—Drink water, Read 20 min, Morning walk, No phone after 10—each with a colored icon, a progress ring, and a check toggle. A floating '+' add button bottom-right and a bottom tab bar. Soft playful UI, mint-and-coral palette, rounded cards, friendly rounded sans-serif.
prompt_zh: 一个习惯打卡App「Streakly」的手机界面设计稿。竖版手机框，顶部问候语「继续加油，Jordan」，配一个小火焰图标和12天连续记录。下方是一条周日历带，今日高亮，接着是竖向习惯卡片列表——喝水、阅读20分钟、晨间散步、十点后不玩手机——每张配彩色图标、进度环和打勾开关。右下角有一个浮动「+」添加按钮，底部有标签栏。柔和俏皮的UI，薄荷与珊瑚配色，圆角卡片，友好的圆体无衬线字体。

prompt_en: A bold landing-page hero mockup for a creative studio 'Northlight Studio'. Full-bleed dark hero with an oversized gradient headline 'We build brands that move', a short tagline, and a rounded 'Start a project' button. A subtle animated-looking particle motif in the background. Top nav with wordmark left and Work / Services / About / Contact right. Below the fold, a horizontal marquee of invented client names. Dark charcoal background, electric-lime accent, huge expressive typography, generous negative space, 16:9 desktop.
prompt_zh: 一个创意工作室「Northlight Studio」的大胆落地页首屏设计稿。全出血深色首屏配一个超大渐变标题「我们打造有力量的品牌」，一行简短标语，以及一个圆角「启动项目」按钮。背景有一层看似动态的微妙粒子图案。顶部导航左侧为文字商标，右侧为作品/服务/关于/联系。首屏下方是一条横向滚动的虚构客户名称跑马灯。深炭黑背景，电光青柠强调色，超大富有表现力的排版，充裕留白，16:9桌面端。

prompt_en: A mobile event-ticketing app screen mockup for an app 'Frontrow'. Vertical phone frame, top hero image of a concert crowd with a back arrow and share icon. Below a content sheet with the event title 'Neon Nights Festival', date and venue rows with line icons, a ticket-tier selector showing General, VIP, and Backstage with prices, a quantity stepper, and a bright 'Get tickets' sticky button. A small map preview and a lineup chip row below. Dark vibrant UI, purple-to-pink gradient accents, rounded cards, bold type.
prompt_zh: 一个活动票务App「Frontrow」的手机界面设计稿。竖版手机框，顶部是演唱会人群的首图，配返回箭头和分享图标。下方是内容面板，含活动标题「霓虹之夜音乐节」，带线性图标的日期和场地信息行，一个票档选择器显示普通票、VIP票和后台票及价格，一个数量调节器，以及一个亮色「购票」吸底按钮。下方有一个小地图预览和一排阵容标签。深色鲜艳UI，紫到粉的渐变强调色，圆角卡片，粗体字。
